explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up and discuss with your partner: A. How long does it take students to get used to life at DLI? B. What classes do you take every day? How do you say them in Chinese? C. What kind of tests do you have? How do you say those in Chinese?

explanations.title: Presentation 2: 小文 asks 大卫 about his life in Taiwan
explanations.body: The book also prints this dialog in traditional characters (for example 大衛，你在台灣的學習生活怎麼樣？).

examples.text: 小文：大卫，你在台湾的学习生活怎么样？
examples.translation: xiǎo wén dà wèi nǐ zài tái wān de xué xí shēng huó zěn me yàng — David, how is your school life in Taiwan?

examples.text: 大卫：挺好的。开始不太习惯，现在完全适应了。
examples.translation: dà wèi tǐng hǎo de kāi shǐ bú tài xí guàn xiàn zài wán quán shì yìng le — Quite good. At first I wasn’t used to it, but now I have completely adjusted.

examples.text: 小文：你们每天上几节课？
examples.translation: xiǎo wén nǐ men měi tiān shàng jǐ jié kè — How many classes do you have every day?

examples.text: 大卫：五节课。上午三节，下午两节。
examples.translation: dà wèi wǔ jié kè shàng wǔ sān jié xià wǔ liǎng jié — Five classes. Three in the morning and two in the afternoon.

examples.text: 小文：都有什么课？
examples.translation: xiǎo wén dōu yǒu shén me kè — What classes are there?

examples.text: 大卫：有听力课、阅读课、语法课和说话课。
examples.translation: dà wèi yǒu tīng lì kè yuè dú kè yǔ fǎ kè hé shuō huà kè — There are listening, reading, grammar and speaking classes.

examples.text: 小文：你们每天作业多吗？
examples.translation: xiǎo wén nǐ men měi tiān zuò yè duō ma — Do you have a lot of homework every day?

examples.text: 大卫：还可以。差不多要做两个小时。
examples.translation: dà wèi hái kě yǐ chà bu duō yào zuò liǎng gè xiǎo shí — It’s okay. It takes about two hours.

examples.text: 小文：考试多不多？
examples.translation: xiǎo wén kǎo shì duō bù duō — Are there a lot of tests?

examples.text: 大卫：很多，除了每天的生词考试以外，还有单元和期末考试。
examples.translation: dà wèi hěn duō chú le měi tiān de shēng cí kǎo shì yǐ wài hái yǒu dān yuán hé qī mò kǎo shì — A lot. Besides the daily vocabulary tests, there are also unit tests and final exams.

examples.text: 小文：你学习这么努力，一定考得不错吧？
examples.translation: xiǎo wén nǐ xué xí zhè me nǔ lì yí dìng kǎo de bú cuò ba — You study so hard, so you must do well on tests, right?

examples.text: 大卫：因为老师们教得很好，所以，我差不多每次都得优。
examples.translation: dà wèi yīn wèi lǎo shī men jiāo de hěn hǎo suǒ yǐ wǒ chà bu duō měi cì dōu dé yōu — Because the teachers teach very well, I get an A (优, top grade) almost every time.

examples.text: 小文：太好了。祝贺你！
examples.translation: xiǎo wén tài hǎo le zhù hè nǐ — Great. Congratulations!

examples.text: 大卫：谢谢。
examples.translation: dà wèi xiè xiè — Thank you.

explanations.title: Activities 1 to 3
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening): A. Global listening: What kind of information does Xiao Wen want to find out from David? What are the main differences between David’s life in Taiwan and yours at DLI? B. Detailed listening: complete a table about David’s life in Taiwan (life in general, classes, tests, homework, grades). Activity 2 (Writing): in pairs, complete a table of expressions: kinds of classes and tests; asking how something or someone is; being completely used to something; attending five class periods every day; “in addition to …”; “about two hours”; someone does something well. Activity 3 (Listening): a dialog about Wang Zhong’s son: what and where he is studying, what classes he takes, how many classes a day, and how he is doing and why (audio, not included). The questions are practiced below from the text.

explanations.title: Activity 4: rearrange the sentences into a coherent paragraph
explanations.body: A. With a partner, rearrange the five sentences (a to e) to make a paragraph: a. 她每天上午上听力课和说话课，下午上阅读课和语法课。 b. 因为她学习很努力，所以每次考试她差不多都得优。 c. 琳达是今年八月开始在天津大学学中文的。 d. 除了上课，她每天还有很多作业。 e. 她的学习生活很忙，不过她已经适应了。 B. lessons.title: 181. Presentation 2 grammar: the question word 怎么样
lessons.subtitle: 他的身体怎么样？ · 今天的天气怎么样？ · 不怎么好 · 还可以

explanations.title: 怎么样: how is it?
explanations.body: To ask how someone or something is, we often use the question word 怎么样, as in 他在北京的生活怎么样？ and 今天的天气怎么样？ The pattern is Subject + 怎么样？

examples.text: 他在北京的生活怎么样？
examples.translation: tā zài běi jīng de shēng huó zěn me yàng — How is his life in Beijing?

examples.text: 今天的天气怎么样？
examples.translation: jīn tiān de tiān qì zěn me yàng — How is the weather today?

examples.text: 甲：他的身体怎么样？
examples.translation: jiǎ tā de shēn tǐ zěn me yàng — How is his health?

examples.text: 乙：他的身体很好。
examples.translation: yǐ tā de shēn tǐ hěn hǎo — His health is very good.

examples.text: 甲：今天的天气怎么样？
examples.translation: jiǎ jīn tiān de tiān qì zěn me yàng — How is the weather today?

examples.text: 乙：今天的天气不怎么好。
examples.translation: yǐ jīn tiān de tiān qì bù zěn me hǎo — Today’s weather is not very good.

explanations.title: Answers: 不错, 还可以, 不怎么好, 不怎么样
explanations.body: The book’s model question is 大卫的爷爷的身体怎么样？ and the answer 他爷爷的身体很好 (or 不错, 还可以, 不怎么好, 不怎么样). 不怎么 + adjective is a mild negative, “not very …”.

examples.text: 大卫的爷爷的身体怎么样？
examples.translation: dà wèi de yé yé de shēn tǐ zěn me yàng — How is David’s grandfather’s health?

examples.text: 他爷爷的身体很好。
examples.translation: tā yé yé de shēn tǐ hěn hǎo — His grandfather’s health is very good.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Speaking and Writing)
explanations.body: Pair up as Student A and Student B. Ask five questions using the words in your column and 怎么样; your partner writes your questions and then changes them into statements. Student A’s words: 身体, 中文听力, 英语, 照片, 中学. Student B’s words: 公司, 大学, 医院, 老家, 中文语法.

Which is a positive answer to “他的身体怎么样？”?
exercises.explanation: 很好 is the positive one.

exercises.prompt: Which is a negative answer to “今天的天气怎么样？”?

exercises.explanation: 不怎么好: not very good.

exercises.prompt: 大卫的爷爷的身体怎么样？ 他爷爷的身体很___。

exercises.explanation: 怎么样 (zěn me yàng) means “how about, how is it”.

lessons.title: 182. Presentation 2 grammar: the 除了… (以外) construction
lessons.subtitle: 除了…以外，还… · 除了…以外，都… · 除了班长以外

explanations.title: 除了…(以外): in addition to, or except for
explanations.body: When 除了… (以外) is used with 还 or 也, it means “in addition to …”. Using 以外 is optional. For example: 我们每天除了学中文（以外），还/也锻炼身体。 When it is used with the adverb 都, it shows exclusiveness and means “with the exception of …”. For example: 除了小王（以外），我们都喜欢锻炼身体。

examples.text: 我们每天除了学中文以外，还锻炼身体。
examples.translation: wǒ men měi tiān chú le xué zhōng wén yǐ wài hái duàn liàn shēn tǐ — Every day, besides studying Chinese, we also exercise.

examples.text: 除了小王以外，我们都喜欢锻炼身体。
examples.translation: chú le xiǎo wáng yǐ wài wǒ men dōu xǐ huān duàn liàn shēn tǐ — Except for Xiao Wang, we all like to exercise.

explanations.title: The patterns
explanations.body: In addition to … Same subject: Subject + 除了…，也/还…。 or 除了…，Subject + 也/还…。 Different subjects: 除了 Subject A…，Subject B 也/还…。 Except for … Same subject: Subject + 除了…，都…。 or 除了…，Subject + 都…。 Different subjects: 除了 Subject A…，Subject B (the rest) 都…。

explanations.title: Examples (the book’s five)
explanations.body: The book gives these without English; the translations are added.

examples.text: 我们除了上听力课以外，还/也上阅读课。
examples.translation: wǒ men chú le shàng tīng lì kè yǐ wài hái yě shàng yuè dú kè — Besides having listening class, we also have reading class.

examples.text: 除了上听力课以外，我们还/也上阅读课。
examples.translation: chú le shàng tīng lì kè yǐ wài wǒ men hái yě shàng yuè dú kè — Besides having listening class, we also have reading class.

examples.text: 除了星期三，星期五早上我们还/也要集合。
examples.translation: chú le xīng qī sān xīng qī wǔ zǎo shàng wǒ men hái yě yào jí hé — Besides Wednesday, on Friday mornings we also have formation.

examples.text: 我们班的同学除了班长以外，都不是陆军。
examples.translation: wǒ men bān de tóng xué chú le bān zhǎng yǐ wài dōu bú shì lù jūn — In our class, except for the class leader, nobody is in the Army.

examples.text: 除了班长以外，我们班的同学都不是陆军。
examples.translation: chú le bān zhǎng yǐ wài wǒ men bān de tóng xué dōu bú shì lù jūn — Except for the class leader, nobody in our class is in the Army.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to a dialog and answer: In this class, who doesn’t attend formation every morning and why? In addition to formation, what else do they do every morning? Where do they have morning formation? B. Share your answers in pairs. C. Check against the script (audio, not included).

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Speaking and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Using the 除了 construction, think of someone in your class and ask your partner if anyone else in the class has something in common with them. If no one does, use 都 to show exclusivity. Take notes (who, things in common, exceptions). The book’s two examples are 琳达，陆军 and 大卫，德州的天气:

examples.text: 甲：除了琳达以外，我们班谁还是陆军？
examples.translation: jiǎ chú le lín dá yǐ wài wǒ men bān shuí hái shì lù jūn — Besides Linda, who else in our class is in the Army?

examples.text: 乙：除了琳达以外，马强和我也是陆军。
examples.translation: yǐ chú le lín dá yǐ wài mǎ qiáng hé wǒ yě shì lù jūn — Besides Linda, Ma Qiang and I are in the Army too.

examples.text: 甲：除了大卫以外，谁还喜欢德州的天气？
examples.translation: jiǎ chú le dà wèi yǐ wài shuí hái xǐ huān dé zhōu de tiān qì — Besides David, who else likes Texas weather?

examples.text: 乙：除了大卫以外，谁都不喜欢德州的天气。
examples.translation: yǐ chú le dà wèi yǐ wài shéi dōu bù xǐ huān dé zhōu de tiān qì — Besides David, nobody likes Texas weather.

explanations.title: Activity 3 B
explanations.body: Think of a sentence using the 除了… construction and one of the expressions below. Your partner tries to guess the sentence; when they get it right, switch and do the next expression, until all the expressions have been used. Write your partner’s questions in a table. The book’s examples (经常下雪 and 加州大学):

rows: guó fáng yǔ yán xué yuàn

examples.text: 冬天除了山上以外，这几个地方都不经常下雪。
examples.translation: dōng tiān chú le shān shàng yǐ wài zhè jǐ gè dì fāng dōu bù jīng cháng xià xuě — In winter, except for the mountains, it doesn’t snow often in these places.

examples.text: 冬天除了纽约以外，华盛顿也经常下雪。
examples.translation: dōng tiān chú le niǔ yuē yǐ wài huá shèng dùn yě jīng cháng xià xuě — In winter, besides New York, it also often snows in Washington.

examples.text: 除了大卫以外，我们都不是加州大学的学生。
examples.translation: chú le dà wèi yǐ wài wǒ men dōu bú shì jiā zhōu dà xué de xué shēng — Except for David, none of us is a student of the University of California.

examples.text: 除了大卫以外，我们也是加州大学的学生。
examples.translation: chú le dà wèi yǐ wài wǒ men yě shì jiā zhōu dà xué de xué shēng — Besides David, we are also students of the University of California.

exercises.prompt: What does 除了…以外，还… mean?
exercises.explanation: With 还 or 也, 除了 means “in addition to”.

exercises.prompt: What does 除了…以外，都… mean?
exercises.explanation: With 都, 除了 means “except for”.

exercises.prompt: What does 我们班的同学除了班长以外，都不是陆军 mean?
options: The class leader is not in the Army
Besides the class leader, we are also in the Army
Everyone in our class is in the Army
Except for the class leader, nobody in our class is in the Army

exercises.prompt: What does 除了上听力课以外，我们还上阅读课 mean?
options: Except for listening class, we have no class
We have listening class instead of reading class
Besides listening class, we also have reading class

exercises.prompt: What does 除了大卫以外，谁都不喜欢德州的天气 mean?
options: Besides David, others like it too
Besides David, nobody likes Texas weather

exercises.prompt: Is 以外 required in the 除了 construction?
exercises.explanation: The use of 以外 is optional.

exercises.prompt: 除了星期三，星期五早上我们___要集合。
exercises.explanation: 还 / 也 means “also” in the “in addition to” pattern.

exercises.prompt: 除了班长以外，我们班的同学___不是陆军。
exercises.explanation: 都 shows exclusiveness: the rest all …

exercises.prompt: 我们___了上听力课以外，还上阅读课。
除了琳达以外，我们班谁___是陆军？

lessons.title: 183. Presentation 2 grammar: the complement of degree (1)
lessons.subtitle: 他写得很好 · 她说中文说得很好 · 她做得不好 · 他做得好不好？

explanations.title: 得 + complement: judging how an action is done
explanations.body: The Complement of Degree is often used to judge or comment on an action. It normally needs an adverb of degree, as in 她说中文说得真好, where 真 is the adverb of degree that modifies the complement 好. If there is no adverb of degree before the complement, it implies a comparison: 她说中文说得好 suggests that she speaks Chinese well compared with some others. The pattern is Subject + Verb + 得 + (Adverb of Degree +) Complement. Here 得 is the structural particle, pronounced de (neutral tone), not děi.

examples.text: 中文字大卫写得怎么样？
examples.translation: zhōng wén zì dà wèi xiě de zěn me yàng — How does David write Chinese characters?

examples.text: 他写得很好。
examples.translation: tā xiě de hěn hǎo — He writes very well.

examples.text: 昨天的作业她做得怎么样？
examples.translation: zuó tiān de zuò yè tā zuò de zěn me yàng — How did she do yesterday’s homework?

examples.text: 她做得真好。
examples.translation: tā zuò de zhēn hǎo — She did it really well.

examples.text: 你们那儿雨下得大吗？
examples.translation: nǐ men nàr yǔ xià de dà ma — Does it rain hard where you are?

examples.text: 我们这儿雨下得很大。
examples.translation: wǒ men zhèr yǔ xià de hěn dà — It rains very hard here.

examples.text: 旧金山的雾下得大，蒙特雷的雾下得不大。
examples.translation: jiù jīn shān de wù xià de dà méng tè léi de wù xià de bú dà — San Francisco’s fog is heavy; Monterey’s fog is not heavy. (a comparison)

explanations.title: Negative and affirmative-negative questions
explanations.body: Negative and affirmative-negative questions do NOT take adverbs of degree. Negative: Subject + Verb + 得 + 不 + Complement. Question: Subject + Verb + 得 + Complement + 不 + Complement? Or: Subject + Verb + 得 + (Adverb of Degree +) Complement + 吗？

examples.text: 她做得不好。
examples.translation: tā zuò de bù hǎo — She didn’t do it well.

examples.text: 我说得不好。
examples.translation: wǒ shuō de bù hǎo — I don’t speak well.

examples.text: 他做得好不好？
examples.translation: tā zuò de hǎo bù hǎo — Did he do it well?

examples.text: 旧金山的雾下得大不大？
examples.translation: jiù jīn shān de wù xià de dà bú dà — Is San Francisco’s fog heavy?

examples.text: 今天她来得早不早？
examples.translation: jīn tiān tā lái de zǎo bù zǎo — Did she come early today?

examples.text: 今天她来得很早吗？
examples.translation: jīn tiān tā lái de hěn zǎo ma — Did she come very early today?

explanations.title: A verb with an object
explanations.body: With a transitive verb (verb + object), the verb is repeated after the object and before 得; the complement of degree then comes after 得. The object can also be moved to the front of the sentence, either before the predicate or before the entire sentence. Patterns: Subject + Verb1 + Object + Verb1 + 得 + Complement; Subject + Object + Verb + 得 + Complement; Object + Subject + Verb + 得 + Complement.

examples.text: 他做作业做得很好。
examples.translation: tā zuò zuò yè zuò de hěn hǎo — He does homework very well.

examples.text: 他作业做得很好。
examples.translation: tā zuò yè zuò de hěn hǎo — He does homework very well.

examples.text: 作业他做得很好。
examples.translation: zuò yè tā zuò de hěn hǎo — As for homework, he does it very well.

examples.text: 她说中文说得很好。
examples.translation: tā shuō zhōng wén shuō de hěn hǎo — She speaks Chinese very well.

examples.text: 她中文说得很好。
examples.translation: tā zhōng wén shuō de hěn hǎo — She speaks Chinese very well.

examples.text: 中文她说得很好。
examples.translation: zhōng wén tā shuō de hěn hǎo — As for Chinese, she speaks it very well.

examples.text: 她考听力考得很好。
examples.translation: tā kǎo tīng lì kǎo de hěn hǎo — She does very well on listening tests.

examples.text: 她听力考得很好。
examples.translation: tā tīng lì kǎo de hěn hǎo — She does very well on listening tests.

examples.text: 听力她考得很好。
examples.translation: tīng lì tā kǎo de hěn hǎo — As for listening, she does very well on the tests.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Writing)
explanations.body: Using the words in the table, write sentences for each of seven items: 1. Someone does something well. 2. Someone does not do something well. 3. Someone does something really well. 4. Someone does not do something very well. 5. Ask if someone does something really well. 6. It rained really hard some place this summer. 7. It didn’t snow very hard some place this winter. The book’s example: someone does something really well 大卫说中文说得非常好。 and the question 大卫说中文说得非常好吗？ Then share your sentences with a partner and make any necessary corrections.

examples.text: 大卫说中文说得非常好。
examples.translation: dà wèi shuō zhōng wén shuō de fēi cháng hǎo — David speaks Chinese really well.

examples.text: 大卫说中文说得非常好吗？
examples.translation: dà wèi shuō zhōng wén shuō de fēi cháng hǎo ma — Does David speak Chinese really well?

exercises.prompt: What does 他写得很好 mean?
What does 她做得真好 mean?
exercises.explanation: 真 is the adverb of degree.

exercises.prompt: What does 她说中文说得很好 mean?
Which is the correct negative of “She did it well”?
exercises.explanation: Subject + Verb + 得 + 不 + Complement.

exercises.prompt: Which is the correct affirmative-negative question for “Did he do it well?”
exercises.explanation: Verb + 得 + complement + 不 + complement.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence puts the object first?
Which sentence is correct for “She speaks Chinese very well”?
exercises.explanation: The verb is repeated after the object, before 得.

exercises.prompt: What does 她说中文说得好 (no adverb) imply?
options: She speaks Chinese well compared with others
exercises.explanation: Without an adverb of degree there is a comparison.

exercises.prompt: Do negative questions take adverbs of degree?
exercises.explanation: Negative and affirmative-negative questions do not take adverbs of degree.
做得不好: didn’t do it well.
The structural particle 得 follows the verb.
The verb is repeated: 说中文说得很好.
得 (de) means “structural particle (as in 说得好)”.

lessons.title: 184. Presentation 2 skill integration: two military-school passages
lessons.subtitle: 王军 · 李明 · 每天有七节课 · 起床以后，我先去操场集合，然后去吃早饭

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 1 (Listening, Writing and Reading)
explanations.body: Three recordings are matched with pictures (the third dialog adds the word 难 nán, difficult). In groups of three each person listens to one dialog and completes a table (what the dialog is about and three details), then translates its first four lines, and asks the other two students for the rest of the information. Audio and pictures are not included.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): Passage A and Passage B
explanations.body:
Divide into two groups. Group 1 reads Passage A while Group 2 reads Passage B, and each completes a table in pinyin or characters: who the passage is about; what it is about; the AM activities and times; the PM activities and times. Then pair up with someone from the other group and ask them questions in Chinese to complete your table. With your new partner, write a Chinese dialog between one of you and one of the persons in the passages, and act it out.
Passage A:

examples.text: 我叫王军，是中国国防大学的学生。
examples.translation: wǒ jiào wáng jūn shì zhōng guó guó fáng dà xué de xué shēng — My name is Wang Jun, and I am a student at China’s National Defense University.

examples.text: 我是去年上大学的，现在已经完全适应军校的生活了。
examples.translation: wǒ shì qù nián shàng dà xué de xiàn zài yǐ jīng wán quán shì yìng jūn xiào de shēng huó le — I started college last year, and now I have completely adjusted to life at a military school.

examples.text: 我每天早上五点三刻起床。起床以后，我先去操场集合，然后去吃早饭。
examples.translation: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng wǔ diǎn sān kè qǐ chuáng qǐ chuáng yǐ hòu wǒ xiān qù cāo chǎng jí hé rán hòu qù chī zǎo fàn — Every morning I get up at a quarter to six. After I get up, I first go to the drill field for formation, and then go to eat breakfast.

examples.text: 我们每天有七节课。上午七点半到教室去上课，十一点二十分下课。
examples.translation: wǒ men měi tiān yǒu qī jié kè shàng wǔ qī diǎn bàn dào jiào shì qù shàng kè shí yī diǎn èr shí fēn xià kè — We have seven classes every day. In the morning at 7:30 we go to the classroom for class, and class ends at 11:20.

examples.text: 十一点半我去吃午饭。下午一点开始上课，三点五十分下课。
examples.translation: shí yī diǎn bàn wǒ qù chī wǔ fàn xià wǔ yì diǎn kāi shǐ shàng kè sān diǎn wǔ shí fēn xià kè — At 11:30 I go to eat lunch. In the afternoon class begins at 1:00 and ends at 3:50.

examples.text: 下课以后，我们得到操场去锻炼身体。
examples.translation: xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ men děi dào cāo chǎng qù duàn liàn shēn tǐ — After class, we have to go to the drill field to exercise.

examples.text: 我晚上六点半吃晚饭。晚饭以后，我和同学们一起做作业。我十点十五分睡觉。
examples.translation: wǒ wǎn shàng liù diǎn bàn chī wǎn fàn wǎn fàn yǐ hòu wǒ hé tóng xué men yì qǐ zuò zuò yè wǒ shí diǎn shí wǔ fēn shuì jiào — I eat dinner at 6:30 in the evening. After dinner, my classmates and I do homework together. I go to bed at 10:15.

examples.text: 我叫李明，是中国人民解放军外语学院英语系的学生。
examples.translation: wǒ jiào lǐ míng shì zhōng guó rén mín jiě fàng jūn wài yǔ xué yuàn yīng yǔ xì de xué shēng — My name is Li Ming, and I am a student in the English Department of the Foreign Language Institute of the PLA.

examples.text: 我每天都很忙，除了上课以外，还要做很多作业，有时候还得值班。
examples.translation: wǒ měi tiān dōu hěn máng chú le shàng kè yǐ wài hái yào zuò hěn duō zuò yè yǒu shí hòu hái děi zhí bān — I am busy every day: besides going to class, I have to do a lot of homework, and sometimes I also have to be on duty.

examples.text: 我们每天上七节课。我早上六点起床，然后去操场集合，六点四十吃早饭。
examples.translation: wǒ men měi tiān shàng qī jié kè wǒ zǎo shàng liù diǎn qǐ chuáng rán hòu qù cāo chǎng jí hé liù diǎn sì shí chī zǎo fàn — We have seven classes every day. I get up at 6:00, and then go to the drill field for formation, and I eat breakfast at 6:40.

examples.text: 上午八点到十二点，我们上英语听力和阅读课，下午一点到五点，我们上说话课、语法课，还有翻译课。
examples.translation: shàng wǔ bā diǎn dào shí èr diǎn wǒ men shàng yīng yǔ tīng lì hé yuè dú kè xià wǔ yì diǎn dào wǔ diǎn wǒ men shàng shuō huà kè yǔ fǎ kè hái yǒu fān yì kè — From 8:00 to 12:00 in the morning we have English listening and reading classes; from 1:00 to 5:00 in the afternoon we have speaking class, grammar class, and also translation class.

examples.text: 下午五点到六点我锻炼身体。因为我们有很多作业，所以我常常晚上十点半以后睡觉。
examples.translation: xià wǔ wǔ diǎn dào liù diǎn wǒ duàn liàn shēn tǐ yīn wèi wǒ men yǒu hěn duō zuò yè suǒ yǐ wǒ cháng cháng wǎn shàng shí diǎn bàn yǐ hòu shuì jiào — From 5:00 to 6:00 in the afternoon I exercise. Because we have a lot of homework, I often go to bed after 10:30 in the evening.

examples.text: 我们没有生词考试，但是每一课都有考试，还有单元考试和期末考试。
examples.translation: wǒ men méi yǒu shēng cí kǎo shì dàn shì měi yí kè dōu yǒu kǎo shì hái yǒu dān yuán kǎo shì hé qī mò kǎo shì — We don’t have vocabulary tests, but there is a test for every lesson, and also unit tests and final exams.

examples.text: 我学习很努力，所以考得不错。
examples.translation: wǒ xué xí hěn nǔ lì suǒ yǐ kǎo de bú cuò — I study very hard, so I do well on tests.

explanations.title: Names and words in the passages
Activity 3 (Speaking and Writing)
explanations.body: In Chinese, ask three of your classmates about their classes on a particular day. Also ask how much time they spend on each of the following homework or study areas: listening, reading, writing and vocabulary. Take notes in pinyin or characters, and share your information with the class in Chinese.

options: 李明, a student at a foreign language institute
王军, a student at China’s National Defense University
exercises.explanation: 我叫王军，是中国国防大学的学生。

exercises.prompt: When did 王军 start college?
What time does 王军 get up?
exercises.explanation: 我每天早上五点三刻起床。

exercises.prompt: What does 王军 do after he gets up?
options: Goes to the drill field for formation, then eats breakfast
Eats breakfast, then goes to class
exercises.explanation: 起床以后，我先去操场集合，然后去吃早饭。

exercises.prompt: How many classes does 王军 have every day, and when does the morning class end?
options: Seven; the morning class ends at 11:20
exercises.explanation: 我们每天有七节课。… 十一点二十分下课。

exercises.prompt: What time does 王军 eat dinner?
What time does 王军 go to bed?

options: 李明, an English Department student at the PLA Foreign Language Institute
exercises.explanation: 我叫李明，是中国人民解放军外语学院英语系的学生。

exercises.prompt: What time does 李明 get up?
When does 李明 eat breakfast?
What classes does 李明 have in the afternoon?
exercises.explanation: 下午一点到五点，我们上说话课、语法课，还有翻译课。
下午五点到六点我锻炼身体。

exercises.prompt: Why does 李明 often go to bed after 10:30?
options: Because he has duty every night
Because they have a lot of homework
exercises.explanation: 因为我们有很多作业，所以我常常晚上十点半以后睡觉。

exercises.prompt: Does 李明’s school have vocabulary tests?
options: No, but every lesson has a test, plus unit and final exams
exercises.explanation: 我们没有生词考试，但是每一课都有考试，还有单元考试和期末考试。
睡觉 (shuì jiào) means “go to bed, sleep”.

lessons.title: 185. Presentation 2: class schedules, an email for help and a survey
lessons.subtitle: 听力课 · 阅读课 · 苏教官 · 马大卫 · 设计 · 了解

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 1: a two-day intensive course
explanations.body: You are a Chinese instructor at UCLA. A college in Singapore asks you and a Chinese colleague to design a teaching schedule for a two-day intensive Chinese course. A. Review the possible classes below, decide which ones would fit the program and the duration of each, and complete a table in Chinese (Day 1 and Day 2: duration and class). B. On the phone with a colleague (your partner), ask for their class arrangement in Chinese, then work together to finalize the two-day schedule and share it with the class in Chinese.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): an email from 王老师
explanations.body: You are now an MLI (military language instructor) in the Chinese school and have just received an email from Wang Laoshi asking for your help. A. Read the email, then write in Chinese in a table how you think Ma Dawei should spend the eight hours mentioned in the message (Saturday and Sunday: duration and action); consult a dictionary if necessary. B. In Chinese, share your suggestions with a partner and devise a final plan; then write a short Chinese email to Wang Laoshi presenting your ideas.

examples.text: 苏教官：
examples.translation: sū jiào guān — Instructor Su:

examples.text: 你好！
examples.translation: nǐ hǎo — Hello!

examples.text: 我们班的马大卫是个很好的学生，以前每次单元考试，阅读和听力他都考得很好。
examples.translation: wǒ men bān de mǎ dà wèi shì gè hěn hǎo de xué shēng yǐ qián měi cì dān yuán kǎo shì yuè dú hé tīng lì tā dōu kǎo de hěn hǎo — Ma Dawei in our class is a very good student; on every unit test before, he did very well on reading and listening.

examples.text: 可是前个月他每天晚上都要值班，学习的时间很少，所以这次单元考试，他的听力和阅读都没有以前考得好。
examples.translation: kě shì qián gè yuè tā měi tiān wǎn shàng dōu yào zhí bān xué xí de shí jiān hěn shǎo suǒ yǐ zhè cì dān yuán kǎo shì tā de tīng lì hé yuè dú dōu méi yǒu yǐ qián kǎo de hǎo — But last month he had to be on duty every evening and had very little time to study, so on this unit test his listening and reading were not as good as before.

examples.text: 现在怎么做好呢？他想这样：除了星期一到星期五努力学习以外，他还想每个星期六和星期天都学习四个小时的中文。
examples.translation: xiàn zài zěn me zuò hǎo ne tā xiǎng zhè yàng chú le xīng qī yī dào xīng qī wǔ nǔ lì xué xí yǐ wài tā hái xiǎng měi gè xīng qī liù hé xīng qī tiān dōu xué xí sì gè xiǎo shí de zhōng wén — What is the best thing to do now? He wants to do this: besides studying hard from Monday to Friday, he also wants to study Chinese for four hours every Saturday and Sunday.

examples.text: 你以前是学生的时候学习就非常好，你看马大卫在周末学习什么，怎么学好呢？
examples.translation: nǐ yǐ qián shì xué shēng de shí hòu xué xí jiù fēi cháng hǎo nǐ kàn mǎ dà wèi zài zhōu mò xué xí shén me zěn me xué hǎo ne — When you were a student, you studied extremely well. What do you think Ma Dawei should study on weekends, and how can he do it well?

examples.text: 谢谢！
examples.translation: xiè xiè — Thank you!

examples.text: 王红
examples.translation: wáng hóng — Wang Hong

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening, Writing and Speaking): a survey
explanations.body: You are studying at Nanjing University while working part-time at the International Students Office. The director, Wang Zhong, asks you to design a survey of international students. A. Listen to Mr. Wang’s message (audio, not included), then write the five questions that go on the questionnaire, and devise the answer choices on a scale of 1 to 5, from very poor to very good, or from not enough to too many. B. Pilot the questionnaire: in Chinese, ask a partner the questions, record the answers, then switch roles. C. Work together to write Mr. Wang an email in Chinese briefing him on the results.

exercises.prompt: What does Wang Laoshi say about Ma Dawei before last month?
options: He was a very good student and did well on reading and listening on every unit test
exercises.explanation: 以前每次单元考试，阅读和听力他都考得很好。

exercises.prompt: Why did Ma Dawei’s test results drop?

He moved to a new school

exercises.explanation: 他还想每个星期六和星期天都学习四个小时的中文。

exercises.prompt: How many weekend hours does that make in total?
exercises.explanation: Four hours on each of Saturday and Sunday: eight.

options: 王红 (Wang Hong), to Instructor 苏
exercises.explanation: The signature is 王红 and it is addressed to 苏教官.

units.title: 第七课 校园生活 Presentation 3: the weekend, 先…然后…, 有时…有时…, comparisons and area studies

lessons.title: 187. Presentation 3: the weekend (passage)
lessons.subtitle: 我很喜欢周末 · 先去体育馆锻炼，然后… · 有时…有时…

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up and discuss with your partner (the book has three photos of weekend activities): A. Which of the activities pictured do you do on the weekends? B. What outdoor activities do you most like to do? C. Do you study Chinese on weekends? If so, when?

explanations.title: Presentation 3: my weekend
explanations.body: The book also prints the passage in traditional characters.

examples.text: 我很喜欢周末，因为周末不上课，可以做很多自己喜欢的事情。
examples.translation: wǒ hěn xǐ huān zhōu mò yīn wèi zhōu mò bú shàng kè kě yǐ zuò hěn duō zì jǐ xǐ huān de shì qíng — I like weekends very much, because there is no class on weekends and I can do many things I like.

examples.text: 星期六早上，我十点起床。
examples.translation: xīng qī liù zǎo shàng wǒ shí diǎn qǐ chuáng — On Saturday morning I get up at ten.

examples.text: 起床以后，我先去体育馆锻炼，然后，请几个朋友来宿舍聊天。
examples.translation: qǐ chuáng yǐ hòu wǒ xiān qù tǐ yù guǎn duàn liàn rán hòu qǐng jǐ gè péng yǒu lái sù shè liáo tiān — After getting up, I first go to the gym to work out, and then invite a few friends to come chat in the dormitory.

examples.text: 中午，我们常常一起去中国饭馆吃饭。
examples.translation: zhōng wǔ wǒ men cháng cháng yì qǐ qù zhōng guó fàn guǎn chī fàn — At noon, we often go to a Chinese restaurant to eat together.

examples.text: 午饭以后，我有时和女朋友去看电影，有时和同学们去海边散步。
examples.translation: wǔ fàn yǐ hòu wǒ yǒu shí hé nǚ péng yǒu qù kàn diàn yǐng yǒu shí hé tóng xué men qù hǎi biān sàn bù — After lunch, sometimes I go to see a movie with my girlfriend, and sometimes I go for a walk on the beach with classmates.

examples.text: 星期天早上和星期六早上差不多一样，不过，星期天下午，我要去图书馆做作业，然后，我还要预习新课。
examples.translation: xīng qī tiān zǎo shàng hé xīng qī liù zǎo shàng chà bu duō yí yàng bú guò xīng qī tiān xià wǔ wǒ yào qù tú shū guǎn zuò zuò yè rán hòu wǒ hái yào yù xí xīn kè — Sunday morning is about the same as Saturday morning, but on Sunday afternoon I go to the library to do homework, and then I also have to preview the new lesson.

examples.text: 因为星期一要很早起床，所以我星期天晚上常常十点睡觉。
examples.translation: yīn wèi xīng qī yī yào hěn zǎo qǐ chuáng suǒ yǐ wǒ xīng qī tiān wǎn shàng cháng cháng shí diǎn shuì jiào — Because I have to get up very early on Monday, I often go to bed at ten on Sunday evenings.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening)
explanations.body: A. Global listening: What is this passage mainly about? What kind of activities does the speaker do more of? B. Detailed listening: list the indoor and outdoor activities in two tables in English and compare your lists in pairs (audio, not included; the questions are practiced below from the text).

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Writing): the expressions you have just learned
explanations.body: In pairs, complete a table of expressions for six hints. The expressions in this passage:

rows: do something at a certain time with someone
do A first, then do B
sometimes do A, sometimes do B
often go somewhere to do something
A and B are almost the same

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading): choose the expressions to complete the sentences
explanations.body: Choose the appropriate expression from each list (a, b or c) to fill the numbered blanks, then check your work in pairs and explain your choices. The book gives no key; the key here is my reading of the text (the correct choice is c for 1, 2 and 5, a for 3 and 4, b for 6 and 7, and c for 8). The text with blanks: 1. ____星期六不上课，所以我经常九点起床。起床 2. ____，我先去操场锻炼身体，3. ____和我女朋友去看电影。中午我会和我女朋友 4. ____。下午我 5. ____去图书馆看书，有时在宿舍和同学聊天。星期天和星期六 6. ____。星期天我八点半 7. ____。上午我会给爸爸妈妈打电话，下午我会 8. ____。

lessons.title: 188. Presentation 3 grammar: the 先…，然后… construction
lessons.subtitle: 我先做作业，然后预习课文 · 她先去北京，然后去上海

explanations.title: 先…，然后…: first … then …
explanations.body: The 先…，然后… construction shows actions in sequence. Same subject: Subject + 先 + Verb Phrase，然后 + Verb Phrase. Different subjects: Subject A + 先 + Verb Phrase，然后 + Subject B + Verb Phrase.

examples.text: 我先做作业，然后预习课文。
examples.translation: wǒ xiān zuò zuò yè rán hòu yù xí kè wén — I do homework first, and then preview the text.

examples.text: 我们先锻炼身体，然后去上课。
examples.translation: wǒ men xiān duàn liàn shēn tǐ rán hòu qù shàng kè — We exercise first, and then go to class.

examples.text: 她先去北京，然后去上海。
examples.translation: tā xiān qù běi jīng rán hòu qù shàng hǎi — She goes to Beijing first, and then to Shanghai.

examples.text: 空军先集合，然后海军集合。
examples.translation: kōng jūn xiān jí hé rán hòu hǎi jūn jí hé — The Air Force has formation first, and then the Navy does.

examples.text: 小张先来了美国，然后她弟弟也来了美国。
examples.translation: xiǎo zhāng xiān lái le měi guó rán hòu tā dì di yě lái le měi guó — Xiao Zhang came to America first, and then her younger brother came to America too.

explanations.title: Activity 1 and Activity 2
explanations.body: Activity 1: A. Listen to a dialog and put in order the events shown in four pictures. B. In pairs, use 先…，然后… to write three sentences describing the sequence of events in the dialog, then read the script and check your work (audio and pictures, not included). Activity 2: A. Use 先…，然后… to write your plan for next Sunday (your plan and your partner’s plan). B. Tell your partner in Chinese what your plan for next Sunday is; listen to your partner’s plan, take notes, then present their plan to the class in Chinese. A model:

examples.text: 下个星期天我先去图书馆做作业，然后去中国饭馆吃饭。
examples.translation: xià gè xīng qī tiān wǒ xiān qù tú shū guǎn zuò zuò yè rán hòu qù zhōng guó fàn guǎn chī fàn — Next Sunday I will first go to the library to do homework, and then go to a Chinese restaurant to eat. (a model plan; the book leaves this blank)

exercises.prompt: What does 我先做作业，然后预习课文 mean?
options: I do homework first, then preview the text
I preview the text first, then do homework

exercises.prompt: What does 她先去北京，然后去上海 mean?
options: She goes to Beijing and Shanghai at the same time
She goes to Beijing first, then to Shanghai

exercises.prompt: Which sentence has two different subjects?
options: 我们先锻炼身体，然后去上课。
她先去北京，然后去上海。
我先做作业，然后预习课文。
空军先集合，然后海军集合。
exercises.explanation: Different subjects: 空军 … 海军.

exercises.prompt: What does 小张先来了美国，然后她弟弟也来了美国 mean?
options: Xiao Zhang came to America first, then her younger brother came too
exercises.explanation: 先…然后: sequence, with two subjects.

exercises.prompt: Which is correct for “We exercise first and then go to class”?
options: 我们锻炼先身体，去上课然后。
我们先锻炼身体，然后去上课。
先然后我们锻炼身体去上课。
我们然后锻炼身体，先去上课。

exercises.prompt: 我们___锻炼身体，然后去上课。

exercises.explanation: Different subjects: the Navy has formation after the Air Force.
然后 (rán hòu) means “and then, after that”.

lessons.title: 189. Presentation 3 grammar: the 有时…，有时… construction
lessons.subtitle: 雨有时大有时小 · 我有时去有时不去 · 有时我去看他，有时他来看我

explanations.title: 有时…，有时…: sometimes … sometimes …
explanations.body: The 有时…，有时… construction shows that sometimes one action or state occurs, while sometimes another occurs. Connecting phrases: Subject + 有时…，有时…. Connecting sentences: 有时 + Subject A …，有时 + Subject B …. The book’s opening examples are below, followed by its six examples.

examples.text: 她有时在美国过春节，有时在中国过春节。
examples.translation: tā yǒu shí zài měi guó guò chūn jié yǒu shí zài zhōng guó guò chūn jié — Sometimes she celebrates the Chinese New Year in America, sometimes in China.

examples.text: 他有时读课文，有时预习生词。
examples.translation: tā yǒu shí dú kè wén yǒu shí yù xí shēng cí — Sometimes he reads the text, sometimes he previews new words.

examples.text: 雨有时大有时小。
examples.translation: yǔ yǒu shí dà yǒu shí xiǎo — Sometimes the rain is heavy, sometimes it is light.

examples.text: 我有时去有时不去。
examples.translation: wǒ yǒu shí qù yǒu shí bú qù — Sometimes I go, sometimes I don’t.

examples.text: 我们有时去中国饭馆吃饭，有时去日本饭馆吃饭。
examples.translation: wǒ men yǒu shí qù zhōng guó fàn guǎn chī fàn yǒu shí qù rì běn fàn guǎn chī fàn — Sometimes we eat at a Chinese restaurant, sometimes at a Japanese restaurant.

examples.text: 他有时星期六来看我，有时星期天来看我。
examples.translation: tā yǒu shí xīng qī liù lái kàn wǒ yǒu shí xīng qī tiān lái kàn wǒ — Sometimes he comes to see me on Saturday, sometimes on Sunday.

examples.text: 有时我去看他，有时他来看我。
examples.translation: yǒu shí wǒ qù kàn tā yǒu shí tā lái kàn wǒ — Sometimes I go to see him, sometimes he comes to see me.

examples.text: 有时张老师给我们上听力课，有时王老师给我们上听力课。
examples.translation: yǒu shí zhāng lǎo shī gěi wǒ men shàng tīng lì kè yǒu shí wáng lǎo shī gěi wǒ men shàng tīng lì kè — Sometimes Teacher Zhang teaches us listening, sometimes Teacher Wang does.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Speaking)
explanations.body: Tell your partner how you would say five sentences in Chinese: 1. On Saturday, you sometimes get up at 7:30 and sometimes at 8:00. 2. In the evening, you sometimes do reading homework and sometimes listening homework. 3. Sometimes you go on duty, and sometimes your class leader goes on duty. 4. During the summer in your hometown, sometimes it rains very hard and sometimes very lightly. 5. Sometimes he goes to his older brother’s house to celebrate the Chinese New Year, and sometimes his older brother comes to his house. The book gives these in English; one way to say each:

examples.text: 星期六我有时七点半起床，有时八点起床。
examples.translation: xīng qī liù wǒ yǒu shí qī diǎn bàn qǐ chuáng yǒu shí bā diǎn qǐ chuáng — On Saturday, I sometimes get up at 7:30, and sometimes at 8:00.

examples.text: 晚上我有时做阅读作业，有时做听力作业。
examples.translation: wǎn shàng wǒ yǒu shí zuò yuè dú zuò yè yǒu shí zuò tīng lì zuò yè — In the evening, I sometimes do reading homework, and sometimes listening homework.

examples.text: 有时我值班，有时我们班长值班。
examples.translation: yǒu shí wǒ zhí bān yǒu shí wǒ men bān zhǎng zhí bān — Sometimes I am on duty, and sometimes our class leader is.

examples.text: 夏天我老家有时雨下得很大，有时雨下得很小。
examples.translation: xià tiān wǒ lǎo jiā yǒu shí yǔ xià de hěn dà yǒu shí yǔ xià de hěn xiǎo — In summer in my hometown, sometimes it rains very hard, and sometimes very lightly.

examples.text: 他有时去哥哥家过春节，有时哥哥来他家过春节。
examples.translation: tā yǒu shí qù gē gē jiā guò chūn jié yǒu shí gē gē lái tā jiā guò chūn jié — Sometimes he goes to his older brother’s house for the Chinese New Year, sometimes his older brother comes to his house.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Speaking)
explanations.body: A. In Chinese, interview two classmates about their activities last Saturday (remind them to use 有时…，有时… as much as possible) and take notes in a table (Saturday morning, afternoon and evening for Student A and Student B). B. In Chinese, share your information with a partner; then choose one of your partner’s interviewees and report their activities to the class in Chinese.

exercises.prompt: What does 有时…，有时… mean?
What does 雨有时大有时小 mean?
options: It rains and it is big
Sometimes the rain is heavy, sometimes it is light
The rain is heavy, then light

exercises.prompt: What does 我有时去有时不去 mean?
options: I go, then I don’t go
Sometimes I go, sometimes I don’t

exercises.prompt: What does 有时我去看他，有时他来看我 mean?
options: Sometimes I go to see him, sometimes he comes to see me
I go to see him and he comes to see me
exercises.explanation: Two subjects: 我 and 他.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence connects two sentences (different subjects)?
options: 他有时读课文，有时预习生词。
有时张老师给我们上听力课，有时王老师给我们上听力课。
exercises.explanation: 有时 + Subject A …，有时 + Subject B ….

exercises.prompt: Which sentence connects two phrases (same subject)?
options: 有时我去看他，有时他来看我。
我们有时去中国饭馆吃饭，有时去日本饭馆吃饭。
有时张老师上课，有时王老师上课。

exercises.prompt: 她___在美国过春节，有时在中国过春节。

exercises.explanation: 大 and 小 are opposites.

exercises.prompt: 他有时星期六来看我，有时星期天___看我。
exercises.explanation: 来看我: comes to see me.

exercises.explanation: 去饭馆吃饭: go to a restaurant to eat.

lessons.title: 190. Presentation 3 grammar: the complement of degree (2), comparisons
lessons.subtitle: 做得比我好 · 好得多 · 多多了 · 没有她那么好 · 有没有我那么好？

explanations.title: Comparing with 比
explanations.body: Complement of Degree constructions are used to make comparisons. The full pattern is A + Verb1-Object + Verb1 得 + 比 B + Verb1 得 + Complement. It can be simplified by skipping one “Verb 得”: A + Verb1-Object + Verb1 得 + 比 B + Complement, or A + Verb1-Object + 比 B + Verb1 得 + Complement. Complement + 很多 / 得多 / 多了 means “much more …”. The book’s examples, each in its three forms:

examples.text: 她做作业做得比我做得好。
examples.translation: tā zuò zuò yè zuò de bǐ wǒ zuò de hǎo — She does homework better than I do.

examples.text: 她做作业做得比我好。
examples.translation: tā zuò zuò yè zuò de bǐ wǒ hǎo — She does homework better than I do.

examples.text: 她做作业比我做得好。
examples.translation: tā zuò zuò yè bǐ wǒ zuò de hǎo — She does homework better than I do.

examples.text: 他说中文说得比我说得好很多。
examples.translation: tā shuō zhōng wén shuō de bǐ wǒ shuō de hǎo hěn duō — He speaks Chinese much better than I do.

examples.text: 他说中文说得比我好很多。
examples.translation: tā shuō zhōng wén shuō de bǐ wǒ hǎo hěn duō — He speaks Chinese much better than I do.

examples.text: 他说中文比我说得好很多。
examples.translation: tā shuō zhōng wén bǐ wǒ shuō de hǎo hěn duō — He speaks Chinese much better than I do.

examples.text: 她起床起得比我起得早得多。
examples.translation: tā qǐ chuáng qǐ de bǐ wǒ qǐ de zǎo de duō — She gets up much earlier than I do.

examples.text: 她起床起得比我早得多。
examples.translation: tā qǐ chuáng qǐ de bǐ wǒ zǎo de duō — She gets up much earlier than I do.

examples.text: 她起床比我起得早得多。
examples.translation: tā qǐ chuáng bǐ wǒ qǐ de zǎo de duō — She gets up much earlier than I do.

examples.text: 我看电影看得比她看得多多了。
examples.translation: wǒ kàn diàn yǐng kàn de bǐ tā kàn de duō duō le — I watch many more movies than she does.

examples.text: 我看电影看得比她多多了。
examples.translation: wǒ kàn diàn yǐng kàn de bǐ tā duō duō le — I watch many more movies than she does.

examples.text: 我看电影比她看得多多了。
examples.translation: wǒ kàn diàn yǐng bǐ tā kàn de duō duō le — I watch many more movies than she does.

explanations.title: Negative and affirmative-negative questions with 没有 and 有没有
explanations.body: To negate, use 没有 instead of 不: A + Verb1-Obj. + Verb1 得 + 没有 B + Verb1 得 + (那么) Complement; this can also be simplified by skipping one “Verb1 得”. Affirmative-negative questions use 有没有: A + Verb1-Obj. + Verb1 得 + 有没有 B (+ Verb1 得) + (那么) Complement? 那么 is often inserted before the complement.

examples.text: 我做作业做得没有她做得那么好。
examples.translation: wǒ zuò zuò yè zuò de méi yǒu tā zuò de nà me hǎo — I don’t do homework as well as she does.

examples.text: 我做作业做得没有她那么好。
examples.translation: wǒ zuò zuò yè zuò de méi yǒu tā nà me hǎo — I don’t do homework as well as she does.

examples.text: 我做作业没有她做得那么好。
examples.translation: wǒ zuò zuò yè méi yǒu tā zuò de nà me hǎo — I don’t do homework as well as she does.

examples.text: 我说英语说得没有他说得那么好。
examples.translation: wǒ shuō yīng yǔ shuō de méi yǒu tā shuō de nà me hǎo — I don’t speak English as well as he does.

examples.text: 我说英语说得没有他那么好。
examples.translation: wǒ shuō yīng yǔ shuō de méi yǒu tā nà me hǎo — I don’t speak English as well as he does.

examples.text: 我说英语没有他说得那么好。
examples.translation: wǒ shuō yīng yǔ méi yǒu tā shuō de nà me hǎo — I don’t speak English as well as he does.

examples.text: 她做作业做得有没有我做得那么好？
examples.translation: tā zuò zuò yè zuò de yǒu méi yǒu wǒ zuò de nà me hǎo — Does she do homework as well as I do?

examples.text: 她做作业做得有没有我那么好？
examples.translation: tā zuò zuò yè zuò de yǒu méi yǒu wǒ nà me hǎo — Does she do homework as well as I do?

examples.text: 她做作业有没有我做得那么好？
examples.translation: tā zuò zuò yè yǒu méi yǒu wǒ zuò de nà me hǎo — Does she do homework as well as I do?

examples.text: 我起床起得有没有你起得那么早？
examples.translation: wǒ qǐ chuáng qǐ de yǒu méi yǒu nǐ qǐ de nà me zǎo — Do I get up as early as you do?

examples.text: 我起床起得有没有你那么早？
examples.translation: wǒ qǐ chuáng qǐ de yǒu méi yǒu nǐ nà me zǎo — Do I get up as early as you do?

examples.text: 我起床有没有你起得那么早？
examples.translation: wǒ qǐ chuáng yǒu méi yǒu nǐ qǐ de nà me zǎo — Do I get up as early as you do?

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Write sentences using the expressions provided. The book’s example: 我哥哥，我，说日文，好 → 我哥哥说日文说得比我说得好。 or 我哥哥说日文说得比我好 / 我哥哥说日文比我说得好。 The four items are: 1. 大卫，琳达，写中文字，好，多了; 2. 琳达，大卫，读中文，好得多; 3. 大卫，琳达，做作业，没有，好，那么; 4. 琳达，大卫，说中文，那么，有没有，好. B. Read your sentences to a partner. The book gives no key; model sentences:

examples.text: 我哥哥说日文说得比我说得好。
examples.translation: wǒ gē gē shuō rì wén shuō de bǐ wǒ shuō de hǎo — My older brother speaks Japanese better than I do.

examples.text: 大卫写中文字写得比琳达好多了。
examples.translation: dà wèi xiě zhōng wén zì xiě de bǐ lín dá hǎo duō le — David writes Chinese characters much better than Linda does.

examples.text: 琳达读中文读得比大卫好得多。
examples.translation: lín dá dú zhōng wén dú de bǐ dà wèi hǎo de duō — Linda reads Chinese much better than David does.

examples.text: 大卫做作业做得没有琳达那么好。
examples.translation: dà wèi zuò zuò yè zuò de méi yǒu lín dá nà me hǎo — David doesn’t do homework as well as Linda does.

examples.text: 琳达说中文说得有没有大卫那么好？
examples.translation: lín dá shuō zhōng wén shuō de yǒu méi yǒu dà wèi nà me hǎo — Does Linda speak Chinese as well as David does?

exercises.prompt: What does 她做作业做得比我好 mean?
options: I do homework better than she does
She does homework as well as I do
She does homework better than I do

exercises.prompt: What does 他说中文说得比我好很多 mean?
options: I speak Chinese much better than he does
He speaks Chinese much better than I do

exercises.prompt: What does 她起床起得比我早得多 mean?
options: I get up much earlier than she does
She gets up much earlier than I do
She gets up a bit later

exercises.prompt: What does 我看电影看得比她多多了 mean?
options: I watch as many as she does
She watches many more than I do
I watch many more movies than she does

exercises.prompt: What does 我做作业做得没有她那么好 mean?
options: I don’t do homework as well as she does
I do homework better than she does
exercises.explanation: 没有 + B + 那么 + adjective: “not as … as”.

exercises.prompt: What does 她做作业做得有没有我那么好？ ask?
options: Does she do homework as well as I do?
exercises.explanation: 有没有 forms the affirmative-negative question.

exercises.prompt: Which three phrases can follow the complement to mean “much more”?
options: 一点, 一些, 差不多
有时, 常常, 经常
很少, 不多, 太多
很多, 得多, 多了
exercises.explanation: Complement + 很多 / 得多 / 多了.

exercises.prompt: Which word replaces 不 in the negative comparison?
exercises.explanation: To negate, use 没有 instead of 不.

exercises.prompt: Which word is often inserted before the complement after 没有 or 有没有?
exercises.explanation: 那么 is often inserted before the complement.

exercises.prompt: 她做作业做得___我做得好。
我做作业做得___有她那么好。
她做作业做得___没有我那么好？
我看电影看得比她多___了。
他说中文说得比我好很___。

lessons.title: 191. Presentation 3 skill integration: weekend plans and hobbies
lessons.subtitle: 你现在已经完全习惯… · 星期六早上起床以后 · 你的爱好是什么？

explanations.title: Skill Integration, Activity 1 (Listening, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the passage and mark five statements true or false: 1. The speaker talks about how he spent last weekend. 2. His girlfriend likes Chinese food, so most weekends they eat Chinese. 3. He and his girlfriend often go to the library on Saturday. 4. His normal sequence is: workout, chat with classmates, eat take-out, walk on the beach and then read at the library. 5. Some Saturdays he has duties after dinner, so he gets to bed late. B. Read the script your teacher provides and check your work; ask a partner three questions about the passage. C. Pair up: while your partner looks away from the script, orally translate one of the underlined sentences so your partner can translate it back into Chinese; review the script. (The recording is not included; the five statements are checked against the Presentation 3 passage below.)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Speaking and Writing): say it in Chinese
explanations.body: A. Tell your partner how you would say seven sentences in Chinese (the book gives them in English). B. Work with a partner to write a dialog based on part A, then perform it for the class. One way to say each sentence:

examples.text: 你现在已经完全习惯在国防语言学院的学生生活了。
examples.translation: nǐ xiàn zài yǐ jīng wán quán xí guàn zài guó fáng yǔ yán xué yuàn de xué shēng shēng huó le — You are now completely accustomed to student life at DLI.

examples.text: 这个星期五没有作业，所以你可以做自己喜欢的事情。
examples.translation: zhè ge xīng qī wǔ méi yǒu zuò yè suǒ yǐ nǐ kě yǐ zuò zì jǐ xǐ huān de shì qíng — As you don’t have homework this Friday, you can do something you enjoy.

examples.text: 星期六早上起床以后，你常常去体育馆锻炼，然后去海边散步。
examples.translation: xīng qī liù zǎo shàng qǐ chuáng yǐ hòu nǐ cháng cháng qù tǐ yù guǎn duàn liàn rán hòu qù hǎi biān sàn bù — After you get up Saturday mornings, you often go to the gym to work out, and then take a walk on the beach.

examples.text: 星期六下午，你有时在宿舍和同学聊天，有时和朋友去看电影。
examples.translation: xīng qī liù xià wǔ nǐ yǒu shí zài sù shè hé tóng xué liáo tiān yǒu shí hé péng yǒu qù kàn diàn yǐng — Saturday afternoons, sometimes you chat with classmates in the dormitory, sometimes you go see a movie with friends.

examples.text: 星期天早上，你先去图书馆做作业，然后和朋友去中国饭馆吃饭。
examples.translation: xīng qī tiān zǎo shàng nǐ xiān qù tú shū guǎn zuò zuò yè rán hòu hé péng yǒu qù zhōng guó fàn guǎn chī fàn — Sunday mornings, you first do your homework at the library, then you go eat at a Chinese restaurant with friends.

examples.text: 星期天下午，你常常在宿舍和同学一起学习生词。
examples.translation: xīng qī tiān xià wǔ nǐ cháng cháng zài sù shè hé tóng xué yì qǐ xué xí shēng cí — Sunday afternoons, you often stay in the dormitory studying vocabulary with a classmate.

examples.text: 因为星期一早上要很早起床，所以星期天晚上九点以前你要预习新课。
examples.translation: yīn wèi xīng qī yī zǎo shàng yào hěn zǎo qǐ chuáng suǒ yǐ xīng qī tiān wǎn shàng jiǔ diǎn yǐ qián nǐ yào yù xí xīn kè — Because Monday mornings you have to get up early, you need to preview the new presentation before 9 p.m. Sunday evening.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Speaking and Writing): hobbies
explanations.body: In Chinese, interview three classmates to find out what their hobbies are and when they usually do them, and write your notes in Chinese in a table (name, hobby, when); consult a dictionary if necessary. B. Pair up. Each student thinks of one classmate and one of their hobbies; your partner asks questions in Chinese to find out who you were thinking of and their hobby. C. When both partners have asked and answered the questions, repeat step B with a different partner.

exercises.prompt: True or false: the speaker talks about how he spent last weekend.
options: True: he describes only last weekend
False: he talks about the week
False: he describes what he usually does on weekends
exercises.explanation: The passage says 常常 and 有时 — usual habits.

exercises.prompt: True or false: his girlfriend likes Chinese food, so most weekends they eat Chinese.
options: True: because she likes Chinese food
Not stated: the passage says they often go to a Chinese restaurant at noon, not why
exercises.explanation: 中午，我们常常一起去中国饭馆吃饭。 The passage does not give a reason.

exercises.prompt: True or false: he and his girlfriend often go to the library on Saturday.
options: False: on Saturday they sometimes see a movie; the library is on Sunday afternoon
exercises.explanation: 星期天下午，我要去图书馆做作业。

exercises.prompt: True or false: his normal Saturday sequence is workout, chat, eat, walk on the beach, library.
options: True: but the library is first
False: the library is on Sunday, and Saturday afternoon is a movie or the beach
exercises.explanation: 星期六: gym, chat, noon at a restaurant, afternoon movie or beach.

exercises.prompt: True or false: some Saturdays he has duties after dinner, so he gets to bed late.
options: True: he goes to bed at midnight
Not in this passage: he goes to bed at ten on Sunday evenings
True: he is on duty every Saturday
False: he never goes to bed
exercises.explanation: 因为星期一要很早起床，所以我星期天晚上常常十点睡觉。

exercises.prompt: How do you say “After getting up on Saturday morning, I often go to the gym”?
options: 起床星期六早上以后，我去常常体育馆。
我常常去体育馆锻炼星期六早上起床。
星期六早上起床以后，我常常去体育馆锻炼。
星期六早上以后起床，我常常去体育馆锻炼。
exercises.explanation: Time + 起床以后 + 常常 + verb.

exercises.prompt: How do you say “Sometimes I chat with classmates, sometimes I see a movie”?
options: 有时有时我聊天看电影。
有时我和同学聊天，然后我去看电影。
有时我和同学聊天，有时我去看电影。
我先和同学聊天，有时去看电影。

exercises.prompt: How do you say “First do homework at the library, then eat at a restaurant”?
options: 先去图书馆做作业，然后去饭馆吃饭
先然后做作业去图书馆
然后去图书馆做作业，先去饭馆吃饭
去图书馆做作业，先然后去饭馆吃饭

exercises.prompt: 因为星期一要很早起床，___我星期天晚上常常十点睡觉。
星期天和星期六差不多___。
exercises.explanation: 差不多一样: almost the same.

lessons.title: 192. Presentation 3: plans for a long weekend, and an email to a teacher
lessons.subtitle: 长周末 · 研究生俱乐部 · 张琳 · 大卫老师 · 打电话

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context, Activity 1 (Listening, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: Work in pairs. You are studying at Guangzhou University. On Friday, one of your WeChat groups posts two audios about plans for Saturday (three pictures). A. Listen to Audio 1 while your partner listens to Audio 2; write your notes in English in a table (time, location, activity). B. Ask your partner questions to complete the table. C. Go over the scripts and correct them, then discuss in Chinese which plan works best for both of you, and explain your decision to the class in Chinese (audio, not included).

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): an email from the Graduate Student Club
explanations.body: You are in Beijing for graduate studies and your Graduate Student Club has sent an email asking for suggestions on how to spend the coming long weekend. A. Read the email below (use a dictionary if necessary), then complete the tables in Chinese: Saturday and Sunday, four items each. B. Share your suggestions in pairs and modify them from your partner’s feedback. C. Speak in Chinese with another classmate who is secretary of the Graduate Student Club: give them your suggestions and answer their questions.

examples.text: 各位同学：
examples.translation: gè wèi tóng xué — Dear fellow students:

examples.text: 你们好！
examples.translation: nǐ men hǎo — Hello!

examples.text: 长周末快要到了，我们怎么过一个有意思的周末呢？请各位同学告诉我们您想怎么过，好吗？
examples.translation: zhǎng zhōu mò kuài yào dào le wǒ men zěn me guò yí gè yǒu yì si de zhōu mò ne qǐng gè wèi tóng xué gào sù wǒ men nín xiǎng zěn me guò hǎo ma — The long weekend is coming soon; how can we spend an interesting weekend? Please tell us how you would like to spend it, okay?

examples.text: 比如，星期六、星期天这两天，您想做什么事，什么时间做。
examples.translation: bǐ rú xīng qī liù xīng qī tiān zhè liǎng tiān nín xiǎng zuò shén me shì shén me shí jiān zuò — For example, on these two days, Saturday and Sunday: what you would like to do, and at what time.

examples.text: 下面是一个表格，请填一下。我们会根据你们的意见，组织一些有意思的活动。
examples.translation: xià miàn shì yí gè biǎo gé qǐng tián yí xià wǒ men huì gēn jù nǐ men de yì jiàn zǔ zhī yì xiē yǒu yì si de huó dòng — Below is a form; please fill it in. Based on your opinions, we will organize some interesting activities.

examples.text: 谢谢！
examples.translation: xiè xiè — Thank you!

examples.text: 研究生俱乐部
examples.translation: yán jiū shēng jù lè bù — The Graduate Student Club

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): Zhang Lin’s email
explanations.body: A. Read the following email and consult a dictionary when necessary; then reply to your former English student to answer her questions. B. Pair up. Read your email reply to your partner and answer any questions your partner may have.

examples.text: 大卫老师：
examples.translation: dà wèi lǎo shī — Teacher David:

examples.text: 您好！

lessons.title: 193. Area Studies: daily routine in China
lessons.subtitle: Daily Routine in China · taijiquan · public transportation · dinner between 6 and 8

explanations.title: Daily Routine in China (1): the city and the morning
explanations.body:
China is a geographically diverse country with a vast population. Although most people still live in the countryside, it is in the cities where business, technology, education, and culture continue to advance and evolve. An overview of daily routines in the city will therefore lend insight into today’s China.

Many Chinese begin their day exercising in local parks or city squares. While some do Western-style aerobics, traditional Chinese morning exercises are more common. Groups greet the sunrise with organized sessions of taijiquan, wushu and other traditional Chinese disciplines. People participate in these exercises right next to other groups that practice ballroom and modern dancing.

After their workouts, they return home, bathe, have breakfast and prepare for the day. For city dwellers, at least, breakfast is not much different than in the West. Some even skip breakfast, snacking on the go as they head to school or work.

explanations.title: Daily Routine in China (2): the day and the evening
explanations.body:
Although many families own cars, most workers and students still rely on public transportation or bicycles. After school, some students may go home, play soccer, basketball or ping-pong, while others stay late on campus and study. High school students preparing for the national college entrance exams may use this time to take preparatory courses for the exams. Chinese urbanites can shop at giant department stores, small street markets, fashion boutiques, or traditional Chinese medicine shops. Friends meet in libraries, coffee shops, or internet cafes after work or class.

As evenings settle in, families return home to prepare their dinners, or they go to restaurants for more formal dining with relatives, business partners or friends. Dinner is usually between 6 and 8 p.m. In China, many men learn to cook as a hobby—on special occasions it is not unusual for husbands to do the cooking.

explanations.title: Daily Routine in China (3): nights, weekends and the young
explanations.body:
On evenings, weekends and holidays, people go to clubs, bars and internet cafes. Some go to see movies or plays, Chinese and Western operas, or soccer and basketball games. Chinese cities are large and densely populated, so there is guaranteed to be a big crowd at every event. None of this would be possible, however, without China’s excellent public transportation system. Subways will usually run until midnight, while buses and cabs operate throughout the night.

Just like young Americans, young people in China often stay up late talking on their cell phones, watching movies or shows online, or playing video games. As China’s economy continues to grow, Chinese city life grows richer and more varied in its wake.

Reference: wikipedia.org. (The book’s photos, all from People.com.cn, are not included.)

explanations.title: Lesson 8 Chinese Food and Restaurants: objectives
explanations.body: 第八课 中国食品与餐馆. Upon completion of this lesson you will be able to: order food at a restaurant; reserve a table; describe dishes; narrate simple past events. To do this you must master: new words and phrases for these functions; formulaic expressions for eating at restaurants; the modal verbs 想, 会, 想要 and 不要; 要 as a notional verb; the preposition 给; the adverbs 再 and 才; the adverb 就 (2); 了 indicating a new event; 了 in sequential actions; the 一边…一边… construction; Verb + (一)点儿 and Verb + 一下; and the pivotal construction. Area Studies: Food in Chinese Culture.

explanations.title: 要 and 想
explanations.body: In Lesson 7 we learned the modal verb 要 + Verb pattern, for example 我要值班. While both 要 and 想 can express desire or intention, 要 is stronger in tone, implying a decision has already been made.

examples.text: 我要喝啤酒。
examples.translation: wǒ yào hē pí jiǔ — I am going to drink some beer.

examples.text: 我想喝啤酒。
examples.translation: wǒ xiǎng hē pí jiǔ — I would like to have some beer, but I may or may not act on that.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening)
explanations.body: Listen to four short dialogs and answer: Dialog 1, who is going to see the movie? Dialog 2, who wants to have Chinese food? Dialog 3, who would like to go to China? Dialog 4, what are they going to order? (The recordings are not included; the patterns are practiced below.)

The object of 吃 must be something to eat.

lessons.title: 198. Presentation 1 grammar: 要 + noun, and menu questions
lessons.subtitle: 你想要什么饮料？ · 我要一杯橙汁 · 美味家常菜 · 你想学中文还是韩文？

explanations.title: 要 + Noun
explanations.body: To order food using 要, place 要 before the noun (object). In this case 要 is the main verb of the sentence. Subject + (Modal Verb) + 要 + Object.

examples.text: 你想要什么饮料？
examples.translation: nǐ xiǎng yào shén me yǐn liào — What beverage would you like?

examples.text: 我要一杯橙汁。
examples.translation: wǒ yào yì bēi chéng zhī — I want a glass of orange juice.

examples.text: 你要什么主食？
examples.translation: nǐ yào shén me zhǔ shí — What staple food do you want?

examples.text: 我要一盘饺子。
examples.translation: wǒ yào yì pán jiǎo zi — I want a plate of dumplings.

examples.text: 你们想要饺子还是米饭？
examples.translation: nǐ men xiǎng yào jiǎo zi hái shì mǐ fàn — Do you want dumplings or rice?

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening)
explanations.body: Listen to four sentences, translate them, and decide whether 要 serves as a modal or a main verb in each (the recordings are not included). Rule of thumb: 要 before a verb is modal (want to, am going to); 要 before a noun is the main verb (want, order).

explanations.title: Activity 3: the menu 美味家常菜 (Tasty Home Cooking)
explanations.body: Choose the food and drink you would like to order, then write questions to ask a partner what they would like to order, using the modal verbs 想 and 想要 and the main verb 要 wherever appropriate. New words: 牛肉 beef, 可乐 Coke, 面 noodles.

lessons.title: 199. Presentation 1 grammar: the adverb 再
lessons.subtitle: 再要一个… · 再来一盘… · 再给我们两双筷子

explanations.title: Adverb 再
explanations.body: While the meaning of the adverb 再 depends on context, in this lesson it means “in addition”. Pattern: 再 + Verb + Object.

examples.text: 再要一个西红柿炒鸡蛋吧。
examples.translation: zài yào yí gè xī hóng shì chǎo jī dàn ba — Let’s order a tomato and scrambled eggs as well.

examples.text: 请给我两碗米饭，再来一盘饺子。
examples.translation: qǐng gěi wǒ liǎng wǎn mǐ fàn zài lái yì pán jiǎo zi — Please give me two bowls of rice, and a plate of dumplings too.

examples.text: 我想再点一个糖醋鱼。
examples.translation: wǒ xiǎng zài diǎn yí gè táng cù yú — I would like to order another sweet and sour fish.

examples.text: 服务员，请再给我们两双筷子。
examples.translation: fú wù yuán qǐng zài gěi wǒ men liǎng shuāng kuài zi — Waiter, please give us two more pairs of chopsticks.

explanations.title: Activities 5 and 6
explanations.body: Activity 5 (Listening): listen to three dialogs: What does the woman suggest? What do the speakers plan to order? (recordings not included). Activity 6 (Speaking): pair up, use your menu to role-play waiter and customer, and use 再 wherever appropriate; switch roles and repeat (the book shows two pictures of diners).

exercises.prompt: What does 再 mean in 再要一个西红柿炒鸡蛋吧?
exercises.explanation: 再 + verb + object: order one more.

exercises.explanation: 再 + 要 + number + measure word + noun.

exercises.prompt: How do you say “Please give me two more bowls of rice”?

exercises.prompt: 请给我两碗米饭，___来一盘饺子。
服务员，请___给我们两双筷子。

options: again; once more; and then; in addition
exercises.explanation: 再 (zài) means “again; once more; and then; in addition”.

lessons.title: 200. Presentation 1 grammar: Verb + (一)点儿 to soften the tone
lessons.subtitle: 喝点儿 · 吃点儿菜吧 · 想要点儿什么主食 · 委婉语气

explanations.title: Verb + (一)点儿 to soften the tone of voice (委婉语气)
explanations.body: (一)点儿 usually means “a little bit”: 我喝了一点儿酒 (I drank a little wine). It is also used in imperative and request sentences to make a suggestion or request sound more tactful, polite or casual. The character 一 can be omitted. The noun that follows (一)点儿 can also be omitted when it is clear from context. Pattern: Verb + (一)点儿 + Noun.

examples.text: 我喝了一点儿酒。
examples.translation: wǒ hē le yì diǎnr jiǔ — I drank a little wine.

examples.text: 我可以喝点儿酒吗？
examples.translation: wǒ kě yǐ hē diǎnr jiǔ ma — May I drink a little wine?

examples.text: 吃点儿菜吧。
examples.translation: chī diǎnr cài ba — Have some food.

examples.text: 再喝点儿啤酒！
examples.translation: zài hē diǎnr pí jiǔ — Have some more beer!

examples.text: 你们想喝点儿什么？
examples.translation: nǐ men xiǎng hē diǎnr shén me — What would you like to drink?

examples.text: 你们想要点儿什么主食？
examples.translation: nǐ men xiǎng yào diǎnr shén me zhǔ shí — What staple food would you like?

explanations.body: A. In groups of three, think of questions containing (一)点儿 that a waiter or waitress might ask the diners. B. In the same group, think of things a host might say to a dinner guest containing (一)点儿. Share your work with the class. Some of mine (the book leaves the answer open):

examples.text: 你们想喝点儿什么？
examples.translation: nǐ men xiǎng hē diǎnr shén me — What would you like to drink?

examples.text: 您想吃点儿什么？
examples.translation: nín xiǎng chī diǎnr shén me — What would you like to eat?

examples.text: 吃点儿菜吧。
examples.translation: chī diǎnr cài ba — Have some food.

examples.text: 再喝点儿啤酒！
examples.translation: zài hē diǎnr pí jiǔ — Have some more beer!

examples.translation: duō chī diǎnr — Eat a little more.

exercises.explanation: 我喝了一点儿酒: I drank a little wine.

exercises.explanation: Verb + 点儿 softens a request.

What does 你们想喝点儿什么？ ask?
options: What would you like to drink?
How much beer do you drink?

exercises.explanation: 再 + 喝 + 点儿 + noun.

options: Do you drink wine every day?
May I drink a little wine?
exercises.explanation: 可以 + verb + 点儿 + noun + 吗.

exercises.prompt: Where is the noun in Verb + (一)点儿 + Noun?
exercises.explanation: 喝点儿酒: the noun follows 点儿.

exercises.prompt: Which is the more tactful request?
exercises.explanation: 点儿 and 吧 soften the tone.

lessons.title: 201. Presentation 1 grammar: 给 as a preposition
lessons.subtitle: 麻烦您给我们拿… · 我想给饭馆打电话 · 给 + receiver + verb

explanations.title: As a verb, 给 means “to give”; as a preposition it introduces the receiver
explanations.body: As a verb 给 means to give: 请给我一杯水. In 麻烦您给我们拿两双筷子, 给 is a preposition that introduces the receiver of the action, 给我们 (to us); (给 + receiver) often appears before a verb phrase. Pattern: Subject + (给 receiver) + VP.

examples.text: 请给我一杯水。
examples.translation: qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi shuǐ — Please give me a cup of water.

examples.text: 王老师给我一本书。
examples.translation: wáng lǎo shī gěi wǒ yì běn shū — Teacher Wang gave me a book.

examples.text: 麻烦您给我们拿两双筷子。
examples.translation: má fán nín gěi wǒ men ná liǎng shuāng kuài zi — Could you please bring two pairs of chopsticks to us?

explanations.title: More examples
explanations.body: Activity 8: A. Pair up and highlight the (给 + object) in the sentences, then read them aloud in Chinese and in English.

examples.text: 请给她来杯橙汁，给我来杯茶。
examples.translation: qǐng gěi tā lái bēi chéng zhī gěi wǒ lái bēi chá — Juice for her and tea for me, please.

examples.text: 我想给饭馆打电话。
examples.translation: wǒ xiǎng gěi fàn guǎn dǎ diàn huà — I want to call the restaurant.

examples.text: 他要我给他点个烤鱼。
examples.translation: tā yào wǒ gěi tā diǎn gè kǎo yú — He wants me to order a grilled fish for him.

examples.text: 我给你们做个蛋炒饭吧。
examples.translation: wǒ gěi nǐ men zuò gè dàn chǎo fàn ba — Let me cook some egg fried rice for you.

examples.text: 请给我拿一本英文菜单。
examples.translation: qǐng gěi wǒ ná yì běn yīng wén cài dān — Please give me an English menu.

explanations.title: Activity 8B: how would you say these in Chinese?
explanations.body: The book asks you to draft six sentences; one possible answer for each (the key is mine):

examples.text: 快！给她拿一杯水。
examples.translation: kuài gěi tā ná yì bēi shuǐ — Quick! Bring her a cup of water.

examples.text: 请给他点一盘饺子。
examples.translation: qǐng gěi tā diǎn yì pán jiǎo zi — Please order a plate of dumplings for him.

examples.text: 你想让我给你做一杯咖啡吗？

lessons.title: 202. Presentation 1 skill integration: orders and four passages about restaurants
lessons.subtitle: 有饺子吗？ · 十分钟就好 · 小面馆 · 马克点菜 · 点菜机

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening and Reading): match the questions with the answers
explanations.body: Listen to eight questions (audio, not included) and match each with its answer, a to h (shown here as 甲 to 辛, in the book’s order). The eight answers:

examples.text: 甲．先来一只烤鸭吧。
examples.translation: jiǎ xiān lái yì zhī kǎo yā ba — Let’s start with a roast duck.

examples.text: 乙．来一瓶啤酒和一杯可乐。
examples.translation: yǐ lái yì píng pí jiǔ hé yì bēi kě lè — A bottle of beer and a glass of Coke.

examples.text: 丙．十分钟就好。
examples.translation: bǐng shí fēn zhōng jiù hǎo — It will be ready in ten minutes.

examples.text: 丁．有饺子吗？
examples.translation: dīng yǒu jiǎo zi ma — Do you have dumplings?

examples.text: 戊．有五个人。
examples.translation: wù yǒu wǔ gè rén — There are five people.

examples.text: 己．我们去长城饭店，怎么样？
examples.translation: jǐ wǒ men qù cháng chéng fàn diàn zěn me yàng — Shall we go to the Great Wall Restaurant?

examples.text: 庚．请稍等一下。
examples.translation: gēng qǐng shāo děng yí xià — Please wait a moment.

examples.text: 辛．很好。
examples.translation: xīn hěn hǎo — Very good.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading and Listening): four passages
explanations.body: Pair up. Student A reads Passages 1 and 2 and answers the questions; Student B reads Passages 3 and 4. Then each listens to the partner’s passages (audio, not included) and answers the same questions; compare all four. The questions: Passage 1: What does the speaker say about the restaurant? Passage 2: How do the teachers order their dishes and why? Passage 3: What differences between Chinese and Westerners are mentioned? Passage 4: What would the waiter’s likely response to the diner’s comment be? (New word: 按 àn, push or press.)

examples.text: 在我住的地方有一家小面馆。那家面馆太小了，只有一个人，他又是老板，又是服务员。不过，那里的饭菜都很好吃，最有特色的是牛肉面。我常常去那儿吃牛肉面。时间长了，老板看见我就问：“今天又吃牛肉面？”
examples.translation: zài wǒ zhù de dì fāng yǒu yì jiā xiǎo miàn guǎn nà jiā miàn guǎn tài xiǎo le zhǐ yǒu yí gè rén tā yòu shì lǎo bǎn yòu shì fú wù yuán bú guò nà lǐ de fàn cài dōu hěn hǎo chī zuì yǒu tè sè de shì niú ròu miàn wǒ cháng cháng qù nàr chī niú ròu miàn shí jiān zhǎng le lǎo bǎn kàn jiàn wǒ jiù wèn jīn tiān yòu chī niú ròu miàn — Where I live there is a small noodle restaurant. It is so small that there is only one person; he is both the owner and the waiter. But the food there is delicious; the most distinctive dish is beef noodles. I often go there to eat beef noodles. After a while, when the owner sees me, he asks: “Beef noodles again today?”

examples.text: 马克在中国的一所大学教英文。学校有好几位外国老师。他们常常一起去饭馆吃饭。每次都是马克点菜，因为他在中国的时间最长，中文也最好。在中国，除了非常有名的大饭店，小饭店里的菜单都是中文，很多服务员也不会说英文。
examples.translation: mǎ kè zài zhōng guó de yì suǒ dà xué jiào yīng wén xué xiào yǒu hǎo jǐ wèi wài guó lǎo shī tā men cháng cháng yì qǐ qù fàn guǎn chī fàn měi cì dōu shì mǎ kè diǎn cài yīn wèi tā zài zhōng guó de shí jiān zuì zhǎng zhōng wén yě zuì hǎo zài zhōng guó chú le fēi cháng yǒu míng de dà fàn diàn xiǎo fàn diàn lǐ de cài dān dōu shì zhōng wén hěn duō fú wù yuán yě bú huì shuō yīng wén — Mark teaches English at a university in China. The school has several foreign teachers. They often eat at restaurants together. Every time Mark orders, because he has been in China the longest and his Chinese is the best. In China, except for very famous big restaurants, the menus in small restaurants are in Chinese, and many waiters cannot speak English either.

examples.text: 中国人吃饭的习惯跟我们很不一样。在我们那儿每一个人点自己的菜，吃自己的菜，但是在中国，大家一起点菜，一起吃。不过中国和西方最不一样的是：西方最好的饭馆常常也是最贵的，在中国最好的饭馆常常都不贵。
examples.translation: zhōng guó rén chī fàn de xí guàn gēn wǒ men hěn bù yí yàng zài wǒ men nàr měi yí gè rén diǎn zì jǐ de cài chī zì jǐ de cài dàn shì zài zhōng guó dà jiā yì qǐ diǎn cài yì qǐ chī bú guò zhōng guó hé xī fāng zuì bù yí yàng de shì xī fāng zuì hǎo de fàn guǎn cháng cháng yě shì zuì guì de zài zhōng guó zuì hǎo de fàn guǎn cháng cháng dōu bú guì — Chinese eating habits are very different from ours. Where we are, everyone orders their own dish and eats their own dish, but in China everyone orders together and eats together. But the biggest difference between China and the West is that the best restaurants in the West are often also the most expensive, while in China the best restaurants are often not expensive.

examples.text: 现在很多饭店都开始用点菜机。有一天，我和朋友一起去饭馆吃饭。我们点菜的时候，服务员在点菜机上不停地按。我的朋友说：“请不要在我们点菜的时候玩儿手机，好吗？！”
examples.translation: xiàn zài hěn duō fàn diàn dōu kāi shǐ yòng diǎn cài jī yǒu yì tiān wǒ hé péng yǒu yì qǐ qù fàn guǎn chī fàn wǒ men diǎn cài de shí hòu fú wù yuán zài diǎn cài jī shàng bù tíng dì àn wǒ de péng yǒu shuō qǐng bú yào zài wǒ men diǎn cài de shí hòu wánr shǒu jī hǎo ma — Now many restaurants have begun to use order machines. One day I went to a restaurant with a friend. While we were ordering, the waiter kept pressing the order machine. My friend said: “Please don’t play with your cell phone while we are ordering, okay?!”

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up and discuss with your partner. A. Have you ever reserved a table? For what event in particular? B. What information do you need to provide when reserving a table? C. What information would you like to have from the restaurant when reserving a table? D. What kind of complications might you encounter when reserving a table?

explanations.title: Presentation 2: 大卫 reserves a table at the Great Wall Restaurant
explanations.body: The book also prints this dialog in traditional characters (for example 喂，您好！這裡是長城飯店).

examples.text: 服务员：喂，您好！这里是长城饭店。
examples.translation: fú wù yuán wèi nín hǎo zhè lǐ shì cháng chéng fàn diàn — Hello! This is the Great Wall Restaurant.

examples.text: 大卫：您好。我想订一张八人的桌子。
examples.translation: dà wèi nín hǎo wǒ xiǎng dìng yì zhāng bā rén de zhuō zi — Hello. I would like to reserve a table for eight.

examples.text: 服务员：什么时间？
examples.translation: fú wù yuán shén me shí jiān — What time?

examples.text: 大卫：最好晚上六点以后，我们四点才下课。
examples.translation: dà wèi zuì hǎo wǎn shàng liù diǎn yǐ hòu wǒ men sì diǎn cái xià kè — Preferably after six in the evening; we don’t finish class until four.

examples.text: 服务员：我查一下。对不起，六点的桌子都订满了。
examples.translation: fú wù yuán wǒ chá yí xià duì bù qǐ liù diǎn de zhuō zi dōu dìng mǎn le — Let me check. Sorry, the tables at six are all booked.

examples.text: 大卫：那，七点的呢？
examples.translation: dà wèi nà qī diǎn de ne — Then how about seven?

examples.text: 服务员：七点的还有。
examples.translation: fú wù yuán qī diǎn de hái yǒu — There are still tables at seven.

examples.text: 大卫：行。你们餐馆有什么特色菜？
examples.translation: dà wèi xíng nǐ men cān guǎn yǒu shén me tè sè cài — Okay. What specialty dishes does your restaurant have?

examples.text: 服务员：我们的广东菜很有特色。
examples.translation: fú wù yuán wǒ men de guǎng dōng cài hěn yǒu tè sè — Our Cantonese food is very distinctive.

examples.text: 大卫：太好了！我朋友很喜欢广东菜。对了，菜不要太咸，不要放味精。
examples.translation: dà wèi tài hǎo le wǒ péng yǒu hěn xǐ huān guǎng dōng cài duì le cài bú yào tài xián bú yào fàng wèi jīng — Great! My friends like Cantonese food very much. Oh, by the way, don’t make the dishes too salty, and don’t put in MSG.

examples.text: 服务员：没问题，我们的菜都很清淡，你们一定喜欢。请问，你叫什么名字？

examples.text: 大卫：我叫大卫。姓石，石头的石。
examples.translation: dà wèi wǒ jiào dà wèi xìng shí shí tou de shí — My name is David. The surname is Shi, the shi of 石头 (stone).

examples.text: 服务员：谢谢！明天晚上见。
examples.translation: fú wù yuán xiè xiè míng tiān wǎn shàng jiàn — Thank you! See you tomorrow evening.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening): global and detailed listening
explanations.body: A. Is this conversation face-to-face or over the phone? How do you know? Why does David want to reserve a table? Why does he prefer to reserve for after 6 p.m.? B. Take notes as if you were taking David’s reservation: customer name, reservation time, number of people, special requests. (The recording is not included. From the text: it is over the phone, since the waiter answers 喂 and the restaurant is named; David wants a table for eight; he prefers after six because his class ends at four. The reservation: 石 (David), seven in the evening, tomorrow, eight people; not too salty and no MSG.)
