lessons.title: 383. Lesson 15 Presentation 3 grammar: the V + 来 + V + 去 construction
lessons.subtitle: 飞来飞去 · 挑来选去 · 走来走去 · 想来想去

explanations.title: The V + 来 + V + 去 construction
explanations.body: This construction indicates that an action happens repeatedly or moves back and forth. It is generally used with two verbs that are either identical or synonymous, for example 飞来飞去 and 挑来选去. Subject + V + 来 + V + 去. (Note: if the verb has an object, the object is usually at the beginning of the sentence.)

examples.text: 很多鸟在天上飞来飞去。
examples.translation: hěn duō niǎo zài tiān shàng fēi lái fēi qù — Many birds fly back and forth in the sky.

examples.text: 他看来看去，都看不出那位医生写了什么。
examples.translation: tā kàn lái kàn qù dōu kàn bù chū nà wèi yī shēng xiě le shén me — He looked this way and that, but could not make out what the doctor had written.

examples.text: 我不喜欢靠过道的座位，因为总有人在旁边走来走去。
examples.translation: wǒ bù xǐ huān kào guò dào de zuò wèi yīn wèi zǒng yǒu rén zài páng biān zǒu lái zǒu qù — I don’t like aisle seats, because there are always people walking back and forth next to them.

examples.text: 他把沙发搬来搬去，也没找到合适的地方。
examples.translation: tā bǎ shā fā bān lái bān qù yě méi zhǎo dào hé shì de dì fāng — He moved the sofa around, but still didn’t find a suitable place.

examples.text: 这件事他想来想去，不知道应该怎么办。
examples.translation: zhè jiàn shì tā xiǎng lái xiǎng qù bù zhī dào yīng gāi zěn me bàn — He thought it over and over, and didn’t know what to do.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Work in pairs to rewrite the following sentences using the V + 来 + V + 去 construction. The originals: 爸爸做了很多菜，她尝尝这个，又尝尝那个，还是觉得烤鸭最好吃。 早上很多人在公园里来回走路。 这句话我听了一遍又一遍，还是听不懂。 我在公共汽车站等了很长时间，还是没有车过来。 这些肉他烤了又烤。因为烤得时间太长，已经不好吃了。 The book leaves the rewritten column empty; my rewrites (mine):

examples.text: 爸爸做了很多菜，她尝来尝去，还是觉得烤鸭最好吃。
examples.translation: bà bà zuò le hěn duō cài tā cháng lái cháng qù hái shì jué de kǎo yā zuì hǎo chī — Dad made many dishes; she tasted this and that, and still felt the roast duck was the best. (mine)

examples.text: 早上很多人在公园里走来走去。
examples.translation: zǎo shàng hěn duō rén zài gōng yuán lǐ zǒu lái zǒu qù — In the morning many people walk back and forth in the park. (mine)

examples.text: 这句话我听来听去，还是听不懂。
examples.translation: zhè jù huà wǒ tīng lái tīng qù hái shì tīng bù dǒng — I listened to this sentence over and over and still couldn’t understand it. (mine)

examples.text: 我在公共汽车站等来等去，还是没有车过来。
examples.translation: wǒ zài gōng gòng qì chē zhàn děng lái děng qù hái shì méi yǒu chē guò lái — I waited at the bus stop for a long time and still no bus came. (mine)

examples.text: 这些肉他烤来烤去。因为烤得时间太长，已经不好吃了。
examples.translation: zhè xiē ròu tā kǎo lái kǎo qù yīn wèi kǎo de shí jiān tài cháng yǐ jīng bù hǎo chī le — He grilled this meat over and over. Because it was grilled for too long, it’s no longer tasty. (mine)

lessons.title: 384. Lesson 15 Presentation 3 grammar: the 不…不… construction
lessons.subtitle: 不大不小 · 不冷不热 · 不急不慢 · 不快不慢地散步

explanations.title: The 不…不… construction
explanations.body: The 不…不… construction is used to express that neither A nor B are true; in colloquial Chinese it is often used to indicate a desirable state, such as 这双皮鞋不大不小 (neither too big nor too small) or 蒙特雷的天气不冷不热 (not too cold, not too hot). 不…不… + 的 + Noun (Noun Phrase). 不…不… + 地 + Verb (Verb Phrase).

examples.text: 这部电影不长不短。
examples.translation: zhè bù diàn yǐng bù cháng bù duǎn — This movie is neither long nor short.

examples.text: 这个房子不大不小。
examples.translation: zhè ge fáng zi bú dà bù xiǎo — This house is neither big nor small.

examples.text: 他是一个做事不急不慢的人。
examples.translation: tā shì yí gè zuò shì bù jí bú màn de rén — He is a person who does things neither hurriedly nor slowly.

examples.text: 爸爸给他买了一张不高不矮的书桌。
examples.translation: bà bà gěi tā mǎi le yì zhāng bù gāo bù ǎi de shū zhuō — Dad bought him a desk that is neither tall nor short.

examples.text: 小李说话不快不慢。
examples.translation: xiǎo lǐ shuō huà bú kuài bú màn — Xiao Li speaks neither fast nor slow.

examples.text: 老王不言不语地看着电视。
examples.translation: lǎo wáng bù yán bù yǔ de kàn zhe diàn shì — Lao Wang watched TV without saying a word.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing, and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. In the passage the book gives, fill in the blanks with the words provided in parentheses using the 不…不… construction: 高、矮; 胖、瘦; 早、晚; 大、小; 多、少; 快、慢; 大、小; 远、近. B. Answer the questions: 1. 王丽长得什么样？ 2. 王丽什么时候去的电影院？ 3. 他们的晚饭吃得怎么样？ 4. 吃完晚饭以后他们做什么了？ (Mine: 不高不矮，不胖不瘦，爱笑; 三点半; 菜有点儿咸，但味道不错，四个菜八十元; 去海边不快不慢地散步，然后小李送她回公寓.) C. Check your work against the complete passage:

examples.text: 小李的女朋友王丽今年二十四岁，长得不高不矮，不胖不瘦，说话的时候总是笑。今天小李和她去看了一场电影。他们约好三点半在电影院门口见面，可是小李三点就在电影院门口等。王丽呢，不早不晚三点半到那儿。看完电影，小李带王丽去一家不大不小的饭馆吃晚饭。那儿的菜虽然有点儿咸，但味道不错。他们点了四个菜，花了不多不少八十元钱。吃完饭，他们又到了海边，不快不慢地散了一会儿步。然后，小李送王丽回到她那套不大不小离海边不远不近的公寓。
examples.translation: xiǎo lǐ de nǚ péng yǒu wáng lì jīn nián èr shí sì suì zhǎng de bù gāo bù ǎi bú pàng bú shòu shuō huà de shí hòu zǒng shì xiào jīn tiān xiǎo lǐ hé tā qù kàn le yì cháng diàn yǐng tā men yuē hǎo sān diǎn bàn zài diàn yǐng yuàn mén kǒu jiàn miàn kě shì xiǎo lǐ sān diǎn jiù zài diàn yǐng yuàn mén kǒu děng wáng lì ne bù zǎo bù wǎn sān diǎn bàn dào nàr kàn wán diàn yǐng xiǎo lǐ dài wáng lì qù yì jiā bú dà bù xiǎo de fàn guǎn chī wǎn fàn nàr de cài suī rán yǒu diǎnr xián dàn wèi dào bú cuò tā men diǎn le sì gè cài huā le bù duō bù shǎo bā shí yuán qián chī wán fàn tā men yòu dào le hǎi biān bú kuài bú màn de sàn le yí huìr bù rán hòu xiǎo lǐ sòng wáng lì huí dào tā nà tào bú dà bù xiǎo lí hǎi biān bù yuǎn bú jìn de gōng yù — Xiao Li’s girlfriend Wang Li is twenty-four this year; she is neither tall nor short, neither fat nor thin, and always smiles when she talks. Today Xiao Li and she went to see a movie. They had agreed to meet at the movie theater entrance at three thirty, but Xiao Li was already waiting there at three. Wang Li arrived there neither early nor late, at three thirty. After the movie, Xiao Li took Wang Li to a restaurant that was neither big nor small for dinner. Although the food there was a bit salty, the taste was good. They ordered four dishes, which cost exactly eighty yuan. After eating they went to the seaside and took a walk neither fast nor slow. Then Xiao Li took Wang Li back to her apartment, which is neither big nor small and neither far nor near the sea.

lessons.title: 385. Lesson 15 Presentation 3 grammar: the adverbial modifier marker 地
lessons.subtitle: 高兴地告诉我 · 慢慢地走 · 你跑得很慢 vs. 你慢慢地跑过去

explanations.title: The adverbial modifier marker 地
explanations.body: An adverb is a part of speech that modifies (i.e., describes) a verb. When an adverb describes the manner of a verb, it is often formed with an adjective and marked by the adverbial modifier 地. Example: 小王高兴地告诉我，她考上北京大学了。 An adverbial expression is different from a complement expression. A complement expression is descriptive in nature, whereas an adverbial expression tells the “attitude” or manner of an action. Also, a complement is most often used in connection with a habitual action, or an action that has already taken place, whereas an adverbial modifier may also refer to an action that has yet to happen. Example: 你跑得很慢 vs. 你慢慢地跑过去。 Adjective + 地 + Verb (+ Object).

examples.text: 小王高兴地告诉我，她考上北京大学了。

examples.text: 他开心地笑了。

lessons.title: 386. Lesson 15 Presentation 3 grammar: the aspect particle 着
lessons.subtitle: 客厅里摆着沙发 · 带着孩子们踢球 · 忙着收拾垃圾 · 笑着说

explanations.title: The aspect particle 着
explanations.body: The aspect particle 着 appears after a verb indicating the state or continuation of an action in a static mode. Example: 大明在院子里站着；客厅里放着一张沙发。 We can use the pattern verb + 着 to modify the following verb, thus indicating the state or manner in which the action is carried out. Example: 她坐着讲课。 In Lesson 10 Presentation 3 we learned: 客厅里摆着一张三人沙发。主卧室里面放着一张双人床。后院种着很多果树。 In the current presentation: 爸爸们又带着孩子们踢球，而妈妈们忙着收拾垃圾。 In all these sentences, the aspect particle 着 appears after a verb indicating continuation, either a) indicating an existing state, such as sentences 1 to 3; or b) indicating the manner of carrying out an action, such as sentences 4 and 5. Manner and action: 带着孩子们 (taking the kids) + 踢球 (to play soccer); 忙着 (being busy) + 收拾垃圾 (to clean up). *着 can also be a suffix for some words to form a preposition, such as 沿着 in this presentation.

examples.text: 客厅里摆着一张三人沙发。
examples.translation: kè tīng lǐ bǎi zhe yì zhāng sān rén shā fā — In the living room is placed a three-person sofa.

examples.text: 主卧室里面放着一张双人床。

examples.text: 大明在院子里站着。

examples.text: 他穿着军服。

explanations.title: Patterns and examples
explanations.body: Affirmative: Subject + Verb + 着; Subject + Verb + 着 + Verb (+ Object). Negative: Subject + 不/没有 + verb + 着 (+ Object); Subject + 不是/没有 + verb + 着 + Verb (+ Object). Interrogative: Subject + Verb + 着 + 吗？; Subject + Verb + 着 + Verb (+ Object) + 吗？ Affirmative-Negative: Subject + 有没有/是不是 + verb + 着？; Subject + 有没有/是不是 + Verb + 着 + Verb (+ Object)？ The eight examples:

examples.text: 李老师在教室里坐着。
examples.translation: lǐ lǎo shī zài jiào shì lǐ zuò zhe — Teacher Li is sitting in the classroom.

examples.text: 教室里放着四张桌子和十把椅子。

lessons.title: 387. Lesson 15 Presentation 3 grammar: the (一)直到…才… construction

explanations.title: The (一)直到…才… construction
explanations.body: This construction expresses the idea of “not until….” Example: 昨天他一直到十点才回家。 Affirmative: (一)直到 + Time/Event + Subject + 才…; Subject + (一)直到 + Time/Event + 才… Negative: (一)直到 + Time/Event + Subject + 都/还 + 不/没…; Subject + (一)直到 + Time/Event + 都/还 + 不/没… The eight examples (the book prints them in two columns, 1 to 8; the first example is repeated at the end):

examples.text: 昨天晚上一直到十点半我才做完作业。

examples.text: 昨天晚上我一直到十点半才做完作业。
examples.translation: zuó tiān wǎn shàng wǒ yì zhí dào shí diǎn bàn cái zuò wán zuò yè — Last night I didn’t finish my homework until ten thirty.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Speaking, and Writing): Erlin’s email
explanations.body: A. Read the email below (the book prints TO, CC and Subject lines empty). Look up any unfamiliar words, then answer in English: 1. Why did Erlin write this message? 2. How did his family in China celebrate Chinese New Year? 3. What did the Chinese community do to celebrate Chinese New Year on Sunday? 4. What did Erlin, his wife, and children do respectively for the gathering? (Mine: to say Happy New Year to his parents and tell them about his celebration; over ten people gathered, eating, drinking, talking and laughing; they gathered in the school auditorium, each bringing dishes, drinks, fruit and dessert, with performances; Erlin made red-braised pork and boiled fish, Pingping organized the performances, and the children danced.) B. Pair up and compare; ask each other three questions in Chinese about the details. C. Work with your partner to rewrite the passage as a dialog between Erlin and his father (five exchanges) and act it out.

examples.text: 爸爸、妈妈过年好！刚才看到爸爸发来的视频。全家十几口人在一起过年，又吃又喝又说又笑，真热闹。爸爸、妈妈的身体看上去也不错，太好了！美国加州春节不放假，但今年春节是个星期天，大家不上班，很多华人朋友在我们学校的礼堂聚了聚。那天，大家每个人都带了一两个菜，还准备了各种饮料、水果、甜点。我做了一个红烧肉，还有一个水煮鱼，大家都很喜欢。那天最忙的要数您儿媳萍萍了。她组织了一些朋友给大家表演节目。有的唱歌，有的跳舞，很受欢迎。我最喜欢的节目是孩子们的舞蹈，里面也有您的孙子和孙女。看他们在舞台上高兴地跳来跳去，觉得特别开心。聚会从中午十二点开始，一直到下午四点才结束。明年我和萍萍打算带着两个孩子回老家，和爸爸妈妈还有其他家人一起过年。多多保重！您的儿媳、孙子、孙女也祝您身体健康！二林
examples.translation: bà bà mā mā guò nián hǎo gāng cái kàn dào bà bà fā lái de shì pín quán jiā shí jǐ kǒu rén zài yì qǐ guò nián yòu chī yòu hē yòu shuō yòu xiào zhēn rè nào bà bà mā mā de shēn tǐ kàn shàng qù yě bú cuò tài hǎo le měi guó jiā zhōu chūn jié bú fàng jià dàn jīn nián chūn jié shì gè xīng qī tiān dà jiā bú shàng bān hěn duō huá rén péng yǒu zài wǒ men xué xiào de lǐ táng jù le jù nà tiān dà jiā měi gè rén dōu dài le yì liǎng gè cài hái zhǔn bèi le gè zhǒng yǐn liào shuǐ guǒ tián diǎn wǒ zuò le yí gè hóng shāo ròu hái yǒu yí gè shuǐ zhǔ yú dà jiā dōu hěn xǐ huān nà tiān zuì máng de yào shǔ nín ér xí píng píng le tā zǔ zhī le yì xiē péng yǒu gěi dà jiā biǎo yǎn jié mù yǒu de chàng gē yǒu de tiào wǔ hěn shòu huān yíng wǒ zuì xǐ huān de jié mù shì hái zi men de wǔ dǎo lǐ miàn yě yǒu nín de sūn zi hé sūn nǚ kàn tā men zài wǔ tái shàng gāo xìng de tiào lái tiào qù jué de tè bié kāi xīn jù huì cóng zhōng wǔ shí èr diǎn kāi shǐ yì zhí dào xià wǔ sì diǎn cái jié shù míng nián wǒ hé píng píng dǎ suàn dài zhe liǎng gè hái zi huí lǎo jiā hé bà bà mā mā hái yǒu qí tā jiā rén yì qǐ guò nián duō duō bǎo zhòng nín de ér xí sūn zi sūn nǚ yě zhù nín shēn tǐ jiàn kāng èr lín — Dad and Mom, happy New Year! I just saw the video Dad sent. The whole family, over ten people, spent the New Year together, eating, drinking, talking and laughing; so lively. Dad and Mom look well too, which is great! In California, the US, there is no holiday for Spring Festival, but this year Spring Festival was on a Sunday and nobody was at work, so many Chinese friends gathered in our school’s auditorium. That day everyone brought one or two dishes, and there were also all kinds of drinks, fruit and desserts. I made a red-braised pork and a boiled fish, which everyone liked. The busiest that day was your daughter-in-law Pingping. She organized some friends to perform for everyone. Some sang, some danced, and it was very popular. My favorite item was the children’s dance, which included your grandson and granddaughter. Watching them jump around happily on the stage, I felt especially happy. The party started at twelve noon and did not end until four in the afternoon. Next year Pingping and I plan to take our two children back to our hometown to spend the New Year with you and our other family. Take good care! Your daughter-in-law, grandson and granddaughter also wish you good health! Erlin

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Reading, and Speaking): Sun Laoshi’s email
explanations.body: Last Wednesday your class had a very successful picnic. You invited both Sun Laoshi and Gao Laoshi, but only Sun was able to attend. A. Both teachers contacted you after the event. In pairs, you read Sun Laoshi’s email (subject 孙老师的邮件), and your partner listens to Gao Laoshi’s message (audio, not included). B. Share the main idea of your message with your partner and write down what you heard; to double-check, read the script of Gao Laoshi’s message while your partner reads Sun Laoshi’s email, and give each other feedback. C. Work together to write an email to Gao Laoshi (subject 给高老师的邮件) and describe what happened at the picnic last Wednesday; include the EEIs plus information about the weather, food, and what attendees were talking about. D. Share your email with the class.

examples.text: 马龙：你好！谢谢你邀请我参加星期三的聚会！很长时间没见到同学们，这次见面，发现大家的中文比以前更好了，我非常高兴。那天的活动组织得真不错。我在系里开会一直开到十一点半才过去，到那儿一看，啊，你们准备了那么多又好吃又好看的菜，还有各种饮料和水果，太棒了！我特别喜欢同学们做的苹果派，王老师做的牛肉也好吃，很受欢迎。西瓜是你买的吧？那么甜，我吃了可不少呢。大家坐着边吃边聊，都是讲中文。看来同学们都喜欢学中文，学习也很努力，这是让老师们最开心的事儿。很高兴见到你太太和你们的儿子。你儿子我以前见过，这次又看到他，发现这孩子比上次高了很多，也更可爱了。再次感谢你邀请我参加这次活动！孙老师
examples.translation: mǎ lóng nǐ hǎo xiè xiè nǐ yāo qǐng wǒ cān jiā xīng qī sān de jù huì hěn cháng shí jiān méi jiàn dào tóng xué men zhè cì jiàn miàn fā xiàn dà jiā de zhōng wén bǐ yǐ qián gèng hǎo le wǒ fēi cháng gāo xìng nà tiān de huó dòng zǔ zhī de zhēn bú cuò wǒ zài xì lǐ kāi huì yì zhí kāi dào shí yī diǎn bàn cái guò qù dào nàr yí kàn a nǐ men zhǔn bèi le nà me duō yòu hǎo chī yòu hǎo kàn de cài hái yǒu gè zhǒng yǐn liào hé shuǐ guǒ tài bàng le wǒ tè bié xǐ huān tóng xué men zuò de píng guǒ pài wáng lǎo shī zuò de niú ròu yě hǎo chī hěn shòu huān yíng xī guā shì nǐ mǎi de ba nà me tián wǒ chī le kě bù shǎo ne dà jiā zuò zhe biān chī biān liáo dōu shì jiǎng zhōng wén kàn lái tóng xué men dōu xǐ huān xué zhōng wén xué xí yě hěn nǔ lì zhè shì ràng lǎo shī men zuì kāi xīn de shì ér hěn gāo xìng jiàn dào nǐ tài tài hé nǐ men de ér zi nǐ ér zi wǒ yǐ qián jiàn guò zhè cì yòu kàn dào tā fā xiàn zhè hái zi bǐ shàng cì gāo le hěn duō yě gèng kě ài le zài cì gǎn xiè nǐ yāo qǐng wǒ cān jiā zhè cì huó dòng sūn lǎo shī — Ma Long: Hello! Thank you for inviting me to Wednesday’s gathering! I hadn’t seen the students for a long time; meeting this time, I found everyone’s Chinese better than before, and I’m very happy. The event was really well organized. My meeting at the department went on until eleven thirty before I could come over; when I got there, ah, you had prepared so many delicious and good-looking dishes, plus all kinds of drinks and fruit; wonderful! I especially liked the apple pie the students made, and the beef Teacher Wang made was also tasty and popular. The watermelon was bought by you, right? So sweet; I ate quite a lot. Everyone sat eating and chatting while speaking Chinese. It seems the students all like learning Chinese and study very hard, which is what makes teachers happiest. I was very glad to see your wife and your son. I had seen your son before; seeing him again this time, I found he is much taller than last time and cuter. Thank you again for inviting me to this event! Teacher Sun

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Writing, Reading, and Speaking): the potluck
explanations.body: You are a graduate student at Shenzhen University in China; the president of the Graduate Student Club wants you to help organize an American-style potluck during the coming weekend. A. First, listen to an audio file you found online, then write in Chinese a brief description of potlucks in the United States (audio, not included). B. The potluck took place yesterday. You want to write an article for the Graduate Students Newsletter about the event (title 我们的百乐餐). Use your past experiences and imagination. The following passage may also help. C. Share your work in pairs.

examples.text: 前几天同学老王打来电话，说小钱从美国回来了，想和老同学们一起吃个饭。我说，这次不去饭店吃了，咱们去海边来一次百乐餐怎么样？老王说，好啊，你来组织吧。我马上发邮件给每个同学，告诉他们我的计划，请他们到时候每人带一个菜去海边。老王准备喝的东西，我准备餐具和甜点。聚会那天，我早早地坐公共汽车到了海边，发现有一半的同学早就到了。他们边喝茶边聊天，十分热闹。小钱和他太太也在，还给大家带来了美国巧克力。一会儿大家就都到了，各种各样的饭菜放在一起，差不多有二十个，有鱼、牛肉、猪肉、素菜……，还有饺子和面条。我买了一个大蛋糕，老王带了啤酒、葡萄酒和饮料。大家边吃边聊天，说了很多上大学时候的事。最后，小钱说，欢迎大家明年去美国，到加州玩儿几天。到时候，他会请大家到他们家吃烤肉，大家一起热闹热闹。
examples.translation: qián jǐ tiān tóng xué lǎo wáng dǎ lái diàn huà shuō xiǎo qián cóng měi guó huí lái le xiǎng hé lǎo tóng xué men yì qǐ chī gè fàn wǒ shuō zhè cì bú qù fàn diàn chī le zán men qù hǎi biān lái yí cì bǎi lè cān zěn me yàng lǎo wáng shuō hǎo a nǐ lái zǔ zhī ba wǒ mǎ shàng fā yóu jiàn gěi měi gè tóng xué gào sù tā men wǒ de jì huà qǐng tā men dào shí hòu měi rén dài yí gè cài qù hǎi biān lǎo wáng zhǔn bèi hē de dōng xī wǒ zhǔn bèi cān jù hé tián diǎn jù huì nà tiān wǒ zǎo zǎo de zuò gōng gòng qì chē dào le hǎi biān fā xiàn yǒu yí bàn de tóng xué zǎo jiù dào le tā men biān hē chá biān liáo tiān shí fēn rè nào xiǎo qián hé tā tài tài yě zài hái gěi dà jiā dài lái le měi guó qiǎo kè lì yí huìr dà jiā jiù dōu dào le gè zhǒng gè yàng de fàn cài fàng zài yì qǐ chà bu duō yǒu èr shí gè yǒu yú niú ròu zhū ròu sù cài hái yǒu jiǎo zi hé miàn tiáo wǒ mǎi le yí gè dà dàn gāo lǎo wáng dài le pí jiǔ pú táo jiǔ hé yǐn liào dà jiā biān chī biān liáo tiān shuō le hěn duō shàng dà xué shí hòu de shì zuì hòu xiǎo qián shuō huān yíng dà jiā míng nián qù měi guó dào jiā zhōu wánr jǐ tiān dào shí hòu tā huì qǐng dà jiā dào tā men jiā chī kǎo ròu dà jiā yì qǐ rè nào rè nào — A few days ago my classmate Lao Wang called and said Xiao Qian had come back from the US and wanted to have a meal with old classmates. I said, this time let’s not eat at a restaurant; how about having a potluck by the sea? Lao Wang said, good, you organize it. I immediately emailed every classmate to tell them my plan and ask each to bring a dish to the seaside. Lao Wang would prepare the drinks and I would prepare tableware and dessert. On the day of the gathering I took the bus early to the seaside and found that half of the classmates had arrived long before. They were drinking tea and chatting; very lively. Xiao Qian and his wife were also there and had brought American chocolate for everyone. Soon everybody had arrived; all kinds of food were put together, almost twenty dishes, including fish, beef, pork, vegetables…, as well as dumplings and noodles. I bought a big cake, and Lao Wang brought beer, wine and drinks. Everyone ate and chatted and talked about many things from their university days. In the end Xiao Qian said, everyone is welcome to come to the US next year and play for a few days in California. By then he will invite everyone to his home to have a barbecue and have fun together.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Writing and Speaking): the Chinese New Year report
explanations.body: The local Chinese community celebrated the Chinese New Year last Saturday, and you did your part by helping to prepare a flyer in Chinese for the event. A. Below is a report about the event in the local newspaper. Write a summary in Chinese to share with your classmates, including the EEIs plus several important details. The report: “Around 500 people crowded the Monterey Community Center on Saturday afternoon to celebrate the Chinese New Year, with Monterey’s Mayor as special guest. The event started at 11:30. Speaking at the celebration, Mayor Smith congratulated the Chinese community on the arrival of the Chinese New Year, and he also thanked them for their contribution to the local community. Following the speeches were cultural performances. The performers sang songs and performed traditional Chinese dances. The audience loved the performances so much that they kept cheering and applauding, especially for those done by students from DLI. The organizers ordered food from local Chinese restaurants, and many participants brought their home-made food as well. One elderly lady, Mrs. Liu, brought dumplings she had made. She told the reporter that people in her hometown have to eat dumplings on Chinese New Year’s Eve. The celebrations ended around 3:30 pm. Monterey has been hosting annual celebrations of Chinese Lunar New Year for the last seven years.” B. Pair up and, in Chinese, ask each other about the event. (Pictures, not included.) My Chinese summary:

examples.text: 星期六下午，大约五百人来到蒙特雷社区中心庆祝春节，市长是特别客人。活动十一点半开始，市长向华人社区祝贺春节，也感谢他们对本地社区的贡献。接着是文化表演，大家唱歌，跳传统舞蹈，观众不停地欢呼鼓掌，特别是学生们的表演。主办方在当地的中餐馆订了菜，很多人也带来了自己做的菜。刘奶奶带来了她包的饺子，她说她老家的人除夕一定要吃饺子。庆祝活动三点半左右结束。蒙特雷已经连续七年举办春节庆祝活动。
examples.translation: xīng qī liù xià wǔ dà yuē wǔ bǎi rén lái dào méng tè léi shè qū zhōng xīn qìng zhù chūn jié shì zhǎng shì tè bié kè rén huó dòng shí yī diǎn bàn kāi shǐ shì zhǎng xiàng huá rén shè qū zhù hè chūn jié yě gǎn xiè tā men duì běn dì shè qū de gòng xiàn jiē zhe shì wén huà biǎo yǎn dà jiā chàng gē tiào chuán tǒng wǔ dǎo guān zhòng bù tíng de huān hū gǔ zhǎng tè bié shì xué shēng men de biǎo yǎn zhǔ bàn fāng zài dāng dì de zhōng cān guǎn dìng le cài hěn duō rén yě dài lái le zì jǐ zuò de cài liú nǎi nǎi dài lái le tā bāo de jiǎo zi tā shuō tā lǎo jiā de rén chú xī yí dìng yào chī jiǎo zi qìng zhù huó dòng sān diǎn bàn zuǒ yòu jié shù méng tè léi yǐ jīng lián xù qī nián jǔ bàn chūn jié qìng zhù huó dòng — Mine: On Saturday afternoon about five hundred people came to Monterey Community Center to celebrate Chinese New Year, with the mayor as special guest. The event started at eleven thirty; the mayor congratulated the Chinese community and thanked it for its contribution. Next came cultural performances: singing and traditional dances, and the audience kept cheering and applauding, especially for the students. The organizers ordered food from local Chinese restaurants and many people brought home-made food. Mrs. Liu brought dumplings, saying people in her hometown must eat dumplings on New Year’s Eve. The event ended around three thirty. Monterey has hosted the celebration for seven years.

lessons.title: 391. Lesson 15 Area Studies: Invitations and Parties
lessons.subtitle: 邀请和聚会 · family celebrations · weddings · business receptions

explanations.title: Invitations and Parties
explanations.body: Like all cultures, the Chinese have parties and celebrations to mark rites of passage or important transitions and passages from one stage of life to another. These celebrations share the good fortune of families, promote the success of firms and reaffirm the value of traditions to Chinese both in China and overseas. In general, formal invitations are not very common for Chinese family celebrations, which include housewarming, birthdays, funerals, annual family get-togethers during the autumn, and spring festivals. This is not to say that anyone can attend the celebrations, but the custom of delivering a formal written invitation for family activities is less popular in China than it is in the U.S. Family celebrations are frequently coordinated by word of mouth, phone calls or text messaging. Formal business dinners and government-sponsored banquets, on the other hand, often use written invitations similar to those used in Western cultures. Whether it is an informal phone call or a formal invitation card, the information given is essentially the same. The invitee is informed of the special occasion, when and where the celebration will be held and (often) what to wear or bring. (Photographs, not included.)

explanations.title: Family parties and weddings
explanations.body: Family parties are usually held for culturally identified special occasions. In China these include special birthdays, like celebrating the first month anniversary of a new baby’s birth or the 60th birthday of an adult. For these types of celebrations families invite relatives from near and far and prepare special dishes that are usually eaten only at these special occasions. These parties are likely to be held in the family’s home or the home of a close relative that is large enough to accommodate all the guests. Weddings also are an occasion for large family gatherings. Traditional Chinese society has many wedding rituals and party customs. These elaborate traditions were practiced less frequently in the twentieth century, because of war and internal strife that faced China in the first half of the century. After the founding of the People’s Republic of China, weddings in the city remained low key and were a smaller scale than the large gatherings of the past, which were still common in many parts of the countryside. Today, with China’s economic reforms, increased stability and growing wealth, weddings are again becoming larger and more complex. Some couples have traditional Chinese weddings, some follow Western ceremonies, and some do both!

explanations.title: Business receptions and conclusion
explanations.body: Business receptions and dinners are another sort of party. A foreign businessman or businesswoman may receive an invitation from a senior representative of a Chinese company who will host a dinner or evening reception to which the businessperson is invited. These invitations might also include a reference to attire and even the end time for the function, particularly if it is a reception and not a dinner. Some large enterprises or manufacturing corporations in China also host parties to celebrate their success or any positive changes that occur in their business and the surrounding community. These firms will post announcements on their public bulletin boards to tell their employees where and when to go for the celebration. They also may use invitation letters or even faxes and phone calls to invite local officials to participate as well. In conclusion, Chinese culture shares a link to Western culture in the use of parties and invitations to celebrate significant cultural events. Even though the holidays, foods and customs are unique to China, the activity is one common to the whole world. While formal invitations are less popular in China today than in the West, businesspeople, academics and other professionals who travel to China may well receive a formal dinner, banquet or even a party invitation from a firm or government organization’s representative that they work with. References: “Chinese Festivals and Events” (chinahighlights.com); “Cultural Atlas-China Etiquette” (culturalatlas.sbs.com.au).

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Collocation practice: match the verbs with their most likely objects by writing the object numbers. More than one object may match a verb. Verbs: 点, 下载, 看, 查, 玩, 上, 中, 装, 听. The book leaves the key out; my matches (mine): 点 → 8 鼠标; 下载 → 7 音乐, 4 视频, 9 软件, 2 游戏; 看 → 1 新闻, 4 视频; 查 → 3 邮件; 玩 → 2 游戏; 上 → 5 网瘾; 中 → 6 病毒; 装 → 9 软件; 听 → 7 音乐. B. What did you hear that led to your answer? B. Detailed listening: listen again and list the activities the speakers enjoy online and the issues they encountered (columns 大卫 and 马克). C. Pair up; in Chinese, Student A reports David’s experiences and Student B reports Mark’s. D. With your partner, read Presentation 1 aloud. (Audio, not included.) Activity 3 (Listening and Speaking). Pair up; Student A reports on one half of the family’s internet habits and Student B the other half. C. Survey your classmates on their internet activities and find classmates who match: 1. who spends most of their time online on the weekend; 2. who plays Chinese computer games; 3. who shops online at least five times per month; 4. who has a Facebook account; 5. who makes friends via the internet; 6. who knows how to download a video; 7. whose computer has been infected by a virus. lessons.title: 393. Lesson 16 Presentation 1 grammar: the progressive aspect 正在/在
lessons.subtitle: 我正在学习呢 · 正在 + Predicate + 呢 · 没有在… · 正做着饭呢

explanations.title: The progressive aspect 正在/在
explanations.body: In this presentation, David says 我正在学习呢 to indicate he is studying. Therefore 正在 V(P) 呢 is a pattern that indicates an action (VP) is going on. This pattern has three alternative forms, with no difference in meaning. Statement: 正在 + Predicate + (呢); 正 + Predicate + 呢; 在 + Predicate + (呢); Predicate + 呢. Question: (正)在 + Predicate + 吗？ Negation: 没有(+ 在) + Predicate.

examples.text: 我正在吃饭(呢)。
examples.translation: wǒ zhèng zài chī fàn ne — I am eating.

examples.text: 我正吃饭呢。
examples.translation: wǒ zhèng chī fàn ne — I am eating.

examples.text: 我在吃饭(呢)。
examples.translation: wǒ zài chī fàn ne — I am eating.

examples.text: 我吃饭呢。
examples.translation: wǒ chī fàn ne — I am eating.

examples.text: 我正在学习英文呢！

examples.text: 妈妈正在打电话吗？

examples.translation: lǎo shī méi yǒu zài shàng kè — The teacher is not teaching.

explanations.title: Past, present and future
explanations.body: An action in the progressive aspect may take place at the present time, in the past or the future. 着 used in the continuation of an action sometimes accompanies 正 or 呢.

examples.text: 昨天我给你打电话的时候，你在做什么？

examples.translation: nǐ děng yí huìr zài zǒu wài biān zhèng xià zhe yǔ ne — Wait a while before you leave; it’s raining outside.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Speaking, Listening and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Student A chooses one word from the table (散步, 聊天, 看电影, 上网, 游泳, 照相, 骑自行车 for A; 买东西, 滑雪, 踢球, 吃零食, 喝茶, 打乒乓球, 排队 for B) and acts it out. Student B observes and forms a yes/no question using (正)在 while guessing; Student A answers with the negation or affirmative form. For example: B: 你正在锻炼吗？ A: 我没有在锻炼。 B: 你正在跳舞吗？ A: 对。 B. Each partner takes turns completing the sentences below; the other partner translates the entire sentence into English: 1. 我去他宿舍的时候，____。 2. 老师进教室的时候，____。 3. 我刚才给我女朋友打电话，____。 4. 我昨天下课回家的时候，____。 5. 明天中午的这个时候，____。 My completions (mine):

explanations.body: A. Pair up and read the conversation between two friends, using a timeline to record 林文’s actions (mine: now he is watching TV; half an hour ago he was sleeping at home). Compare your answer with your partner in Chinese using the progressive pattern. B. Listen to a dialog between two friends and mark the statements True or False: 1. Da Li asked Li Dong to help him with his homework. 2. Li Dong is doing his homework and would like to help Da Li later. 3. Da Li’s roommate cannot help him because he is taking a test. 4. The other students in Da Li’s dorm building have all left. 5. Li Dong agrees to go and help Da Li immediately. (Audio, not included.) C. Pair up, compare your answers and explain them in Chinese.

examples.translation: lín wén wǒ zhèng zài jiā lǐ shuì jiào méi tīng jiàn nǐ lái — I was sleeping at home. I didn’t hear you come.

examples.text: 大年：现在我到你那儿去一趟，有一点儿事要跟你说。
examples.translation: dà nián xiàn zài wǒ dào nǐ nàr qù yí tàng yǒu yì diǎnr shì yào gēn nǐ shuō — I’ll come over to your place now; there’s something I need to tell you.

examples.text: 林文：来吧！我等着你。
examples.translation: lín wén lái ba wǒ děng zhe nǐ — Come on! I’ll be waiting for you.

lessons.title: 394. Lesson 16 Presentation 1 grammar: 从来不/没
lessons.subtitle: 她从来不喝酒 · 我从来没有去过中国 · 从不

explanations.title: 从来不
explanations.body: Although 从来 can work in the positive meaning “always,” it is usually used in negation. When used as 从来不, you are saying that you never do something (e.g., as a habit or as a rule). 从来不 may be shortened to 从不 in casual speech. Subject + 从(来)不 + Verb Phrase.

examples.text: 她从来不喝酒。
examples.translation: tā cóng lái bù hē jiǔ — She never drinks alcohol.

examples.text: 他的女朋友从来不给他打电话。
examples.translation: tā de nǚ péng yǒu cóng lái bù gěi tā dǎ diàn huà — His girlfriend never calls him.

examples.text: 我从来不十二点以后睡觉。
examples.translation: wǒ cóng lái bù shí èr diǎn yǐ hòu shuì jiào — I never go to bed after twelve.

examples.text: 我从不一边吃饭一边玩手机。
examples.translation: wǒ cóng bù yì biān chī fàn yì biān wán shǒu jī — I never play with my phone while eating.

explanations.title: 从来没(有)…过
explanations.body: When used as 从来没 or 没有 (and 过 after the verb), you are saying that you have never done something (i.e., it is not a part of your life experience). Subject + 从(来)没有 + Verb + 过.

examples.text: 我从来没有去过中国。
examples.translation: wǒ cóng lái méi yǒu qù guò zhōng guó — I have never been to China.

examples.text: 我从来没有想过这个问题。
examples.translation: wǒ cóng lái méi yǒu xiǎng guò zhè ge wèn tí — I have never thought about this question.

examples.text: 我从来没有听说过这个地方。
examples.translation: wǒ cóng lái méi yǒu tīng shuō guò zhè ge dì fāng — I have never heard of this place.

examples.text: 我从来没有学过这个生词。
examples.translation: wǒ cóng lái méi yǒu xué guò zhè ge shēng cí — I have never learned this new word.

examples.text: 我从来没有出国旅游过。
examples.translation: wǒ cóng lái méi yǒu chū guó lǚ yóu guò — I have never traveled abroad.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: Write three statements about something you have never done or never do, using 从来不/从来没; one of the statements must be false and the other two must be true. Read them aloud to the class and have your classmates guess which are true. My statements (mine):

examples.text: 我从来不吃早饭。
examples.translation: wǒ cóng lái bù chī zǎo fàn — I never eat breakfast. (mine)

examples.text: 我从来没有坐过飞机。
examples.translation: wǒ cóng lái méi yǒu zuò guò fēi jī — I have never flown on a plane. (mine)

examples.text: 我从来不在网上买东西。
examples.translation: wǒ cóng lái bú zài wǎng shàng mǎi dōng xī — I never shop online. (mine)

options: You have never done something once

exercises.prompt: What does 从来没有…过 say?
options: You never do it as a habit

exercises.prompt: How is 从来不 shortened in casual speech?
What does 她从来不喝酒 mean?
What does 我从来没有去过中国 mean?
options: I have never been to China

exercises.prompt: What does 他的女朋友从来不给他打电话 mean?
What does 我从不一边吃饭一边玩手机 mean?
options: I never play on my phone while eating
I always play on my phone

lessons.title: 395. Lesson 16 Presentation 1 grammar: 上 used after a noun
lessons.subtitle: 在网上 · 书上 · 学习上 · 在聚会上 · 班上

explanations.title: 上 used after a noun
explanations.body: When 上 is used after a noun, it indicates range, sphere, limits, or a particular aspect of something, as in 在网上, “online,” 书上, “in the book” and 学习上, “in studies.” (在) + Noun + 上.

examples.text: 许多人在网上买机票，订旅馆，方便极了。
examples.translation: xǔ duō rén zài wǎng shàng mǎi jī piào dìng lǚ guǎn fāng biàn jí le — Many people buy plane tickets and book hotels online; it is extremely convenient.

examples.text: 在聚会上大家常常一边喝酒，一边聊天。
examples.translation: zài jù huì shàng dà jiā cháng cháng yì biān hē jiǔ yì biān liáo tiān — At parties everyone often drinks and chats at the same time.

examples.text: 她是我们班上最努力的学生。
examples.translation: tā shì wǒ men bān shàng zuì nǔ lì de xué shēng — She is the hardest-working student in our class.

examples.text: 在生活上我们什么都有，所以我们要多帮助别人。
examples.translation: zài shēng huó shàng wǒ men shén me dōu yǒu suǒ yǐ wǒ men yào duō bāng zhù bié rén — In life we have everything, so we should help others more.

explanations.title: Activity 4 看图说话 (Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Describe each of five pictures using the “N + 上” construction (pictures, not included). Example: 这个人在电视上/网上玩电脑游戏。 B. Pair up. Read the following conversation between a teacher and student with your partner. Take turns writing translations of the underlined sentences (the three sentences are: 1) 你今天在中文课上讲的语法，我还不太懂。 2) 你先回家看看你的书，书上有练习。 3) 要是你看了书还不会，你把语法上的问题写在笔记本上，明天下课以后，我再给你讲。). Speakers: 李大力 and 王老师.

examples.text: 这个人在电视上/网上玩电脑游戏。
examples.translation: zhè ge rén zài diàn shì shàng wǎng shàng wán diàn nǎo yóu xì — This person is playing a computer game on TV/online. (the book’s example)

examples.text: 你今天在中文课上讲的语法，我还不太懂。
examples.translation: nǐ jīn tiān zài zhōng wén kè shàng jiǎng de yǔ fǎ wǒ hái bú tài dǒng — I still don’t quite understand the grammar you taught in Chinese class today.

examples.text: 你先回家看看你的书，书上有练习。
examples.translation: nǐ xiān huí jiā kàn kàn nǐ de shū shū shàng yǒu liàn xí — First go home and look at your book; there are exercises in the book.

examples.text: 要是你看了书还不会，你把语法上的问题写在笔记本上，明天下课以后，我再给你讲。
examples.translation: yào shì nǐ kàn le shū hái bú huì nǐ bǎ yǔ fǎ shàng de wèn tí xiě zài bǐ jì běn shàng míng tiān xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ zài gěi nǐ jiǎng — If you still can’t do it after reading the book, write the grammar problems in your notebook, and tomorrow after class I’ll explain to you.

options: Range, sphere or aspect (e.g. online, in the book)

lessons.title: 396. Lesson 16 Presentation 1: skill integration
lessons.subtitle: 你有网瘾吗？ · 怎么在网上玩游戏 · 网吧和网咖

explanations.title: Activity 1 你有网瘾吗？ (Listening, Speaking and Writing)
explanations.body: A. You are studying at Beijing University. One day you receive a phone call from a polling company asking you to complete a survey. Listen to the questions (nine) and answer them based on your situation; several answers are chosen from 总是, 常常, 不常, 从不. B. Using the findings of the survey, the whole class discusses key elements of identifying someone with internet addiction and makes a list of the elements. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): how to play an online game
explanations.body: A. David is asking a friend to show him how to play an online computer game. Read the instructions and write the key steps in the boxes (第一步, 第二步, 第三步, 第四步, 最后). B. Pair up and, in Chinese, share your work. C. Think of an online activity you often do (e.g., shopping, downloading e-books, streaming movies or music) and write four steps of simple instructions for your partner. D. In Chinese, share your instructions verbally. My key steps (mine): 第一步 get a computer that can get online; 第二步 go to a game-download website and choose a game; 第三步 open an account, set a user name and password, and pay by credit card; 第四步 download and play, alone or with online friends; 最后 be careful, because downloading may bring a virus.

examples.text: 要是你要上网玩游戏，你得做一些准备。第一步，你的电脑需要能上网，这样你能在网上找可以下载电脑游戏的网站。第二步是到那个网站去。网站上会有各种各样的游戏，有些是学习的游戏，有些是锻练的游戏。你可以挑选你喜欢的，游戏不一样，价钱也不一样。第三步，你得在这个网站开一个账户，设好用户名和密码。这样你才可以在网上付钱。你用信用卡付完钱后，就可以在网上下载你买的游戏。第四步，下载完游戏，你就可以开始玩了。你可以自己一个人玩或是在网上找网友一块儿玩。最后我想说的是上网下载游戏得小心。最好去你常去的网站，因为下载游戏可能让你的电脑中病毒。
examples.translation: yào shì nǐ yào shàng wǎng wán yóu xì nǐ děi zuò yì xiē zhǔn bèi dì yī bù nǐ de diàn nǎo xū yào néng shàng wǎng zhè yàng nǐ néng zài wǎng shàng zhǎo kě yǐ xià zài diàn nǎo yóu xì de wǎng zhàn dì èr bù shì dào nà ge wǎng zhàn qù wǎng zhàn shàng huì yǒu gè zhǒng gè yàng de yóu xì yǒu xiē shì xué xí de yóu xì yǒu xiē shì duàn liàn de yóu xì nǐ kě yǐ tiāo xuǎn nǐ xǐ huān de yóu xì bù yí yàng jià qián yě bù yí yàng dì sān bù nǐ děi zài zhè ge wǎng zhàn kāi yí gè zhàng hù shè hǎo yòng hù míng hé mì mǎ zhè yàng nǐ cái kě yǐ zài wǎng shàng fù qián nǐ yòng xìn yòng kǎ fù wán qián hòu jiù kě yǐ zài wǎng shàng xià zài nǐ mǎi de yóu xì dì sì bù xià zài wán yóu xì nǐ jiù kě yǐ kāi shǐ wán le nǐ kě yǐ zì jǐ yí gè rén wán huò shì zài wǎng shàng zhǎo wǎng yǒu yí kuài ér wán zuì hòu wǒ xiǎng shuō de shì shàng wǎng xià zài yóu xì děi xiǎo xīn zuì hǎo qù nǐ cháng qù de wǎng zhàn yīn wèi xià zài yóu xì kě néng ràng nǐ de diàn nǎo zhòng bìng dú — If you want to play games online, you have to make some preparations. Step one: your computer needs to be able to get online, so that you can find websites online where you can download computer games. Step two is to go to that website. There will be all kinds of games on the website, some for learning and some for exercise. You can choose the ones you like; games differ, and so do prices. Step three: you have to open an account on this website and set a user name and password. Only then can you pay online. After you pay with a credit card, you can download the game you bought online. Step four: when the download is finished, you can start playing. You can play by yourself, or find online friends to play together. Finally, what I want to say is that downloading games online requires caution. It is best to go to websites you often use, because downloading games may give your computer a virus.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening, Speaking and Writing)
explanations.body: New vocabulary: 保龄球 (bǎolíngqiú; bowling). A. Listen to the conversation and answer: 1. What is the relationship between the two speakers? 2. What conclusion does the first speaker come to? B. Listen again and, in the table, list the differences described between Taiwanese young people (台湾年轻人) and Teacher Li (李老师). C. Pair up and, in Chinese, share your answer. D. Work with your partner to think of five questions about your teacher’s internet or recreational activities, select one of your team’s teachers to interview, then write a summary report (我的老师) and post it on MS Teams or Linoit. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading and Speaking): the internet bar
explanations.body: A. Read the passage and use the timeline as a template to illustrate the development of an internet cafe in China. B. Pair up and share your answers in Chinese; each student reports one block of information, and you take turns reporting the entire story.

examples.text: 以前中国人家里有电脑的不多，所以网路刚开始流行的时候，很多人喜欢去网吧上网。在网吧你可以上网看新闻或是发电子邮件。后来网吧的服务越来越多，你不但能在网吧上网，还能点东西吃。所以很多地方又把网吧叫做网咖（网路咖啡店）。他们除了咖啡以外，还卖很多吃的和喝的东西，像其它的饮料、小吃、方便面什么的。近几年来，因为有越来越多人家里都装了电脑，也有了手机，他们随时都能上网看新闻，发电子邮件。所以现在很多人去网咖都是为了打电子游戏。他们一打就是几个小时，还有人一连几天都“住”在网咖里。有些网咖还有洗澡的地方，不想吃网咖的东西还可以点外卖，方便、舒服极了！
examples.translation: yǐ qián zhōng guó rén jiā lǐ yǒu diàn nǎo de bù duō suǒ yǐ wǎng lù gāng kāi shǐ liú xíng de shí hòu hěn duō rén xǐ huān qù wǎng ba shàng wǎng zài wǎng ba nǐ kě yǐ shàng wǎng kàn xīn wén huò shì fā diàn zi yóu jiàn hòu lái wǎng ba de fú wù yuè lái yuè duō nǐ bú dàn néng zài wǎng ba shàng wǎng hái néng diǎn dōng xī chī suǒ yǐ hěn duō dì fāng yòu bǎ wǎng ba jiào zuò wǎng kā wǎng lù kā fēi diàn tā men chú le kā fēi yǐ wài hái mài hěn duō chī de hé hē de dōng xī xiàng qí tā de yǐn liào xiǎo chī fāng biàn miàn shén me de jìn jǐ nián lái yīn wèi yǒu yuè lái yuè duō rén jiā lǐ dōu zhuāng le diàn nǎo yě yǒu le shǒu jī tā men suí shí dōu néng shàng wǎng kàn xīn wén fā diàn zi yóu jiàn suǒ yǐ xiàn zài hěn duō rén qù wǎng kā dōu shì wèi le dǎ diàn zǐ yóu xì tā men yì dǎ jiù shì jǐ gè xiǎo shí hái yǒu rén yì lián jǐ tiān dōu zhù zài wǎng kā lǐ yǒu xiē wǎng kā hái yǒu xǐ zǎo de dì fāng bù xiǎng chī wǎng kā de dōng xī hái kě yǐ diǎn wài mài fāng biàn shū fú jí le — In the past not many Chinese families had a computer at home, so when the internet first became popular, many people liked to go to internet bars to get online. At an internet bar you could go online to read the news or send email. Later the internet bars offered more and more services: you could not only get online but also order things to eat. So in many places internet bars were also called 网咖 (internet cafes). Besides coffee they also sell many things to eat and drink, such as other drinks, snacks, instant noodles and so on. In recent years, because more and more homes have installed computers and people also have mobile phones, they can go online anytime to read the news and send email. So now many people go to internet cafes in order to play video games. They play for hours at a stretch, and some even “live” in the internet cafe for days in a row. Some internet cafes even have places to take a shower, and if you don’t want to eat the cafe’s food you can order takeout; extremely convenient and comfortable!

exercises.explanation: 有些网咖还有洗澡的地方，可以点外卖。

lessons.title: 397. Lesson 16 Presentation 1: using Chinese in context
lessons.subtitle: 网咖的好处 · 订单和寄 · 网咖的比较 · 电子书项目

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to a conversation between two friends and list at least four advantages of using an internet cafe (网咖). B. Pair up and, in Chinese, discuss your answers. C. Number the sentences below in a logical order; the first sentence (张华: 大明，休息的时候你都做些什么？) has been done for you. The book prints the twelve lines out of order; the order below is my key (mine): 1 张华, 2 大明, 3 张华, 4 大明, 5 张华, 6 大明, 7 张华, 8 大明, 9 张华, 10 大明, 11 张华, 12 大明. (Audio, not included.)

examples.text: 张华：大明，休息的时候你都做些什么？
examples.translation: zhāng huá dà míng xiū xī de shí hòu nǐ dōu zuò xiē shén me — Daming, what do you do when you rest?

examples.text: 大明：我喜欢上网玩游戏。
examples.translation: dà míng wǒ xǐ huān shàng wǎng wán yóu xì — I like to play games online.

examples.text: 张华：你在家里打吗？
examples.translation: zhāng huá nǐ zài jiā lǐ dǎ ma — Do you play at home?

examples.text: 大明：家里上网太慢，我喜欢去网咖打。网咖上网快得多。
examples.translation: dà míng jiā lǐ shàng wǎng tài màn wǒ xǐ huān qù wǎng kā dǎ wǎng kā shàng wǎng kuài de duō — Internet at home is too slow; I like to play at the internet cafe. It’s much faster there.

examples.text: 张华：在网吧打游戏很贵吧？
examples.translation: zhāng huá zài wǎng ba dǎ yóu xì hěn guì ba — Isn’t playing games at an internet bar expensive?

examples.text: 大明：不太贵，一个小时大约十块。而且网咖什么游戏都有。想玩什么就玩什么。
examples.translation: dà míng bú tài guì yí gè xiǎo shí dà yuē shí kuài ér qiě wǎng kā shén me yóu xì dōu yǒu xiǎng wán shén me jiù wán shén me — Not very; about ten yuan an hour. And the cafe has every game. You play whatever you want.

examples.text: 张华：那网咖还有什么别的服务吗？
examples.translation: zhāng huá nà wǎng kā hái yǒu shén me bié de fú wù ma — Does the cafe have any other services?

examples.text: 大明：有啊！有时要是你打累了，想吃东西也没问题。只要鼠标点一下，服务员就会把你点的东西送过来。非常方便。
examples.translation: dà míng yǒu a yǒu shí yào shì nǐ dǎ lèi le xiǎng chī dōng xī yě méi wèn tí zhǐ yào shǔ biāo diǎn yí xià fú wù yuán jiù huì bǎ nǐ diǎn de dōng xī sòng guò lái fēi cháng fāng biàn — Yes! If you get tired from playing and want to eat, no problem. Just click the mouse and the waiter will bring what you ordered. Very convenient.

examples.text: 张华：听起来挺不错的！
examples.translation: zhāng huá tīng qǐ lái tǐng bú cuò de — Sounds pretty good!

examples.text: 大明：是啊！我还在网咖认识许多网友。我们常一块上网打游戏！比自己在家玩有意思得多！

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Speaking, Listening, Writing and Reading): instructional e-book project
explanations.body: Most DLI students currently enrolled are “digital natives.” However, some teachers are not. In order to help teachers narrow the technology gap, your class is creating an instructional e-book that shows teachers how to utilize technology and the internet to make their lives more convenient. A. Work in groups of three. Identify and list three key online activities you think your teachers would benefit from in your instruction. B. Select one activity from your group list. Follow the layout you learned in Activity 2 of the Skill Integration section and write step-by-step instructions in Chinese. C. Peer review: share your instructions with your group member and help each other revise them to ensure the language is clear and easy to follow. D. Publish your group instruction pages on MS Teams Wiki; each group reads the other groups’ work and provides feedback. E. The class combines each group’s final products into one e-book.

explanations.title: Getting Started

explanations.body: The book also prints the dialog in traditional characters. Note: 听起来, a colloquial expression, in English similar to “sounds like”.

examples.text: 马克：平常空闲的时候你喜欢做什么？
examples.translation: mǎ kè píng cháng kòng xián de shí hòu nǐ xǐ huān zuò shén me — What do you like to do in your free time?

examples.text: 琳达：我以前特别喜欢去歌厅唱歌或是去舞厅跳舞。不过最近学习很紧张，已经好久没去了。
examples.translation: lín dá wǒ yǐ qián tè bié xǐ huān qù gē tīng chàng gē huò shì qù wǔ tīng tiào wǔ bú guò zuì jìn xué xí hěn jǐn zhāng yǐ jīng hǎo jiǔ méi qù le — I used to especially like going to a karaoke hall to sing or to a dance hall to dance. explanations.body: A. Read the passage below and complete the sentences using the linguistic and contextual clues, without consulting Presentation 2 first. Word box: 合唱团, 音乐, 报名, 表演, 乐队, 鼓, 吉他, 粉丝, 跳舞. The book leaves nine blanks; my completed passage (mine):

examples.text: 最近琳达学习很忙，没有时间去歌厅唱歌或是去舞厅跳舞。所以马克告诉她学校就有合唱团。要是她感兴趣，她可以去打听一下看怎么报名。马克不喜欢合唱，但是他也对音乐感兴趣，所以他参加了一个摇滚乐队。他的乐队有三个人，每个人玩不一样的乐器。马克打鼓，他的朋友弹吉他和键盘。除了自己玩音乐以外，他的乐队也会在别的地方表演。下个星期他们会在一个音乐节演出。琳达打算去看看。说不定她会成为他们的粉丝。

His band has three people, and each plays a different instrument. Mark plays drums, and his friends play guitar and keyboard. Besides playing music by themselves, his band also performs elsewhere. Next week they will perform at a music festival. Linda plans to go and see. She may well become their fan. (completed text; the blanks are filled by me: 跳舞, 合唱团, 报名, 音乐, 乐队, 鼓, 吉他, 表演, 粉丝)

lessons.title: 400. Lesson 16 Presentation 2 grammar: 就 to express “ease”
lessons.subtitle: 学校就有一个合唱团 · 超级市场就有三家 · 五分钟就可以做完

explanations.title: 就 to express “ease”
explanations.body: In the previous lessons and units you have learned various uses of 就, indicating “then,” “as soon as,” “just/only,” and “indeed/exactly.” In this lesson, 就 is used to express the “ease” of doing something. Subject + 就 + Verb.

examples.text: 学校就有一个合唱团，人人都可以参加。
examples.translation: xué xiào jiù yǒu yí gè hé chàng tuán rén rén dōu kě yǐ cān jiā — The school has a choir that everyone can join. (right there)

examples.text: 住在这里很方便，超级市场就有三家。
examples.translation: zhù zài zhè lǐ hěn fāng biàn chāo jí shì chǎng jiù yǒu sān jiā — Living here is convenient; there are three supermarkets right here.

examples.text: 蒙特雷的蔬菜很便宜，五块钱就可以买到好几把。
examples.translation: méng tè léi de shū cài hěn pián yi wǔ kuài qián jiù kě yǐ mǎi dào hǎo jǐ bǎ — Vegetables in Monterey are cheap; five dollars buys several bunches.

examples.text: 去银行转账太麻烦，上网五分钟就可以做完。
examples.translation: qù yín háng zhuǎn zhàng tài má fán shàng wǎng wǔ fēn zhōng jiù kě yǐ zuò wán — Going to the bank to transfer money is too troublesome; online it takes only five minutes.

examples.text: 买机票不用找旅行社，我女朋友就可以帮你。

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: One of your friends has just moved to Monterey and, because of their unfamiliarity with the city, voiced complaints about accomplishing tasks. You want to persuade them of the convenience and ease with which the activities can be done, using the 就 pattern. Pair up: Student A makes complaints based on the situations; Student B uses the 就 pattern to persuade. The five situations: 1. 我很想吃 pizza，可是 Costco 太远。 2. 我想吃中国饭，可是不想走到蒙特雷市中心。 3. 我得买衬衫，可是我没有车。 4. 我想坐公共汽车去 Del Monte 电影院，可是我不知道哪儿有公共汽车站？ 5. 我听说蒙特雷的公寓不好找。 The book’s example and my answers (mine):

examples.text: 我很喜欢举重，可是在蒙特雷很难找到健身房。

examples.text: 你刚来，还不太熟悉蒙特雷，蒙特雷有很多健身房，你公寓的附近就有三家。
examples.translation: nǐ gāng lái hái bú tài shú xī méng tè léi méng tè léi yǒu hěn duō jiàn shēn fáng nǐ gōng yù de fù jìn jiù yǒu sān jiā — Student B: You just arrived and aren’t familiar with Monterey yet; there are many gyms, and near your apartment there are three.

examples.text: 你家附近就有两家比萨店，十分钟就可以走到。
examples.translation: nǐ jiā fù jìn jiù yǒu liǎng jiā bǐ sà diàn shí fēn zhōng jiù kě yǐ zǒu dào — 1. There are two pizza places right near your home; you can walk there in ten minutes. (mine)

examples.text: 你不用去市中心，学校旁边就有一家很好的中国饭馆。
examples.translation: nǐ bú yòng qù shì zhōng xīn xué xiào páng biān jiù yǒu yì jiā hěn hǎo de zhōng guó fàn guǎn — 2. You don’t need to go downtown; there is a very good Chinese restaurant right next to the school. (mine)

examples.text: 你不用开车，学校的商店就有衬衫。
examples.translation: nǐ bú yòng kāi chē xué xiào de shāng diàn jiù yǒu chèn shān — 3. You don’t need to drive; the school store has shirts. (mine)

lessons.title: 401. Lesson 16 Presentation 2 grammar: the 越来越 construction
lessons.subtitle: 越来越好 · 越吃越多 · 越多越好 · 越讲越高兴

explanations.title: The 越来越 construction
explanations.body: The 越来越 construction indicates comparison and may be used to show how a person or thing changes in a certain respect as time goes on. When the 越来越 construction is used, no other adverbs of degree, such as 很, 非常, 太, can be placed after it to modify the predicate. For example, it is incorrect to say “*天气越来越很冷了。” Subject + 越来越 + Adj./Mental Verb.

examples.text: 大卫的中文越来越好了。
examples.translation: dà wèi de zhōng wén yuè lái yuè hǎo le — David’s Chinese is getting better and better.

examples.text: 这里的天气越来越冷了。
examples.translation: zhè lǐ de tiān qì yuè lái yuè lěng le — The weather here is getting colder and colder.

examples.text: 我越来越喜欢学习中文了。
examples.translation: wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐ huān xué xí zhōng wén le — I like studying Chinese more and more.

explanations.title: 越…越… (越 A 越 B)
explanations.body: 越来越 has a variation 越 A 越 B, which indicates that B changes according to the change of A. Subj. + 越 + V + 越 + Adj./Mental Verb (examples 1 and 2). Subj. + 越 Adj. 越 + Adj. (examples 3 and 4). Subj. 1 + 越 + V, Subj. 2 + 越 + Adj./mental Verb (examples 5 and 6).

examples.text: 他越吃越多。
examples.translation: tā yuè chī yuè duō — The more he eats, the more he eats. (越+V+越+Adj.)

examples.text: 他的中文越学越好。
examples.translation: tā de zhōng wén yuè xué yuè hǎo — The more he studies, the better his Chinese gets.

examples.text: 大家都说朋友越多越好。
examples.translation: dà jiā dōu shuō péng yǒu yuè duō yuè hǎo — Everyone says the more friends the better. (越+Adj.+越+Adj.)

examples.text: 蒙特雷的房子越大越贵。
examples.translation: méng tè léi de fáng zi yuè dà yuè guì — In Monterey, the bigger the house the more expensive.

examples.text: 他越讲，他的太太越高兴。
examples.translation: tā yuè jiǎng tā de tài tài yuè gāo xìng — The more he talks, the happier his wife is. (Subj. 1 越 V, Subj. 2 越 Adj.)

examples.text: 他越说，我们越害怕。
examples.translation: tā yuè shuō wǒ men yuè hài pà — The more he speaks, the more afraid we are.

explanations.title: Activities 2 and 3
explanations.body: Activity 2 (Reading, Speaking, Listening) Your Opinion Counts! A. Pair up. Student A uses Column A (汉字, 蒙特雷的气候, 我的家乡, 我的朋友, 我的家人, 我的身体, 考试, 我的听力课/语法课/说话课, 我的作业) and Student B uses Column B (多, 差, 好, 漂亮, 麻烦, 有意思, 闷热, 长, 可爱) to create a sentence using 越来越/越…越…; the partner translates orally. The book’s examples and my sentences (mine):

examples.text: 我的汉字越学越好。
examples.translation: wǒ de hàn zì yuè xué yuè hǎo — Student A: The more I learn characters, the better I am. (the book’s example)

examples.text: 我们要记的生词越来越多。
examples.translation: wǒ men yào jì de shēng cí yuè lái yuè duō — Student B: There are more and more new words we need to memorize. (the book’s example)

examples.text: 蒙特雷的气候越来越差。
examples.translation: méng tè léi de qì hòu yuè lái yuè chà — Monterey’s climate is getting worse and worse. (mine)

examples.text: 我的家乡越来越漂亮。
examples.translation: wǒ de jiā xiāng yuè lái yuè piào liàng — My hometown is getting more and more beautiful. (mine)

examples.text: 考试越来越麻烦。
examples.translation: kǎo shì yuè lái yuè má fán — Exams are getting more and more troublesome. (mine)

examples.text: 我的作业越来越多。
examples.translation: wǒ de zuò yè yuè lái yuè duō — My homework is getting more and more. (mine)

explanations.title: Activity 2 B and Activity 3
explanations.body: B. Using the following questions, interview your partner to learn their opinions: 1. 你觉得什么越多越好？什么越少越好？ 2. 你觉得什么越快越好？什么越慢越好？ 3. 你觉得什么越来越贵？什么越来越便宜？ 4. 你觉得什么越来越方便？什么越来越麻烦？ 5. 你觉得什么越玩越有意思？ 6. 你觉得什么越吃越好吃？ 7. 你觉得越做什么越想睡觉？ C. The class shares the findings they found interesting. Activity 3 (Listening, Speaking and Writing). A. Listen to a conversation between two friends and write four differences you heard about life in Beijing before and now. B. Pair up and, in Chinese, compare your answers by repeating the sentence using the 越来越/越…越 structure. C. Write a brief report using 越来越/越…越 about how your life has changed after coming to DLI to study Chinese; post it on Linoit and share with your classmates. (Audio, not included.)

options: A change that grows as time goes on
大卫的中文越来越好了
我越来越喜欢学习中文了
exercises.explanation: No degree adverb after 越来越.

exercises.prompt: What does 他的中文越学越好 mean?
options: The more he studies, the better his Chinese

exercises.prompt: What does 朋友越多越好 mean?
What does 蒙特雷的房子越大越贵 mean?
options: In Monterey, the bigger the house, the more expensive

exercises.prompt: What does 他越说，我们越害怕 mean?
options: The more he speaks, the more afraid we are
exercises.explanation: Subj. 1 越 V, Subj. 2 越 Adj.

exercises.prompt: What does 这里的天气越来越冷了 mean?
options: The weather here is getting colder and colder

exercises.prompt: 我___来越喜欢学习中文了。

lessons.title: 402. Lesson 16 Presentation 2 grammar: reduplication of measure words (量词重叠)
lessons.subtitle: 人人都 · 天天都 · 个个都 · 次次都 · 家家的门上都

explanations.title: Reduplication of measure words (量词重叠)
explanations.body: The reduplication of measure words indicates the meaning of “everyone or everything without exception.” It is usually followed by 都. This pattern can only be used as subjects or attributes of subjects; it cannot be used as the objects or attributes of objects. For example, one cannot say: “*我告诉人人。” “*我喜欢张张照片。” Subj. + AA + 都; AA + Subj. + 都; AA 的 + noun phrase + 都 (used as attribute of the subject).

examples.text: 学校就有一个合唱团，人人都可以参加。
examples.translation: xué xiào jiù yǒu yí gè hé chàng tuán rén rén dōu kě yǐ cān jiā — The school has a choir that everyone can join.

examples.text: 他天天都上网玩游戏。
examples.translation: tā tiān tiān dōu shàng wǎng wán yóu xì — He plays games online every day.

examples.text: 他们个个都喜欢学汉字。
examples.translation: tā men gè gè dōu xǐ huān xué hàn zì — They each and every one like learning characters.

examples.text: 这个风景点他去了很多次，次次都觉得有意思。
examples.translation: zhè ge fēng jǐng diǎn tā qù le hěn duō cì cì cì dōu jué de yǒu yì si — He has been to this scenic spot many times and finds it interesting every time. (adverbial)

examples.text: 春节到了，家家的门上都挂着红色的春字。
examples.translation: chūn jié dào le jiā jiā de mén shàng dōu guà zhe hóng sè de chūn zì — Spring Festival has arrived; every home has the red character “spring” hung on its door. (attribute of the subject)

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Speaking and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Use the characters in the box (个个, 天天, 样样, 人人, 张张, 件件) to complete the sentences with reduplication of measure words: 1. 这些照片___都很漂亮。 2. 她___都去公园跳广场舞。 3. 现在___都会用手机上网。 4. 百货公司的衣服，___价格都很贵。 5. Costco 的东西___都很便宜。 6. 他的家人___都是军人。 B. With your partner, read your answers aloud and provide a rationale. C. As a class, use the topic “our class” to find something you and your classmates have in common and create a list of sentences using reduplication of measure words (the book’s example: 我们班天天都有生词考试). The book leaves the key out; my answers: 1 张张, 2 天天, 3 人人, 4 件件, 5 样样, 6 个个 (mine):

examples.text: 这些照片张张都很漂亮。
examples.translation: zhè xiē zhào piān zhāng zhāng dōu hěn piào liàng — 1. Every one of these photos is beautiful. (mine)

examples.text: 她天天都去公园跳广场舞。
examples.translation: tā tiān tiān dōu qù gōng yuán tiào guǎng chǎng wǔ — 2. She goes to the park to do square dancing every day. (mine)

examples.text: 现在人人都会用手机上网。
examples.translation: xiàn zài rén rén dōu huì yòng shǒu jī shàng wǎng — 3. Nowadays everybody can use a phone to get online. (mine)

examples.text: 百货公司的衣服，件件价格都很贵。
examples.translation: bǎi huò gōng sī de yī fú jiàn jiàn jià gé dōu hěn guì — 4. The clothes at the department store: every piece is expensive. (mine)

examples.text: 东西样样都很便宜。
examples.translation: dōng xī yàng yàng dōu hěn pián yi — 5. Everything at the warehouse store is cheap. (mine; the book writes the store name in Latin letters)

examples.text: 他的家人个个都是军人。
examples.translation: tā de jiā rén gè gè dōu shì jūn rén — 6. His family members are all in the military. (mine)

examples.text: 我们班天天都有生词考试。
examples.translation: wǒ men bān tiān tiān dōu yǒu shēng cí kǎo shì — (the book’s example) In our class there is a new-word quiz every day.

exercises.prompt: What does a reduplicated measure word mean?
What does 人人都可以参加 mean?
What does 天天都上网 mean?
What does 个个都喜欢学汉字 mean?
options: Each and every one likes learning characters

exercises.prompt: What does 次次都觉得有意思 mean?

options: 家家的门上都挂着春字

exercises.prompt: Which fills 这些照片___都很漂亮？
exercises.explanation: 张 is the measure word for photos.

exercises.prompt: Which fills 百货公司的衣服，___价格都很贵？
她天天___去公园跳广场舞。

lessons.title: 403. Lesson 16 Presentation 2 grammar: 对…感兴趣
lessons.subtitle: 我对合唱不太感兴趣 · 他对学习外语很感兴趣 · 旅游、音乐、乐器

explanations.title: 对…感兴趣
explanations.body: In English, we use statements to say that we are “interested in something.” In this construction, “something” terminates the sentence. However, in Chinese, you “对 something 感兴趣.” Statement: Subj. + 对 + something/person/verb phrase + 感兴趣。 Negation: Subj. + 对 + something/person/verb phrase + 不 + 感兴趣。

examples.text: 我对合唱不太感兴趣。
examples.translation: wǒ duì hé chàng bú tài gǎn xìng qù — I am not very interested in choral singing.

examples.text: 我对这个人感兴趣。
examples.translation: wǒ duì zhè ge rén gǎn xìng qù — I am interested in this person.

examples.text: 他对参加乐队感兴趣。
examples.translation: tā duì cān jiā yuè duì gǎn xìng qù — He is interested in joining a band.

examples.text: 他对学习外语很感兴趣。
examples.translation: tā duì xué xí wài yǔ hěn gǎn xìng qù — He is very interested in learning foreign languages.

examples.text: 老师对她以后的打算很感兴趣。
examples.translation: lǎo shī duì tā yǐ hòu de dǎ suàn hěn gǎn xìng qù — The teacher is very interested in her future plans.

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Speaking, and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Below are topics people may be interested in (旅游, 参加聚会, 参观 XXX, 音乐, 学乐器, 看电影, 锻炼/健身). Interview your classmates; in addition to the topic question, ask at least one follow-up question to get more information and write the responses in the table (Who, Additional info). If the answer is no, move on to the next student. B. Guessing game: each student writes 3–4 sentences on a blank card describing what they are interested in and why, using 对…感兴趣; the teacher gathers the cards and puts them in a box; each student draws a card and reads it aloud, and the class guesses who wrote it (if a student draws their own card they draw another). The book’s example dialog and example card:

examples.text: 你对旅游感兴趣吗？
examples.translation: nǐ duì lǚ yóu gǎn xìng qù ma — Student A: Are you interested in travel? (the book’s example)

examples.text: 对，我对旅游感兴趣。
examples.translation: duì wǒ duì lǚ yóu gǎn xìng qù — Student B: Yes, I’m interested in travel.

examples.text: 不，我对旅游不感兴趣。
examples.translation: bù wǒ duì lǚ yóu bù gǎn xìng qù — No, I’m not interested in travel.

examples.text: 你对坐飞机旅游感兴趣还是坐火车旅游感兴趣？
examples.translation: nǐ duì zuò fēi jī lǚ yóu gǎn xìng qù hái shì zuò huǒ chē lǚ yóu gǎn xìng qù — Are you interested in traveling by plane or by train? (additional question)

examples.text: 我对坐火车旅游感兴趣。
examples.translation: wǒ duì zuò huǒ chē lǚ yóu gǎn xìng qù — I’m interested in traveling by train.

examples.text: 为什么？
examples.translation: wèi shén me — Why? (additional question)

examples.text: 我高中的时候开始对弹吉他很感兴趣。那个时候我去听了一场吉他音乐会。里面的吉他手弹得很棒！后来我的妈妈送了我一把吉他当生日礼物，所以我就开始自学吉他。
examples.translation: wǒ gāo zhōng de shí hòu kāi shǐ duì dàn jí tā hěn gǎn xìng qù nà ge shí hòu wǒ qù tīng le yì cháng jí tā yīn yuè huì lǐ miàn de jí tā shǒu dàn de hěn bàng hòu lái wǒ de mā mā sòng le wǒ yì bǎ jí tā dāng shēng rì lǐ wù suǒ yǐ wǒ jiù kāi shǐ zì xué jí tā — When I was in high school I began to be very interested in playing the guitar. At that time I went to a guitar concert. The guitarist there played wonderfully! Later my mother gave me a guitar as a birthday present, so I started to teach myself guitar. (the book’s example card)

exercises.prompt: How do you say “interested in X”?
What does 我对合唱不太感兴趣 mean?
options: I’m not very interested in choral singing

exercises.prompt: What does 他对学习外语很感兴趣 mean?
options: He is very interested in learning foreign languages

exercises.prompt: What does 老师对她以后的打算很感兴趣 mean?
options: The teacher is very interested in her future plans
She is interested in the teacher

exercises.prompt: How did the example writer start learning guitar?
options: Her mother gave her a guitar as a birthday gift
exercises.explanation: 妈妈送了我一把吉他当生日礼物.

lessons.title: 404. Lesson 16 Presentation 2: skill integration
lessons.subtitle: ＫＴＶ唱歌 · 两个音乐会 · 旧金山交响乐团 · 上海音乐厅

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 3 (listening)
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening and Speaking). A. Listen to the dialogs twice and answer the questions. Dialog 1: 1. What is the upcoming event? When and where will it be held? 2. What will the male speaker do for the female speaker? 3. What is the female speaker instructed to do? Dialog 2: 1. What is the topic of the conversation? 2. What questions are asked by the first speaker? (list three) 3. What advice is given by the second speaker? (list two) B. In Chinese, share your answers with your partner. Activity 3 (Listening and Speaking). Below are two conversations between a male and a female. Listen once and answer the questions for each conversation (What is the relationship between the two speakers? Where did this conversation most likely take place? What did they discuss? / What information has the male speaker requested from the female speaker? (list two)); listen again to learn additional details and decide which conversation happens first and which next, and give your rationale. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Speaking and Listening): a college student’s diary
explanations.body: New vocabulary: 休闲娱乐 (xiūxián yúlè; entertainment and recreation), 爱好 (àihào; hobby), 博物馆 (bówùguǎn; museum). A. Read a college student’s diary entry and, in English, write a summary. B. Pair up. Each partner writes three questions from the passage to ask of their partner. C. Take turns with your partner using the prompts to retell the story: 1. 我最大的爱好是：为什么？ 2. 但是爸爸妈妈觉得：因为…，所以…

examples.text: 我是一个大学二年级的学生，我平常的休闲娱乐不太多。我最大的爱好是跟朋友去ＫＴＶ唱歌。我的爸妈都告诉我ＫＴＶ不好，我应该好好努力学习，如果我真要做什么休闲活动，就应该去参观博物馆，看看展览什么的，可是他们不知道，在那儿唱歌我可以完全放松，不但可以唱很多新歌和老歌，而且中文歌唱完了，还可以唱英文歌。有时我自己一个人唱，有时和朋友一块唱。有时我们甚至会一边唱，一边跳。开心极了！我们常一去就是好几个小时。唱累了，那儿的服务员还会给我们送上各种吃的。你想这么好的服务去哪儿找。不过在ＫＴＶ唱歌一个小时要三百多块钱，吃东西还得另外付钱，所以我的钱越来越少了。我得好好努力学习，这样爸妈才会给我更多零用钱。
examples.translation: wǒ shì yí gè dà xué èr nián jí de xué shēng wǒ píng cháng de xiū xián yú lè bú tài duō wǒ zuì dà de ài hào shì gēn péng yǒu qù chàng gē wǒ de bà mā dōu gào sù wǒ bù hǎo wǒ yīng gāi hǎo hǎo nǔ lì xué xí rú guǒ wǒ zhēn yào zuò shén me xiū xián huó dòng jiù yīng gāi qù cān guān bó wù guǎn kàn kàn zhǎn lǎn shén me de kě shì tā men bù zhī dào zài nàr chàng gē wǒ kě yǐ wán quán fàng sōng bú dàn kě yǐ chàng hěn duō xīn gē hé lǎo gē ér qiě zhōng wén gē chàng wán le hái kě yǐ chàng yīng wén gē yǒu shí wǒ zì jǐ yí gè rén chàng yǒu shí hé péng yǒu yí kuài chàng yǒu shí wǒ men shèn zhì huì yì biān chàng yì biān tiào kāi xīn jí le wǒ men cháng yí qù jiù shì hǎo jǐ gè xiǎo shí chàng lèi le nàr de fú wù yuán hái huì gěi wǒ men sòng shàng gè zhǒng chī de nǐ xiǎng zhè me hǎo de fú wù qù nǎr zhǎo bú guò zài chàng gē yí gè xiǎo shí yào sān bǎi duō kuài qián chī dōng xī hái děi lìng wài fù qián suǒ yǐ wǒ de qián yuè lái yuè shǎo le wǒ děi hǎo hǎo nǔ lì xué xí zhè yàng bà mā cái huì gěi wǒ gèng duō líng yòng qián — I am a second-year university student, and my usual recreation is not much. My biggest hobby is going to KTV (karaoke) with friends to sing. My parents both tell me KTV is bad, that I should study hard, and that if I really want to do some leisure activity I should visit museums and look at exhibitions and so on, but they don’t know that singing there lets me relax completely: I can sing many new and old songs, and when I finish the Chinese songs I can also sing English songs. Sometimes I sing by myself, and sometimes with friends. Sometimes we even sing and dance at the same time. Great fun! We often go and stay several hours. When we’re tired from singing, the waiters there bring us all kinds of food. Where else would you find such good service? However, singing at KTV costs over three hundred yuan an hour, and eating costs extra, so my money keeps getting less. I have to study hard so that my parents will give me more pocket money. (The book writes KTV in Latin letters; full-width letters here.)

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Listening and Speaking): two concert passages
explanations.body: New vocabulary: 交响乐团 (jiāoxiǎngyuè tuán; Symphony Orchestra), 观众 (guānzhòng; Audience), 鼓掌 (gǔzhǎng; applaud), 光盘 (guāngpán; CD). Below are two passages about two people’s concert experience. A. Pair up. Student A reads Passage 1 and Student B reads Passage 2; take notes in the box provided (Specific event; Location; How he found out about it; Concert details; What he did after the event). B. In Chinese, Student A shares the information from Passage 1 with Student B, and Student B shares Passage 2. C. With your partner, write the similarities and differences between the two passages.

examples.text: 两年以前，我在中国的南京市工作。我的工作不太忙，有空的时候，我常常去听音乐会。我喜欢流行音乐，也喜欢交响乐。要是有有名的西方交响乐团来南京演出，我一定会去看。有一次，我在报上看到新闻，美国的旧金山交响乐团要来中国演出。我很高兴，马上发电子邮件告诉我的朋友。可是他告诉我，旧金山交响乐团只在上海演出一场。时间是下个月的五号。我想，南京离上海不远，开车只要两个多小时。我还没有去过上海，我很想去上海看看。所以，我告诉我的朋友，我一定得去看这场音乐会。一个月后，我去上海看了音乐会。那场音乐会下午开始，中国的观众很多，也很热情。我想那是我看过的最好的演出之一。看完演出，我还在上海逛了大商场，也参观了几个有名的风景点。我觉得这次的上海二日游很有意思。下次我还要再来！
examples.translation: liǎng nián yǐ qián wǒ zài zhōng guó de nán jīng shì gōng zuò wǒ de gōng zuò bú tài máng yǒu kòng de shí hòu wǒ cháng cháng qù tīng yīn yuè huì wǒ xǐ huān liú xíng yīn yuè yě xǐ huān jiāo xiǎng yuè yào shì yǒu yǒu míng de xī fāng jiāo xiǎng yuè tuán lái nán jīng yǎn chū wǒ yí dìng huì qù kàn yǒu yí cì wǒ zài bào shàng kàn dào xīn wén měi guó de jiù jīn shān jiāo xiǎng yuè tuán yào lái zhōng guó yǎn chū wǒ hěn gāo xìng mǎ shàng fā diàn zi yóu jiàn gào sù wǒ de péng yǒu kě shì tā gào sù wǒ jiù jīn shān jiāo xiǎng yuè tuán zhǐ zài shàng hǎi yǎn chū yì cháng shí jiān shì xià gè yuè de wǔ hào wǒ xiǎng nán jīng lí shàng hǎi bù yuǎn kāi chē zhǐ yào liǎng gè duō xiǎo shí wǒ hái méi yǒu qù guò shàng hǎi wǒ hěn xiǎng qù shàng hǎi kàn kàn suǒ yǐ wǒ gào sù wǒ de péng yǒu wǒ yí dìng děi qù kàn zhè chǎng yīn yuè huì yí gè yuè hòu wǒ qù shàng hǎi kàn le yīn yuè huì nà chǎng yīn yuè huì xià wǔ kāi shǐ zhōng guó de guān zhòng hěn duō yě hěn rè qíng wǒ xiǎng nà shì wǒ kàn guò de zuì hǎo de yǎn chū zhī yí kàn wán yǎn chū wǒ hái zài shàng hǎi guàng le dà shāng chǎng yě cān guān le jǐ gè yǒu míng de fēng jǐng diǎn wǒ jué de zhè cì de shàng hǎi èr rì yóu hěn yǒu yì si xià cì wǒ hái yào zài lái — Two years ago I worked in Nanjing, China. My work wasn’t very busy, and when I had free time I often went to concerts. I like pop music and also symphonic music. If a famous Western symphony orchestra came to Nanjing to perform, I would definitely go. Once I saw in the paper that the San Francisco Symphony Orchestra was coming to China to perform. I was very happy and immediately emailed my friend. But he told me the San Francisco Symphony would perform only one show, in Shanghai, on the fifth of next month. I thought, Nanjing is not far from Shanghai; by car it takes only a bit over two hours. I hadn’t been to Shanghai and wanted to see it. So I told my friend I had to go to this concert. A month later I went to Shanghai and saw the concert. It began in the afternoon; the Chinese audience was large and enthusiastic. I think it was one of the best performances I’ve seen. After the show I also strolled the big shopping malls in Shanghai and visited a few famous scenic spots. I found this two-day Shanghai trip very interesting. I’ll come again next time! (Passage 1, printed in traditional characters in the book.)

examples.text: 我在上海出差的时候，听过一次音乐会。记得那是一个星期六的下午，我问旅馆服务员上海什么地方有音乐会。服务员马上就给上海音乐厅打了一个电话，然后告诉我上海音乐厅晚上七点半有一场音乐会，是中国流行音乐。下午六点半，我坐地铁到上海音乐厅，在售票处买到票以后，我拿着票高高兴兴地走进音乐厅。我一走进音乐厅的大门，一位服务员就热情地走过来问我的座位在哪儿，需不需要帮助。我告诉他我自己可以找到座位。那天听音乐会的人很多。演出结束以后，大家都站起来鼓掌。离开音乐厅的时候，我在音乐厅的门口买了一张中国流行音乐的光盘。我很喜欢那张光盘上的音乐。到现在，有时间的时候，我还经常听那张光盘。
examples.translation: wǒ zài shàng hǎi chū chāi de shí hòu tīng guò yí cì yīn yuè huì jì de nà shì yí gè xīng qī liù de xià wǔ wǒ wèn lǚ guǎn fú wù yuán shàng hǎi shén me dì fāng yǒu yīn yuè huì fú wù yuán mǎ shàng jiù gěi shàng hǎi yīn yuè tīng dǎ le yí gè diàn huà rán hòu gào sù wǒ shàng hǎi yīn yuè tīng wǎn shàng qī diǎn bàn yǒu yì cháng yīn yuè huì shì zhōng guó liú xíng yīn yuè xià wǔ liù diǎn bàn wǒ zuò dì tiě dào shàng hǎi yīn yuè tīng zài shòu piào chù mǎi dào piào yǐ hòu wǒ ná zhe piào gāo gāo xìng xìng de zǒu jìn yīn yuè tīng wǒ yì zǒu jìn yīn yuè tīng de dà mén yí wèi fú wù yuán jiù rè qíng de zǒu guò lái wèn wǒ de zuò wèi zài nǎr xū bù xū yào bāng zhù wǒ gào sù tā wǒ zì jǐ kě yǐ zhǎo dào zuò wèi nà tiān tīng yīn yuè huì de rén hěn duō yǎn chū jié shù yǐ hòu dà jiā dōu zhàn qǐ lái gǔ zhǎng lí kāi yīn yuè tīng de shí hòu wǒ zài yīn yuè tīng de mén kǒu mǎi le yì zhāng zhōng guó liú xíng yīn yuè de guāng pán wǒ hěn xǐ huān nà zhāng guāng pán shàng de yīn yuè dào xiàn zài yǒu shí jiān de shí hòu wǒ hái jīng cháng tīng nà zhāng guāng pán — When I was on a business trip in Shanghai I once attended a concert. I remember it was a Saturday afternoon; I asked the hotel attendant where in Shanghai there was a concert. The attendant immediately phoned the Shanghai Concert Hall and told me there was a concert at the hall at seven thirty in the evening, Chinese pop music. At six thirty in the afternoon I took the subway to the hall, and after buying a ticket at the ticket office I walked happily into the hall holding the ticket. As soon as I walked through the gate, an attendant warmly came over and asked where my seat was and whether I needed help. I told him I could find the seat myself. There were a lot of people at the concert that day. After the performance everyone stood up and applauded. When I left the hall I bought a CD of Chinese pop music at the entrance. I liked the music on that CD very much. Even now, when I have time, I still often listen to it.

explanations.body: New vocabulary: 演唱会 (yǎnchàng huì; concert), 京剧 (Jīngjù; Beijing Opera), 音乐剧 (yīnyuè jù; musical). Liu Yawen just moved to Shanghai and would like to attend a Chinese concert for the first time. A. Listen to the conversation and extract the EEIs: What does she want to see? How many tickets did she buy? When is the event? Where does she want to sit? How much do the tickets cost? How does she choose to pay? B. Pair up, read the script aloud and check your answers. C. Role play: read the schedule below and find a music performance you would like to see this week. Follow the format of the conversation and purchase a ticket; your partner plays the salesperson in the ticket booth; then switch. (Audio and the script, not included.)
