Except for swimming and surfing, we can’t do any other activities. Li Ming, how is your hometown?

examples.text: 李明：我的老家四季分明，每个季节都可以做不同的活动，不但可以滑雪、滑冰，而且可以爬山、露营。
examples.translation: lǐ míng wǒ de lǎo jiā sì jì fēn míng měi gè jì jié dōu kě yǐ zuò bù tóng de huó dòng bú dàn kě yǐ huá xuě huá bīng ér qiě kě yǐ pá shān lù yíng — My hometown has four distinct seasons, and each season you can do different activities: not only can you ski and ice-skate, but you can also hike and camp.

examples.text: 张文：那你最喜欢干什么呢？
examples.translation: zhāng wén nà nǐ zuì xǐ huān gàn shén me ne — Then what do you like to do most?

examples.text: 李明：我最大的爱好是滑雪，从六岁起就开始了。每年冬天，我们全家都去滑雪场度假。
examples.translation: lǐ míng wǒ zuì dà de ài hào shì huá xuě cóng liù suì qǐ jiù kāi shǐ le měi nián dōng tiān wǒ men quán jiā dōu qù huá xuě chǎng dù jià — My biggest hobby is skiing; I started at the age of six. Every winter our whole family goes to a ski resort for vacation.

examples.text: 张文：听起来很有意思。有空儿的时候，你能不能教我滑雪？
examples.translation: zhāng wén tīng qǐ lái hěn yǒu yì si yǒu kòng er de shí hòu nǐ néng bù néng jiāo wǒ huá xuě — That sounds interesting. When you have time, could you teach me to ski?

examples.text: 李明：没问题。
examples.translation: lǐ míng méi wèn tí — No problem.

examples.text: 张文：滑雪都需要什么装备？
examples.translation: zhāng wén huá xuě dōu xū yào shén me zhuāng bèi — What equipment do you need for skiing?

examples.text: 李明：你得有滑雪板，还得有滑雪服，滑雪鞋，滑雪眼镜，头盔什么的。不过，不用担心，这些东西都可以在滑雪场租到。
examples.translation: lǐ míng nǐ děi yǒu huá xuě bǎn hái děi yǒu huá xuě fú huá xuě xié huá xuě yǎn jìng tóu kuī shén me de bú guò bú yòng dān xīn zhè xiē dōng xī dōu kě yǐ zài huá xuě chǎng zū dào — You need skis, and a ski suit, ski boots, ski goggles, a helmet and so on. But don’t worry; you can rent all of these at the ski resort.

examples.text: 张文：太棒了，我简直都等不及啦。
examples.translation: zhāng wén tài bàng le wǒ jiǎn zhí dōu děng bù jí la — Great, I simply can’t wait.

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 2 (listening)
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening, Writing and Speaking). A. Global listening: 1. What is discussed in this conversation? 2. What season is it now? How could you tell? B. Detailed listening: 1. How did Zhang Wen get a tan? 2. What kind of outdoor activities can the people in his hometown do during the summer? 3. How different is Li Ming’s hometown from Zhang Wen’s? 4. What does Zhang Wen ask Li Ming to do? 5. What things do you think Zhang Wen will buy after their conversation? C. Pair up, discuss and share with the class. (From the dialog, mine: outdoor activities and hometowns; it has just become the start of a new term after the summer vacation; he went surfing every weekend; swimming and surfing; Li Ming’s hometown has four distinct seasons and Zhang Wen’s is hot all year; to teach him to ski; ski gear such as a ski board and goggles.) Activity 2 (Listening, Writing and Speaking). A. Listen to Dialog 1 and answer: 1. What did the two speakers talk about? 2. What did Wang Lin say about his hometown? 3. What did Linda say about her hometown? 4. What is Linda’s favorite outdoor activity? Can Wang Lin do it too? How do you know? B–C. Discuss and conduct the same conversation with your partner. D. Listen to Dialog 1 again: 1. What did the two speakers talk about? 2. What did you hear about Linda? 3. What do you think Wang Lin will probably do after their conversation? E–F. Discuss and conduct the same conversation. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): 举一反三
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Using the words in the first column as a cue, write the words that show what is needed for the activities shown in the other columns: 滑雪 (skiing), 滑冰 (ice skating), 冲浪 (surfing), 游泳 (swimming). The cue words are 滑雪板, 滑雪服, 滑雪鞋, 滑雪眼镜, 滑雪帽, 滑雪场. B. With your partner, discuss the characteristics of these words and analyze how they are formed. For example, 滑雪板 = 滑雪 + 板 (snowboard = snow + board): the activity plus the thing it needs. C. Report your analyses to the class. My completed words (mine): 滑冰鞋, 滑冰帽, 滑冰场; 冲浪板, 冲浪服, 冲浪帽; 游泳衣, 游泳帽, 游泳眼镜, 游泳池 (the book leaves the table blank).

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Using the words 担心, 头盔, 简直, 有空儿, 等不及, 度假, 装备, 租到, 爬山, 露营, complete the sentences and translate them into English. B. Pair up and explain which strategies you used. C. One partner reads the sentences and the other translates them. The book leaves the key out; my completed sentences (mine). In sentence 9 the book writes Jackie Chan’s name in English as well:

examples.text: 今年春节，你们全家打算去哪里度假？
examples.translation: jīn nián chūn jié nǐ men quán jiā dǎ suàn qù nǎ lǐ dù jià — 1. Where is your whole family planning to go on vacation this Spring Festival? (度假; key mine)

examples.text: 你有空儿的时候，能不能陪我去渔人码头看看海景？
examples.translation: nǐ yǒu kòng er de shí hòu néng bù néng péi wǒ qù yú rén mǎ tóu kàn kàn hǎi jǐng — 2. When you have time, could you go with me to Fisherman’s Wharf to look at the sea view? (有空儿)

examples.text: 这个地方风景很美，有很多树，也很安静，很适合露营。
examples.translation: zhè ge dì fāng fēng jǐng hěn měi yǒu hěn duō shù yě hěn ān jìng hěn shì hé lù yíng — 3. This place has beautiful scenery, lots of trees and is quiet; it’s very suitable for camping. (露营)

examples.text: 下个周末我们就要去滑雪了。你的滑雪装备都准备好了吗？
examples.translation: xià gè zhōu mò wǒ men jiù yào qù huá xuě le nǐ de huá xuě zhuāng bèi dōu zhǔn bèi hǎo le ma — 4. We’re going skiing next weekend. Is all your ski equipment ready? (装备)

examples.text: 不用担心，滑雪用的东西，我在网上已经买了，明天就到了。
examples.translation: bú yòng dān xīn huá xuě yòng de dōng xī wǒ zài wǎng shàng yǐ jīng mǎi le míng tiān jiù dào le — 5. Don’t worry; I already bought the skiing things online and they’ll arrive tomorrow. (担心)

examples.text: 骑自行车的时候，不要忘了戴头盔，这样你不会受伤。
examples.translation: qí zì xíng chē de shí hòu bú yào wàng le dài tóu kuī zhè yàng nǐ bú huì shòu shāng — 6. When riding a bike, don’t forget to wear a helmet; that way you won’t get hurt. (头盔)

examples.text: 我们学校附近有很多山，周末的时候，我们常常去爬山。
examples.translation: wǒ men xué xiào fù jìn yǒu hěn duō shān zhōu mò de shí hòu wǒ men cháng cháng qù pá shān — 7. There are many mountains near our school, and on weekends we often go hiking. (爬山)

examples.text: 我最好的朋友明天要来蒙特雷看我。我高兴得等不及了。
examples.translation: wǒ zuì hǎo de péng yǒu míng tiān yào lái méng tè léi kàn wǒ wǒ gāo xìng de děng bù jí le — 8. My best friend is coming to Monterey tomorrow to see me. I’m so happy I can’t wait. (等不及; the book’s blank is 我高兴地____; mine)

examples.text: 成龙的新动作片简直太好看了。我都看了三遍了。
examples.translation: chéng lóng de xīn dòng zuò piàn jiǎn zhí tài hǎo kàn le wǒ dōu kàn le sān biàn le — 9. Jackie Chan’s new action movie is simply so good. I’ve already watched it three times. (简直)

examples.text: 大卫昨天租到了一辆车。我们可以一起开车去旧金山。
examples.translation: dà wèi zuó tiān zū dào le yí liàng chē wǒ men kě yǐ yì qǐ kāi chē qù jiù jīn shān — 10. David rented a car yesterday. We can drive to San Francisco together. (租到)

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Interview a classmate about their hobbies. Use the patterns 除了…以外, 不但…，而且… or 从…起 and …什么的 to ask and answer the interview questions. Interview at least one student in your class. The questions (the right-hand column is for the interviewee’s answers); question 7 is 其他问题 (other questions). B. Consolidate your interviewee’s answers and report to the class.

examples.text: 1. 你最喜欢什么户外运动？
examples.translation: nǐ zuì xǐ huān shén me hù wài yùn dòng — What outdoor sport do you like best?

examples.text: 2. 你从几岁开始做这个运动？
examples.translation: nǐ cóng jǐ suì kāi shǐ zuò zhè ge yùn dòng — At what age did you begin this sport?

examples.text: 3. 你常常在什么季节做这个运动？
examples.translation: nǐ cháng cháng zài shén me jì jié zuò zhè ge yùn dòng — In which season do you usually do this sport?

examples.text: 4. 做这个活动需要什么装备？
examples.translation: zuò zhè ge huó dòng xū yào shén me zhuāng bèi — What equipment does this activity need?

examples.text: 5. 你在哪儿买这些装备？
examples.translation: nǐ zài nǎr mǎi zhè xiē zhuāng bèi — Where do you buy this equipment?

examples.text: 6. 除了这个以外你还喜欢什么？
examples.translation: chú le zhè ge yǐ wài nǐ hái xǐ huān shén me — Besides this, what else do you like?

exercises.prompt: Why is Zhang Wen so tanned?
What is Zhang Wen’s hometown like?
options: By the sea and hot and stuffy all year

exercises.prompt: What can Zhang Wen do in summer at home?
exercises.explanation: 除了游泳、冲浪以外，其他活动都做不了.

exercises.prompt: What is Li Ming’s hometown like?
What is Li Ming’s biggest hobby?
When did Li Ming start skiing?
What does Zhang Wen ask Li Ming?
Where can the ski gear be rented?
What does 滑雪板 break down into?
What does 简直都等不及啦 express?
我的老家四季___明，每个季节都可以做不同的活动。
这些东西都可以在滑雪场租___。

lessons.title: 426. Lesson 17 Presentation 2 grammar: more uses of the adverb 才
lessons.subtitle: 所以才晒得这么黑 · 这个班才两个学生 · 才 = cause and effect, only

explanations.title: More Uses of the Adverb 才
explanations.body: The adverb 才 in Chinese has many meanings. We have learned two of them so far: in Lesson 8 and Lesson 15, the adverb 才 indicates that something happened later than expected. In this lesson the adverb 才 is used to connect cause and effect. 才 can also mean “only” and be used to express how few in quantity something is. 才 + Predicate. (The book labels the first example “L18 Presentation 1”; the sentence 我们四点才下课 is from the earlier lessons.)

examples.text: 我们四点才下课。
examples.translation: wǒ men sì diǎn cái xià kè — We don’t finish class until four. (L8 and L15: later than expected)

examples.text: 大家一直玩到天黑才回家。
examples.translation: dà jiā yì zhí wán dào tiān hēi cái huí jiā — Everybody played until dark before going home. (L15 Presentation 3)

examples.text: 我每个周末都去冲浪，所以才晒得这么黑。
examples.translation: wǒ měi gè zhōu mò dōu qù chōng làng suǒ yǐ cái shài de zhè me hēi — I went surfing every weekend, so I got tanned. (cause and effect)

examples.text: 下个星期，我要去滑冰，所以我才想去买滑冰鞋。
examples.translation: xià gè xīng qī wǒ yào qù huá bīng suǒ yǐ wǒ cái xiǎng qù mǎi huá bīng xié — I’ll go ice skating next week. That’s why I want to buy skates.

examples.text: 这个班才两个学生。
examples.translation: zhè ge bān cái liǎng gè xué shēng — There are only two students in this class. (only)

examples.text: 她才学了三个月中文。
examples.translation: tā cái xué le sān gè yuè zhōng wén — She only studied Chinese for three months.

examples.text: 现在才七点。还不到上课时间。
examples.translation: xiàn zài cái qī diǎn hái bú dào shàng kè shí jiān — Now it is only seven o’clock. It is not time for class yet.

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 2
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening and Speaking). A. Listen to eight sentences that use 才 and translate them into English. B. Work in pairs to check your translation and repeat the sentences in Chinese. (Audio, not included.) Activity 2 (Writing and Speaking). What would you say in the following situations? Work in pairs and explain the situations by using “…，所以我才…”. 1. I don’t have money to pay the rent. That’s why I borrowed money from you. 2. This gym has all kinds of equipment. That’s why I come here to work out. 3. This tie is only $10. That’s why I bought it. 4. Li Hua doesn’t like to jog outdoors, so she bought a treadmill to work out at home. 5. Jane will vacation in Hawaii next weekend, so she bought a swimming suit. My sentences (mine):

examples.text: 我没有钱付房租，所以我才向你借钱。
examples.translation: wǒ méi yǒu qián fù fáng zū suǒ yǐ wǒ cái xiàng nǐ jiè qián — 1. I don’t have money to pay the rent. That’s why I borrowed money from you. (key mine)

examples.text: 这个健身房什么器械都有，所以我才来这儿锻炼。
examples.translation: zhè ge jiàn shēn fáng shén me qì xiè dōu yǒu suǒ yǐ wǒ cái lái zhèr duàn liàn — 2. This gym has all kinds of equipment. That’s why I come here to work out.

examples.text: 这条领带才十美元，所以我才买了。
examples.translation: zhè tiáo lǐng dài cái shí měi yuán suǒ yǐ wǒ cái mǎi le — 3. This tie is only ten dollars. That’s why I bought it.

examples.text: 李华不喜欢在户外慢跑，所以她才买了一个跑步机在家锻炼。
examples.translation: lǐ huá bù xǐ huān zài hù wài màn pǎo suǒ yǐ tā cái mǎi le yí gè pǎo bù jī zài jiā duàn liàn — 4. Li Hua doesn’t like to jog outdoors, so she bought a treadmill to work out at home.

examples.text: 简下个周末要去夏威夷度假，所以她才买了一件游泳衣。
examples.translation: jiǎn xià gè zhōu mò yào qù xià wēi yí dù jià suǒ yǐ tā cái mǎi le yí jiàn yóu yǒng yī — 5. Jane will vacation in Hawaii next weekend, so she bought a swimming suit.

exercises.prompt: What does 才 connect in 所以才晒得这么黑?
What does 这个班才两个学生 mean?
options: There are only two students in this class

exercises.prompt: What does 才 mean in 我们四点才下课?
What does 她才学了三个月中文 mean?
options: She has studied Chinese for only three months

exercises.prompt: What does 现在才七点 imply?
Which fits “I bought skates because I’ll go skating”?
options: 我才要去滑冰，所以买鞋
我要去滑冰，所以我才想去买滑冰鞋
我要去滑冰，但是我才想去买滑冰鞋

exercises.prompt: 现在___七点。还不到上课时间。

lessons.title: 427. Lesson 17 Presentation 2 grammar: the demonstrative pronoun 其他/别的
lessons.subtitle: 其他活动 · 别的爱好 · 其他的 · 有别的

explanations.title: The Demonstrative Pronoun 其他/别的
explanations.body: The demonstrative pronouns 其他 and 别的 are almost the same as “other.” They can be placed before nouns and used as subjects and objects, but there are slight differences between them. 其他 can be used with numbers and measure words, but 别的 cannot. 其他 can also be used with or without 的. 其他 + Number + Measure Word + Noun; 别的 + Noun. When 其他 is used as an object, it is usually accompanied by 的 (as a subject 其他 can stand without 的; 别的 can be used as a subject, an object and an attribute, with or without 的). 别的 is usually used as an object instead of 其他 if the verb is “有” or “没有”.

examples.text: 除了游泳、冲浪以外，其他活动都做不了。
examples.translation: chú le yóu yǒng chōng làng yǐ wài qí tā huó dòng dōu zuò bù liǎo — Except for swimming and surfing, people cannot do any other activities.

examples.text: 这几本书我拿走，其他几本送给你。
examples.translation: zhè jǐ běn shū wǒ ná zǒu qí tā jǐ běn sòng gěi nǐ — I will take these books and the other books are given to you.

examples.text: 除了唱歌跳舞，我没有别的爱好。
examples.translation: chú le chàng gē tiào wǔ wǒ méi yǒu bié de ài hào — Except for singing and dancing, I don’t have other hobbies.

examples.text: 这家商店没有你要的眼镜，咱们去别的商店看看吧。
examples.translation: zhè jiā shāng diàn méi yǒu nǐ yào de yǎn jìng zán men qù bié de shāng diàn kàn kàn ba — This store does not have the glasses you want. Let’s go to other stores to have a look.

examples.text: 我现在不去想其他的，只想好好睡一觉。
examples.translation: wǒ xiàn zài bú qù xiǎng qí tā de zhǐ xiǎng hǎo hǎo shuì yí jiào — I don’t think about other things now; I just want a good night’s sleep. (其他 as an object takes 的)

examples.text: 除了这些东西以外，我还有别的。
examples.translation: chú le zhè xiē dōng xī yǐ wài wǒ hái yǒu bié de — In addition to these things, I have other things. (verb 有: 别的)

examples.text: 我没有别的，只有一个箱子。
examples.translation: wǒ méi yǒu bié de zhǐ yǒu yí gè xiāng zi — I have nothing else, only a box. (verb 没有: 别的)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading and Speaking): 考考你
explanations.body: A. Complete the sentences using 其他 or 别的. B. Discuss the answers with a classmate and explain why you chose either 其他 or 别的 in the sentences. The book leaves the key out; my completed sentences (mine):

examples.text: 家里其他人都去了国外，只有他一个人在国内。
examples.translation: jiā lǐ qí tā rén dōu qù le guó wài zhǐ yǒu tā yí gè rén zài guó nèi — 1. All the other family members went abroad; only he is in the country. (其他; key mine)

examples.text: 除了中文，你还会说别的外语吗？
examples.translation: chú le zhōng wén nǐ hái huì shuō bié de wài yǔ ma — 2. Besides Chinese, can you speak other foreign languages? (别的)

examples.text: 要想健康，最好多吃水果蔬菜。还有别的方法吗？
examples.translation: yào xiǎng jiàn kāng zuì hǎo duō chī shuǐ guǒ shū cài hái yǒu bié de fāng fǎ ma — 3. To be healthy, it’s best to eat more fruit and vegetables. Are there other ways? (别的; verb 有)

examples.text: 这次单元考试，只有一个同学不及格，其他五个人都通过了。
examples.translation: zhè cì dān yuán kǎo shì zhǐ yǒu yí gè tóng xué bù jí gé qí tā wǔ gè rén dōu tōng guò le — 4. In this unit test only one student failed; the other five all passed. (其他 + number + measure word)

examples.text: 这种颜色的衣服不太适合我，你有别的颜色的吗？
examples.translation: zhè zhǒng yán sè de yī fú bú tài shì hé wǒ nǐ yǒu bié de yán sè de ma — 5. Clothes in this color don’t suit me very well; do you have other colors? (别的)

examples.text: 这些水果我吃不了。给我留两个桔子，其他的，你拿走吧。
examples.translation: zhè xiē shuǐ guǒ wǒ chī bù liǎo gěi wǒ liú liǎng gè jú zi qí tā de nǐ ná zǒu ba — 6. I can’t finish this fruit. Leave me two tangerines; you take the rest. (其他的; object)

examples.text: 你有这么多问题，我现在只能回答一个，明天再回答其他的。
examples.translation: nǐ yǒu zhè me duō wèn tí wǒ xiàn zài zhǐ néng huí dá yí gè míng tiān zài huí dá qí tā de — 7. You have so many questions; I can only answer one now and will answer the others tomorrow. (其他的; object)

examples.text: 除了这些问题，还有别的吗？
examples.translation: chú le zhè xiē wèn tí hái yǒu bié de ma — 8. Besides these questions, are there any others? (别的; verb 有)

exercises.prompt: Which can be used with a number and a measure word?
exercises.explanation: 其他 + number + measure word + noun.

exercises.prompt: Which is usually used as the object after 有 or 没有?
What does 其他 take when it is an object?
Which fits 其他___五个人都通过了 (the other five)?
Which fits 你有___颜色的吗？
Which fits 除了中文，你还会说___外语吗？
家里___人都去了国外，只有他一个人在国内。
这些水果我吃不了。给我留两个桔子，___的，你拿走吧。

lessons.title: 428. Lesson 17 Presentation 2 grammar: the prepositional structure 从……起
lessons.subtitle: 从一月一号起 · 从三楼起才有电梯 · 从…开始

explanations.title: The Prepositional Structure 从……起
explanations.body: 从……起 means “from … on” and indicates the beginning of something. It is used as an adverbial adjunct between the subject and the predicate. It can also be placed at the beginning of a sentence. Subject + 从…起，+ Predicate; 从…起，Subject + Predicate. 从……起 can be replaced by 从……开始 and carry the same meaning.

examples.text: 我从一月一号起，每天会去健身房运动。
examples.translation: wǒ cóng yī yuè yī hào qǐ měi tiān huì qù jiàn shēn fáng yùn dòng — Starting from January 1st, I will go to the gym every day. (Subject + 从…起)

examples.text: 从一月一号起，我每天会去健身房运动。
examples.translation: cóng yī yuè yī hào qǐ wǒ měi tiān huì qù jiàn shēn fáng yùn dòng — From January 1st on, I will go to the gym every day. (从…起 at the beginning)

examples.text: 这个大楼不太方便，从三楼起才有电梯。
examples.translation: zhè ge dà lóu bú tài fāng biàn cóng sān lóu qǐ cái yǒu diàn tī — This building is not very convenient; there are elevators only from the third floor up.

examples.text: 从明天开始，我每天去体育馆游泳。
examples.translation: cóng míng tiān kāi shǐ wǒ měi tiān qù tǐ yù guǎn yóu yǒng — From tomorrow on, I will go swimming at the gym every day. (从…开始 = 从…起)

examples.text: 从下个星期开始，我们要学习第四单元的课本。
examples.translation: cóng xià gè xīng qī kāi shǐ wǒ men yào xué xí dì sì dān yuán de kè běn — From next week on, we will study the textbook of Unit 4.

explanations.title: Activities 4 and 5
explanations.body: Activity 4 (Listening, Writing and Speaking). A. Listen to the dialogs and write responses using the pattern 从…起. B. Work in pairs to practice the dialogs (you can also read from the script provided by the teacher). The five questions are printed in the book; the answers are blank, so mine follow. Activity 5 (Writing and Speaking). In groups, write at least five sentences about your favorite hobby using 从…起 and tell your story to your group; the book’s starter is 我的爱好是游泳。从五岁起我就开始… My story (mine):

examples.text: 你最近胖了不少，得减肥了。
examples.translation: nǐ zuì jìn pàng le bù shǎo děi jiǎn féi le — 1. A: You’ve gotten quite a bit fatter recently; you have to lose weight.

examples.text: 从明天起，我每天早上去跑步。
examples.translation: cóng míng tiān qǐ wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng qù pǎo bù — B: From tomorrow on, I’ll go running every morning. (mine)

examples.text: 你几岁开始学滑冰的？
examples.translation: nǐ jǐ suì kāi shǐ xué huá bīng de — 2. A: At what age did you start to learn ice skating?

examples.text: 我从七岁起就开始学滑冰了。
examples.translation: wǒ cóng qī suì qǐ jiù kāi shǐ xué huá bīng le — B: I started learning ice skating at the age of seven. (mine)

examples.text: 这个小区环境怎么样？
examples.translation: zhè ge xiǎo qū huán jìng zěn me yàng — 3. A: How is the environment in this neighborhood?

examples.text: 很不错，从搬来这里起，我每天早上都能听到小鸟唱歌。
examples.translation: hěn bú cuò cóng bān lái zhè lǐ qǐ wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng dōu néng tīng dào xiǎo niǎo chàng gē — B: Very nice; ever since I moved here I can hear the birds sing every morning. (mine)

examples.text: 听说这个周末梅西百货商店的衣服大降价。
examples.translation: tīng shuō zhè ge zhōu mò méi xī bǎi huò shāng diàn de yī fú dà jiàng jià — 4. A: I heard the clothes at Macy’s will be on sale this weekend.

examples.text: 对，从这个周末起，所有的衣服都打五折。
examples.translation: duì cóng zhè ge zhōu mò qǐ suǒ yǒu de yī fú dōu dǎ wǔ zhé — B: Yes, from this weekend on all the clothes are half price. (mine)

examples.text: 中国的学生从什么时候开始学外语？
examples.translation: zhōng guó de xué shēng cóng shén me shí hòu kāi shǐ xué wài yǔ — 5. A: From when do students in China start to learn foreign languages?

examples.text: 从小学三年级起就开始学英语了。
examples.translation: cóng xiǎo xué sān nián jí qǐ jiù kāi shǐ xué yīng yǔ le — B: They begin learning English from the third grade of elementary school. (mine)

examples.text: 我的爱好是游泳。从五岁起我就开始学游泳了。
examples.translation: wǒ de ài hào shì yóu yǒng cóng wǔ suì qǐ wǒ jiù kāi shǐ xué yóu yǒng le — My hobby is swimming. I began learning to swim from the age of five. (the book’s starter; the continuation is mine)

examples.text: 我每年夏天都去海边游泳。
examples.translation: wǒ měi nián xià tiān dōu qù hǎi biān yóu yǒng — I go swimming at the beach every summer. (mine)

examples.text: 从去年起，我每个星期都去学校的游泳馆练习两次。
examples.translation: cóng qù nián qǐ wǒ měi gè xīng qī dōu qù xué xiào de yóu yǒng guǎn liàn xí liǎng cì — Since last year, I have practiced at the school pool twice every week. (mine)

examples.text: 游泳不但对身体好，而且可以让我放松。
examples.translation: yóu yǒng bú dàn duì shēn tǐ hǎo ér qiě kě yǐ ràng wǒ fàng sōng — Swimming is not only good for the body but also lets me relax. (mine)

examples.text: 除了游泳以外，我还喜欢爬山和露营什么的。
examples.translation: chú le yóu yǒng yǐ wài wǒ hái xǐ huān pá shān hé lù yíng shén me de — Besides swimming, I also like hiking, camping and so on. (mine)

options: Before the subject or between subject and predicate

exercises.prompt: What does 从三楼起才有电梯 mean?
options: There are elevators only from the third floor up
Elevators on the third floor only
我七岁从起就学滑冰了

lessons.title: 429. Lesson 17 Presentation 2 grammar: the adverb 简直
lessons.subtitle: 简直等不及了 · 简直太帅了 · 简直美极了 · 简直 + 太…了 / …极了

explanations.title: The Adverb 简直
explanations.body: The adverb 简直 means “simply” or “completely” in English and can be used to modify adjective phrases or verb phrases, adding a tone of excitement on the part of the speaker. Subject + 简直 + adjective phrase/verb phrase. 简直 cannot be followed directly by an unmodified adjective. The modifiers 太 and 极了 can be used with 简直 to modify adjectives: 这个地方简直美！ is incorrect; 这个地方简直太美了 and 这个地方简直美极了！ are correct.

examples.text: 你能教我滑雪，太棒了。我简直等不及了。
examples.translation: nǐ néng jiāo wǒ huá xuě tài bàng le wǒ jiǎn zhí děng bù jí le — It is great that you can teach me to ski. I simply cannot wait.

examples.text: 她男朋友长得简直太帅了。
examples.translation: tā nán péng yǒu zhǎng de jiǎn zhí tài shuài le — Her boyfriend is simply so handsome.

examples.text: 我简直不知道该怎么谢你。
examples.translation: wǒ jiǎn zhí bù zhī dào gāi zěn me xiè nǐ — I just don’t know how I should thank you.

examples.text: 这个地方简直太美了！
examples.translation: zhè ge dì fāng jiǎn zhí tài měi le — This place is simply so beautiful! (correct)

examples.text: 这个地方简直美极了！
examples.translation: zhè ge dì fāng jiǎn zhí měi jí le — This place is simply beautiful! (correct)

explanations.title: Activity 6 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Pair up and read the sentences that use the adverb 简直. Identify the incorrect sentences, discuss why they are incorrect and how to correct them. Then translate them into English. The book prints two versions of each sentence (one correct, one incorrect); the key is mine, and the correct versions are:

examples.text: 这个菜简直太辣了，我吃不了。
examples.translation: zhè ge cài jiǎn zhí tài là le wǒ chī bù liǎo — 1. This dish is simply so spicy; I can’t eat it. (the incorrect version is 简直辣了; key mine)

examples.text: 天气这么热，我简直睡不着。
examples.translation: tiān qì zhè me rè wǒ jiǎn zhí shuì bù zháo — 2. The weather is so hot that I simply can’t sleep. (the incorrect version is 我睡不着简直)

examples.text: 这件大衣简直太漂亮了，我想再买一件给我姐姐。
examples.translation: zhè jiàn dà yī jiǎn zhí tài piào liàng le wǒ xiǎng zài mǎi yí jiàn gěi wǒ jiě jiě — 3. This coat is simply so beautiful; I want to buy another one for my older sister. (the incorrect version is 简直漂亮)

examples.text: 昨晚的音乐会上，她简直太紧张，忘了怎么唱了。
examples.translation: zuó wǎn de yīn yuè huì shàng tā jiǎn zhí tài jǐn zhāng wàng le zěn me chàng le — 4. At last night’s concert she was simply so nervous that she forgot how to sing. (the incorrect version is 她简直紧张)

examples.text: 公共汽车太挤了，我简直挤不上去。
examples.translation: gōng gòng qì chē tài jǐ le wǒ jiǎn zhí jǐ bú shàng qù — 5. The bus was so crowded that I simply couldn’t get on. (the incorrect version is 我挤不上去简直)

explanations.title: Activity 7 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: What would you say in the following situations? Pair up and comment on the situations with your partner using 简直. 1. You are in a movie theatre with a friend, commenting on the movie, the auditorium or the seats. 2. You are hiking with your friend and admiring the mountains and surroundings. 3. You are camping with your friend and commenting on the environment or surroundings of the campsite. My sentences (mine):

examples.text: 这个电影院的座位简直太舒服了！
examples.translation: zhè ge diàn yǐng yuàn de zuò wèi jiǎn zhí tài shū fú le — 1. The seats in this theater are simply so comfortable! (mine)

examples.text: 这个电影简直好看极了。
examples.translation: zhè ge diàn yǐng jiǎn zhí hǎo kàn jí le — The movie is simply great. (mine)

examples.text: 这里的山简直太美了，我简直不想回去。
examples.translation: zhè lǐ de shān jiǎn zhí tài měi le wǒ jiǎn zhí bù xiǎng huí qù — 2. The mountains here are simply so beautiful; I simply don’t want to go back. (mine)

examples.text: 这个露营的地方风景简直美极了，空气也特别好。
examples.translation: zhè ge lù yíng de dì fāng fēng jǐng jiǎn zhí měi jí le kōng qì yě tè bié hǎo — 3. The scenery of this campsite is simply gorgeous and the air is especially good. (mine)

exercises.prompt: What does 简直 add to a sentence?
What may NOT directly follow 简直?
Where does 简直 go in 我简直挤不上去?
What does 我简直不知道该怎么谢你 mean?
options: I just don’t know how to thank you
I don’t want to thank you

exercises.prompt: 这个菜简直___辣了，我吃不了。
这个地方风景简直美___了！
公共汽车太挤了，我___挤不上去。
exercises.explanation: 简直 before the verb phrase.

lessons.title: 430. Lesson 17 Presentation 2: skill integration
lessons.subtitle: 你喜欢什么运动 · 林红的孩子 · 滑雪度假村 · 滑雪消费价格

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the conversation and transcribe the missing information in pinyin that you heard; then translate it into English orally. The book prints the conversation with blanks (audio, not included); my reconstruction of the whole conversation from the surrounding text, so the filled-in words are mine. B. Write down any words you don’t know and discuss their meanings with your partner. C. Pair up and read the conversation aloud. D. Discuss: 1. What is the topic of this conversation? 2. What is the relationship between these two speakers? How can you tell? 3. Among the activities mentioned, which one do you enjoy doing? Explain why. Make notes on what your partner likes to do and why (喜欢做的 / 原因).

examples.text: 张华：马克，你喜欢什么运动？
examples.translation: zhāng huá mǎ kè nǐ xǐ huān shén me yùn dòng — Mark, what sports do you like? (my reconstruction; the book gives this as a listening cloze)

examples.text: 马克：我喜欢的运动特别多，像游泳、冲浪、滑雪、滑冰、骑自行车、爬山、露营，还有打篮球。我老家四季分明，每个季节可以做不同的运动。张华，你喜欢什么？
examples.translation: mǎ kè wǒ xǐ huān de yùn dòng tè bié duō xiàng yóu yǒng chōng làng huá xuě huá bīng qí zì xíng chē pá shān lù yíng hái yǒu dǎ lán qiú wǒ lǎo jiā sì jì fēn míng měi gè jì jié kě yǐ zuò bù tóng de yùn dòng zhāng huá nǐ xǐ huān shén me — I like a great many sports, such as swimming, surfing, skiing, ice skating, cycling, hiking, camping and also basketball. My hometown has four distinct seasons and each season you can do different sports. Zhang Hua, what do you like?

examples.text: 张华：我喜欢室内运动，像游泳、乒乓球、羽毛球和篮球。我常常参加乒乓球比赛，每次比赛，我都很紧张。
examples.translation: zhāng huá wǒ xǐ huān shì nèi yùn dòng xiàng yóu yǒng pīng pāng qiú yǔ máo qiú hé lán qiú wǒ cháng cháng cān jiā pīng pāng qiú bǐ sài měi cì bǐ sài wǒ dōu hěn jǐn zhāng — I like indoor sports, such as swimming, table tennis, badminton and basketball. I often take part in table tennis matches, and every match I get very nervous.

examples.text: 马克：我也很喜欢这些活动，可是我不会打乒乓球，你可以教我吗？
examples.translation: mǎ kè wǒ yě hěn xǐ huān zhè xiē huó dòng kě shì wǒ bú huì dǎ pīng pāng qiú nǐ kě yǐ jiāo wǒ ma — I like these activities too, but I can’t play table tennis; can you teach me?

examples.text: 张华：可以。我们可以去学校的体育馆练习。
examples.translation: zhāng huá kě yǐ wǒ men kě yǐ qù xué xiào de tǐ yù guǎn liàn xí — Yes. We can practice at the school gym.

examples.text: 马克：太好了。我简直等不及了。我需要买什么装备？
examples.translation: mǎ kè tài hǎo le wǒ jiǎn zhí děng bù jí le wǒ xū yào mǎi shén me zhuāng bèi — Great. I simply can’t wait. What equipment do I need to buy?

examples.text: 张华：你得买一个球拍，一些乒乓球，还有球鞋和运动服。
examples.translation: zhāng huá nǐ děi mǎi yí gè qiú pāi yì xiē pīng pāng qiú hái yǒu qiú xié hé yùn dòng fú — You have to buy a racket, some table tennis balls, and also sneakers and sports clothes.

examples.text: 马克：没问题，我今天下课以后就去体育用品商店买。
examples.translation: mǎ kè méi wèn tí wǒ jīn tiān xià kè yǐ hòu jiù qù tǐ yù yòng pǐn shāng diàn mǎi — No problem; after class today I’ll go to the sporting goods store to buy them.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading and Speaking): Lin Hong’s children
explanations.body: A. Read the passage and write a summary of it in pinyin or characters. B. Read the passage again and mark each statement as True or False (key mine). C. Pair up and discuss: 1. 美国的孩子放学以后也去做运动吗？他们都做什么运动？ 2. 美国的妈妈们是不是也和林红一样每天去接送孩子？

examples.text: 林红有两个孩子，都很喜欢运动。儿子今年十二岁，喜欢游泳，女儿今年十岁，喜欢滑冰。每天放学以后，是林红一天最忙的时候，她要先去送儿子去游泳馆游泳，然后再送女儿去滑冰场学滑冰。林红的先生是电脑工程师，每天很忙，没有时间，只好林红一个人接送孩子。送完孩子以后，她马上回家做晚饭，她想在孩子们回家以前把饭做好，因为她知道孩子们回家以后会又累又饿，需要马上吃饭。她一边做饭一边看时间，到五点半的时候，她得开车去把孩子们一个一个地接回家。孩子们吃完饭还得做功课，所以不能太晚去接他们。林红常常想，如果在她家附近能有一个体育馆该有多好啊。体育馆里最好有游泳池和滑冰场，这样她就不用每天开车跑这么多个地方了。
examples.translation: lín hóng yǒu liǎng gè hái zi dōu hěn xǐ huān yùn dòng ér zi jīn nián shí èr suì xǐ huān yóu yǒng nǚ ér jīn nián shí suì xǐ huān huá bīng měi tiān fàng xué yǐ hòu shì lín hóng yì tiān zuì máng de shí hòu tā yào xiān qù sòng ér zi qù yóu yǒng guǎn yóu yǒng rán hòu zài sòng nǚ ér qù huá bīng chǎng xué huá bīng lín hóng de xiān shēng shì diàn nǎo gōng chéng shī měi tiān hěn máng méi yǒu shí jiān zhǐ hǎo lín hóng yí gè rén jiē sòng hái zi sòng wán hái zi yǐ hòu tā mǎ shàng huí jiā zuò wǎn fàn tā xiǎng zài hái zi men huí jiā yǐ qián bǎ fàn zuò hǎo yīn wèi tā zhī dào hái zi men huí jiā yǐ hòu huì yòu lèi yòu è xū yào mǎ shàng chī fàn tā yì biān zuò fàn yì biān kàn shí jiān dào wǔ diǎn bàn de shí hòu tā děi kāi chē qù bǎ hái zi men yí gè yí gè de jiē huí jiā hái zi men chī wán fàn hái děi zuò gōng kè suǒ yǐ bù néng tài wǎn qù jiē tā men lín hóng cháng cháng xiǎng rú guǒ zài tā jiā fù jìn néng yǒu yí gè tǐ yù guǎn gāi yǒu duō hǎo a tǐ yù guǎn lǐ zuì hǎo yǒu yóu yǒng chí hé huá bīng chǎng zhè yàng tā jiù bú yòng měi tiān kāi chē pǎo zhè me duō gè dì fāng le — Lin Hong has two children, and both like sports. Her son is twelve this year and likes swimming; her daughter is ten and likes ice skating. After school every day is Lin Hong’s busiest time of the day: she first takes her son to the swimming pool to swim and then takes her daughter to the skating rink to learn skating. Lin Hong’s husband is a computer engineer and is very busy every day with no time, so Lin Hong has to pick up and drop off the children alone. After dropping off the children, she goes home right away to cook dinner; she wants to have the meal ready before the children get home, because she knows that when they get home they will be both tired and hungry and will need to eat right away. She watches the time while cooking, and at five-thirty she has to drive and pick the children up one by one. After dinner the children still have to do homework, so she can’t go to pick them up too late. Lin Hong often thinks how nice it would be if there were a gym near her home. It would be best if the gym had a swimming pool and a skating rink; that way she wouldn’t have to drive to so many places every day.

examples.text: 林红的两个孩子都喜欢游泳。
examples.translation: lín hóng de liǎng gè hái zi dōu xǐ huān yóu yǒng — 1. Both of Lin Hong’s children like swimming. — False (the son swims, the daughter skates; key mine)

examples.text: 林红的孩子每天放学以后先不回家。
examples.translation: lín hóng de hái zi měi tiān fàng xué yǐ hòu xiān bù huí jiā — 2. Lin Hong’s children do not go home first after school. — True

examples.text: 每天不是林红接送孩子就是她先生接送。
examples.translation: měi tiān bú shì lín hóng jiē sòng hái zi jiù shì tā xiān shēng jiē sòng — 3. Either Lin Hong or her husband picks up and drops off the children every day. — False (her husband has no time)

examples.text: 孩子回到家以后，林红才给他们做饭。
examples.translation: hái zi huí dào jiā yǐ hòu lín hóng cái gěi tā men zuò fàn — 4. Lin Hong only cooks for the children after they get home. — False (she cooks before they get home)

examples.text: 林红家附近有一个大体育馆，里面什么都有。
examples.translation: lín hóng jiā fù jìn yǒu yí gè dà tǐ yù guǎn lǐ miàn shén me dōu yǒu — 5. There is a big gym near Lin Hong’s home with everything in it. — False (she only wishes for one)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): the ski resort
explanations.body: A. Read the passage and write a short summary in pinyin or characters. B. Pair up and exchange your summaries. C. Translate the sentence 滑雪度假村的设施也很全，有中、西式餐厅、咖啡厅、滑雪用具商店、超市等服务设施，随时为滑雪者提供一流的服务 into English (my translation: The ski resort’s facilities are also complete, with Chinese and Western restaurants, coffee shops, ski-equipment stores, supermarkets and other service facilities, providing skiers with first-class service at any time). D. Discuss: 1. 你会滑雪吗？你从什么时候开始滑雪的？ 2. 你通常去哪里滑雪？ 3. 在美国，你去过滑雪度假村滑雪吗？这个度假村在哪儿？ 4. 这个度假村都有什么设施？ 5. 你第一次滑雪是什么时候？请讲讲你第一次滑雪的经历。

examples.text: 下个月，林红的孩子就要放寒假了。因为孩子们都喜欢运动，林红打算带孩子们去一个既可以度假又可以运动的地方。昨天她在电视上看到一个滑雪度假村的广告。这个度假村是新开的，看起来又大又漂亮，而且离家很近，开车不到两个小时。滑雪设备可以自己带，也可以在那儿租。如果不会滑雪也没关系，这个度假村提供初级滑雪课，教你怎么滑。滑雪度假村的设施也很全，有中、西式餐厅、咖啡厅、滑雪用具商店、超市等服务设施，随时为滑雪者提供一流的服务。林红觉得这是个度假的好地方，她打算上网订票，然后一家人准备去那儿滑雪。
examples.translation: xià gè yuè lín hóng de hái zi jiù yào fàng hán jià le yīn wèi hái zi men dōu xǐ huān yùn dòng lín hóng dǎ suàn dài hái zi men qù yí gè jì kě yǐ dù jià yòu kě yǐ yùn dòng de dì fāng zuó tiān tā zài diàn shì shàng kàn dào yí gè huá xuě dù jià cūn de guǎng gào zhè ge dù jià cūn shì xīn kāi de kàn qǐ lái yòu dà yòu piào liàng ér qiě lí jiā hěn jìn kāi chē bú dào liǎng gè xiǎo shí huá xuě shè bèi kě yǐ zì jǐ dài yě kě yǐ zài nàr zū rú guǒ bú huì huá xuě yě méi guān xì zhè ge dù jià cūn tí gōng chū jí huá xuě kè jiāo nǐ zěn me huá huá xuě dù jià cūn de shè shī yě hěn quán yǒu zhōng xī shì cān tīng kā fēi tīng huá xuě yòng jù shāng diàn chāo shì děng fú wù shè shī suí shí wèi huá xuě zhě tí gōng yì liú de fú wù lín hóng jué de zhè shì gè dù jià de hǎo dì fāng tā dǎ suàn shàng wǎng dìng piào rán hòu yì jiā rén zhǔn bèi qù nàr huá xuě — Next month Lin Hong’s children will be on winter vacation (寒假 hánjià). Because the children all like sports, Lin Hong plans to take them to a place where they can both take a vacation and exercise. Yesterday she saw an advertisement on TV for a ski resort. This resort is newly opened and looks big and beautiful, and it is close to home, less than two hours by car. You can bring your own ski equipment or rent it there. If you don’t know how to ski it doesn’t matter; the resort offers beginner ski classes that teach you how to ski. The resort’s facilities are also complete, with Chinese and Western restaurants, a coffee shop, ski-gear stores, a supermarket and other service facilities, offering skiers first-class service at any time. Lin Hong thinks this is a good place for a vacation; she plans to book tickets online and then the family will go skiing there.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): role play
explanations.body: Role-play: You are studying Chinese in a university in China. While at a weekend party at your Chinese teacher’s house you are talking with one of your teacher’s friends who likes outdoor activities very much, so you exchange information about activities in your hometown. A. Pair up. Your partner plays the role of the Chinese friend. Discuss outdoor activities during the seasons in your hometown (the vocabulary below is a cue). B. In pairs, discuss your favorite outdoor activity with your partner and explain why you enjoy it (最喜欢的户外活动 / 为什么喜欢这个活动 for 你自己 and 你的朋友). (Photograph, not included.)

tables.title: Activity 1: outdoor activities and settings (the book prints them as a word cloud)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking): Liu Chong’s family
explanations.body: Scenario: You received a voice mail from your Chinese friend in Beijing. Your friend told you that his family would be visiting Monterey next month and asked you to make arrangements for outdoor activities during their stay. You asked your classmates to help you to think about the things your Chinese friends could do. A. Listen to the recording and write a summary of what you heard. (Audio, not included.) B. Divide into two groups. In your group, discuss an outdoor activity plan for Liu Chong’s family. Consider: 1. 刘冲一家在蒙特雷只呆五天。 2. 他们喜欢户外活动。 3. 选择适合他们的活动。 4. 最好在蒙特雷附近或是开车不超过四个小时。 C. After discussion with your group members, write down your arrangements for the outdoor activities (给刘冲一家的户外活动安排). D. Each group takes turns presenting their plan and the class selects the best one. Email the best plan to Liu Chong. The book leaves the plan blank; a sample plan (mine):

examples.text: 第一天：在蒙特雷海边骑自行车，去渔人码头看海景。
examples.translation: dì yī tiān zài méng tè léi hǎi biān qí zì xíng chē qù yú rén mǎ tóu kàn hǎi jǐng — Day 1: ride bikes along the Monterey shore and go to Fisherman’s Wharf to see the sea view. (my sample plan; mine)

examples.text: 第二天：去卡梅尔的海滩晒太阳，躺在草地上休息。
examples.translation: dì èr tiān qù kǎ méi ěr de hǎi tān shài tài yáng tǎng zài cǎo dì shàng xiū xī — Day 2: sunbathe on the beach at Carmel and rest lying on the grass.

examples.text: 第三天：开车去大苏尔爬山、露营，看海景。
examples.translation: dì sān tiān kāi chē qù dà sū ěr pá shān lù yíng kàn hǎi jǐng — Day 3: drive to Big Sur to hike, camp and see the coast.

examples.text: 第四天：开车去圣克鲁斯冲浪，开车不到一个半小时。
examples.translation: dì sì tiān kāi chē qù shèng kè lǔ sī chōng làng kāi chē bú dào yí gè bàn xiǎo shí — Day 4: drive to Santa Cruz to surf, less than an hour and a half by car.

examples.text: 第五天：开车去旧金山玩一天，晚上回来。
examples.translation: dì wǔ tiān kāi chē qù jiù jīn shān wán yì tiān wǎn shàng huí lái — Day 5: drive to San Francisco for a day and come back in the evening.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): the ski-resort call
explanations.body: Role-play: You are studying Chinese at Beijing University in China. Winter vacation is coming, and you plan to go skiing with your friends. You saw an advertisement for a ski resort, and you’d like to know more about it. Call the resort and ask for the information you need. A classmate will play the role of the receptionist at the resort. A. In pairs, read the advertisement and discuss the content (the book prints the advertisement with pictures, not included). B. Call the ski resort to ask for more information; your partner plays the receptionist. You may use the questions below as a reference and make notes when you speak to the receptionist: 你们的滑雪场在哪儿？ 开车需要多长时间到你们的滑雪场？ 门票一个人多少钱？ 我不会滑雪，你们有人教怎么滑雪吗？ 可以自己带滑雪设备吗？ 你们出租滑雪设备吗？你们都有什么设备？ 有吃饭的地方吗？ 有没有住的地方？一个晚上多少钱？ 滑雪场可以上网吗？ 滑雪场有商店吗？ 你们有停车场吗？停车场收费吗？ 其他问题。

lessons.title: 433. Lesson 17 Presentation 3: ball-game fans
lessons.subtitle: 张东明是一个足球迷 · 收集海报 · 熬夜看球赛 · 最大的愿望

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Photographs: a soccer match, a basketball game (not included). Pair up and discuss: A. Do you like soccer or basketball? If yes, who is your favorite player? B. Have you ever watched or played soccer or basketball in a stadium? When was that? C. Does any of your family members or friends like to play soccer or basketball? Are they the fans of any star players? If yes, who are those players?

explanations.title: Presentation 3: 球迷一家
explanations.body: The book also prints the passage in traditional characters.

examples.text: 张东明是一个足球迷。他最喜欢的球星是巴塞罗那俱乐部的梅西，所以他收集了很多梅西的海报。只要电视上有球赛，他就不会错过。为了看球赛，他常常熬夜。他也喜欢去现场看球，因为和别的球迷一起看球更热闹。他最大的愿望就是攒钱去巴塞罗那看一次梅西的主场比赛。有空儿的时候，他也会约几个朋友踢球。虽然他踢得不太好，可是不管输赢，他都很开心。张东明的太太是个篮球迷，她从上中学起就开始打球。后来，她在一个高中当体育老师，也是学校篮球队的教练。他们有一个儿子叫张新，今年十一岁，上六年级。他从小就跟爸爸妈妈一起看球赛。他说他长大以后要当一个体育记者，这样就可以经常去世界各地免费看球赛了。
examples.translation: zhāng dōng míng shì yí gè zú qiú mí tā zuì xǐ huān de qiú xīng shì bā sāi luó nà jù lè bù de méi xī suǒ yǐ tā shōu jí le hěn duō méi xī de hǎi bào zhǐ yào diàn shì shàng yǒu qiú sài tā jiù bú huì cuò guò wèi le kàn qiú sài tā cháng cháng áo yè tā yě xǐ huān qù xiàn chǎng kàn qiú yīn wèi hé bié de qiú mí yì qǐ kàn qiú gèng rè nào tā zuì dà de yuàn wàng jiù shì zǎn qián qù bā sāi luó nà kàn yí cì méi xī de zhǔ chǎng bǐ sài yǒu kòng er de shí hòu tā yě huì yuē jǐ gè péng yǒu tī qiú suī rán tā tī de bú tài hǎo kě shì bù guǎn shū yíng tā dōu hěn kāi xīn zhāng dōng míng de tài tài shì gè lán qiú mí tā cóng shàng zhōng xué qǐ jiù kāi shǐ dǎ qiú hòu lái tā zài yí gè gāo zhōng dāng tǐ yù lǎo shī yě shì xué xiào lán qiú duì de jiào liàn tā men yǒu yí gè ér zi jiào zhāng xīn jīn nián shí yī suì shàng liù nián jí tā cóng xiǎo jiù gēn bà bà mā mā yì qǐ kàn qiú sài tā shuō tā zhǎng dà yǐ hòu yào dāng yí gè tǐ yù jì zhě zhè yàng jiù kě yǐ jīng cháng qù shì jiè gè dì miǎn fèi kàn qiú sài le — Zhang Dongming is a soccer fan. His favorite star is Messi of the Barcelona club, so he has collected many Messi posters. Whenever there is a match on TV, he won’t miss it. In order to watch matches, he often stays up late. He also likes to watch games live, because watching with other fans is livelier. His biggest wish is to save money and go to Barcelona to see one of Messi’s home games. When he has time, he also invites a few friends to play soccer. Although he doesn’t play very well, he is happy regardless of winning or losing. Zhang Dongming’s wife is a basketball fan; she began playing basketball from the time she was in middle school. Later she became a physical education teacher at a high school and is also the coach of the school’s basketball team. They have a son named Zhang Xin, who is eleven this year and in the sixth grade. Since childhood he has watched games with his father and mother. He says that when he grows up he wants to be a sports reporter, so that he can often go all over the world to watch matches for free.

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 2 (listening)
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening, Writing and Speaking). A. Global listening: 1. What is the topic of this presentation? 2. What is common among all the family members? B. Detailed listening: fill in the boxes with details about each family member’s recreational interests (张东明, 张太太, 儿子张新). C. Pair up, discuss and read Presentation 3 again if necessary. (From the passage, mine: ball games; they all love watching or playing ball games. 张东明: soccer fan, loves Messi, collects posters, stays up late, wishes to see Messi’s home game in Barcelona; 张太太: basketball fan, a high-school PE teacher and the coach of the school team; 张新: age eleven in sixth grade, watches games with his parents, wants to be a sports reporter.) Activity 2 (Listening, Writing and Speaking). Listen to Passages 1, 2 and 3, write a summary of each, exchange summaries, and talk with your partner about a parent’s favorite sports and players and about your own favorite sports and player and why. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Pair up and discuss the following words. Select any word that seems odd in each group and explain why those words were chosen. The book leaves the explanations blank; several answers are possible, and mine are:

examples.translation: hǎi bào yuàn wàng cuò guò jì zhě — Group 2. Mine: 错过 is a verb while the others are nouns.

examples.text: 输赢，主场，现场，巴塞罗那
examples.translation: shū yíng zhǔ chǎng xiàn chǎng bā sāi luó nà — Group 3. Mine: 输赢 is about the result while the others are places.

examples.text: 球星，球迷，体育，收集
examples.translation: qiú xīng qiú mí tǐ yù shōu jí — Group 4. Mine: 收集 is a verb while the others are nouns about sports.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Complete the sentences using the words 输赢, 错过, 攒钱, 免费, 熬夜, 收集, 愿望, 现场, 主场, 俱乐部. B. Pair up, check your work, read the sentences aloud and translate them into English. The book leaves the key out; my completed sentences (mine). The book writes NBA and FIFA World Cup in English in sentences 3 and 10; here they are 篮球联赛 and 世界杯:

examples.text: 张军是个足球迷。明天晚上有欧洲杯足球赛，张军打算熬夜看球赛。
examples.translation: zhāng jūn shì gè zú qiú mí míng tiān wǎn shàng yǒu ōu zhōu bēi zú qiú sài zhāng jūn dǎ suàn áo yè kàn qiú sài — 1. Zhang Jun is a soccer fan. Tomorrow night there is a European Cup match and Zhang Jun plans to stay up late to watch it. (熬夜; key mine)

examples.text: 下个周末，大卫请我一起去工人体育场看中国女足和美国女足的现场比赛。
examples.translation: xià gè zhōu mò dà wèi qǐng wǒ yì qǐ qù gōng rén tǐ yù chǎng kàn zhòng guó nǚ zú hé měi guó nǚ zú de xiàn chǎng bǐ sài — 2. Next weekend, David invited me to the Workers’ Stadium to watch the Chinese and American women’s soccer teams play live. (现场)

examples.text: 王力从小就喜欢看篮球。每次电视上有篮球联赛，他都不错过。
examples.translation: wáng lì cóng xiǎo jiù xǐ huān kàn lán qiú měi cì diàn shì shàng yǒu lán qiú lián sài tā dōu bú cuò guò — 3. Wang Li has liked watching basketball since childhood. Whenever there is a basketball league game on TV, he never misses it. (错过; the book writes the league’s name in English)

examples.text: 今天晚上德国和英国足球赛的主场在德国，你认为德国会赢吗？
examples.translation: jīn tiān wǎn shàng dé guó hé yīng guó zú qiú sài de zhǔ chǎng zài dé guó nǐ rèn wéi dé guó huì yíng ma — 4. Tonight’s Germany–England soccer match has its home field in Germany; do you think Germany will win? (主场)

examples.text: 李华特别喜欢足球。一上大学就参加了学校的足球俱乐部。
examples.translation: lǐ huá tè bié xǐ huān zú qiú yí shàng dà xué jiù cān jiā le xué xiào de zú qiú jù lè bù — 5. Li Hua especially likes soccer. As soon as he went to college he joined the school’s soccer club. (俱乐部)

examples.text: 我爸爸是个足球迷。虽然去国外看球很贵，他也要攒钱去看。
examples.translation: wǒ bà bà shì gè zú qiú mí suī rán qù guó wài kàn qiú hěn guì tā yě yào zǎn qián qù kàn — 6. My dad is a soccer fan. Although going abroad to watch a game is expensive, he wants to save money and go. (攒钱)

examples.text: 昨天，我哥哥的朋友送了他一张免费的摇滚乐演出票。
examples.translation: zuó tiān wǒ gē gē de péng yǒu sòng le tā yì zhāng miǎn fèi de yáo gǔn yuè yǎn chū piào — 7. Yesterday my older brother’s friend gave him a free ticket to a rock concert. (免费)

examples.text: 我弟弟最喜欢篮球，他收集了很多篮球明星的海报。
examples.translation: wǒ dì di zuì xǐ huān lán qiú tā shōu jí le hěn duō lán qiú míng xīng de hǎi bào — 8. My younger brother likes basketball best; he has collected many posters of basketball stars. (收集)

examples.text: 很多人喜欢参加体育比赛，不管输赢都觉得很开心。
examples.translation: hěn duō rén xǐ huān cān jiā tǐ yù bǐ sài bù guǎn shū yíng dōu jué de hěn kāi xīn — 9. Many people like taking part in sports competitions and feel happy whether they win or lose. (输赢)

examples.translation: wǒ zuì dà de yuàn wàng jiù shì qù ōu zhōu kàn yì cháng shì jiè bēi zú qiú sài — 10. My biggest wish is to go to Europe and watch a World Cup soccer game. (愿望; the book adds the English name)

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Speaking and Writing): Quick Survey
explanations.body: A. Interview at least two students in your class and ask the following questions; note their answers (学生1的回答 / 学生2的回答). B. Consolidate your notes and report your findings to the class.

examples.translation: wèi le qù xiàn chǎng kàn qiú sài nǐ huì huā hěn duō qián mǎi piào ma wèi shén me — 2. In order to watch a game live, would you spend a lot of money on tickets? Why?

lessons.title: 434. Lesson 17 Presentation 3 grammar: the preposition 为了/为
lessons.subtitle: 为了看球赛 · 为了减肥 · 为我做很多好吃的 · 为了 = in order to; 为 = for

explanations.title: The Preposition 为了/为
explanations.body: The preposition 为了 indicates the purpose of an action. It means “in order to” and is often used at the beginning of the sentence. 为了 + Noun/Verb. The preposition 为 means “for,” “for the reason of,” “for the sake of,” and “on behalf of.” 为 can precede nouns and pronouns. 为 + Noun/Pronoun. The book prints the five examples without English; the translations are mine.

examples.text: 为了看球赛，他常常熬夜。
examples.translation: wèi le kàn qiú sài tā cháng cháng áo yè — In order to watch ball games, he often stays up late. (为了 + Verb)

examples.text: 为了减肥，她常常去健身房运动。
examples.translation: wèi le jiǎn féi tā cháng cháng qù jiàn shēn fáng yùn dòng — In order to lose weight, she often goes to the gym to exercise.

examples.text: 为了家人，她什么都愿意做。
examples.translation: wèi le jiā rén tā shén me dōu yuàn yì zuò — For her family, she is willing to do anything. (为了 + Noun)

examples.text: 放暑假的时候，妈妈为我做很多好吃的。
examples.translation: fàng shǔ jià de shí hòu mā mā wèi wǒ zuò hěn duō hǎo chī de — During summer vacation, Mom makes lots of delicious food for me. (为 + Pronoun)

examples.text: 我们校长为老师和学生做了很多事。
examples.translation: wǒ men xiào zhǎng wèi lǎo shī hé xué shēng zuò le hěn duō shì — Our principal has done many things for the teachers and students. (为 + Noun)

explanations.title: Activities 1 and 2
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening, Writing, Speaking and Reading). A. Listen to six sentences with 为了/为 and translate them into English. B. Pair up, discuss your translations and repeat them in Chinese. (Audio, not included; the book’s instruction here says 才 by mistake.) Activity 2 (Reading and Speaking): 猜一猜! Pair up and answer the following questions with 为了. 1. 王林为什么周末的时候在餐馆当服务员？ 2. 昨天晚上有世界杯足球赛。老李为什么熬夜？ 3. 你知道今天赵新为什么没来上班？ 4. 你知道大卫为什么天天要练习踢足球？ 5. 小明的妈妈为什么下个周末请很多朋友来他家？ My guesses (mine):

examples.text: 王林为了挣钱交学费。
examples.translation: wáng lín wèi le zhèng qián jiāo xué fèi — 1. Why does Wang Lin work as a waiter in a restaurant on weekends? To earn money for tuition. (mine)

examples.text: 老李为了看世界杯足球赛。
examples.translation: lǎo lǐ wèi le kàn shì jiè bēi zú qiú sài — 2. Why did Old Li stay up late? In order to watch the World Cup match. (mine)

examples.text: 赵新为了陪生病的孩子去医院。
examples.translation: zhào xīn wèi le péi shēng bìng de hái zi qù yī yuàn — 3. Why didn’t Zhao Xin come to work today? To take his sick child to the hospital. (mine)

examples.text: 大卫为了参加学校的足球比赛。
examples.translation: dà wèi wèi le cān jiā xué xiào de zú qiú bǐ sài — 4. Why does David practice soccer every day? In order to take part in the school soccer game. (mine)

examples.text: 小明的妈妈为了给他过生日。
examples.translation: xiǎo míng de mā mā wèi le gěi tā guò shēng rì — 5. Why is Xiao Ming’s mother inviting many friends to his home next weekend? In order to celebrate his birthday. (mine)

options: The purpose of an action (in order to)

exercises.prompt: What does 为 mean before a noun or pronoun?
options: For / for the sake of / on behalf of

exercises.prompt: Where is 为了 often placed?
options: At the beginning of the sentence

exercises.prompt: What does 为了减肥，她常常去健身房运动 mean?
options: She lost weight at the gym
In order to lose weight, she often goes to the gym

exercises.prompt: What does 妈妈为我做很多好吃的 mean?
options: Mom cooks lots of delicious food for me

exercises.prompt: Which fits “For her family she would do anything”?
options: 家人为了她什么都愿意做
因为家人，她什么都愿意
为了家人，她什么都愿意做

exercises.prompt: 我们校长___老师和学生做了很多事。

lessons.title: 435. Lesson 17 Presentation 3 grammar: the degree adverb 更
lessons.subtitle: 和别的球迷一起看球更热闹 · 更喜欢乒乓球 · A 比 B 更…

explanations.title: The Degree Adverb 更
explanations.body: The degree adverb 更 can be used before adjectives/verbs to express “even more.” 更 + Adjective/Verb. 更 is also used in a sentence that shows comparison when introduced by 比. A 比 B + 更 + Adjective.

examples.text: 他喜欢去现场看球，因为和别的球迷一起看球更热闹。
examples.translation: tā xǐ huān qù xiàn chǎng kàn qiú yīn wèi hé bié de qiú mí yì qǐ kàn qiú gèng rè nào — He likes to watch games live, because watching with other fans is livelier. (更 + Adj.)

examples.text: 张新喜欢篮球和足球，但更喜欢乒乓球。
examples.translation: zhāng xīn xǐ huān lán qiú hé zú qiú dàn gèng xǐ huān pīng pāng qiú — Zhang Xin likes basketball and soccer, but likes table tennis even more. (更 + Verb)

examples.text: 在现场看球比在家里看球更热闹。
examples.translation: zài xiàn chǎng kàn qiú bǐ zài jiā lǐ kàn qiú gèng rè nào — Watching a game live is even livelier than watching at home. (A 比 B 更 + Adj.)

examples.text: 我们的球队比你们的球队打得更好。
examples.translation: wǒ men de qiú duì bǐ nǐ men de qiú duì dǎ de gèng hǎo — Our team plays even better than your team.

explanations.title: Activities 3 and 4
explanations.body: Activity 3 (Listening, Speaking and Writing). A. Listen to the conversation and take notes on what activities each speaker likes to do with their spare time and why they prefer one activity over others (the table has 喜欢 / 更喜欢 / 因为 for each speaker, beginning with 王力). B. Using the information you have heard about the use of 更, write a few descriptive sentences beneath each of four groups of images. (Audio and pictures, not included.) Activity 4 (Reading, Writing and Speaking). A. Complete the brief dialogs with 更 and the words in parentheses. B. Pair up, check your sentences and translate what you wrote into English. The book’s example and my answers (mine):

examples.text: 你经常在网上买东西吗？
examples.translation: nǐ jīng cháng zài wǎng shàng mǎi dōng xī ma — Example. A: Do you often shop online?

examples.text: 有时候在网上买，但是我更喜欢去商店买。
examples.translation: yǒu shí hòu zài wǎng shàng mǎi dàn shì wǒ gèng xǐ huān qù shāng diàn mǎi — B: Sometimes I buy online, but I prefer going to the stores. (the book’s example)

examples.text: 王英，你喜欢去哪儿锻炼身体？
examples.translation: wáng yīng nǐ xǐ huān qù nǎr duàn liàn shēn tǐ — 1. A: Wang Ying, where do you like to exercise?

examples.text: 我喜欢去健身房，但是我更喜欢去海边跑步。
examples.translation: wǒ xǐ huān qù jiàn shēn fáng dàn shì wǒ gèng xǐ huān qù hǎi biān pǎo bù — B: I like going to the gym, but I like running by the sea even more. (mine)

examples.text: 李东，你喜欢哪个篮球明星？
examples.translation: lǐ dōng nǐ xǐ huān nǎ ge lán qiú míng xīng — 2. A: Li Dong, which basketball star do you like?

examples.text: 我喜欢乔丹，不过我更喜欢科比。
examples.translation: wǒ xǐ huān qiáo dān bú guò wǒ gèng xǐ huān kē bǐ — B: I like Jordan, but I like Kobe more. (mine; the book writes the names in English too)

examples.text: 林老师，听说您做饭做得非常好？
examples.translation: lín lǎo shī tīng shuō nín zuò fàn zuò de fēi cháng hǎo — 3. A: Teacher Lin, I heard you cook very well?

examples.text: 还可以，不过我太太做得比我更好。
examples.translation: hái kě yǐ bú guò wǒ tài tài zuò de bǐ wǒ gèng hǎo — B: Not bad, but my wife cooks even better than I do. (mine)

examples.text: 今年蒙特雷的冬天不是很冷。
examples.translation: jīn nián méng tè léi de dōng tiān bú shì hěn lěng — 4. A: This year Monterey’s winter isn’t very cold.

examples.text: 是啊，不过夏威夷的冬天更暖和。
examples.translation: shì a bú guò xià wēi yí de dōng tiān gèng nuǎn huo — B: Yes, but Hawaii’s winter is even warmer. (mine)

examples.text: 琳达，你喜欢打什么球？
examples.translation: lín dá nǐ xǐ huān dǎ shén me qiú — 5. A: Linda, what ball sport do you like to play?

examples.text: 我喜欢足球和篮球，不过我更喜欢乒乓球。
examples.translation: wǒ xǐ huān zú qiú hé lán qiú bú guò wǒ gèng xǐ huān pīng pāng qiú — B: I like soccer and basketball, but I like table tennis even more. (mine)

examples.text: 马克，你喜欢什么户外运动？
examples.translation: mǎ kè nǐ xǐ huān shén me hù wài yùn dòng — 6. A: Mark, what outdoor sport do you like?

examples.text: 我喜欢滑雪和滑冰，但是我更喜欢冲浪。
examples.translation: wǒ xǐ huān huá xuě hé huá bīng dàn shì wǒ gèng xǐ huān chōng làng — B: I like skiing and ice skating, but I like surfing even more. (mine)

exercises.prompt: Where does 更 go in a 比 sentence?
options: After 比 B, before the adjective
exercises.explanation: A 比 B 更 + Adj.

exercises.prompt: What does 张新…但更喜欢乒乓球 mean?
options: He likes table tennis even more

exercises.prompt: What does 在现场看球比在家里看球更热闹 mean?
options: Watching live is livelier than watching at home
我们的球队比你们的球队更打得好
更我们的球队比你们打得好
我们的球队比你们的球队打得更好
我们的球队更比你们的球队打得好
exercises.explanation: A 比 B 打得更好.

options: 我喜欢足球，但是我更喜欢篮球

lessons.title: 436. Lesson 17 Presentation 3 grammar: the construction 不管……都……
lessons.subtitle: 不管输赢，他都很开心 · 不管明天下不下雨，我们都要去爬山 · 开心一刻

explanations.title: The Construction 不管…，都…
explanations.body: 不管 means “no matter,” “regardless” and “in despite of.” It appears at the beginning of the sentence. 都 is used in the second part of the sentence to emphasize that the action or decision will not change. 不管…，都…

examples.text: 虽然他踢得不太好，可是不管输赢，他都很开心。
examples.translation: suī rán tā tī de bú tài hǎo kě shì bù guǎn shū yíng tā dōu hěn kāi xīn — Although he doesn’t play very well, he is very happy regardless of winning or losing.

examples.text: 不管明天下不下雨，我们都要去爬山。
examples.translation: bù guǎn míng tiān xià bú xià yǔ wǒ men dōu yào qù pá shān — We must go hiking whether it rains or not.

examples.text: 妈妈常常对我说，不管你有没有时间，都得吃早饭。
examples.translation: mā mā cháng cháng duì wǒ shuō bù guǎn nǐ yǒu méi yǒu shí jiān dōu děi chī zǎo fàn — My mother always says to me, whether you have time or not, you must eat breakfast.

explanations.title: Activities 5 and 6
explanations.body: Activity 5 (Listening and Speaking). A. Listen to six sentences with 不管…，都… and translate them into English. B. In pairs, check your translation and repeat the sentences in Chinese. (Audio, not included.) Activity 6 (Reading and Writing). Pair up and write answers to the six questions using 不管…，都… (the book leaves the lines blank; mine):

examples.text: 今天我做晚饭，你想吃什么？
examples.translation: jīn tiān wǒ zuò wǎn fàn nǐ xiǎng chī shén me — 1. A: I’ll cook dinner today; what do you want to eat?

examples.text: 不管你做什么，我都爱吃。
examples.translation: bù guǎn nǐ zuò shén me wǒ dōu ài chī — B: No matter what you cook, I love it. (mine)

examples.text: 这个周末我们去哪儿玩比较好？
examples.translation: zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ men qù nǎr wán bǐ jiào hǎo — 2. A: Where would be better to go this weekend?

examples.text: 不管去哪儿，我都愿意。
examples.translation: bù guǎn qù nǎr wǒ dōu yuàn yì — B: No matter where, I’m willing. (mine)

examples.text: 今天我有点儿不开心，我可以不上课吗？
examples.translation: jīn tiān wǒ yǒu diǎnr bù kāi xīn wǒ kě yǐ bú shàng kè ma — 3. A: I’m a little unhappy today; may I skip class?

examples.text: 不管你开心不开心，都得去上课。
examples.translation: bù guǎn nǐ kāi xīn bù kāi xīn dōu děi qù shàng kè — B: Whether you’re happy or not, you have to go to class. (mine)

examples.text: 我不太喜欢逛商店，你和别人去行吗？
examples.translation: wǒ bú tài xǐ huān guàng shāng diàn nǐ hé bié rén qù xíng ma — 4. A: I don’t much like shopping; is it OK if you go with someone else?

examples.text: 不管你喜欢不喜欢，今天你都得陪我去。
examples.translation: bù guǎn nǐ xǐ huān bù xǐ huān jīn tiān nǐ dōu děi péi wǒ qù — B: Whether you like it or not, you have to go with me today. (mine)

examples.text: 我不想弹钢琴，我可以玩游戏吗？
examples.translation: wǒ bù xiǎng tán gāng qín wǒ kě yǐ wán yóu xì ma — 5. A: I don’t want to play the piano; may I play games?

examples.text: 不管你想不想弹，都得先练习半个小时。
examples.translation: bù guǎn nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng dàn dōu děi xiān liàn xí bàn gè xiǎo shí — B: Whether you want to or not, you have to practice for half an hour first. (mine)

examples.text: 我知道你不高兴，你今天谁都不想见吗？
examples.translation: wǒ zhī dào nǐ bù gāo xìng nǐ jīn tiān shéi dōu bù xiǎng jiàn ma — 6. A: I know you’re unhappy; do you not want to see anyone today?

examples.text: 不管谁来，我都不想见。
examples.translation: bù guǎn shuí lái wǒ dōu bù xiǎng jiàn — B: No matter who comes, I don’t want to see them. (mine)

explanations.title: Activity 7 (Reading and Speaking): 开心一刻
explanations.body: Read the joke. Do you find it funny? Do you have a joke to tell the class?

examples.text: 爸爸：小明，爸爸今天太累了，不管谁打来电话，你都说我不在家。
examples.translation: bà bà xiǎo míng bà bà jīn tiān tài lèi le bù guǎn shuí dǎ lái diàn huà nǐ dōu shuō wǒ bú zài jiā — Dad: Xiao Ming, Dad is too tired today. No matter who calls, you say I’m not at home.

examples.text: 小明（接电话）：喂，我爸爸说他不在家。
examples.translation: xiǎo míng jiē diàn huà wèi wǒ bà bà shuō tā bú zài jiā — Xiao Ming (answering the phone): Hello, my dad says he’s not at home.

options: At the beginning of the sentence
The action or decision will not change

exercises.prompt: What does 不管输赢，他都很开心 mean?
options: He is happy whether he wins or loses
He is sad when he loses

exercises.prompt: What does 不管明天下不下雨，我们都要去爬山 mean?
options: We’ll go only if it’s sunny
We’ll go hiking whether or not it rains
Xiao Ming tells the caller his dad says he’s not at home

exercises.prompt: ___管你有没有时间，都得吃早饭。

lessons.title: 437. Lesson 17 Presentation 3 grammar: the time words 后来 vs. 以后
lessons.subtitle: 后来 for the past · 以后 for past and future · 然后 · 姚明

explanations.title: The Time Words 后来 vs. 以后
explanations.body: Both 后来 and 以后 can be translated as “afterwards,” but they are not always interchangeable. 以后 can be used to refer to both past and future events, whereas 后来 is restricted to only the past. 以后 can be used after a clause to express the meaning “after…,” while 后来 cannot. 然后, which you learned earlier, is another expression that can be translated as “afterward.” It has the same function as 后来, but 然后 can be used to refer to both past and future time frames. The incorrect sentences the book marks are 这个问题后来再说 and 我下课后来去看你.

examples.text: 她从上中学起就开始打球。后来，她在一个高中当体育老师。
examples.translation: tā cóng shàng zhōng xué qǐ jiù kāi shǐ dǎ qiú hòu lái tā zài yí gè gāo zhōng dāng tǐ yù lǎo shī — She began playing from middle school on. Later she became a PE teacher at a high school. (后来: past)

examples.text: 他说他长大以后要当一个体育记者。
examples.translation: tā shuō tā zhǎng dà yǐ hòu yào dāng yí gè tǐ yù jì zhě — He says that when he grows up he wants to become a sports reporter. (以后: future)

examples.text: 十年前我在这儿住过，以后就再没来过。
examples.translation: shí nián qián wǒ zài zhèr zhù guò yǐ hòu jiù zài méi lái guò — Ten years ago I lived here; ever since then I have never come again. (以后)

examples.text: 十年前我在这儿住过，后来就再没来过。
examples.translation: shí nián qián wǒ zài zhèr zhù guò hòu lái jiù zài méi lái guò — Ten years ago I lived here; after that I never came again. (后来)

examples.text: 这个问题以后再说。
examples.translation: zhè ge wèn tí yǐ hòu zài shuō — Let’s talk about this problem later. (correct)

examples.text: 我下课以后去看你。
examples.translation: wǒ xià kè yǐ hòu qù kàn nǐ — I’ll go see you after class. (以后 after a clause; correct. 我下课后来去看你 is incorrect.)

examples.text: 那天我们先去了银行，然后才回学校。
examples.translation: nà tiān wǒ men xiān qù le yín háng rán hòu cái huí xué xiào — That day we first went to the bank and then went back to school. (然后, past)

explanations.title: Activity 7 (Reading and Speaking): 考考你
explanations.body: A. Complete the sentences using 后来, 以后 or 然后. B. Pair up and compare your answers, explaining the differences between 后来, 以后 and 然后. The book leaves the key out; my completed sentences (mine):

examples.text: 我小学的时候喜欢踢足球，上了中学后来我开始喜欢篮球了。

explanations.title: Activity 8 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): Yao Ming
explanations.body: A. Read the passage below about the Chinese basketball player Yao Ming and write a summary, paying attention to 后来, 以后 and 然后. B. Pair up and compare your summaries. C. Tell your partner about your interests and hobbies using 后来, 以后 and 然后 (your story).

examples.text: 姚明从小就喜欢篮球。上小学时，每天下课以后，他先去打篮球，然后再回家。后来，他去上海的体育运动技术学院训练篮球。那个时候，他的身高是一米九一，比别人高很多。到了那儿以后，教练让他多睡觉，这样他会长得更高。后来，他的身高长到二米二六。一九九八年他开始在中国国家篮球队打球，得了很多冠军。后来他成为了美国职业篮球联赛的球员。
examples.translation: yáo míng cóng xiǎo jiù xǐ huān lán qiú shàng xiǎo xué shí měi tiān xià kè yǐ hòu tā xiān qù dǎ lán qiú rán hòu zài huí jiā hòu lái tā qù shàng hǎi de tǐ yù yùn dòng jì shù xué yuàn xùn liàn lán qiú nà ge shí hòu tā de shēn gāo shì yì mǐ jiǔ yī bǐ bié rén gāo hěn duō dào le nàr yǐ hòu jiào liàn ràng tā duō shuì jiào zhè yàng tā huì zhǎng de gèng gāo hòu lái tā de shēn gāo zhǎng dào èr mǐ èr liù yī jiǔ jiǔ bā nián tā kāi shǐ zài zhōng guó guó jiā lán qiú duì dǎ qiú dé le hěn duō guàn jūn hòu lái tā chéng wéi le měi guó zhí yè lán qiú lián sài de qiú yuán — Yao Ming has liked basketball since childhood. In elementary school, after class every day he first went to play basketball and then went home. Later he went to the Shanghai Sports Technical Institute to train in basketball. At that time his height was 1.91 meters, much taller than others. After arriving there, the coach had him sleep more so that he would grow even taller. Later his height grew to 2.26 meters. In 1998 he began playing for the Chinese national basketball team and won many championships. Later he became a player in the American professional basketball league (the NBA). (The book writes the height and year as digits and the league as NBA.)

lessons.title: 438. Lesson 17 Presentation 3: skill integration
lessons.subtitle: 张军一家的爱好 · 习近平的爱好 · 李军这样的球迷

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Writing, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the monolog and write the EEIs (essential elements of information) about Zhang Jun’s family in pinyin: for each of 爸爸, 妈妈, 哥哥 and 我, fill in 爱好 (…迷) and 其他信息. B. Pair up and exchange your EEIs, then read the script and summarize it. C. Talk about your family members’ interest in sports with your partner and note the information (你同学的家人: 爸爸, 妈妈, 兄弟姐妹, 你同学本人; 体育爱好 and 其他信息). D. Report the hobbies of your partner’s family members to the class. (Audio and script, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): the interview article
explanations.body: Read the article about Chinese President Xi Jinping. A. Pair up. The teacher cuts the article into four to six segments and mixes them up. Each pair picks two or three segments and arranges them in logical order, then (1) writes any words you don’t know and discusses their meanings, and (2) summarizes the segments and prepares to retell them to a new partner. B. Pair up with a new partner: read your summary and explain the new words; re-order all the segments and summarize the entire article in a few sentences. C. Talk about any American president that you know of who likes sports. (Photograph, public domain, not included.)

examples.text: 最近中国国家主席习近平接受了俄罗斯记者的采访。当记者问他有些什么爱好时，他说：“我爱阅读、看电影、旅游、散步。说到体育活动，我喜欢游泳、爬山等运动，我还喜欢足球、排球、篮球、网球、武术等运动。另外，我也喜欢看冰雪类比赛，像冰球和花样滑冰比赛什么的。”习近平在年轻的时候就特别喜欢足球，他不但喜欢踢球，而且也爱看球赛。他的父亲习仲勋在北京工作的时候，习近平就常常去北京工人体育馆的足球场踢球。每次有大的足球赛时，他早早地就跑去体育馆的售票窗口排队买票看比赛。在二零零八年七月，北京办奥林匹克运动会以前，习近平到北京附近检查足球场地的时候，穿着皮鞋就在草地上踢起了足球，看到他踢球的人都认为他踢得很棒，还说他一定常常练习踢球。除了踢足球踢得很好以外，习近平游泳也游得非常好。在《华盛顿邮报》的书面采访中，他说：“我爱运动，游泳是我的最爱。锻炼身体不但让我的身体更健康，也让我的工作更有效率！”
examples.translation: zuì jìn zhōng guó guó jiā zhǔ xí xí jìn píng jiē shòu le é luó sī jì zhě de cǎi fǎng dāng jì zhě wèn tā yǒu xiē shén me ài hào shí tā shuō wǒ ài yuè dú kàn diàn yǐng lǚ yóu sàn bù shuō dào tǐ yù huó dòng wǒ xǐ huān yóu yǒng pá shān děng yùn dòng wǒ hái xǐ huān zú qiú pái qiú lán qiú wǎng qiú wǔ shù děng yùn dòng lìng wài wǒ yě xǐ huān kàn bīng xuě lèi bǐ sài xiàng bīng qiú hé huā yàng huá bīng bǐ sài shén me de xí jìn píng zài nián qīng de shí hòu jiù tè bié xǐ huān zú qiú tā bú dàn xǐ huān tī qiú ér qiě yě ài kàn qiú sài tā de fù qīn xí zhòng xūn zài běi jīng gōng zuò de shí hòu xí jìn píng jiù cháng cháng qù běi jīng gōng rén tǐ yù guǎn de zú qiú chǎng tī qiú měi cì yǒu dà de zú qiú sài shí tā zǎo zǎo de jiù pǎo qù tǐ yù guǎn de shòu piào chuāng kǒu pái duì mǎi piào kàn bǐ sài zài èr líng líng bā nián qī yuè běi jīng bàn ào lín pǐ kè yùn dòng huì yǐ qián xí jìn píng dào běi jīng fù jìn jiǎn chá zú qiú chǎng dì de shí hòu chuān zhe pí xié jiù zài cǎo dì shàng tī qǐ le zú qiú kàn dào tā tī qiú de rén dōu rèn wéi tā tī de hěn bàng hái shuō tā yí dìng cháng cháng liàn xí tī qiú chú le tī zú qiú tī de hěn hǎo yǐ wài xí jìn píng yóu yǒng yě yóu de fēi cháng hǎo zài huá shèng dùn yóu bào de shū miàn cǎi fǎng zhōng tā shuō wǒ ài yùn dòng yóu yǒng shì wǒ de zuì ài duàn liàn shēn tǐ bú dàn ràng wǒ de shēn tǐ gèng jiàn kāng yě ràng wǒ de gōng zuò gèng yǒu xiào lǜ — Recently China’s President Xi Jinping gave an interview to a Russian reporter. When the reporter asked him what hobbies he has, he said: “I love reading, watching movies, traveling and taking walks. As for sports, I like swimming, mountain climbing and the like, and I also like soccer, volleyball, basketball, tennis, martial arts and so on. In addition, I also like watching ice-and-snow competitions, such as ice hockey and figure skating.” When he was young Xi Jinping especially liked soccer; he not only liked to play but also loved watching matches. When his father Xi Zhongxun worked in Beijing, Xi Jinping often went to play soccer on the soccer field of the Beijing Workers’ Gymnasium. Every time there was a big soccer match, he would run to the stadium’s ticket window early to line up to buy tickets to watch the game. In July 2008, before Beijing hosted the Olympic Games, when Xi Jinping went to the area near Beijing to inspect soccer fields, he started playing soccer on the grass in leather shoes, and the people who saw him play thought he played very well and said he must practice playing often. Besides playing soccer very well, Xi Jinping also swims very well. In a written interview with the Washington Post he said: “I love sports, and swimming is my favorite. Exercising not only makes my body healthier but also makes my work more efficient!” (The book glosses 俄罗斯, 武术, 奥林匹克 and 效率 in pinyin and writes the year as digits.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening, Writing, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the passage about Li Jun and note the EEIs in pinyin. New words: 采访 (cǎifǎng; interview), 大喊大叫 (dà hǎn dà jiào; yell), 生气 (shēngqì; upset), 受不了 (shòu bùliǎo; can’t stand). B. Pair up and, using what you heard, mark the statements as True or False and explain why any is false: 1. 李军工作很忙，很少去现场看球赛。 2. 李军的太太常常和他一起看球赛。 3. 李军通常周末看球赛，平时看其他的电视节目。 4. 李军的太太经常自己逛商店。 5. 李军和朋友看球的时候，非常安静。 6. 李军的太太在自己的房间里看球。 C. In two groups discuss: 1. 你喜欢李军这样的球迷吗？为什么？ 2. 你是球迷吗？你是一个什么样的球迷？ 3. 在美国，什么球迷最多？为什么会有这么多的球迷？ 4. 请说说你最喜欢的一场球赛。 (Audio, not included, so no answers for the statements.)

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): the ticket office
explanations.body: Role-Play: You are studying Chinese at Beijing University in China. You like soccer very much and hope to watch a soccer match at the stadium. You saw a notice in the newspaper about the China Cup International Soccer Championship and you’d like to see it. Call the ticket office to ask about the game schedule, the availability and price of tickets, which match you want to see, etc. A. Pair up and read the notice below; think of questions with your partner. B. Call the ticket office; your partner plays the ticket seller. You may use the following questions as reference (你要问的问题 / 接电话人的问题 and 其他问题). C. Note your information. The book prints the dates and the phone number in digits; here they are spelled out.

examples.text: 中国杯国际足球锦标赛
examples.translation: zhōng guó bēi guó jì zú qiú jǐn biāo sài — China Cup International Soccer Championship

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Speaking and Writing): popular American athletes
explanations.body: Scenario: You are studying Chinese at a university in China. Your teacher assigns you a project to introduce popular American athletes. You will choose one star player each from basketball (篮球 lánqiú), baseball (棒球 bàngqiú) and football (橄榄球 gǎnlǎnqiú). Divide into three groups; each group reports on one player. A. In your group, discuss which player you’d like to introduce, following the questions as a guide (conduct online research if necessary): the table has Group 1 (篮球球星), Group 2 (棒球球星) and Group 3 (橄榄球球星) under 报告内容, and the questions below plus 其他信息. B. Consolidate your group discussion and prepare a PowerPoint presentation. C. Each group takes turns to present their player to the class. (Pictures, not included.)

examples.text: 1. 你要介绍的球星是谁？
examples.translation: nǐ yào jiè shào de qiú xīng shì shuí — Who is the star you will introduce?

examples.text: 2. 他是哪个球队的？
examples.translation: tā shì nǎ ge qiú duì de — Which team is he on?

examples.text: 3. 他的老家在哪儿？
examples.translation: tā de lǎo jiā zài nǎr — Where is his hometown?

examples.text: 4. 他是几号球员？
examples.translation: tā shì jǐ hào qiú yuán — What is his number?

examples.text: 5. 他从什么时候起在这个球队打球？
examples.translation: tā cóng shén me shí hòu qǐ zài zhè ge qiú duì dǎ qiú — Since when has he played for this team?

examples.text: 6. 他的球队赢了多少次？
examples.translation: tā de qiú duì yíng le duō shǎo cì — How many times has his team won?

examples.text: 7. 他们最近的一次比赛是什么时候？
examples.translation: tā men zuì jìn de yí cì bǐ sài shì shén me shí hòu — When was their most recent game?

examples.text: 8. 除了打球，他有什么兴趣和爱好？
examples.translation: chú le dǎ qiú tā yǒu shén me xìng qù hé ài hào — Besides playing ball, what interests and hobbies does he have?

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening, Writing and Speaking): which team to join
explanations.body: Scenario: You are studying Chinese in a university in China. You just heard a radio announcement on campus that the school is recruiting players for basketball and soccer, sports you really enjoy playing. However, you can only join one team because your Chinese studies are very intensive and you don’t have time to play two sports. Seek advice from your classmates to help you decide which sport to play. A. Listen to the radio announcement and write a summary. (Audio, not included.) B. Divide into two groups. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of basketball and soccer and explain which sport is better for you. C. Each group presents its discussion to the class and explains why they made the right choice; you will make a final decision about which sport to play. The book leaves the table blank; a sample:

可以和很多朋友一起踢，对身体好，不用太多装备
场地大，练习需要的时间长，下雨天不能踢

lessons.title: 441. Lesson 17 Area Studies: Sports in China
lessons.subtitle: 足球 · 篮球 · 乒乓球 · 排球 · traditional sports · minority sports · the sports industry

explanations.title: Sports in China: soccer, basketball and ping pong
explanations.body: Chinese people today enjoy a variety of competitive sports. Among them, football (soccer) is one of the most popular. Football games earn the highest television ratings of any sport in the country. The Chinese Football Association (CFA) established China’s first professional football league in 2004, the Chinese Super League (CSL), the premier football league in China. However, at the international level, Chinese football has enjoyed little success despite the amount of support it receives from fans. Basketball is now the number one sport in China. There are about 300 million basketball fans, ranking first in all sports. The total number of basketball courts in China is close to 800,000. The Chinese Men’s Basketball Professional League has a huge number of followers. It starts in October or November each year and ends around April of the following year. The league’s scale, management, operation and attention are all rated as the best professional league in China. Ping pong (乒乓球) is a popular and revered game in China. Apart from the national teams, the table tennis community in the country continues to produce many world-class players, and this depth of skill allows the country to continue dominating world titles after a short break during the 1990s. The overwhelming dominance of China in the sport has triggered a series of rule changes in the International Table Tennis Federation.

explanations.title: Volleyball, traditional sports and the sports industry
explanations.body: Volleyball is another very popular game in China, especially on school campuses. The China Women’s National Volleyball Team is one of the leading squads in women’s international volleyball. The team became the world’s first team with “five consecutive championships” in the 1980s. It went on to win another five world championships from 2003 to 2019. China has inherited a variety of traditional sports, which have very distinct Chinese characteristics. The most popular ones are martial arts, taijiquan (shadow boxing), qigong (deep breathing exercises), Xiangqi (Chinese chess), Weiqi (known as “Go” in the West) and mahjong. Taijiquan is a kind of Chinese boxing that combines control of breath, mind and body. It emphasizes body movement following mind movement, tempering toughness with gentleness and graceful carriage. Qigong is a unique Chinese way of keeping fit. It aims at enhancing health, prolonging life, curing illness and improving physiological functions by concentrating the mind and regulating breathing. Xiangqi and Weiqi were two of the five sports featured at the 2008 World Mind Sports Games held in Beijing. There are also various entertaining and competitive sports activities in the minority inhabited areas. For example, wrestling and horsemanship are popular among Mongols, Uyghurs and Kazaks. Tibetan people like yak racing very much, and people in Korean communities enjoy “seesaw jumping.” Crossbow archery is very trendy among the Miao, and dragon-boat racing attracts a large number of followers among the Dai ethnic minority. Sports has become a huge industry in China. The total output of China’s national sports industry is about 3 trillion yuan, and the added value of the sports industry is over one trillion yuan, more than 1% of China’s GDP. (Photographs, not included.)
