explanations.title: Activity 9 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening): the DLI teacher’s journal
explanations.body: Read the following journal of a teacher at the Defense Language Institute and complete the tasks. A. Make a list of things you often bring to social gatherings (我常常带去派对或聚会的东西), then pair up and share it. B. Each partner reads two paragraphs of the passage and writes a summary of that part. C. Exchange the information and together mark each of the statements True or False (my key follows the passage). D. Share your answers with the class.

examples.text: 上个周末是一个长周末，所以我们请了一些朋友到家里来聚一聚。星期六那天是个阳光灿烂、风和日丽的日子，气温大约七十华氏度，不冷不热，非常适合聚会。我们大概请了十几个朋友，他们有的带来了自己的孩子，有的带来了男朋友或女朋友，甚至有的还把爸妈也带来了，一下子我们家后院到处都是人，热闹极了。
examples.translation: shàng gè zhōu mò shì yí gè cháng zhōu mò suǒ yǐ wǒ men qǐng le yì xiē péng yǒu dào jiā lǐ lái jù yí jù xīng qī liù nà tiān shì gè yáng guāng càn làn fēng hé rì lì de rì zi qì wēn dà yuē qī shí huá shì dù bù lěng bú rè fēi cháng shì hé jù huì wǒ men dà gài qǐng le shí jǐ gè péng yǒu tā men yǒu de dài lái le zì jǐ de hái zi yǒu de dài lái le nán péng yǒu huò nǚ péng yǒu shèn zhì yǒu de hái bǎ bà mā yě dài lái le yí xià zi wǒ men jiā hòu yuàn dào chù dōu shì rén rè nào jí le — 1. Last weekend was a long weekend, so we invited some friends to our home to get together. Saturday was a sunny, bright and pleasant day, with a temperature of about seventy degrees Fahrenheit, neither cold nor hot, perfect for a party. We invited about a dozen or so friends; some brought their own children, some brought boyfriends or girlfriends, and some even brought their parents too, so all at once our backyard was full of people everywhere, extremely lively.

examples.text: 我和太太准备了餐具、桌子、椅子和一些饮料、果汁和冰块。在客人们到以前，我已经把烧烤的东西准备好了，烤羊肉和烤鸡腿、鸡翅是我的拿手菜。我太太还亲自做了一个苹果派作为大家的甜点。
examples.translation: wǒ hé tài tài zhǔn bèi le cān jù zhuō zi yǐ zi hé yì xiē yǐn liào guǒ zhī hé bīng kuài zài kè rén men dào yǐ qián wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ shāo kǎo de dōng xī zhǔn bèi hǎo le kǎo yáng ròu hé kǎo jī tuǐ jī chì shì wǒ de ná shǒu cài wǒ tài tài hái qīn zì zuò le yí gè píng guǒ pài zuò wéi dà jiā de tián diǎn — 2. My wife and I prepared tableware, tables, chairs and some drinks, juice and ice cubes. Before the guests arrived I had already gotten the barbecue things ready; grilled lamb, grilled chicken legs and wings are my specialties. My wife also personally made an apple pie as everyone’s dessert.

examples.text: 马克和他的女朋友带来了一些啤酒和热狗。张林和他的爸妈准备了很多中式的食品：烧牛肉、鸡蛋饼和饺子。我太太的同学安娜买了两大盒水果，有草莓、菠萝、西瓜等等，另外她还做了一个意大利面。
examples.translation: mǎ kè hé tā de nǚ péng yǒu dài lái le yì xiē pí jiǔ hé rè gǒu zhāng lín hé tā de bà mā zhǔn bèi le hěn duō zhōng shì de shí pǐn shāo niú ròu jī dàn bǐng hé jiǎo zi wǒ tài tài de tóng xué ān nà mǎi le liǎng dà hé shuǐ guǒ yǒu cǎo méi bō luó xī guā děng děng lìng wài tā hái zuò le yí gè yì dà lì miàn — 3. Mark and his girlfriend brought some beer and hot dogs. Zhang Lin and his parents prepared lots of Chinese food: braised beef, egg pancakes and dumplings. My wife’s classmate Anna bought two big boxes of fruit, including strawberries, pineapple, watermelon and so on, and she also made a pasta dish.

examples.text: 大家都到了以后，我们把所有的饭菜、酒、饮料、水果、餐具等摆到了桌子上，然后大家就开始一边吃、一边喝、一边聊天。在大家吃着的时候，我还忙着我的烧烤，因为我想给大家吃热的烤肉。孩子们很快就吃好了，然后他们就在院子里的草地上跑来跑去地玩。我们大人们则围坐在桌边，开心地喝酒聊天。大家一直玩到下午五点才回家。
examples.translation: dà jiā dōu dào le yǐ hòu wǒ men bǎ suǒ yǒu de fàn cài jiǔ yǐn liào shuǐ guǒ cān jù děng bǎi dào le zhuō zi shàng rán hòu dà jiā jiù kāi shǐ yì biān chī yì biān hē yì biān liáo tiān zài dà jiā chī zhe de shí hòu wǒ hái máng zhe wǒ de shāo kǎo yīn wèi wǒ xiǎng gěi dà jiā chī rè de kǎo ròu hái zi men hěn kuài jiù chī hǎo le rán hòu tā men jiù zài yuàn zi lǐ de cǎo dì shàng pǎo lái pǎo qù de wán wǒ men dà rén men zé wéi zuò zài zhuō biān kāi xīn de hē jiǔ liáo tiān dà jiā yì zhí wán dào xià wǔ wǔ diǎn cái huí jiā — 4. After everyone had arrived, we set all the dishes, wine, drinks, fruit and tableware on the table, and then everyone began eating, drinking and chatting. While everyone was eating I was still busy with my barbecue because I wanted everyone to eat hot grilled meat. The children finished eating quickly, then ran around playing on the grass in the yard. We adults sat around the table drinking and chatting happily. Everyone played until five in the afternoon before going home. (The book writes 70 as digits.)

examples.text: 作者邀请朋友们到他家参加一个生日聚会。
examples.translation: zuò zhě yāo qǐng péng yǒu men dào tā jiā cān jiā yí gè shēng rì jù huì — 1. The author invited friends to a birthday party at his home. — False (it was a get-together over the long weekend; key mine)

examples.text: 那天的天气晴朗，不冷不热。
examples.translation: nà tiān de tiān qì qíng lǎng bù lěng bú rè — 2. The weather that day was clear, neither cold nor hot. — True

examples.text: 参加聚会的都是作者和他太太的朋友。
examples.translation: cān jiā jù huì de dōu shì zuò zhě hé tā tài tài de péng yǒu — 3. Everyone at the party was a friend of the author and his wife. — False (some brought their children and even parents)

examples.text: 作者最喜欢烤牛肉、羊肉和鸡肉，都是他的拿手菜。
examples.translation: zuò zhě zuì xǐ huān kǎo niú ròu yáng ròu hé jī ròu dōu shì tā de ná shǒu cài — 4. The author likes grilling beef, lamb and chicken, all his specialties. — False (his specialties are lamb, chicken legs and wings; no beef)

examples.text: 聚会上，安娜带来了水果和甜点，还有意大利面。
examples.translation: jù huì shàng ān nà dài lái le shuǐ guǒ hé tián diǎn hái yǒu yì dà lì miàn — 5. At the party Anna brought fruit and dessert, and also pasta. — False (the dessert, an apple pie, was made by the author’s wife)

examples.text: 聚会开始以后，作者和大家一起围着桌子坐下来，边吃边聊。
examples.translation: jù huì kāi shǐ yǐ hòu zuò zhě hé dà jiā yì qǐ wéi zhe zhuō zi zuò xià lái biān chī biān liáo — 6. After the party started, the author sat around the table with everyone eating and chatting. — False (he was busy with the barbecue)

examples.text: 孩子们很饿，他们跟大人们吃得时间一样长。
examples.translation: hái zi men hěn è tā men gēn dà rén men chī de shí jiān yí yàng cháng — 7. The children were hungry and ate for as long as the adults. — False (they finished quickly)

explanations.title: Activity 9 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening): two families
explanations.body: Read the passages about two families and complete the tasks. A. Pair up; one partner reads Passage 1 and the other reads Passage 2; take notes in the table below each passage (家人的休闲娱乐: 爸爸, 妈妈, 我 for Passage 1; 爸爸, 妈妈, 哥哥, 我 for Passage 2). B. Exchange information with your partner and complete the table for that passage. C. Compare the two families with your own and find any differences or similarities. The two passages (the tables are filled in by me):

rows: 看电视，更爱看书，下棋，打牌
橄榄球迷，打橄榄球，看球赛，去现场看球
做饭，看肥皂剧，用微信聊天，散步
去海边散步或跑步，带狗散步，种花种草
摇滚迷，有乐队，练习，表演，收集海报
看电影，打游戏，打篮球，看职业篮球比赛
tables.title: Activity 9: what each family member does for fun (the book leaves the tables blank)

examples.text: 我们家是一个非常中式的家庭，只有三口人，我爸爸、妈妈和我。我爸妈都是爱静不爱动的人，他们喜欢呆在家里，做他们喜欢的事情。
examples.translation: wǒ men jiā shì yí gè fēi cháng zhōng shì de jiā tíng zhǐ yǒu sān kǒu rén wǒ bà bà mā mā hé wǒ wǒ bà mā dōu shì ài jìng bú ài dòng de rén tā men xǐ huān dāi zài jiā lǐ zuò tā men xǐ huān de shì qíng — Passage 1. Our family is a very Chinese-style family, with only three people: my dad, my mom and me. My parents both love quiet rather than activity; they like to stay at home and do the things they like.

examples.text: 我妈妈是个家庭主妇，所以她特别喜欢做饭，而且她做的饭也特别好吃。另外，她也喜欢看电视。肥皂剧，她可以一部接一部地看，她不但晚上看，白天有空的时候也看。有时候，甚至还让我陪着她一起看。最近呢，她迷上了用微信跟她的朋友们聊天，视频聊天、语音聊天什么的，她都会。
examples.translation: wǒ mā mā shì gè jiā tíng zhǔ fù suǒ yǐ tā tè bié xǐ huān zuò fàn ér qiě tā zuò de fàn yě tè bié hǎo chī lìng wài tā yě xǐ huān kàn diàn shì féi zào jù tā kě yǐ yí bù jiē yí bù de kàn tā bú dàn wǎn shàng kàn bái tiān yǒu kòng de shí hòu yě kàn yǒu shí hòu shèn zhì hái ràng wǒ péi zhe tā yì qǐ kàn zuì jìn ne tā mí shàng le yòng wēi xìn gēn tā de péng yǒu men liáo tiān shì pín liáo tiān yǔ yīn liáo tiān shén me de tā dōu huì — My mom is a housewife, so she especially likes cooking, and what she cooks is especially delicious. She also likes watching TV. Soap operas she can watch one after another, not only in the evening but also in the daytime when she has time. Sometimes she even makes me watch with her. Recently she has gotten into chatting with her friends on WeChat; video chat, voice chat and so on, she can do all of it.

examples.text: 我爸呢，虽然他也喜欢看电视，但是他更爱看书。在他的书房里有很多书，国内的、国外的都有。因为我爸是医生，所以他也看很多医学的书。除了看书以外，我爸也喜欢在周末的时候跟邻居们或老朋友们一起下下棋，打打牌。我妈害怕我爸出去打牌，因为他打牌可以打两三个小时，甚至忘了回家。可我爸说打牌是他难得的放松的机会。
examples.translation: wǒ bà ne suī rán tā yě xǐ huān kàn diàn shì dàn shì tā gèng ài kàn shū zài tā de shū fáng lǐ yǒu hěn duō shū guó nèi de guó wài de dōu yǒu yīn wèi wǒ bà shì yī shēng suǒ yǐ tā yě kàn hěn duō yī xué de shū chú le kàn shū yǐ wài wǒ bà yě xǐ huān zài zhōu mò de shí hòu gēn lín jū men huò lǎo péng yǒu men yì qǐ xià xià qí dǎ dǎ pái wǒ mā hài pà wǒ bà chū qù dǎ pái yīn wèi tā dǎ pái kě yǐ dǎ liǎng sān gè xiǎo shí shèn zhì wàng le huí jiā kě wǒ bà shuō dǎ pái shì tā nán dé de fàng sōng de jī huì — My dad, although he also likes TV, loves reading even more. In his study there are many books, both domestic and foreign. Because my dad is a doctor he also reads many medical books. Besides reading, my dad also likes to play chess and cards with neighbors or old friends on weekends. My mom worries about his going out to play cards, because he can play for two or three hours and even forget to come home. But my dad says playing cards is his rare chance to relax.

examples.text: 对我爸妈来说，他们仅有的运动就是散步。我们小区的对面就是一个大公园，他们喜欢早上或是晚饭后去公园里一边散步一边聊天，有时候也看看广场上的大妈们跳广场舞。
examples.translation: duì wǒ bà mā lái shuō tā men jǐn yǒu de yùn dòng jiù shì sàn bù wǒ men xiǎo qū de duì miàn jiù shì yí gè dà gōng yuán tā men xǐ huān zǎo shàng huò shì wǎn fàn hòu qù gōng yuán lǐ yì biān sàn bù yì biān liáo tiān yǒu shí hòu yě kàn kàn guǎng chǎng shàng de dà mā men tiào guǎng chǎng wǔ — For my parents, their only exercise is walking. Across from our neighborhood is a big park, and they like to go to the park in the morning or after dinner to walk and chat, and sometimes watch the aunties on the square dance.

examples.text: 我自己喜欢看电影，常常跟我的同学或朋友们一起去电影院看电影。我们不是看恐怖片，就是看动作片，有时候也看看搞笑片。还有，我也喜欢打游戏。我不但跟同学一起打游戏，而且也在网上跟网友一起打游戏。别的空闲时间，我会去体育馆或学校的操场打打篮球，我也喜欢看美国的职业篮球比赛。
examples.translation: wǒ zì jǐ xǐ huān kàn diàn yǐng cháng cháng gēn wǒ de tóng xué huò péng yǒu men yì qǐ qù diàn yǐng yuàn kàn diàn yǐng wǒ men bú shì kàn kǒng bù piàn jiù shì kàn dòng zuò piàn yǒu shí hòu yě kàn kàn gǎo xiào piàn hái yǒu wǒ yě xǐ huān dǎ yóu xì wǒ bú dàn gēn tóng xué yì qǐ dǎ yóu xì ér qiě yě zài wǎng shàng gēn wǎng yǒu yì qǐ dǎ yóu xì bié de kòng xián shí jiān wǒ huì qù tǐ yù guǎn huò xué xiào de cāo chǎng dǎ dǎ lán qiú wǒ yě xǐ huān kàn měi guó de zhí yè lán qiú bǐ sài — I like watching movies myself and often go to the cinema with classmates or friends. We watch either horror movies or action movies, and sometimes comedies. Also I like playing games; I play not only with classmates but also online with online friends. In other free time I go to the gym or the school’s playground to play basketball, and I also like watching American professional basketball games.

examples.text: 我们家有四口人，在美国我们这样的家庭很多。我们家有我爸爸、妈妈、哥哥和我。我们家的人都喜欢玩、喜欢动。
examples.translation: wǒ men jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén zài měi guó wǒ men zhè yàng de jiā tíng hěn duō wǒ men jiā yǒu wǒ bà bà mā mā gē gē hé wǒ wǒ men jiā de rén dōu xǐ huān wán xǐ huān dòng — Passage 2. Our family has four people; in America there are many families like ours. In our family there are my dad, my mom, my older brother and me. Everyone in our family likes to play and likes to be active.

examples.text: 我爸是个美式足球迷，也就是美国人说的橄榄球迷。他周末的时候不是约朋友一起去打橄榄球，就是喜欢在电视上看橄榄球比赛。有时候他也带着我们全家去现场看球赛，因为比赛现场人山人海，非常热闹。比赛的输赢对他来说没有关系，重要的是可以和那么多球迷一起看球，一起为球队加油，那就是他最开心的事。
examples.translation: wǒ bà shì gè měi shì zú qiú mí yě jiù shì měi guó rén shuō de gǎn lǎn qiú mí tā zhōu mò de shí hòu bú shì yuē péng yǒu yì qǐ qù dǎ gǎn lǎn qiú jiù shì xǐ huān zài diàn shì shàng kàn gǎn lǎn qiú bǐ sài yǒu shí hòu tā yě dài zhe wǒ men quán jiā qù xiàn chǎng kàn qiú sài yīn wèi bǐ sài xiàn chǎng rén shān rén hǎi fēi cháng rè nào bǐ sài de shū yíng duì tā lái shuō méi yǒu guān xì zhòng yào de shì kě yǐ hé nà me duō qiú mí yì qǐ kàn qiú yì qǐ wèi qiú duì jiā yóu nà jiù shì tā zuì kāi xīn de shì — My dad is an American-football fan, that is, a football fan as Americans say. On weekends he either invites friends to play football or likes to watch football games on TV. Sometimes he also takes the whole family to watch games live, because the venue is a sea of people and very lively. Winning or losing doesn’t matter to him; what matters is being able to watch with so many fans and cheer on the team together, and that is his happiest thing.

examples.text: 在我们家，我妈喜欢去海边散步或跑步。有时候她也喜欢带着我们家的狗一起去散步。只要天气好，她就会出门，因为海边的景色太美，她不想错过。要是我妈不出门，她喜欢在后院里种花、种草，我们家花园里有她种的各种各样的花，美极了。
examples.translation: zài wǒ men jiā wǒ mā xǐ huān qù hǎi biān sàn bù huò pǎo bù yǒu shí hòu tā yě xǐ huān dài zhe wǒ men jiā de gǒu yì qǐ qù sàn bù zhǐ yào tiān qì hǎo tā jiù huì chū mén yīn wèi hǎi biān de jǐng sè tài měi tā bù xiǎng cuò guò yào shì wǒ mā bù chū mén tā xǐ huān zài hòu yuàn lǐ zhòng huā zhòng cǎo wǒ men jiā huā yuán lǐ yǒu tā zhòng de gè zhǒng gè yàng de huā měi jí le — In our family, my mom likes to walk or run by the sea. Sometimes she also likes to take our dog along for a walk. As long as the weather is good she goes out, because the seaside scenery is so beautiful that she doesn’t want to miss it. If my mom doesn’t go out, she likes to plant flowers and grass in the backyard; in our garden are all kinds of flowers she planted, extremely beautiful.

examples.text: 我哥是个摇滚迷，他和他的大学同学有一个乐队，平时有空的时候，他们就一起练习、一起参加音乐会的表演。在他的房间里，他收集了很多摇滚明星的海报，墙上贴满了著名乐队的照片。不管是哪个乐队或歌手，他都知道。我很高兴，因为在家里可以常常听到我哥免费的音乐会。
examples.translation: wǒ gē shì gè yáo gǔn mí tā hé tā de dà xué tóng xué yǒu yí gè yuè duì píng shí yǒu kòng de shí hòu tā men jiù yì qǐ liàn xí yì qǐ cān jiā yīn yuè huì de biǎo yǎn zài tā de fáng jiān lǐ tā shōu jí le hěn duō yáo gǔn míng xīng de hǎi bào qiáng shàng tiē mǎn le zhù míng yuè duì de zhào piān bù guǎn shì nǎ ge yuè duì huò gē shǒu tā dōu zhī dào wǒ hěn gāo xìng yīn wèi zài jiā lǐ kě yǐ cháng cháng tīng dào wǒ gē miǎn fèi de yīn yuè huì — My brother is a rock fan; he and his college classmates have a band, and when they have free time they practice together and take part in concert performances together. In his room he has collected many posters of rock stars and the wall is covered with photos of famous bands. No matter which band or singer, he knows them. I’m very glad, because at home I can often hear my brother’s free concerts.

examples.text: 我自己呢，喜欢很多户外活动，比如：冲浪、爬山、滑雪等等。因为我在海边长大，所以从小就喜欢游泳，然后开始学冲浪。我们这个州有很多有名的国家公园，我喜欢和朋友或是家人一起去国家公园爬山。冬天的时候，我们家喜欢一起去滑雪场滑雪。

lessons.title: 450. Lesson 18 (Unit 3 review): using Chinese in context review
lessons.subtitle: 给女儿的出国建议 · 北京西安旅行计划 · 烧烤派对 · 问卷调查 · 室友聊天

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Writing and Speaking): the voice mail from your teacher
explanations.body: Scenario: You received a voice mail from your Chinese teacher in China. Her daughter is going to America to study at a high school, but she is concerned about her trip to the U.S. Your teacher asks you to write and explain the procedures for boarding a plane, the security check and passing through U.S. customs. A. Listen to the voice mail and write a summary in pinyin or characters (张老师留言的主要意思是什么？). B. Form three groups. Each group explains one procedure and writes notes in the table: 第一组 登机前需要做什么; 第二组 安检时候做什么; 第三组 入美国海关时做什么. C. After your discussion, consolidate all three groups’ work into one document and email it to your teacher (TO: 张老师; Subject:). (Audio and pictures, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): Beijing and Xi’an
explanations.body: Scenario: You are studying Chinese at Tianjin University. Your class plans to take a field trip to Beijing and Xi’an next month. You can only stay in Beijing for two days and Xi’an for one day. You are tasked by your teacher to make an itinerary for this trip and decide what you would like to see, given your time constraints. Divide into two groups and write up an itinerary; your teacher will select the best one. The places shown: 天安门广场, 长城, 北海公园, 西安古城, 秦始皇兵马俑, 大雁塔. A. In your group, discuss and choose your itinerary by following the considerations in the diagram: for 天津: 旅游团/自己去, 什么时候出发, 怎么去北京 (开车, 坐火车, 坐飞机); for 北京 and 西安: 时间怎么安排, 游览哪个地方, 要不要导游, 交通工具, 在哪儿吃饭, 住民宿/旅馆. B. In your group, create your itinerary and submit it to your teacher by email (TO: 老师; Subject: 旅游计划). (Photographs of 中国民宿, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Speaking and Writing): the barbecue party
explanations.body: Scenario: Your class just completed Unit 3 and would like to have a party to celebrate. Your teacher suggests having a barbecue party at her house, which she recently bought because it is a big house where you can have a lot of fun. To ensure a successful party, you and your classmates must prepare for it. A. Pair up, read the email below and verbally summarize it for your partner. B. With your partner, think of what you will need for the party and fill in the table. C. Summarize your findings and write them in an email to Professor Wang (TO:; Subject:). The email (the book writes “卡拉 OK”) and my sample table:

rows: 希望王老师做什么中国菜
饺子，炒面，宫爆鸡丁，红烧肉
牛肉，羊肉，鸡翅，玉米，蔬菜

examples.text: 同学们，大家好，

examples.text: 祝贺你们完成了第三单元的学习并取得了优异的成绩。这个周末我想请同学们到我家来烧烤，放松一下。我最近刚买了一个房子，上个星期才搬进来。我家房子很大，有很多好玩的东西，比如卡拉ＯＫ机，乒乓球台等。我想请你们一起想一想烧烤需要准备什么，你们会带什么吃的，你们希望我给你们做什么中国菜，还有饭后我们做什么娱乐活动。想好了以后，请给我发一个电子邮件告诉我，我好提前做准备。
examples.translation: zhù hè nǐ men wán chéng le dì sān dān yuán de xué xí bìng qǔ dé le yōu yì de chéng jì zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng qǐng tóng xué men dào wǒ jiā lái shāo kǎo fàng sōng yí xià wǒ zuì jìn gāng mǎi le yí gè fáng zi shàng gè xīng qī cái bān jìn lái wǒ jiā fáng zi hěn dà yǒu hěn duō hǎo wán de dōng xī bǐ rú kǎ lā jī pīng pāng qiú tái děng wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ men yì qǐ xiǎng yì xiǎng shāo kǎo xū yào zhǔn bèi shén me nǐ men huì dài shén me chī de nǐ men xī wàng wǒ gěi nǐ men zuò shén me zhōng guó cài hái yǒu fàn hòu wǒ men zuò shén me yú lè huó dòng xiǎng hǎo le yǐ hòu qǐng gěi wǒ fā yí gè diàn zi yóu jiàn gào sù wǒ wǒ hǎo tí qián zuò zhǔn bèi — Congratulations on completing Unit 3 and achieving excellent results. This weekend I’d like to invite you to my home for a barbecue to relax. I just bought a house recently and only moved in last week. My house is big and has lots of fun things, such as a karaoke machine, a table tennis table and so on. I’d like you to think together about what we need to prepare for the barbecue, what food you’ll bring, what Chinese dishes you’d like me to make for you, and what entertainment we’ll do after the meal. After you’ve thought it through, please email me so I can prepare in advance.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): the survey
explanations.body: Scenario: You are studying Chinese at a university in China and work part-time in the International Students Office. The university would like to know what the international students like to do in their spare time so that they can better serve their needs. You and your classmates are asked to conduct a survey about your activities, and to analyze it and write a report to the International Students Office. A. Pair up. Ask your partner the questions in the table and note their answers. B. Each pair reports their survey results in turn by posting their responses on the wall. C. Analyze your class’s responses; write a report (问卷调查结果分析) and submit it to the International Students Office.

explanations.title: Learning objectives (Lesson 19, Travel by High-Speed Rail, 坐高铁旅行)
explanations.body: Unit 4 is Survival Skills and Social Factors. In this lesson you will obtain information and describe a plan for a train ride in China, a ride on China’s high-speed rail, and the services of China’s high-speed rail system. To do so you must master the new words and phrases, the adverb 早(就), the prepositions 为 and 给, the adverb 反正, more about the use of 次, the adverb 根本, the adverb 一定, the modal verb 会, 等 expressing when, the noun 最近, the adverb 才, the prepositions 向, 往 and 对, and the conjunction 由于. The Area Studies topic is China’s transportation system.

explanations.title: Getting Started

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Global listening: listen to Presentation 1 and write answers: 1. Did the son make a considerate travel plan for his father? How do you know? 2. On what issue did the father and son not quite agree initially? B. Detailed listening: 1. What prompted the speakers to travel? 2. What was the father’s opinion about choosing the class of seating? 3. What did the father like to eat and drink? 4. How was the food on a high-speed train? 5. Why did the son mention the windows on the train? (Audio not included.) My answers from the dialog: yes, the son compared plane and train times, looked at the seat classes, the fares, the food, the tea and the windows; they first disagreed about first or second class; the long holiday for the Mid-Autumn Festival; second class is enough because the trip is short; train meals and hot tea; far better than before; so the father can enjoy the scenery and changes along the way.

lessons.title: 468. Lesson 19 Presentation 1 grammar: the adverb 早(就)
lessons.subtitle: 早 + 就 · 没那么早 · long before the time assumed

explanations.title: The adverb 早就
explanations.body: 早 can be used before (V/VP + 了) to indicate the action (V/VP) has occurred for a while or for some time. 就 or 已(经) is often used after 早 and forms 早就 or 早已 to emphasize the action occurred “long before the time assumed”. For instance, “李老师早就从中国回来了” implies that Li Laoshi had come back long before others assumed he would. Affirmative: Subject + 早(就) + Verb phrase / Adjective phrase + 了. Interrogative: Subject + 早(就) + Verb phrase / Adjective phrase + 了 + 吗？ Negative: Subject + 没那么早 (+ other part; often omitted).

examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ zǎo jiù bān dào jiā zhōu lái zhù le ba yǐ méi nà me zǎo qù nián gāng guò lái — 6. A: You moved to California to live long ago, didn’t you? B: Not that early; I just came last year.

explanations.title: Grammar Activity 1 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. With a classmate, complete the exchanges, using 早就 once in each exchange: 1. A: 你去过长城吗？ B: ___的时候，你还是个小孩子呢。 2. A: 你的听力作业做完了吗？ B: ___。我是___ 3. A: 我___，你怎么还没买？ B: 我一直在忙啊！ 4. A: ___ B: 他大学毕业是去年才大学毕业的，没那么早。 5. A: 锻炼完身体以后，咱们把衣服洗洗吧。 B: ___ B. Listen to the exchanges and see if you can improve your work (audio, not included). The book leaves the blanks to the student; my completed exchanges:

examples.text: 甲：你去过长城吗？乙：我早就去过了，我去的时候，你还是个小孩子呢。
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ qù guò cháng chéng ma yǐ wǒ zǎo jiù qù guò le wǒ qù de shí hòu nǐ hái shì gè xiǎo hái zi ne — 1. A: Have you been to the Great Wall? B: I went long ago; when I went you were still a little kid. (the book prints the second half; the rest is mine)

examples.text: 甲：你的听力作业做完了吗？乙：早就做完了。我是昨天晚上做完的。
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ de tīng lì zuò yè zuò wán le ma yǐ zǎo jiù zuò wán le wǒ shì zuó tiān wǎn shàng zuò wán de — 2. A: Have you finished your listening homework? B: Long ago. I finished it last night. (mine)

examples.text: 甲：我早就告诉你要买机票了，你怎么还没买？乙：我一直在忙啊！
examples.translation: jiǎ wǒ zǎo jiù gào sù nǐ yào mǎi jī piào le nǐ zěn me hái méi mǎi yǐ wǒ yì zhí zài máng a — 3. A: I told you long ago to buy the plane ticket; why haven’t you bought it yet? B: I’ve been busy all along! (mine)

examples.text: 甲：你哥哥早就大学毕业了吧？乙：他大学毕业是去年才大学毕业的，没那么早。
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ gē gē zǎo jiù dà xué bì yè le ba yǐ tā dà xué bì yè shì qù nián cái dà xué bì yè de méi nà me zǎo — 4. A: Your older brother graduated from college long ago, didn’t he? B: He only graduated from college last year; not that early. (the book prints B; A is mine)

examples.text: 甲：锻炼完身体以后，咱们把衣服洗洗吧。乙：我早就洗好了。
examples.translation: jiǎ duàn liàn wán shēn tǐ yǐ hòu zán men bǎ yī fú xǐ xǐ ba yǐ wǒ zǎo jiù xǐ hǎo le — 5. A: After we work out, let’s wash our clothes. B: I washed them long ago. (mine)

explanations.title: Grammar Activity 2 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Revise the sentences in Column A using 早就: 1. 今天我起床特别早，因为我要坐九点的飞机去华盛顿。 2. 他很长时间以前就告诉过我了。 3. 雨一小时以前就不下了。咱们快走吧。 4. 他参军不太早。前年他还在上高中呢。 5. 图书馆关门很长时间了。你别去了。 6. 我很久以前就想学开飞机，可是从来没有机会。 B. Share your work with a classmate. Then take turns asking each other questions. My revisions (the book leaves the column blank):

examples.text: 今天我早就起床了，因为我要坐九点的飞机去华盛顿。
examples.translation: jīn tiān wǒ zǎo jiù qǐ chuáng le yīn wèi wǒ yào zuò jiǔ diǎn de fēi jī qù huá shèng dùn — 1. Today I got up early, because I’m taking the nine o’clock plane to Washington. (revised with 早就; mine)

examples.text: 他早就告诉过我了。
examples.translation: tā zǎo jiù gào sù guò wǒ le — 2. He told me long ago. (mine)

examples.translation: yǔ zǎo jiù bú xià le zán men kuài zǒu ba — 3. The rain stopped long ago. Let’s hurry. (mine)

examples.text: 他参军没那么早。前年他还在上高中呢。
examples.translation: tā cān jūn méi nà me zǎo qián nián tā hái zài shàng gāo zhōng ne — 4. He didn’t join the army that early. The year before last he was still in high school. (mine; the negative form 没那么早)

examples.text: 图书馆早就关门了。你别去了。
examples.translation: tú shū guǎn zǎo jiù guān mén le nǐ bié qù le — 5. The library closed long ago. Don’t go. (mine)

examples.translation: wǒ zǎo jiù xiǎng xué kāi fēi jī le kě shì cóng lái méi yǒu jī huì — 6. I’ve wanted to learn to fly a plane for a long time, but I’ve never had the chance. (mine)

Share your statements with the class. The class will guess which three statements are true. (Your own sentences, so there is nothing to print.)

lessons.title: 469. Lesson 19 Presentation 1 grammar: the prepositions 为 and 给
lessons.subtitle: for the beneficiary · colloquial 给 and formal 为 · reason and purpose

explanations.title: The prepositions 为 and 给
explanations.body: In Lesson 7 and in this lesson we learned these two sentences: 请给我们拿一双筷子。售货车为您提供各种饮料和零食。 In both sentences, 给 and 为 can be translated as “for” and introduce the beneficiaries. In terms of introducing beneficiaries, 给 and 为 are interchangeable, but 给 is more colloquial and 为 is more formal. The original meaning of 给 is to give, and the original meaning of 为 is “in order to” or “for the purpose of”. Therefore, their usage sometimes overlaps and other times they remain distinct.

examples.text: 请给我们拿一双筷子。
examples.translation: qǐng gěi wǒ men ná yì shuāng kuài zi — Please get us a pair of chopsticks. (colloquial)

examples.text: 请为客人提供筷子。
examples.translation: qǐng wèi kè rén tí gōng kuài zi — Please provide chopsticks for the guests. (formal)

examples.text: 服务员给我送来了茶水。
examples.translation: fú wù yuán gěi wǒ sòng lái le chá shuǐ — The waiter brought me tea. (colloquial)

examples.text: 列车工作人员热情地为旅客送茶水。
examples.translation: liè chē gōng zuò rén yuán rè qíng de wèi lǚ kè sòng chá shuǐ — The train staff warmly bring tea for the passengers. (formal)

explanations.title: 给 introduces the recipient of delivery; 为 does not
explanations.body: Examples:

examples.text: 我给小王发了一个邮件。
examples.translation: wǒ gěi xiǎo wáng fā le yí gè yóu jiàn — 1. I sent Xiao Wang an email. (给 introduces the recipient of delivery)

examples.text: 有时间给你爸妈去个电话。
examples.translation: yǒu shí jiān gěi nǐ bà mā qù gè diàn huà — 2. When you have time call your parents.

explanations.title: 为 introduces reason and purpose and takes complex objects; 给 does not
explanations.body: Examples:

examples.text: 他们为谁参军？
examples.translation: tā men wèi shuí cān jūn — 1. Who are they joining the army for?

examples.text: 我这样做是为你好。
examples.translation: wǒ zhè yàng zuò shì wèi nǐ hǎo — 2. I do this for your own good.

examples.text: 她为陆军工作了二十多年。
examples.translation: tā wèi lù jūn gōng zuò le èr shí duō nián — 3. She has worked for the army for more than twenty years.

examples.text: 他为让爸爸高兴带他回老家。
examples.translation: tā wèi ràng bà bà gāo xìng dài tā huí lǎo jiā — 4. He took his father back to his hometown to make him happy.

examples.text: 大家都为学好中文努力。
examples.translation: dà jiā dōu wèi xué hǎo zhōng wén nǔ lì — 5. Everyone works hard in order to learn Chinese well.

explanations.title: 为 can be used in abstract sentences; 给 is often used in concrete sentences
explanations.body: Examples:

examples.text: 你不用为我担心。
examples.translation: nǐ bú yòng wèi wǒ dān xīn — 1. You don’t need to worry about me.

examples.text: 大家都为你高兴。
examples.translation: dà jiā dōu wèi nǐ gāo xìng — 2. Everyone is happy for you.

explanations.title: Grammar Activity 4 (Speaking and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Describe each image using 为 or 给 in the table: 1. Your beer. 2. They joined the military for … 3. This phone is yours! 4. You want to buy this. 5. An apartment has been rented for you. 6. You want to see the photos. (Pixabay pictures, not included.) B. Share your sentences with a classmate, and then read the possible answers below:

examples.text: 服务员把啤酒给我们送过来了。
examples.translation: fú wù yuán bǎ pí jiǔ gěi wǒ men sòng guò lái le — 1. The waiter brought the beer over to us. (the book’s picture, Your Beer)

examples.text: 他们为谁参军？
examples.translation: tā men wèi shuí cān jūn — 2. Who are they joining the military for?

examples.text: 军队为我租了一套公寓。
examples.translation: jūn duì wèi wǒ zū le yí tào gōng yù — 3. The army rented an apartment for me.

examples.text: 妈妈给我买了一个新手机。
examples.translation: mā mā gěi wǒ mǎi le yí gè xīn shǒu jī — 4. Mom bought me a new phone.

examples.text: 我给他买了一串香蕉。
examples.translation: wǒ gěi tā mǎi le yí chuàn xiāng jiāo — 5. I bought him a bunch of bananas.

examples.text: 给我看一下照片好吗？
examples.translation: gěi wǒ kàn yí xià zhào piān hǎo ma — 6. May I see the photos?

explanations.title: Grammar Activity 5 (Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. An adult is asking their five-year-old niece about things people do, such as doctors, teachers and attendants on a train. In her answers, the girl often uses 为 and 给. Pair up and write what the girl could have said, using 为 and 给 as often as possible: 医生, 老师, 列车服务员. B. Listen to the passage again and write what you hear Zhenzhen say about the following people: 医生, 老师, 列车服务员, 爸爸妈妈. C. Share your answers with your partner. Go over the script and refine your work. (Audio, not included; the book prints no script. My samples for Step A:)

examples.text: 医生为病人看病。
examples.translation: yī shēng wèi bìng rén kàn bìng — A doctor treats patients. (sample, mine)

examples.text: 医生给病人开药。
examples.translation: yī shēng gěi bìng rén kāi yào — A doctor prescribes medicine for patients. (mine)

examples.text: 老师为学生上课。
examples.translation: lǎo shī wèi xué shēng shàng kè — A teacher teaches classes for students. (mine)

examples.text: 老师给学生讲故事。
examples.translation: lǎo shī gěi xué shēng jiǎng gù shì — A teacher tells students stories. (mine)

examples.text: 列车服务员为旅客提供服务。
examples.translation: liè chē fú wù yuán wèi lǚ kè tí gōng fú wù — A train attendant provides service for the passengers. (mine)

examples.text: 列车服务员给旅客送茶水。
examples.translation: liè chē fú wù yuán gěi lǚ kè sòng chá shuǐ — A train attendant brings the passengers tea. (mine)

exercises.prompt: Which of 给 and 为 is more colloquial?
exercises.explanation: 给 is colloquial; 为 is formal.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is the formal one?
options: 我给小王发了一个邮件
服务员给我送来了茶水

exercises.prompt: Which preposition introduces the recipient of delivery?
exercises.explanation: 我给小王发了一个邮件.

exercises.prompt: Which preposition introduces reason and purpose?
What does “我这样做是为你好” mean?
options: I do this to make you leave
I do this because of you
I do this for your own good

exercises.prompt: What does “他们为谁参军？” ask?
options: Who are they joining the army for?
妈妈给我买了一个新手机
我给小王发了一个邮件
exercises.explanation: 为 can be abstract; 给 is concrete.

exercises.prompt: Which picture sentence says Mom bought me a phone?
options: 妈妈给我买了一个新手机
军队为我租了一套公寓

exercises.prompt: 她为陆军工___了二十多年。

lessons.title: 470. Lesson 19 Presentation 1 grammar: the adverb 反正
lessons.subtitle: 不管…反正… · suggested action, 反正 + reason · anyway

explanations.title: The adverb 反正 (1): 不管/不论 + X/Y …, 反正 Z
explanations.body: The adverb 反正 has two uses. 1. Used in the pattern (不管/不论 + X/Y) …, 反正 Z …, it indicates “regardless of / no matter if X (or Y), Z will happen anyway”. Examples:

examples.text: 不管你想不想买，反正我要买。
examples.translation: bù guǎn nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng mǎi fǎn zhèng wǒ yào mǎi — No matter whether you want to buy it or not, I’m buying it anyway.

examples.text: 不论雨下得有多大，我反正怎么都要去上班。
examples.translation: bú lùn yǔ xià de yǒu duō dà wǒ fǎn zhèng zěn me dōu yào qù shàng bān — No matter how hard the rain falls, I’m going to work anyway.

examples.text: 不管飞机票多便宜，我反正不想坐飞机。
examples.translation: bù guǎn fēi jī piào duō pián yi wǒ fǎn zhèng bù xiǎng zuò fēi jī — No matter how cheap the plane ticket is, I don’t want to fly anyway.

explanations.title: The adverb 反正 (2): suggested action, 反正 + reason
explanations.body: 2. Used to provide reasons or excuses for doing or not doing something, it usually uses the structure “suggested action, 反正 + reason”. Examples:

examples.text: 咱们出去散散步吧，反正现在也没什么事。
examples.translation: zán men chū qù sàn sàn bù ba fǎn zhèng xiàn zài yě méi shén me shì — Let’s go out for a walk; there’s nothing going on now anyway.

examples.text: 我去买菜吧，反正我要开车去银行。
examples.translation: wǒ qù mǎi cài ba fǎn zhèng wǒ yào kāi chē qù yín háng — I’ll go buy groceries; I’m driving to the bank anyway.

examples.text: 你想买一等座就买吧，反正比二等座贵不了多少。
examples.translation: nǐ xiǎng mǎi yì děng zuò jiù mǎi ba fǎn zhèng bǐ èr děng zuò guì bù liǎo duō shǎo — If you want to buy first class then buy it; it’s not much more than second class anyway.

examples.text: 你要回中国就回吧，反正现在机票很便宜。
examples.translation: nǐ yào huí zhōng guó jiù huí ba fǎn zhèng xiàn zài jī piào hěn pián yi — If you want to go back to China then go; plane tickets are cheap now anyway.

explanations.title: Grammar Activities 6 and 7
explanations.body: Activity 6 (Listening, Writing and Speaking): A. Listen to the six statements and write a revised version of each using 反正. B. Share your work with a classmate; then go over the script and suggested answers and refine your sentences. (Audio, not included; the book prints no script.) Activity 7 (Writing and Speaking): A. Write four pairs of sentences in the table: one sentence uses the adverb 反正 and the other does not, while both express the same idea (有“反正” / 没有“反正”). B. Pair up and take turns saying a sentence to your partner without using 反正; your partner will say one to you using 反正. The book leaves the table to the student; my sample pairs:

examples.text: 有“反正”：我今天不去了，反正明天还有时间。
examples.translation: yǒu fǎn zhèng wǒ jīn tiān bú qù le fǎn zhèng míng tiān hái yǒu shí jiān — With 反正: I’m not going today; there’s time tomorrow anyway. (mine)

examples.text: 没有“反正”：我今天不去了，因为明天还有时间。
examples.translation: méi yǒu fǎn zhèng wǒ jīn tiān bú qù le yīn wèi míng tiān hái yǒu shí jiān — Without 反正: I’m not going today, because there’s time tomorrow. (mine)

examples.text: 有“反正”：不管你同意不同意，反正我要去。
examples.translation: yǒu fǎn zhèng bù guǎn nǐ tóng yì bù tóng yì fǎn zhèng wǒ yào qù — With 反正: Whether you agree or not, I’m going anyway. (mine)

examples.text: 没有“反正”：不管你同意不同意，我都要去。
examples.translation: méi yǒu fǎn zhèng bù guǎn nǐ tóng yì bù tóng yì wǒ dōu yào qù — Without 反正: Whether you agree or not, I’m going. (mine)

examples.text: 有“反正”：咱们坐火车吧，反正时间短。
examples.translation: yǒu fǎn zhèng zán men zuò huǒ chē ba fǎn zhèng shí jiān duǎn — With 反正: Let’s take the train; the trip is short anyway. (mine)

examples.text: 没有“反正”：咱们坐火车吧，因为时间短。
examples.translation: méi yǒu fǎn zhèng zán men zuò huǒ chē ba yīn wèi shí jiān duǎn — Without 反正: Let’s take the train because the trip is short. (mine)

exercises.prompt: How many uses does 反正 have in this lesson?
What does “不管你想不想买，反正我要买” mean?
options: Whether or not you want to buy it, I’m buying it anyway

exercises.prompt: What does “不管飞机票多便宜，我反正不想坐飞机” mean?
options: No matter how cheap the ticket, I don’t want to fly anyway

exercises.prompt: Which sentence gives a reason for a suggestion?
options: 不管你想不想买，反正我要买
咱们出去散散步吧，反正现在也没什么事

options: Buy first class if you like; it’s not much more than second class anyway
First class is far more expensive

exercises.prompt: Why will the speaker buy groceries in “我去买菜吧，反正我要开车去银行”?
options: He is driving to the bank anyway

exercises.prompt: What does “你要回中国就回吧，反正现在机票很便宜” mean?
options: Go back to China if you want; tickets are cheap now anyway

exercises.prompt: Which word can replace 不管 in the first pattern?
不管飞机票多便宜，我___正不想坐飞机。
我去买菜吧，反正我要开车去银___。

lessons.title: 471. Lesson 19 Presentation 1 skill integration: the conductor’s announcement
lessons.subtitle: 列车长的广播 · 京沪高铁 · 对错题 · 与列车长对话

explanations.title: Skill Integration Activity 1 (Listening, Speaking, Writing and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog between David and Liu Dong and answer in Chinese (面 in this dialog means “noodle”): 1. 刘冬是什么人？ 2. 她现在经常坐火车去哪儿？为什么？ 3. 二十多年前她不喜欢坐火车去成都，为什么？ B. Listen again and fill in the table 关于 / 细节 (details) with 以前的火车 and 现在的高铁. C. Pair up and ask your partner at least three questions using the information you learned in Step A. D. Playing David’s character, write an email to a Chinese friend telling them what you learned (TO, CC, Subject). E. Go over the script and then refine your email. (Audio, not included; the book prints no script.)

explanations.title: Skill Integration Activity 2 (Reading, Speaking and Writing): the announcement
explanations.body: A. Listen to the passage and mark each statement True or False. (The audio is not included; the book prints the announcement as Step B, below, and my key follows from it.) B. Pair up and take turns translating the sentences into English: Student 1 reads in Chinese and speaks the English version while Student 2 listens to the English and repeats it in Chinese without reading the sentences. The six sentences (the book writes 1318, 4, 28, 350 and 60 as digits and “G1 次”):

examples.text: 我是本次列车的列车长李丽。欢迎您乘坐由北京开往上海的Ｇ一次列车！
examples.translation: wǒ shì běn cì liè chē de liè chē zhǎng lǐ lì huān yíng nín chéng zuò yóu běi jīng kāi wǎng shàng hǎi de yí cì liè chē — 1. I am Li Li, the conductor of this train. Welcome aboard train G1 from Beijing to Shanghai! (the book writes G1)

examples.text: 列车一共运行一千三百一十八公里，时间是四小时二十八分，平均每小时车速接近三百五十公里。
examples.translation: liè chē yí gòng yùn xíng yì qiān sān bǎi yī shí bā gōng lǐ shí jiān shì sì xiǎo shí èr shí bā fēn píng jūn měi xiǎo shí chē sù jiē jìn sān bǎi wǔ shí gōng lǐ — 2. The train runs 1,318 kilometers in total, taking four hours and twenty-eight minutes, an average speed of nearly 350 kilometers per hour. (the book writes the numbers as digits)

explanations.title: Skill Integration Activity 2 C: a dialog with the conductor
explanations.body: C. Work in pairs to create a dialog between an international traveler and a train conductor (旅客 / 列车长, five turns each) using the information you’ve learned and act it out for the class. The book leaves the lines blank; this is a sample dialog (mine).

examples.text: 旅客：请问，这趟车一共要开多长时间？
examples.translation: lǚ kè qǐng wèn zhè tàng chē yí gòng yào kāi duō cháng shí jiān — Excuse me, how long does this train take in all?

examples.text: 列车长：一共四小时二十八分。
examples.translation: liè chē zhǎng yí gòng sì xiǎo shí èr shí bā fēn — Four hours and twenty-eight minutes in all.

examples.text: 旅客：车上有餐车吗？我想买点儿吃的。
examples.translation: lǚ kè chē shàng yǒu cān chē ma wǒ xiǎng mǎi diǎnr chī de — Is there a dining car on the train? I’d like to buy something to eat.

examples.text: 列车长：有。每节车厢也有热水器，您可以泡茶。
examples.translation: liè chē zhǎng yǒu měi jié chē xiāng yě yǒu rè shuǐ qì nín kě yǐ pào chá — Yes. Every carriage also has a water heater, so you can make tea.

examples.text: 旅客：车上可以上网吗？

examples.text: 旅客：谢谢，如果有问题我再来找您。

examples.text: 列车长：没问题，请告诉列车工作人员，他们会很高兴地为您服务。

lessons.title: 472. Lesson 19 Presentation 1 skill integration and using Chinese in context: China’s high-speed rail
lessons.subtitle: 中国高铁里程 · 三小时高铁圈 · 王刚的语音留言 · 各省高铁里程

explanations.title: Skill Integration Activity 3 (Reading, Speaking and Writing): the passage
explanations.body: A. Read the passage and determine the meanings of the underlined expressions (the underlining is not in the text). Then, in English, write an email to a friend about China’s high-speed rail (TO, CC, Subject). B. Share your email with a classmate. Then each partner asks at least four questions. C. You play the role of an international traveler and your partner is a Chinese high-speed rail official. Ask questions about China’s high-speed rail, then switch roles and repeat. The passage (the book writes the numbers as digits and “3.5万”):

examples.text: 中国的高速铁路，是目前世界上最大规模的高速铁路网，从二零零三年十月十二日第一条高速铁路通车，到二零一九年十二月，总里程达到三万五千公里，其中时速达三百公里的线路总里程超过一万公里，占世界的三分之二以上。包括香港在内的三十一个省级行政区已经有了高铁。另外，目前武汉到广州、北京到上海、北京到天津的高速铁路，都达到了每小时三百五十公里的全世界最高速度。按照计划，在二零二五年中国将建成三万八千公里长的高速铁路网。
examples.translation: zhōng guó de gāo sù tiě lù shì mù qián shì jiè shàng zuì dà guī mó de gāo sù tiě lù wǎng cóng èr líng líng sān nián shí yuè shí èr rì dì yī tiáo gāo sù tiě lù tōng chē dào èr líng yī jiǔ nián shí èr yuè zǒng lǐ chéng dá dào sān wàn wǔ qiān gōng lǐ qí zhōng shí sù dá sān bǎi gōng lǐ de xiàn lù zǒng lǐ chéng chāo guò yí wàn gōng lǐ zhàn shì jiè de sān fēn zhī èr yǐ shàng bāo kuò xiāng gǎng zài nèi de sān shí yī gè shěng jí xíng zhèng qū yǐ jīng yǒu le gāo tiě lìng wài mù qián wǔ hàn dào guǎng zhōu běi jīng dào shàng hǎi běi jīng dào tiān jīn de gāo sù tiě lù dōu dá dào le měi xiǎo shí sān bǎi wǔ shí gōng lǐ de quán shì jiè zuì gāo sù dù àn zhào jì huà zài èr líng èr wǔ nián zhōng guó jiāng jiàn chéng sān wàn bā qiān gōng lǐ cháng de gāo sù tiě lù wǎng — 1. China’s high-speed railway is currently the world’s largest-scale high-speed rail network. From the opening of the first high-speed line on October 12, 2003 to December 2019, the total mileage reached 35,000 kilometers, of which the lines running at 300 km/h exceed 10,000 kilometers in total, more than two thirds of the world’s. The 31 provincial-level administrative regions, including Hong Kong, already have high-speed rail. In addition, the lines from Wuhan to Guangzhou, Beijing to Shanghai and Beijing to Tianjin all reach 350 kilometers per hour, the highest speed in the world. According to the plan, in 2025 China will complete a high-speed rail network 38,000 kilometers long. (the book writes the numbers as digits and misprints 达了到)

examples.text: 中国大陆人口非常多，人们的出行对高速铁路的需求很大。而中国大陆各地气候和地形又不一样，给建设高铁带来很多困难。因此，建设高速铁路的时候，中国根据不同地区的情况，建成了针对不同气候、不同地形的高铁系统。
examples.translation: zhōng guó dà lù rén kǒu fēi cháng duō rén men de chū xíng duì gāo sù tiě lù de xū qiú hěn dà ér zhōng guó dà lù gè dì qì hòu hé dì xíng yòu bù yí yàng gěi jiàn shè gāo tiě dài lái hěn duō kùn nán yīn cǐ jiàn shè gāo sù tiě lù de shí hòu zhōng guó gēn jù bù tóng dì qū de qíng kuàng jiàn chéng le zhēn duì bù tóng qì hòu bù tóng dì xíng de gāo tiě xì tǒng — 2. Mainland China has a very large population, and people’s travel creates a big demand for high-speed rail. But climate and terrain differ across mainland China, which brings many difficulties to building high-speed rail. Therefore, when building high-speed rail, China built, according to the conditions in different regions, high-speed rail systems targeted at different climates and different terrains.

examples.text: 高铁给中国人的生活和工作方式带来了很大变化，促进了沿路地区的经济发展，也使中国大陆开始进入“高铁社会”。目前没有时速二百公里以上的铁路运营的地区，只有澳门和西藏。中国也在积极争取参加其他国家高速铁路的建设。
examples.translation: gāo tiě gěi zhōng guó rén de shēng huó hé gōng zuò fāng shì dài lái le hěn dà biàn huà cù jìn le yán lù dì qū de jīng jì fā zhǎn yě shǐ zhōng guó dà lù kāi shǐ jìn rù gāo tiě shè huì mù qián méi yǒu shí sù èr bǎi gōng lǐ yǐ shàng de tiě lù yùn yíng de dì qū zhǐ yǒu ào mén hé xī zàng zhōng guó yě zài jī jí zhēng qǔ cān jiā qí tā guó jiā gāo sù tiě lù de jiàn shè — 3. High-speed rail has brought great changes to the way Chinese people live and work, promoted the economic development of the regions along the lines, and also made mainland China begin to enter the “high-speed rail society”. At present the only places without railways operating at over 200 kilometers per hour are Macao and Tibet. China is also actively seeking to take part in building other countries’ high-speed railways.

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context Activity 1 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Pair up and take turns telling your partner what you would say in the following situations. Provide as many details as possible using two or three sentences. When you are done, switch roles and repeat the activity. (A photograph of a train station, not included.)

examples.text: 春节快到了，你和一位朋友想去杭州玩儿几天。你说最好坐高铁去，她问为什么。
examples.translation: chūn jié kuài dào le nǐ hé yí wèi péng yǒu xiǎng qù háng zhōu wánr jǐ tiān nǐ shuō zuì hǎo zuò gāo tiě qù tā wèn wèi shén me — 1. The Spring Festival is coming and you and a friend want to go to Hangzhou for a few days. You say it’s best to take the high-speed rail and she asks why.

examples.text: 你觉得买一等座的票最合适，她问为什么。
examples.translation: nǐ jué de mǎi yì děng zuò de piào zuì hé shì tā wèn wèi shén me — 2. You think buying first-class tickets is most suitable, and she asks why.

examples.text: 她问你高速列车上的服务怎么样。
examples.translation: tā wèn nǐ gāo sù liè chē shàng de fú wù zěn me yàng — 3. She asks what the service on the high-speed train is like.

examples.text: 她想知道，在高速列车上可以看什么、做什么。
examples.translation: tā xiǎng zhī dào zài gāo sù liè chē shàng kě yǐ kàn shén me zuò shén me — 4. She wants to know what you can look at and do on a high-speed train.

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context Activity 2 (Listening, Writing, Reading and Speaking): Wang Gang’s voice mail
explanations.body: You are David. Recently you told Wang Gang, your Chinese friend in Beijing, that you plan to take your parents on a visit to China for a couple of weeks in August. A. Learn the meanings of these words first, 根据, 建议, 安排, 决定 and 信息, then listen to a voice mail from Wang Gang and take notes in Chinese. (Audio, not included; the book prints no script.) B. Pair up, share your notes and then go over the script. C. Use one of the book’s two websites (links not included) or a site of your choice to find which trains you would take to the destinations listed below, then discuss your choices with your partner. D. Call Wang Gang (played by your partner) and tell him in Chinese about the trains you and your parents will take; he will explain how he will book the tickets and answer your questions.

tables.title: Using Chinese in Context Activity 2 C: the route table the student fills from a booking website (blank in the book)

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context Activity 2 (Reading, Speaking and Writing): the provincial rail systems
explanations.body: You are a graduate student at the University of Macao and you are writing a paper about the provincial high-speed rail systems in China. A. Pair up and answer your academic advisor’s questions about the high-speed rail systems in several provinces; your partner plays the advisor. B. Choose one of the first two provinces, Guangdong and Liaoning. Find which cities can be reached within four hours from the capital city, get the train schedule information and find a tourist attraction to visit in each city. (The two maps, 广东省广州市三小时高铁圈 and 辽宁省沈阳市三小时高铁圈, are not included.) C. Your partner explores the other provinces. D. Share your findings with your partner and discuss which province you would both recommend to friends. E. Write a brief introduction, 200 to 300 characters long, telling your advisor about one three-hour high-speed rail line.

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Two photographs of a train and a station (not included). Pair up and discuss: A. How did you feel the last time you travelled by train? B. What is an Amtrak train like? C. Where in America is a high-speed rail being built?

explanations.title: Presentation 2: 坐高铁的体验
explanations.body: The book also prints the dialog in traditional characters.

examples.text: 安娜：最近你在中国生活还好吗？上次你说要坐高铁去上海，去了吧？高铁怎么样？
examples.translation: ān nà zuì jìn nǐ zài zhōng guó shēng huó hái hǎo ma shàng cì nǐ shuō yào zuò gāo tiě qù shàng hǎi qù le ba gāo tiě zěn me yàng — How have you been living in China lately? Last time you said you would take the high-speed rail to Shanghai; did you go? How was it?

examples.text: 大卫：去了，非常好。高铁的确特别快。从上海到北京一千四百多公里，只要四个半小时，时速三百五十公里。
examples.translation: dà wèi qù le fēi cháng hǎo gāo tiě dí què tè bié kuài cóng shàng hǎi dào běi jīng yì qiān sì bǎi duō gōng lǐ zhǐ yào sì gè bàn xiǎo shí shí sù sān bǎi wǔ shí gōng lǐ — I went, and it was great. The high-speed rail is indeed extremely fast. From Shanghai to Beijing is over 1,400 kilometers and takes only four and a half hours, at 350 kilometers an hour. (the book writes the numbers as digits)

examples.text: 安娜：速度那么快啊！会不会不安全呢？
examples.translation: ān nà sù dù nà me kuài a huì bú huì bù ān quán ne — It’s that fast! Won’t it be unsafe?

examples.text: 大卫：非常安全，而且特别平稳。这么说吧，如果不看窗外，你根本感觉不到列车在运行。
examples.translation: dà wèi fēi cháng ān quán ér qiě tè bié píng wěn zhè me shuō ba rú guǒ bú kàn chuāng wài nǐ gēn běn gǎn jué bú dào liè chē zài yùn xíng — Very safe, and extremely smooth. Put it this way: if you don’t look out the window, you can’t feel the train moving at all.

examples.text: 安娜：高铁上的设施一定也很先进吧？
examples.translation: ān nà gāo tiě shàng de shè shī yí dìng yě hěn xiān jìn ba — The facilities on the high-speed rail must be very advanced too?

examples.text: 大卫：那当然。那当然。车厢里的座位很宽敞，而且可以无线上网。每个座位都有电源插座，可以随时充电。
examples.translation: dà wèi nà dāng rán nà dāng rán chē xiāng lǐ de zuò wèi hěn kuān chǎng ér qiě kě yǐ wú xiàn shàng wǎng měi gè zuò wèi dōu yǒu diàn yuán chā zuò kě yǐ suí shí chōng diàn — Of course, of course. The seats in the carriage are spacious and you can get online wirelessly. Every seat has a power socket, so you can charge at any time.

examples.text: 安娜：高铁上的服务怎么样？
examples.translation: ān nà gāo tiě shàng de fú wù zěn me yàng — How is the service on the high-speed rail?

examples.text: 大卫：相当好，可以说是一流的。服务员个个都很热情，有礼貌，服务也十分周到。
examples.translation: dà wèi xiāng dāng hǎo kě yǐ shuō shì yì liú de fú wù yuán gè gè dōu hěn rè qíng yǒu lǐ mào fú wù yě shí fēn zhōu dào — Quite good; you could say first class. The attendants are all warm and polite, and the service is very thoughtful.

examples.text: 安娜：车票好买吗？
examples.translation: ān nà chē piào hǎo mǎi ma — Are the tickets easy to buy?

examples.text: 大卫：好买。你可以在网上或者在手机上预订，当然也可以直接到火车站去买。
examples.translation: dà wèi hǎo mǎi nǐ kě yǐ zài wǎng shàng huò zhě zài shǒu jī shàng yù dìng dāng rán yě kě yǐ zhí jiē dào huǒ chē zhàn qù mǎi — Easy to buy. You can book online or on your phone, and of course you can also go straight to the train station to buy.

examples.text: 安娜：票价是不是很贵？
examples.translation: ān nà piào jià shì bú shì hěn guì — Are the fares expensive?

examples.text: 大卫：一般来说，比飞机票便宜多了。
examples.translation: dà wèi yì bān lái shuō bǐ fēi jī piào pián yi duō le — Generally speaking, much cheaper than plane tickets.

examples.text: 安娜：听你这么说，我真想马上去体验一下。
examples.translation: ān nà tīng nǐ zhè me shuō wǒ zhēn xiǎng mǎ shàng qù tǐ yàn yí xià — Hearing you say that, I really want to go and experience it right away.

examples.text: 大卫：等你来中国的时候，我一定陪你去。
examples.translation: dà wèi děng nǐ lái zhōng guó de shí hòu wǒ yí dìng péi nǐ qù — When you come to China, I’ll definitely go with you.

lessons.title: 475. Lesson 19 Presentation 2 activities: the experience of the high-speed rail
lessons.subtitle: Activities 1 to 4 · 先进 设施 周到 一流 · 第一次坐高铁

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Global listening: listen to Presentation 2 and choose the correct answers: 1. What did David say about the high-speed rail in China? (They are the fastest in the world. / They are fast, steady and safe. / They are accessible anywhere in China.) 2. What would most likely happen in the future? (David will pick up Anna at a train station in China. / David will take Anna to China and visit places by train. / They will ride high-speed trains together in China.) B. Detailed listening: 1. How did Anna know that David was going to take the high-speed rail? 2. Was the train running smoothly? How do you know? 3. What features are available for each passenger? 4. How does one go about booking a ticket? (Audio, not included. My answers from the dialog: A1 fast, steady and safe; A2 they will ride high-speed trains together in China, since David says he will go with Anna when she comes; B1 David told her last time he would go; B2 yes, he could not feel the train moving; B3 a power socket and wireless internet; B4 online, on the phone, or at the station.)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Writing, Speaking and Writing)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and take turns writing the expressions you’ve just learned in the table (高铁运行, 车厢内部, 服务, 订票). B. With your partner, write sentences using the expressions in parentheses: 1. (从…到…，只要) 2. (如果，根本) 3. (听你这么一说) 4. (一定，体验) 5. (周到，一流). The book leaves both parts to the student; my fills:

rows: 特别快，时速三百五十公里，非常安全，特别平稳
座位很宽敞，可以无线上网，每个座位都有电源插座，可以随时充电
相当好，一流，热情，有礼貌，十分周到
在网上或者在手机上预订，直接到火车站去买，比飞机票便宜多了
tables.title: Activity 2 A: expressions from Presentation 2 (the book leaves the table blank; this fill is mine)

examples.text: 从北京到青岛，坐高铁只要三个小时。
examples.translation: cóng běi jīng dào qīng dǎo zuò gāo tiě zhǐ yào sān gè xiǎo shí — 1. From Beijing to Qingdao it takes only three hours by high-speed rail. (从…到…，只要; sample sentence, mine)

examples.text: 如果不看窗外，你根本感觉不到列车在运行。
examples.translation: rú guǒ bú kàn chuāng wài nǐ gēn běn gǎn jué bú dào liè chē zài yùn xíng — 2. If you don’t look out the window, you can’t feel the train moving at all. (如果，根本; mine)

examples.text: 听你这么一说，我也想去体验一下高铁。
examples.translation: tīng nǐ zhè me yì shuō wǒ yě xiǎng qù tǐ yàn yí xià gāo tiě — 3. Hearing you say that, I want to go and try the high-speed rail too. (听你这么一说; mine)

examples.text: 我一定要去体验一下中国的高铁。
examples.translation: wǒ yí dìng yào qù tǐ yàn yí xià zhōng guó de gāo tiě — 4. I’ll definitely go and experience China’s high-speed rail. (一定，体验; mine)

examples.text: 高铁上的服务很周到，设施也是一流的。
examples.translation: gāo tiě shàng de fú wù hěn zhōu dào shè shī yě shì yì liú de — 5. The service on the high-speed rail is thoughtful and the facilities are first class. (周到，一流; mine)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog and mark each of the following statements as True or False; B. pair up, discuss your answers and go over the script. The audio is not included and the book prints neither the script nor a key, so I do not give a key; the six statements are:

examples.text: 这是妈妈和女儿的对话，她们还谈到女儿的爸爸和姐姐。
examples.translation: zhè shì mā mā hé nǚ ér de duì huà tā men hái tán dào nǚ ér de bà bà hé jiě jiě — 1. This is a conversation between a mother and a daughter; they also talk about the daughter’s father and sister.

examples.text: 妈妈一直觉得坐高铁很安全，所以没担心。
examples.translation: mā mā yì zhí jué de zuò gāo tiě hěn ān quán suǒ yǐ méi dān xīn — 2. The mother has always felt the high-speed rail is very safe, so she didn’t worry.

examples.text: 现在坐高铁的人非常多，有时不是每个人都有座位。
examples.translation: xiàn zài zuò gāo tiě de rén fēi cháng duō yǒu shí bú shì měi gè rén dōu yǒu zuò wèi — 3. Many people ride the high-speed rail now, and sometimes not everyone has a seat.

examples.text: 路上妈妈一直在用手机和她先生还有朋友们聊天。
examples.translation: lù shàng mā mā yì zhí zài yòng shǒu jī hé tā xiān shēng hái yǒu péng yǒu men liáo tiān — 4. On the way the mother kept chatting on her phone with her husband and friends.

examples.text: 他们一家人可能会坐高铁去新疆旅游。
examples.translation: tā men yì jiā rén kě néng huì zuò gāo tiě qù xīn jiāng lǚ yóu — 5. Their family might take the high-speed rail to Xinjiang for a trip.

examples.text: 等爸爸和妈妈下车后，会有汽车在车站的南门接他们。
examples.translation: děng bà bà hé mā mā xià chē hòu huì yǒu qì chē zài chē zhàn de nán mén jiē tā men — 6. After Dad and Mom get off the train, a car will pick them up at the station’s south gate.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Choose the correct answers in the table for each blank in the passage, then summarize the passage in three sentences. B. Go over your work in pairs; then take turns translating the sentences into English. The choices are: 1. a 下次 b 上次 c 每次; 2. a 第一次 b 前次 c 二次; 3. a 可能 b 不一定 c 不喜欢; 4. a 甚至 b 有点儿 c 根本; 5. a 随时 b 马上 c 过一会儿; 6. a 方便 b 礼貌 c 周到. The passage with my key filled in (the book gives no key):

examples.text: 上次放假的时候，我坐高铁从北京去了青岛。以前我没坐过，所以这是我第一次坐高铁。从北京到青岛差不多七百公里，只要三个小时。还没坐高铁的时候，我想列车运行速度那么快，坐在上面可能会觉得不太平稳。可是，真的坐上去以后，列车运行得非常平稳，如果不是服务员告诉我，我根本感觉不到列车是在以每小时二百多公里的速度运行。我坐的是二等座，有无线上网，座位旁边还有电源插座，可以随时给手机充电。高铁上的服务员都很客气，他们的服务也很周到。
examples.translation: shàng cì fàng jià de shí hòu wǒ zuò gāo tiě cóng běi jīng qù le qīng dǎo yǐ qián wǒ méi zuò guò suǒ yǐ zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì zuò gāo tiě cóng běi jīng dào qīng dǎo chà bu duō qī bǎi gōng lǐ zhǐ yào sān gè xiǎo shí hái méi zuò gāo tiě de shí hòu wǒ xiǎng liè chē yùn xíng sù dù nà me kuài zuò zài shàng miàn kě néng huì jué de bú tài píng wěn kě shì zhēn de zuò shàng qù yǐ hòu liè chē yùn xíng de fēi cháng píng wěn rú guǒ bú shì fú wù yuán gào sù wǒ wǒ gēn běn gǎn jué bú dào liè chē shì zài yǐ měi xiǎo shí èr bǎi duō gōng lǐ de sù dù yùn xíng wǒ zuò de shì èr děng zuò yǒu wú xiàn shàng wǎng zuò wèi páng biān hái yǒu diàn yuán chā zuò kě yǐ suí shí gěi shǒu jī chōng diàn gāo tiě shàng de fú wù yuán dōu hěn kè qì tā men de fú wù yě hěn zhōu dào — Last time I had a holiday, I took the high-speed rail from Beijing to Qingdao. I had never ridden before, so this was my first time. From Beijing to Qingdao is about 700 kilometers and takes only three hours. Before I rode it, I thought the train ran so fast that sitting on it I might find it not very smooth. But when I really got on, the train ran very smoothly; if the attendant hadn’t told me, I wouldn’t have felt at all that the train was running at over 200 kilometers an hour. I rode second class; there was wireless internet and a power socket by the seat, so I could charge my phone at any time. The attendants on the high-speed rail were all very polite, and their service was also very thoughtful. (the book gives the six blanks as choices; my key is 1 b 上次, 2 a 第一次, 3 a 可能, 4 c 根本, 5 a 随时, 6 c 周到; the book writes 700 and 3 as digits)

examples.text: 上次放假，我第一次坐高铁从北京去青岛。高铁非常平稳，我根本感觉不到列车在运行。座位旁边有电源插座和无线上网，服务员也很周到。
examples.translation: shàng cì fàng jià wǒ dì yī cì zuò gāo tiě cóng běi jīng qù qīng dǎo gāo tiě fēi cháng píng wěn wǒ gēn běn gǎn jué bú dào liè chē zài yùn xíng zuò wèi páng biān yǒu diàn yuán chā zuò hé wú xiàn shàng wǎng fú wù yuán yě hěn zhōu dào — My three-sentence summary: Last holiday I rode the high-speed rail from Beijing to Qingdao for the first time. It was so smooth that I couldn’t feel the train moving. By the seat there were a power socket and wireless internet, and the attendants were thoughtful too. (mine)

lessons.title: 476. Lesson 19 Presentation 2 grammar: more about the use of 次
lessons.subtitle: 第一次 · 上次 · 下次 · 每次 · 两次 · specified and unspecified frequency

explanations.title: More about the use of 次
explanations.body: As a verbal measure word, 次 is used in two ways. Specified frequency (which time?): it tells us the specified frequency of a particular action and usually follows a specifier such as 第一次, 第三次, 这次, 上次 and 下次. Unspecified frequency (how many times?): it tells us how many times something happens and 次 usually follows a number.

examples.text: 我第一次看到他是三年前。
examples.translation: wǒ dì yī cì kàn dào tā shì sān nián qián — I first saw him three years ago.

examples.text: 我上次去纽约是坐飞机去的。
examples.translation: wǒ shàng cì qù niǔ yuē shì zuò fēi jī qù de — Last time I went to New York I went by plane.

examples.text: 我去过两次纽约。
examples.translation: wǒ qù guò liǎng cì niǔ yuē — I’ve been to New York twice.

examples.text: 她已经给我打过三次电话了。
examples.translation: tā yǐ jīng gěi wǒ dǎ guò sān cì diàn huà le — She has already called me three times.

explanations.title: Grammar Activity 1 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Complete the dialog using the expressions 几次, 这次, 上次, 下次, 每次, 第一次, 第二次 and 两次; some may be used more than once. B. Pair up and share your work; then take turns translating each exchange into English. The book prints the blanks and no key; my completed dialogs:

examples.text: 甲：每次来北京，我都是坐高铁。你呢？乙：我这次是坐高铁来的，上次是坐飞机来的。下次再坐高铁。
examples.translation: jiǎ měi cì lái běi jīng wǒ dōu shì zuò gāo tiě nǐ ne yǐ wǒ zhè cì shì zuò gāo tiě lái de shàng cì shì zuò fēi jī lái de xià cì zài zuò gāo tiě — 1. A: Every time I come to Beijing I take the high-speed rail. And you? B: This time I came by high-speed rail; last time I came by plane. Next time I’ll take the high-speed rail again. (key mine)

examples.text: 甲：你第一次来蒙特雷是什么时候？乙：是六年前了。这是我第二次来蒙特雷。每次来我都会去渔人码头。
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ dì yī cì lái méng tè léi shì shén me shí hòu yǐ shì liù nián qián le zhè shì wǒ dì èr cì lái méng tè léi měi cì lái wǒ dōu huì qù yú rén mǎ tóu — 2. A: When did you first come to Monterey? B: It was six years ago. This is my second time in Monterey. Every time I come I go to Fisherman’s Wharf. (mine)

examples.text: 甲：你说昨天要给我打电话，怎么到现在才打过来？乙：昨天下午我给你打了两次，可是没人接啊！
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ shuō zuó tiān yào gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà zěn me dào xiàn zài cái dǎ guò lái yǐ zuó tiān xià wǔ wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ le liǎng cì kě shì méi rén jiē a — 3. A: You said you’d call me yesterday; why did you only call now? B: Yesterday afternoon I called you twice, but nobody picked up! (mine)

examples.text: 甲：你每年回老家几次？住几天？乙：我每年回老家两次，每次差不多一个星期。第一次是夏天，第二次是冬天。
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ měi nián huí lǎo jiā jǐ cì zhù jǐ tiān yǐ wǒ měi nián huí lǎo jiā liǎng cì měi cì chà bu duō yí gè xīng qī dì yī cì shì xià tiān dì èr cì shì dōng tiān — 4. A: How many times a year do you go back to your hometown? How many days do you stay? B: I go back twice a year, about a week each time. The first time is summer, the second time winter. (mine)

examples.text: 甲：上次打电话的时候，你说今年要回来过年。为什么到现在还不回来？乙：妈，最近我太忙了，回不去。下次您过生日，我一定回来。
examples.translation: jiǎ shàng cì dǎ diàn huà de shí hòu nǐ shuō jīn nián yào huí lái guò nián wèi shén me dào xiàn zài hái bù huí lái yǐ mā zuì jìn wǒ tài máng le huí bú qù xià cì nín guò shēng rì wǒ yí dìng huí lái — 5. A: Last time you phoned you said you’d come back for the New Year this year. Why haven’t you come back yet? B: Mom, I’ve been too busy lately and can’t get back. Next time it’s your birthday I’ll definitely come back. (mine)

exercises.prompt: Which of these is a specifier telling which time?
Which sentence means “I’ve been to New York twice”?
Complete: 我每年回老家两次，___差不多一个星期。
Complete: 你第一次来蒙特雷是什么时候？这是我___来蒙特雷。
Complete: 昨天下午我给你打了___，可是没人接啊！
In “___来北京，我都是坐高铁”, which is best?
她已经给我打过三___电话了。
下___您过生日，我一定回来。

lessons.title: 477. Lesson 19 Presentation 2 grammar: the adverb 根本
lessons.subtitle: 根本就不 · 根本就没 · not at all

explanations.title: The adverb 根本
explanations.body: The adverb 根本 means “at all” and is usually used to emphasize negation; thus it is very similar to the expression “一点儿也不”. 根本 often appears before a verb or as an adjective in a negative sentence and is usually followed by 就. Examples:

examples.text: 我根本就不累。
examples.translation: wǒ gēn běn jiù bú lèi — 1. I’m not tired at all.

examples.text: 雨下得根本就不大。
examples.translation: yǔ xià de gēn běn jiù bú dà — 2. The rain isn’t heavy at all.

examples.text: 我根本就不认识他。
examples.translation: wǒ gēn běn jiù bú rèn shí tā — 3. I don’t know him at all.

examples.text: 这儿离电影院根本就不远。
examples.translation: zhèr lí diàn yǐng yuàn gēn běn jiù bù yuǎn — 4. It’s not far from here to the cinema at all.

examples.text: 老刘说要给我打电话，可是根本就没打。
examples.translation: lǎo liú shuō yào gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà kě shì gēn běn jiù méi dǎ — 5. Lao Liu said he’d call me but didn’t call at all.

explanations.title: Grammar Activity 2 (Writing, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Complete the following sentences using 根本 (the book leaves the answers blank, then prints possible answers that are not in the text I have; my fills below). B. Pair up and check your work; take turns translating the exchanges into English.

examples.text: 甲：对不起，开会的事我全忘了。乙：没关系，我根本就没打算去开会。
examples.translation: jiǎ duì bù qǐ kāi huì de shì wǒ quán wàng le yǐ méi guān xì wǒ gēn běn jiù méi dǎ suàn qù kāi huì — 1. A: Sorry, I forgot all about the meeting. B: It’s OK; I didn’t plan to go to the meeting at all. (the book leaves B blank; the answers are mine)

examples.text: 甲：小王说你是他的朋友。乙：我根本就不认识他。
examples.translation: jiǎ xiǎo wáng shuō nǐ shì tā de péng yǒu yǐ wǒ gēn běn jiù bú rèn shí tā — 2. A: Xiao Wang says you’re his friend. B: I don’t know him at all. (mine)

examples.text: 甲：听说你最近根本就不锻炼身体。乙：不对，昨天我还去操场跑步了呢。
examples.translation: jiǎ tīng shuō nǐ zuì jìn gēn běn jiù bú duàn liàn shēn tǐ yǐ bú duì zuó tiān wǒ hái qù cāo chǎng pǎo bù le ne — 3. A: I hear you haven’t been exercising at all lately. B: Not true, I even went running on the sports field yesterday. (the book prints B; A is mine)

examples.text: 甲：医生要你在家休息，你上午为什么去商店买东西？乙：我根本就没觉得自己有病啊。
examples.translation: jiǎ yī shēng yào nǐ zài jiā xiū xī nǐ shàng wǔ wèi shén me qù shāng diàn mǎi dōng xī yǐ wǒ gēn běn jiù méi jué de zì jǐ yǒu bìng a — 4. A: The doctor told you to rest at home; why did you go to the shop to buy things this morning? B: I didn’t feel sick at all. (mine)

examples.text: 甲：他英文说得根本就不好。乙：他不是去过加拿大吗？我还以为他说英文说得很好呢。
examples.translation: jiǎ tā yīng wén shuō de gēn běn jiù bù hǎo yǐ tā bú shì qù guò jiā ná dà ma wǒ hái yǐ wéi tā shuō yīng wén shuō de hěn hǎo ne — 5. A: His English is not good at all. B: Hasn’t he been to Canada? I thought he spoke English very well. (the book prints B; A is mine)

examples.text: 甲：昨天晚上你为什么那么晚才睡觉？是不是又玩儿游戏了？乙：我根本就没玩儿游戏，我在做作业。

A: Why did you go to bed so late last night? Did you play games again? B: I didn’t play games at all; I was doing homework. (mine)

explanations.title: Grammar Activity 3 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. A little boy has a big sister who continually criticizes him for things she thinks he has done. In Chinese, list four scenarios in which the sister criticizes her brother for doing things but he categorically denies doing them (姐姐 / 男孩). B. Pair up and share your work; choose two of your partner’s scenarios and share them with the class. (A cartoon picture, not included.) My sample scenarios:

examples.text: 姐姐：你又吃了我的巧克力！男孩：我根本就没吃你的巧克力。
examples.translation: jiě jiě nǐ yòu chī le wǒ de qiǎo kè lì nán hái wǒ gēn běn jiù méi chī nǐ de qiǎo kè lì — 1. Sister: You ate my chocolate again! Boy: I didn’t eat your chocolate at all. (sample scenario, mine)

examples.text: 姐姐：你把我的手机弄坏了！男孩：我根本就没动你的手机。
examples.translation: jiě jiě nǐ bǎ wǒ de shǒu jī nòng huài le nán hái wǒ gēn běn jiù méi dòng nǐ de shǒu jī — 2. Sister: You broke my phone! Boy: I didn’t touch your phone at all. (mine)

examples.text: 姐姐：昨天晚上你很晚才睡觉，还玩儿游戏了。男孩：我根本就没玩儿游戏，我九点就睡了。
examples.translation: jiě jiě zuó tiān wǎn shàng nǐ hěn wǎn cái shuì jiào hái wánr yóu xì le nán hái wǒ gēn běn jiù méi wánr yóu xì wǒ jiǔ diǎn jiù shuì le — 3. Sister: You went to bed late last night and played games. Boy: I didn’t play games at all; I was asleep at nine. (mine)

examples.text: 姐姐：你又忘了做作业！男孩：我根本就没忘，早就做完了。
examples.translation: jiě jiě nǐ yòu wàng le zuò zuò yè nán hái wǒ gēn běn jiù méi wàng zǎo jiù zuò wán le — 4. Sister: You forgot to do your homework again! Boy: I didn’t forget at all; I finished long ago. (mine)

options: I don’t know him at all

exercises.prompt: What does “雨下得根本就不大” mean?
options: The rain isn’t heavy at all

exercises.prompt: What does “老刘根本就没打” mean?
options: Lao Liu didn’t call at all

lessons.title: 478. Lesson 19 Presentation 2 grammar: the adverb 一定 and the modal verb 会 for prediction
lessons.subtitle: 一定 · 会 · 可能会 · 一定会 · how certain the speaker is

explanations.title: The adverb 一定 and the modal verb 会 expressing prediction
explanations.body: Both 一定 and 会 can be used for prediction, for example 明天一定很冷 and 明天会很冷. 一定 indicates something the speaker thinks will definitely happen: 明天一定下雨 says the speaker is certain it will rain tomorrow. 会 indicates the likelihood that something will happen: 明天会下雨 says the speaker thinks it very likely that it will rain tomorrow. One can use 可能, 大概 and other words before 会 to stress likelihood, such as 明天可能会下雨 and 明天大概会下雨. 一定会 indicates the speaker is very certain of the likelihood: 明天一定会下雨 says the speaker is certain it is very likely that it will rain tomorrow.

examples.text: 明天一定很冷。
examples.translation: míng tiān yí dìng hěn lěng — Tomorrow it will definitely be cold.

examples.text: 明天会很冷。
examples.translation: míng tiān huì hěn lěng — Tomorrow it will be cold.

examples.text: 明天一定下雨。
examples.translation: míng tiān yí dìng xià yǔ — It will definitely rain tomorrow. (the speaker is certain)

examples.text: 明天会下雨。
examples.translation: míng tiān huì xià yǔ — It will rain tomorrow. (the speaker thinks it very likely)

examples.text: 明天可能会下雨。
examples.translation: míng tiān kě néng huì xià yǔ — It might rain tomorrow.

examples.text: 明天大概会下雨。
examples.translation: míng tiān dà gài huì xià yǔ — It will probably rain tomorrow.

examples.text: 明天一定会下雨。
examples.translation: míng tiān yí dìng huì xià yǔ — It will surely rain tomorrow. (very certain of the likelihood)

explanations.title: Grammar Activity 4 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. 一定 and 会 indicate how certain a speaker thinks that something is true or something will happen. Read the five sentences that use 一定 or 会; with a classmate, revise each sentence to change the speaker’s tone, then take turns translating your revisions into English. The book’s five originals: 1. 夏威夷的风景太漂亮了！没人不喜欢。到了那里你可能就不想回来了。 2. 今天下午一直在下雨，明天一定还要下雨。 3. 如果早饭吃得很少，中午你一定会非常饿。 4. 他学中文歌，看中文电影。我想他可能喜欢学中文。 5. 如果你中文说得很好，你的听力一定更好。 B. Pair up and share your work; then go over the suggested revisions. The book’s suggested revisions are not in the text, so these are mine:

examples.text: 夏威夷的风景太漂亮了！没人不喜欢。到了那里你一定会不想回来了。
examples.translation: xià wēi yí de fēng jǐng tài piào liàng le méi rén bù xǐ huān dào le nà lǐ nǐ yí dìng huì bù xiǎng huí lái le — 1. Hawaii’s scenery is so beautiful! Nobody doesn’t like it. When you get there you will surely not want to come back. (changed 可能 to 一定会; mine)

examples.text: 今天下午一直在下雨，明天可能还会下雨。
examples.translation: jīn tiān xià wǔ yì zhí zài xià yǔ míng tiān kě néng hái huì xià yǔ — 2. It has been raining all afternoon; tomorrow it might still rain. (changed 一定 to 可能…会; mine)

examples.text: 如果早饭吃得很少，中午你可能会非常饿。
examples.translation: rú guǒ zǎo fàn chī de hěn shǎo zhōng wǔ nǐ kě néng huì fēi cháng è — 3. If you eat very little for breakfast, at noon you might be very hungry. (changed 一定会 to 可能会; mine)

examples.text: 他学中文歌，看中文电影。我想他一定喜欢学中文。
examples.translation: tā xué zhōng wén gē kàn zhòng wén diàn yǐng wǒ xiǎng tā yí dìng xǐ huān xué zhōng wén — 4. He learns Chinese songs and watches Chinese movies. I think he surely likes learning Chinese. (changed 可能 to 一定; mine)

examples.text: 如果你中文说得很好，你的听力可能会更好。
examples.translation: rú guǒ nǐ zhōng wén shuō de hěn hǎo nǐ de tīng lì kě néng huì gèng hǎo — 5. If you speak Chinese very well, your listening might be even better. (changed 一定 to 可能会; mine)

explanations.title: Grammar Activity 5 (Listening, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog and answer the questions: 1. What is the relationship between the two speakers? 2. What event is being planned and who will organize it? 3. Was the female speaker sure that the male speaker travelled by air? Why? 4. Will the party start on time? Why or why not? 5. What is said about Er Ge (二哥)? 6. Where will the male speaker buy the cake? Why? B. Pair up and share your answers; then go over the script and refine your work. (Audio, not included; the book prints no script.)

Which indicates the likelihood that something will happen?
What does “明天一定下雨” say?
options: The speaker is certain it will rain tomorrow
The speaker thinks it very likely it will rain
The speaker is sure it will rain

lessons.title: 479. Lesson 19 Presentation 2 grammar: 等 expressing “when”
lessons.subtitle: 等(到) · 等…就… · 等…再… · ordering the words

explanations.title: 等 expressing “when”
explanations.body: In addition to expressing “wait”, 等 can also be used to express “when”, especially in daily conversation. 等到 can also be used to express the same idea. Examples:

examples.text: 等我一到家就给你打电话。
examples.translation: děng wǒ yí dào jiā jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà — 1. As soon as I get home I’ll call you.

examples.text: 等(到)作业做完了我就上床睡觉。
examples.translation: děng dào zuò yè zuò wán le wǒ jiù shàng chuáng shuì jiào — 2. When my homework is done I’ll go to bed.

examples.text: 等(到)太阳出来了咱们再去散步吧。
examples.translation: děng dào tài yáng chū lái le zán men zài qù sàn bù ba — 3. Let’s go for a walk once the sun comes out.

examples.text: 等(到)秋天到了他儿子就会来看他。
examples.translation: děng dào qiū tiān dào le tā ér zi jiù huì lái kàn tā — 4. When autumn comes his son will come to see him.

examples.text: 等(到)老张来电话的时候，你问问他打算什么时候回中国。
examples.translation: děng dào lǎo zhāng lái diàn huà de shí hòu nǐ wèn wèn tā dǎ suàn shén me shí hòu huí zhōng guó — 5. When Lao Zhang calls, ask him when he plans to go back to China.

explanations.title: Grammar Activity 6 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Order the provided words in the correct sequence to make logical sentences: 1. 去锻炼 电话 / 我 / 打完 / 就 / 跟你 / 等 2. 吃饭 咱们 / 老张他们 / 就 / 等 / 到了 / 开始 3. 飞机票 我就 / 等 / 回家的 / 连长 / 买 / 同意了 4. 好吗 等 / 再 / 我 / 作业 / 值完班 / 做 5. 就 我 / 飞机 / 你 / 告诉 / 等 / 下了 / 马上 B. Pair up and share your work; check against the suggested answer keys; translate each sentence into English and back into Chinese. The book’s keys are not in the text, so these are mine:

examples.text: 等我跟你打完电话就去锻炼。
examples.translation: děng wǒ gēn nǐ dǎ wán diàn huà jiù qù duàn liàn — 1. When I finish talking to you on the phone I’ll go work out. (key mine)

examples.text: 等老张他们到了咱们就开始吃饭。
examples.translation: děng lǎo zhāng tā men dào le zán men jiù kāi shǐ chī fàn — 2. When Lao Zhang and the others arrive we’ll start eating. (mine)

examples.text: 等连长同意了我就买回家的飞机票。
examples.translation: děng lián zhǎng tóng yì le wǒ jiù mǎi huí jiā de fēi jī piào — 3. When the company commander agrees I’ll buy the plane ticket home. (mine)

examples.text: 等我值完班再做作业好吗？
examples.translation: děng wǒ zhí wán bān zài zuò zuò yè hǎo ma — 4. May I do my homework after I finish my shift? (mine)

examples.text: 等飞机下了我马上就告诉你。
examples.translation: děng fēi jī xià le wǒ mǎ shàng jiù gào sù nǐ — 5. As soon as the plane lands I’ll tell you right away. (mine)

explanations.title: Grammar Activity 7 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Using 等, write five statements that say Event A will happen after Event B. B. Pair up; Student A reads his or her sentences one by one and Student B translates them verbally into English; repeat and take turns. (A picture of an alarm clock, not included; your own sentences.)

exercises.prompt: What does 等 mean in 等我一到家就给你打电话?
What can replace 等 with the same meaning?
Which sentence means “When my homework is done I’ll go to bed”?
options: 等作业做完了我就上床睡觉
上床睡觉等作业做完了我就
我等作业做完了就睡觉上床
作业等做完了我就上床睡觉
exercises.explanation: 等 + event B, 就 + event A.

exercises.prompt: Which is the correct ordering of 等 飞机 下了 我 马上 就 告诉 你?
options: 飞机等下了我马上就告诉你
我等飞机下了马上就告诉你
等飞机下了我马上就告诉你
等我飞机下了马上就告诉你

What does “等(到)秋天到了他儿子就会来看他” mean?
options: When autumn comes his son will visit him

In 等老张来电话的时候, 等 means?
