lessons.title: 480. Lesson 19 Presentation 2 skill integration: the Little Slow Train
lessons.subtitle: 小慢车 · 厉害 说起来容易做起来难 硬币 倒 级 · 两条美国铁路线

explanations.title: Skill Integration Activity 1 (Listening, Writing, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and guess the meaning of the following expressions: 1. 厉害 (e.g. 她说中文说得比很多中国人还好，真厉害！) 2. 说起来容易做起来难。 3. 硬币 (you’ve learned 硬 in 硬卧, and 币 in 人民币) 4. 倒 (dǎo; e.g. 一场大雨以后，那个老房子倒了。) 5. 级 (e.g. you’ve learned 六年级; what does it mean in 省一级的地方?) B. Listen to the dialog and answer: 1. What is the topic of this dialog? 2. How long is China’s high-speed rail? 3. How common is high-speed rail in China? C. Pair up and share your answers; listen again and list the details in the table (琳达的体验, 另一位外国朋友的体验, 工程师们的努力). D. Write a text message to your Chinese teacher sharing what you’ve learned from the conversation between Linda and Mr. Zhang. E. Go over the script and revise your text message. (Audio, not included; the book prints no script.)

headers: 意思 (my guess for the book’s five expressions)
rows: impressive; formidable (她说中文说得比很多中国人还好，真厉害！)
coin (硬 as in 硬卧, 币 as in 人民币)
to fall down, to collapse (一场大雨以后，那个老房子倒了。)
level, rank (省一级的地方: a place at the provincial level)
tables.title: Skill Integration Activity 1 A: guess the meanings (the book prints only the expressions; the meanings are mine)

explanations.title: Skill Integration Activity 2 (Reading, Speaking and Writing): 小慢车
explanations.body: A. Read the passage below; write an English summary and consult your dictionary if necessary. (Photographs of the train, not included; the book underlines five sentences, which are numbered 1) to 5) in the text; the book writes the numbers as digits.) B. Pair up and, in Chinese, ask each other: 1. 这篇文章是关于什么的？ 2. 为什么住在那儿的人叫那样的火车“小慢车”？ 3. “小慢车”对那儿的老百姓为什么非常重要？ 4. 那儿的老百姓为什么喜欢“小慢车”？ C. Take turns translating the underlined sentences into English; your partner translates them back into Chinese without looking at the passage. D. Work with your partner to rewrite the passage as a conversation between a reporter and a local passenger and act it out for the class. The passage:

examples.text: 在四川省的一个山区，有一条火车线路，火车的行驶速度非常慢。这条线路一共是三百五十三公里，中间有二十六个车站，火车每小时只走四十公里，所以人们叫它“小慢车”。
examples.translation: zài sì chuān shěng de yí gè shān qū yǒu yì tiáo huǒ chē xiàn lù huǒ chē de xíng shǐ sù dù fēi cháng màn zhè tiáo xiàn lù yí gòng shì sān bǎi wǔ shí sān gōng lǐ zhōng jiān yǒu èr shí liù gè chē zhàn huǒ chē měi xiǎo shí zhǐ zǒu sì shí gōng lǐ suǒ yǐ rén men jiào tā xiǎo màn chē — 1. In a mountain area of Sichuan Province there is a railway line on which the trains run very slowly. This line is 353 kilometers in all, with 26 stations in between, and the trains go only 40 kilometers an hour, so people call it the “Little Slow Train”. (the underlined sentence 1; the book writes the numbers as digits)

examples.text: 虽然速度很慢，但是这条火车线路对住在那里的人来说太重要了。一位老人说，她二十五岁结婚后一直住在山里，很长时间，她每次回母亲家要走一天多的山路。后来有了“小慢车”，只要四十多分钟她就可以到家了。
examples.translation: suī rán sù dù hěn màn dàn shì zhè tiáo huǒ chē xiàn lù duì zhù zài nà lǐ de rén lái shuō tài zhòng yào le yí wèi lǎo rén shuō tā èr shí wǔ suì jié hūn hòu yì zhí zhù zài shān lǐ hěn cháng shí jiān tā měi cì huí mǔ qīn jiā yào zǒu yì tiān duō de shān lù hòu lái yǒu le xiǎo màn chē zhǐ yào sì shí duō fēn zhōng tā jiù kě yǐ dào jiā le — 2. Although it is slow, this railway line is extremely important to the people living there. An old woman said that after she married at 25 she lived in the mountains all along; for a long time each trip back to her mother’s home took more than a day on mountain roads. Later, with the “Little Slow Train”, it takes only a little over 40 minutes to reach home. (the underlined sentence 2 begins at 很长时间)

examples.text: 这儿很多人也用“小慢车”运东西。比如去城里卖东西的人，会把一包一包的水果、蔬菜或别的东西放到车上，运到他们要去的地方。
examples.translation: zhèr hěn duō rén yě yòng xiǎo màn chē yùn dōng xī bǐ rú qù chéng lǐ mài dōng xī de rén huì bǎ yì bāo yì bāo de shuǐ guǒ shū cài huò bié de dōng xī fàng dào chē shàng yùn dào tā men yào qù de dì fāng — 3. Many people here also use the “Little Slow Train” to carry things. For example, people going to town to sell things put bundles of fruit, vegetables or other things on the train and send them to where they are going. (the underlined sentence 3 begins at 比如)

examples.text: 到了星期五和星期天，很多孩子会坐这趟“校车”回家或上学。在车厢里你会看到孩子们有的在做作业，有的在看书。
examples.translation: dào le xīng qī wǔ hé xīng qī tiān hěn duō hái zi huì zuò zhè tàng xiào chē huí jiā huò shàng xué zài chē xiāng lǐ nǐ huì kàn dào hái zi men yǒu de zài zuò zuò yè yǒu de zài kàn shū — 4. On Fridays and Sundays, many children ride this “school bus” home or to school. In the carriages you will see some children doing homework and some reading. (the underlined sentence 4)

examples.text: 为什么大家都喜欢“小慢车”？第一是因为车站多，在附近来往很方便。第二是因为它太便宜了。从一九九五年以来票价没有变过。你要是坐它去近的地方，只需要花两元钱。
examples.translation: wèi shén me dà jiā dōu xǐ huān xiǎo màn chē dì yī shì yīn wèi chē zhàn duō zài fù jìn lái wǎng hěn fāng biàn dì èr shì yīn wèi tā tài pián yi le cóng yī jiǔ jiǔ wǔ nián yǐ lái piào jià méi yǒu biàn guò nǐ yào shì zuò tā qù jìn de dì fāng zhǐ xū yào huā liǎng yuán qián — 5. Why does everyone like the “Little Slow Train”? First, because there are many stations and getting around nearby is convenient. Second, because it is so cheap. The fare has not changed since 1995. If you take it to a nearby place you only need to spend two yuan. (the underlined sentence 5 is 从1995年以来票价没有变过)

explanations.title: A conversation between a reporter and a passenger (my sample for Step D)
explanations.body: The book leaves the five turns blank; this is my sample.

examples.text: 记者：请问这条火车线路有多长？
examples.translation: jì zhě qǐng wèn zhè tiáo huǒ chē xiàn lù yǒu duō cháng — How long is this railway line? (sample dialog, mine)

examples.text: 乘客：一共三百五十三公里，中间有二十六个车站，火车每小时只走四十公里，所以人们叫它“小慢车”。
examples.translation: chéng kè yí gòng sān bǎi wǔ shí sān gōng lǐ zhōng jiān yǒu èr shí liù gè chē zhàn huǒ chē měi xiǎo shí zhǐ zǒu sì shí gōng lǐ suǒ yǐ rén men jiào tā xiǎo màn chē — 353 kilometers in all, with 26 stations between, and the train goes only 40 km an hour, so people call it the “Little Slow Train”.

examples.text: 记者：它对您来说重要吗？
examples.translation: jì zhě tā duì nín lái shuō zhòng yào ma — Is it important to you?

examples.text: 乘客：太重要了！以前我回母亲家要走一天多的山路，现在只要四十多分钟。

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context Activity 1 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Pair up and take turns telling your partner what you would say in the following situations. Provide as many details as possible using two to four sentences. (A photograph of a high-speed train, not included.)

examples.text: 中国高铁的速度快不快，时速是多少，从北京到另外一个大城市需要多长时间？
examples.translation: zhōng guó gāo tiě de sù dù kuài bú kuài shí sù shì duō shǎo cóng běi jīng dào lìng wài yí gè dà chéng shì xū yào duō cháng shí jiān — 1. Is China’s high-speed rail fast? What is the speed per hour? How long does it take to go from Beijing to another big city?

explanations.body: You are the manager of an international consulting firm, and China State Railway Co. asks you to conduct a survey with open-ended questions for foreigners about their experiences taking the high-speed rail in China. Soon after you sent out the survey you receive two voice messages, one from Mary in Canada and one from Joe in the U.S. A. Before listening, find the meanings of these words: 出行, 市区, 舒适, 标识 (mine: to travel out; urban area; comfortable; sign). B. Share your notes with your partner; go over the scripts; then prepare five questions for an in-depth interview. C. Conduct the interview; your partner plays the interviewee, using the hints in the table below. D. Write an email to your customer summarizing the in-depth interview (TO, CC, Subject). (Audio, not included; the book prints no script, only the hints table.)

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context Activity 3 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: You write blogs on the tourist industry for a magazine and your job sometimes takes you to China. One day in Beijing you saw a brief news article online, with images; you were quite impressed with the young conductor Zhang Mengmeng. Read the title and examine the images (not included): 十八岁高铁列车长繁忙的假日. A. If you were to interview this person, what questions would you ask? Write five questions and share your work with a classmate. B. You will interview Zhang Mengmeng soon; first read the report below and consult your dictionary for any unknown words. C. Conduct the interview; your partner plays Zhang Mengmeng. D. Write your dialog (记者 / 列车长) and act it out for the class. The report (the book writes the numbers as digits):

examples.text: 十月初国庆节期间，人们不是出去旅游，就是在家休息。但是，今年不到三十岁的张萌萌却更忙了。她是高铁的列车长，放假这几天她每天都要工作十几个小时。张萌萌是四川人，十几年前当上了列车服务员，由于她工作努力，素质优秀，两年前成了一名高铁列车长。国庆节这天，她早上五点就起床了，为上班做准备，六点到了火车站的站台接车。那天她服务了一班又一班列车，最后一班到达重庆的时候，已经是二十三点三十二分了。下车以后，她和车上的工作人员又一起开会，总结一天的工作，看看有没有做得不够好的地方。“虽然工作很累，但我们都觉得很愉快，”张萌萌说。国庆节那几天旅客出行非常多，她和车上的工作人员每天都要工作十个小时以上。她觉得，节日里让每位旅客安全舒适地出行，对她和同事们来说是最重要的事。
examples.translation: shí yuè chū guó qìng jié qī jiān rén men bú shì chū qù lǚ yóu jiù shì zài jiā xiū xī dàn shì jīn nián bú dào sān shí suì de zhāng méng méng què gèng máng le tā shì gāo tiě de liè chē zhǎng fàng jià zhè jǐ tiān tā měi tiān dōu yào gōng zuò shí jǐ gè xiǎo shí zhāng méng méng shì sì chuān rén shí jǐ nián qián dāng shàng le liè chē fú wù yuán yóu yú tā gōng zuò nǔ lì sù zhì yōu xiù liǎng nián qián chéng le yì míng gāo tiě liè chē zhǎng guó qìng jié zhè tiān tā zǎo shàng wǔ diǎn jiù qǐ chuáng le wèi shàng bān zuò zhǔn bèi liù diǎn dào le huǒ chē zhàn de zhàn tái jiē chē nà tiān tā fú wù le yì bān yòu yì bān liè chē zuì hòu yì bān dào dá chóng qìng de shí hòu yǐ jīng shì èr shí sān diǎn sān shí èr fēn le xià chē yǐ hòu tā hé chē shàng de gōng zuò rén yuán yòu yì qǐ kāi huì zǒng jié yì tiān de gōng zuò kàn kàn yǒu méi yǒu zuò de bú gòu hǎo de dì fāng suī rán gōng zuò hěn lèi dàn wǒ men dōu jué de hěn yú kuài zhāng méng méng shuō guó qìng jié nà jǐ tiān lǚ kè chū xíng fēi cháng duō tā hé chē shàng de gōng zuò rén yuán měi tiān dōu yào gōng zuò shí gè xiǎo shí yǐ shàng tā jué de jié rì lǐ ràng měi wèi lǚ kè ān quán shū shì de chū xíng duì tā hé tóng shì men lái shuō shì zuì chóng yào de shì — In early October, during the National Day holiday, people either go out traveling or rest at home. But this year Zhang Mengmeng, who is not yet thirty, was even busier. She is a high-speed rail conductor, and over the holiday days she had to work a dozen or more hours a day. Zhang Mengmeng is from Sichuan; she became a train attendant more than ten years ago, and because she works hard and has excellent qualities she became a high-speed rail conductor two years ago. On National Day she got up at five in the morning to prepare for work, and at six she was at the station platform to meet the train. That day she served one train after another, and when the last one reached Chongqing it was already 23:32. After getting off, she and the staff on the train held a meeting together to sum up the day’s work and see whether anything had not been done well enough. “Although the work is tiring, we all feel very happy,” Zhang Mengmeng said. During those National Day days there were very many travelers, and she and the staff on the train had to work more than ten hours a day. She feels that letting every passenger travel safely and comfortably during the holiday is the most important thing for her and her colleagues. (the book’s title is 十八岁高铁列车长繁忙的假日, “An eighteen-year-old high-speed rail conductor’s busy holiday”; the book writes the times and 10 as digits)

lessons.title: 483. Lesson 19 Presentation 3: my first high-speed ride to Shanghai
lessons.subtitle: 取票机上扫护照 · 高铁站像候机厅 · 列车减速 · 不知不觉到了上海

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: A photograph of a station waiting area (not included). Pair up and discuss: A. What does the waiting area look like in an airport or a train station in America? B. What do the attendants do before an airplane or train departs? C. When do the captain or train conductors make announcements to passengers?

explanations.title: Presentation 3: 第一次乘坐高铁
explanations.body: The book also prints the passage in traditional characters.

examples.text: 最近我去上海旅游，第一次乘坐了高铁。因为我已经在网上订好了票，所以到了火车站以后，我在取票机上扫了一下我的护照，票就出来了。进了火车站以后，我才发现高铁站简直就像机场候机厅一样，墙上挂着几个很大的显示屏，两边还有不少商店和快餐店。检票上车不久，列车就正点发车了，十二分钟后，速度就达到了每小时三百五十公里。很快，车上的服务员就开始服务了，他们热情地询问旅客们有什么需要。列车行驶了半个小时以后，列车长突然宣布：“由于安全原因，列车现在减速运行，我们向各位旅客表示歉意。”我快快地看了一下显示器，列车正以每小时二百七十五公里的速度运行。中国人真是太“风趣”了！几分钟以后，列车又回到了原速。我坐在舒适的座位上，一边听着音乐，一边看着窗外的农田、城镇和村庄。不知不觉，列车就驶进了中国最大的城市——上海。
examples.translation: zuì jìn wǒ qù shàng hǎi lǚ yóu dì yī cì chéng zuò le gāo tiě yīn wèi wǒ yǐ jīng zài wǎng shàng dìng hǎo le piào suǒ yǐ dào le huǒ chē zhàn yǐ hòu wǒ zài qǔ piào jī shàng sǎo le yí xià wǒ de hù zhào piào jiù chū lái le jìn le huǒ chē zhàn yǐ hòu wǒ cái fā xiàn gāo tiě zhàn jiǎn zhí jiù xiàng jī chǎng hòu jī tīng yí yàng qiáng shàng guà zhe jǐ gè hěn dà de xiǎn shì píng liǎng biān hái yǒu bù shǎo shāng diàn hé kuài cān diàn jiǎn piào shàng chē bù jiǔ liè chē jiù zhèng diǎn fā chē le shí èr fēn zhōng hòu sù dù jiù dá dào le měi xiǎo shí sān bǎi wǔ shí gōng lǐ hěn kuài chē shàng de fú wù yuán jiù kāi shǐ fú wù le tā men rè qíng de xún wèn lǚ kè men yǒu shén me xū yào liè chē xíng shǐ le bàn gè xiǎo shí yǐ hòu liè chē zhǎng tū rán xuān bù yóu yú ān quán yuán yīn liè chē xiàn zài jiǎn sù yùn xíng wǒ men xiàng gè wèi lǚ kè biǎo shì qiàn yì wǒ kuài kuài de kàn le yí xià xiǎn shì qì liè chē zhèng yǐ měi xiǎo shí èr bǎi qī shí wǔ gōng lǐ de sù dù yùn xíng zhōng guó rén zhēn shì tài fēng qù le jǐ fēn zhōng yǐ hòu liè chē yòu huí dào le yuán sù wǒ zuò zài shū shì de zuò wèi shàng yì biān tīng zhe yīn yuè yì biān kàn zhe chuāng wài de nóng tián chéng zhèn hé cūn zhuāng bù zhī bù jué liè chē jiù shǐ jìn le zhōng guó zuì dà de chéng shì shàng hǎi — Recently I went to Shanghai on a trip and rode the high-speed rail for the first time. Because I had already booked the ticket online, after arriving at the station I scanned my passport on the ticket machine and the ticket came out. After entering the station I discovered that the high-speed rail station was practically like an airport waiting hall: several very large display screens hung on the walls, and on both sides there were quite a few shops and fast-food restaurants. Soon after I checked my ticket and boarded, the train departed on time, and twelve minutes later its speed reached 350 kilometers an hour. Very soon the attendants on the train began service, warmly asking the passengers what they needed. Half an hour after the train started running, the conductor suddenly announced: “For safety reasons the train is now slowing down; we apologize to all passengers.” I quickly looked at the monitor; the train was running at 275 kilometers an hour. The Chinese are really so “humorous”! A few minutes later the train returned to its original speed. I sat in the comfortable seat listening to music and looking at the farmland, towns and villages outside the window. Before I knew it, the train had pulled into China’s biggest city, Shanghai. (the book also prints it in traditional characters and writes 350 and 275 as digits)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Writing, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and fill in the table with the expressions you’ve just learned (订票、取票, 高铁站, 列车运行, 服务, 体验). B. Rearrange the expressions and write logical, correct sentences. The six sets: 1. 简直就像 / 我才发现 / 一样 / 浦东机场的 / 上海高铁站 / 下了车以后 / 候机厅 2. 达到了 / 显示屏显示 / 每小时 / 350 公里 / 十二分钟后 / 列车时速 3. 询问 / 热情地 / 订餐 / 服务员 / 要不要 / 旅客们 4. 向旅客们 / 飞机要 / 表示歉意 / 减速飞行 / 机长 / 并 / 突然宣布 5. 坐高铁去北京 / 每次都是 / 就到了 / 不知不觉地 / 最近几个月 / 她经常 6. 取票机上 / 飞机场的 / 我的身份证 / 扫了一下 / 我在 / 机票就出来了. C. Pair up, share your work and go over the suggested answers; translate the sentences into English. The book’s suggested answers are not in the text, so my answers:

rows: 在网上订票，取票机，扫一下护照，票就出来了
候机厅，显示屏，商店，快餐店
正点发车，达到每小时三百五十公里，减速运行，回到原速
热情地询问，有什么需要，表示歉意
舒适的座位，听着音乐，看着窗外，不知不觉
tables.title: Activity 2 A: expressions from Presentation 3 (the book leaves the table blank; this fill is mine)

examples.text: 下了车以后我才发现上海高铁站简直就像浦东机场的候机厅一样。
examples.translation: xià le chē yǐ hòu wǒ cái fā xiàn shàng hǎi gāo tiě zhàn jiǎn zhí jiù xiàng pǔ dōng jī chǎng de hòu jī tīng yí yàng — 1. After getting off I discovered that Shanghai’s high-speed rail station was practically like the waiting hall of Pudong Airport. (key mine)

examples.text: 十二分钟后，显示屏显示列车时速达到了每小时三百五十公里。
examples.translation: shí èr fēn zhōng hòu xiǎn shì píng xiǎn shì liè chē shí sù dá dào le měi xiǎo shí sān bǎi wǔ shí gōng lǐ — 2. Twelve minutes later the display screen showed that the train speed reached 350 kilometers an hour. (mine)

examples.text: 服务员热情地询问旅客们要不要订餐。
examples.translation: fú wù yuán rè qíng de xún wèn lǚ kè men yào bú yào dìng cān — 3. The attendant warmly asked the passengers whether they wanted to order a meal. (mine)

examples.text: 机长突然宣布飞机要减速飞行，并向旅客们表示歉意。
examples.translation: jī zhǎng tū rán xuān bù fēi jī yào jiǎn sù fēi xíng bìng xiàng lǚ kè men biǎo shì qiàn yì — 4. The captain suddenly announced that the plane would slow down, and apologized to the passengers. (mine)

examples.text: 最近几个月她经常坐高铁去北京，每次都是不知不觉地就到了。
examples.translation: zuì jìn jǐ gè yuè tā jīng cháng zuò gāo tiě qù běi jīng měi cì dōu shì bù zhī bù jué de jiù dào le — 5. In the last few months she often goes to Beijing by high-speed rail, and every time she arrives before she knows it. (mine)

examples.text: 我在飞机场的取票机上扫了一下我的身份证，机票就出来了。
examples.translation: wǒ zài fēi jī chǎng de qǔ piào jī shàng sǎo le yí xià wǒ de shēn fèn zhèng jī piào jiù chū lái le — 6. I scanned my ID card on the ticket machine at the airport and the ticket came out. (mine)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening, Writing, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the six statements and write down the main idea of each statement in English. B. Pair up and check your answers against the script your teacher provided; take turns translating the sentences into English. (Audio and the teacher’s script, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Complete the eight exchanges (for example: A: 我想坐高铁去杭州，你知道怎么买票吗？ B: ___。 / A: ___？ B: 在取票机上扫一下护照，车票就出来了。 / A: 各位旅客，___。 B: 服务员，请问列车还能正点到达北京吗？ / A: ___？ B: 每小时三百公里。 / A: ___ B: 你可以找列车长询问一下。). B. Share your work in pairs and refine your sentences with your partner’s feedback; take turns translating the exchanges into English and back into Chinese. My completed exchanges:

examples.text: 甲：我想坐高铁去杭州，你知道怎么买票吗？乙：你可以在网上订票，然后到火车站的取票机上取票。
examples.translation: jiǎ wǒ xiǎng zuò gāo tiě qù háng zhōu nǐ zhī dào zěn me mǎi piào ma yǐ nǐ kě yǐ zài wǎng shàng dìng piào rán hòu dào huǒ chē zhàn de qǔ piào jī shàng qǔ piào — 1. A: I want to take the high-speed rail to Hangzhou; do you know how to buy a ticket? B: You can book online and then pick the ticket up at the ticket machine at the station. (the book leaves A’s and B’s blanks; my fills)

examples.text: 甲：请问，进车站以后在哪里能看到列车的到达时间？乙：墙上挂着几个很大的显示屏，你可以在那儿看。
examples.translation: jiǎ qǐng wèn jìn chē zhàn yǐ hòu zài nǎ lǐ néng kàn dào liè chē de dào dá shí jiān yǐ qiáng shàng guà zhe jǐ gè hěn dà de xiǎn shì píng nǐ kě yǐ zài nàr kàn — 2. A: Excuse me, where can I see the train arrival times after entering the station? B: There are several big display screens on the wall; you can look there.

examples.text: 甲：我已经在网上订好票了，请问怎么取票？乙：在取票机上扫一下护照，车票就出来了。
examples.translation: jiǎ wǒ yǐ jīng zài wǎng shàng dìng hǎo piào le qǐng wèn zěn me qǔ piào yǐ zài qǔ piào jī shàng sǎo yí xià hù zhào chē piào jiù chū lái le — 3. A: I’ve already booked online; how do I pick up the ticket? B: Scan your passport on the ticket machine and the ticket comes out.

examples.text: 甲：各位旅客，由于安全原因，列车现在减速运行，我们向各位旅客表示歉意。乙：服务员，请问列车还能正点到达北京吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ gè wèi lǚ kè yóu yú ān quán yuán yīn liè chē xiàn zài jiǎn sù yùn xíng wǒ men xiàng gè wèi lǚ kè biǎo shì qiàn yì yǐ fú wù yuán qǐng wèn liè chē hái néng zhèng diǎn dào dá běi jīng ma — 4. A: Dear passengers, for safety reasons the train is now slowing down; we apologize. B: Attendant, can the train still arrive in Beijing on time?

examples.text: 甲：请问您要喝点儿什么？乙：我要一瓶可乐。谢谢！
examples.translation: jiǎ qǐng wèn nín yào hē diǎnr shén me yǐ wǒ yào yì píng kě lè xiè xiè — 5. A: What would you like to drink? B: I’d like a bottle of cola. Thanks!

examples.text: 甲：这个高铁站简直就像机场候机厅一样。乙：高铁站就是这样啊。
examples.translation: jiǎ zhè ge gāo tiě zhàn jiǎn zhí jiù xiàng jī chǎng hòu jī tīng yí yàng yǐ gāo tiě zhàn jiù shì zhè yàng a — 6. A: This high-speed rail station is practically like an airport waiting hall. B: High-speed rail stations are just like this.

examples.text: 甲：请问这趟高铁的时速是多少？乙：每小时三百公里。
examples.translation: jiǎ qǐng wèn zhè tàng gāo tiě de shí sù shì duō shǎo yǐ měi xiǎo shí sān bǎi gōng lǐ — 7. A: How fast is this high-speed train per hour? B: 300 kilometers an hour.

examples.text: 甲：我想知道怎么换票，您能告诉我吗？乙：你可以找列车长询问一下。
examples.translation: jiǎ wǒ xiǎng zhī dào zěn me huàn piào nín néng gào sù wǒ ma yǐ nǐ kě yǐ zhǎo liè chē zhǎng xún wèn yí xià — 8. A: I want to know how to change a ticket; can you tell me? B: You can ask the conductor.

lessons.title: 485. Lesson 19 Presentation 3 grammar: the adverb 最近
lessons.subtitle: 最近几天 · 最近几个月 · 最近三天 · 最近五年

explanations.title: Use of the adverb 最近
explanations.body: The adverb 最近 can form expressions with certain time words to indicate recent days, weeks, months, years and so on. Compare Chinese and English; in the table the first four are the general expressions and the last four the specific ones.

rows: in/over the last few days; in recent days
in/over the last few weeks; in recent weeks
in/over the last few months; in recent months
in/over the last few years; in recent years
tables.title: The adverb 最近 with time words (the first four are general, the last four specific; the book prints “last few weeks” for the months and years rows, which is corrected here)

explanations.title: Grammar Activities 1 and 2
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening, Writing, Speaking and Reading): A. Listen to the sentences and answer in Chinese: 1. 说话人经常回中国吗？ 2. 说话人最近给家里打电话了吗？为什么？ 3. 现在蔬菜为什么特别贵？ 4. 说话人问的问题是什么？ 5. 说话人还经常去滑雪吗？为什么？ 6. 羊羊为什么还没回家？ B. Pair up, share your work and go over the text. (Audio, not included; the book prints no script.) Activity 2 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): A. Read the exchanges and complete the sentences using one instance of 最近 in each; B. pair up, share your work and go over the suggested text. The blanks were lost in the printed text, so the completed exchanges are my reconstruction:

examples.text: 甲：小李去过苏州吗？乙：他上大学的时候去过，最近几年没去。
examples.translation: jiǎ xiǎo lǐ qù guò sū zhōu ma yǐ tā shàng dà xué de shí hòu qù guò zuì jìn jǐ nián méi qù — 1. A: Has Xiao Li been to Suzhou? B: He went when he was in college, but hasn’t been in recent years. (key mine)

examples.text: 甲：琳达的作业多不多？乙：马上就要考试了，所以最近几天作业很多。
examples.translation: jiǎ lín dá de zuò yè duō bù duō yǐ mǎ shàng jiù yào kǎo shì le suǒ yǐ zuì jìn jǐ tiān zuò yè hěn duō — 2. A: Does Linda have a lot of homework? B: The exam is coming soon, so she has had a lot of homework these last few days. (mine)

examples.text: 甲：小王那里最近的天气怎么样？乙：他们那里最近几天一直在下雨，明天可能要下大雨。
examples.translation: jiǎ xiǎo wáng nà lǐ zuì jìn de tiān qì zěn me yàng yǐ tā men nà lǐ zuì jìn jǐ tiān yì zhí zài xià yǔ míng tiān kě néng yào xià dà yǔ — 3. A: How has the weather been at Xiao Wang’s place lately? B: It has been raining all along these last few days there, and tomorrow it might rain heavily. (mine)

examples.text: 甲：今天小张过生日，他女朋友怎么没来？乙：她最近两个月都在北京学习，下个星期就会回来。
examples.translation: jiǎ jīn tiān xiǎo zhāng guò shēng rì tā nǚ péng yǒu zěn me méi lái yǐ tā zuì jìn liǎng gè yuè dōu zài běi jīng xué xí xià gè xīng qī jiù huì huí lái — 4. A: Today is Xiao Zhang’s birthday; why didn’t his girlfriend come? B: She has been studying in Beijing for the last two months and will come back next week. (mine)

examples.text: 甲：为什么大力很长时间没去操场锻炼身体了？乙：他最近一个月都去体育馆游泳，所以就没去操场。
examples.translation: jiǎ wèi shén me dà lì hěn cháng shí jiān méi qù cāo chǎng duàn liàn shēn tǐ le yǐ tā zuì jìn yí gè yuè dōu qù tǐ yù guǎn yóu yǒng suǒ yǐ jiù méi qù cāo chǎng — 5. A: Why hasn’t Dali been to the sports field to exercise for a long time? B: He has been going to the gym to swim the last month, so he hasn’t gone to the field. (mine)

exercises.prompt: What does 最近几天 mean?
What does 最近五年 mean?
Complete: 琳达的作业多不多？马上就要考试了，所以___作业很多。
Complete: 他___都去体育馆游泳，所以就没去操场。
What does “她最近两个月都在北京学习” mean?
options: She has been studying in Beijing for the last two months

exercises.prompt: What does “最近几个星期” mean?
他最近___个月都在北京学习。

lessons.title: 486. Lesson 19 Presentation 3 grammar: the adverb 才
lessons.subtitle: …以后才… · not until · rewriting with 才

explanations.title: The adverb 才
explanations.body: The adverb 才 can be used to indicate “not until”. In addition to indicating that something does not happen until a certain time, such as 我八点才回到家, 才 can also be used to indicate that something does not happen until another event occurs. For instance, 他们有了第一个孩子以后才搬家, “They didn’t move until they had their first child”. 才 is often used in complex sentences. Like many Chinese complex sentences, if the subject is the same it usually appears just once. For instance, instead of 我做完作业以后我才睡觉, we usually say 做完作业以后我才睡觉, or 我做完作业以后才睡觉. Examples:

examples.text: 每天我们都等爸爸妈妈回家后才吃晚饭。
examples.translation: měi tiān wǒ men dōu děng bà bà mā mā huí jiā hòu cái chī wǎn fàn — 1. Every day we wait until Mom and Dad come home before eating dinner.

examples.text: 你们散步以后才吃晚饭，还是吃了晚饭以后才散步？
examples.translation: nǐ men sàn bù yǐ hòu cái chī wǎn fàn hái shì chī le wǎn fàn yǐ hòu cái sàn bù — 2. Do you eat dinner after you take a walk, or do you walk after you have eaten dinner?

examples.text: 见到他以后我才知道他中文说得那么好。
examples.translation: jiàn dào tā yǐ hòu wǒ cái zhī dào tā zhōng wén shuō de nà me hǎo — 3. Only after meeting him did I know he speaks Chinese so well.

examples.text: 看了今天的新闻我才知道我们老家也有高铁站了。
examples.translation: kàn le jīn tiān de xīn wén wǒ cái zhī dào wǒ men lǎo jiā yě yǒu gāo tiě zhàn le — 4. Only after reading today’s news did I know our hometown has a high-speed rail station too.

examples.text: 你每天都是锻炼完身体以后才做作业吗？
examples.translation: nǐ měi tiān dōu shì duàn liàn wán shēn tǐ yǐ hòu cái zuò zuò yè ma — 5. Do you do your homework only after you finish exercising every day?

explanations.title: Grammar Activity 3 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Rewrite the six sentences using 才 (originals: 1. 我订好了高铁票以后，打电话告诉我父母，说我明天回家。 2. 你是来到蒙特雷以后，发现蒙特雷的海边非常漂亮的吗？ 3. 我订好了机票以后，看到另一个网站卖的机票更便宜。 4. 到了中国以后，我发现大家买东西都用手机付钱。 5. 你们是在旧金山玩儿了半天，然后开车回家的吗？ 6. 我们去商店买了东西，然后去老李家参加老朋友聚会。) B. Pair up, share your work and check the suggested answers. The book’s suggested answers are not in the text, so these are mine:

examples.text: 我订好了高铁票以后才打电话告诉我父母，说我明天回家。
examples.translation: wǒ dìng hǎo le gāo tiě piào yǐ hòu cái dǎ diàn huà gào sù wǒ fù mǔ shuō wǒ míng tiān huí jiā — 1. Only after I booked the high-speed rail ticket did I phone my parents to tell them I’d be home tomorrow. (key mine)

examples.text: 你是来到蒙特雷以后才发现蒙特雷的海边非常漂亮的吗？
examples.translation: nǐ shì lái dào méng tè léi yǐ hòu cái fā xiàn méng tè léi de hǎi biān fēi cháng piào liàng de ma — 2. Was it only after you came to Monterey that you discovered the seaside is so beautiful? (mine)

examples.text: 我订好了机票以后才看到另一个网站卖的机票更便宜。
examples.translation: wǒ dìng hǎo le jī piào yǐ hòu cái kàn dào lìng yí gè wǎng zhàn mài de jī piào gèng pián yi — 3. Only after I booked the plane ticket did I see that another website sold cheaper tickets. (mine)

examples.text: 到了中国以后我才发现大家买东西都用手机付钱。
examples.translation: dào le zhōng guó yǐ hòu wǒ cái fā xiàn dà jiā mǎi dōng xī dōu yòng shǒu jī fù qián — 4. Only after arriving in China did I discover that everyone pays with their phone when shopping. (mine)

examples.text: 你们是在旧金山玩儿了半天以后才开车回家的吗？
examples.translation: nǐ men shì zài jiù jīn shān wánr le bàn tiān yǐ hòu cái kāi chē huí jiā de ma — 5. Did you drive home only after playing half a day in San Francisco? (mine)

examples.text: 我们去商店买了东西以后才去老李家参加老朋友聚会。
examples.translation: wǒ men qù shāng diàn mǎi le dōng xī yǐ hòu cái qù lǎo lǐ jiā cān jiā lǎo péng yǒu jù huì — 6. Only after we bought things at the store did we go to Lao Li’s home for the old friends’ party. (mine)

explanations.title: Grammar Activities 4 and 5
explanations.body: Activity 4 (Listening, Speaking and Reading): A. Listen and transcribe eight statements in English; B. pair up, share your work and go over the script and the suggested English translations. (Audio, not included.) Activity 5 (Speaking and Writing): in pairs, write sentences using the expressions provided and use 才 in each: 1. 走到学校，天黑 2. 学三年中文，看中文报纸 3. 听你这么一说，高铁那么快 4. 体验一下…，喜欢 5. 坐一次…，服务那么周到. The book leaves the sentences to the student; my samples:

examples.text: 我走到学校的时候，天才黑。
examples.translation: wǒ zǒu dào xué xiào de shí hòu tiān cái hēi — 1. By the time I walked to school it was only just getting dark. (sample, mine)

examples.text: 学了三年中文以后，他才能看中文报纸。
examples.translation: xué le sān nián zhōng wén yǐ hòu tā cái néng kàn zhòng wén bào zhǐ — 2. Only after three years of Chinese could he read a Chinese newspaper. (mine)

examples.text: 听你这么一说，我才知道高铁那么快。
examples.translation: tīng nǐ zhè me yì shuō wǒ cái zhī dào gāo tiě nà me kuài — 3. Only after hearing you say that did I know the high-speed rail is that fast. (mine)

examples.text: 我体验了一下高铁，才知道自己那么喜欢它。
examples.translation: wǒ tǐ yàn le yí xià gāo tiě cái zhī dào zì jǐ nà me xǐ huān tā — 4. Only after trying the high-speed rail did I know how much I like it. (mine)

examples.text: 坐了一次高铁，我才知道服务那么周到。
examples.translation: zuò le yí cì gāo tiě wǒ cái zhī dào fú wù nà me zhōu dào — 5. Only after riding the high-speed rail once did I know the service is so thoughtful. (mine)

exercises.prompt: What does “我八点才回到家” mean?
options: I didn’t get home until eight
I will go home at eight
I got home at eight already

exercises.prompt: What does “他们有了第一个孩子以后才搬家” mean?
options: They didn’t move until they had their first child
They moved before their first child

lessons.title: 487. Lesson 19 Presentation 3 grammar: the prepositions 向, 往 and 对
lessons.subtitle: 向 往 对 · toward · 对 introduces the object of an action

explanations.title: The prepositions 向, 往 and 对
explanations.body: 向, 往 and 对 can all be translated as “toward” in English. For example:

examples.text: 他向我们走来。
examples.translation: tā xiàng wǒ men zǒu lái — He walks toward us.

examples.text: 他往我们这儿走来。
examples.translation: tā wǎng wǒ men zhèr zǒu lái — He walks toward us.

examples.text: 他对我们很好。
examples.translation: tā duì wǒ men hěn hǎo — He is nice toward us.

explanations.title: Overlap and differences
explanations.body: 向, 往 and 对 may overlap in meaning or usage, but they are different as well. Etymology: 向 originally meant a window, then to face, then toward; 往 originally meant to go, then toward, then to; 对 originally meant to face, then to respond, then toward, then to. Overlap: both 向 and 往 can indicate moving toward a certain direction or object; 向 is more formal and 往 is colloquial. Differences: 1. 向 can take a person as its object; 往 cannot (the book marks 我们往各位旅客表示歉意 with an asterisk as wrong). 2. 向 and 对 are also used as verbs to describe a static state; 往 is only for moving actions. 3. 对 is used to introduce the object of an action instead of direction. 4. 往 words used in announcements and news reports.

examples.text: 向北走 = 往北走
examples.translation: xiàng běi zǒu wǎng běi zǒu — Walk north (向 more formal, 往 colloquial).

examples.text: 向前看 = 往前看
examples.translation: xiàng qián kàn wǎng qián kàn — Look ahead.

examples.text: 向学校走去 = 往学校走去
examples.translation: xiàng xué xiào zǒu qù wǎng xué xiào zǒu qù — Walk toward the school.

examples.text: 我们向各位旅客表示歉意。
examples.translation: wǒ men xiàng gè wèi lǚ kè biǎo shì qiàn yì — 1. We apologize to all passengers. (向 can take a person as its object; 往 cannot)

examples.text: 他俩面对面聊天。
examples.translation: tā liǎ miàn duì miàn liáo tiān — They chat face to face.

examples.text: 向日葵向着太阳开。
examples.translation: xiàng rì kuí xiàng zhe tài yáng kāi — Sunflowers (Xiàngrìkuí) bloom facing the sun.

examples.text: 我们教室的窗户对着操场。
examples.translation: wǒ men jiào shì de chuāng hù duì zhe cāo chǎng — The windows of our classroom face the sports field.

examples.text: 两架飞机，一架向东飞，一架向西飞。
examples.translation: liǎng jià fēi jī yí jià xiàng dōng fēi yí jià xiàng xī fēi — Two planes, one flying east, one flying west (向).

examples.text: 两架飞机，一架往东飞，一架往西飞。
examples.translation: liǎng jià fēi jī yí jià wǎng dōng fēi yí jià wǎng xī fēi — Two planes, one flying east, one flying west (往).

examples.text: 我对他说：“谢谢啦！”
examples.translation: wǒ duì tā shuō xiè xiè la — I said to him, “Thanks!”

examples.text: 他对中国高铁很感兴趣。
examples.translation: tā duì zhōng guó gāo tiě hěn gǎn xìng qù — He is very interested in China’s high-speed rail.

examples.text: 我们对各位旅客表示歉意。
examples.translation: wǒ men duì gè wèi lǚ kè biǎo shì qiàn yì — We apologize to all passengers (对).

examples.text: 飞往北京，开往北京，通往北京，送往，寄往，运往
examples.translation: fēi wǎng běi jīng kāi wǎng běi jīng tōng wǎng běi jīng sòng wǎng jì wǎng yùn wǎng — Words with 往 often used in announcements and news reports: fly to Beijing, bound for Beijing, lead to Beijing, send to, mail to, transport to.

explanations.title: Grammar Activity 6 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Complete the sentences using 向, 往 or 对 (敬礼, jìnglǐ, salute). The book leaves the blanks to the student and prints no key; my completed sentences:

examples.text: 去北京的火车是往南开还是往北开？
examples.translation: qù běi jīng de huǒ chē shì wǎng nán kāi hái shì wǎng běi kāi — 1. Does the train to Beijing go south or north? (往 or 向; key mine)

examples.text: 离开前，他对连长说：“谢谢连长！”还向连长敬了一个礼。
examples.translation: lí kāi qián tā duì lián zhǎng shuō xiè xiè lián zhǎng hái xiàng lián zhǎng jìng le yí gè lǐ — 2. Before leaving, he said to the company commander, “Thank you, sir!” and also saluted him. (对, 向)

examples.text: 妈妈对我说：“你的学习成绩是不错，但还可以更好。”
examples.translation: mā mā duì wǒ shuō nǐ de xué xí chéng jì shì bú cuò dàn hái kě yǐ gèng hǎo — 3. Mom said to me, “Your grades are good, but they can be even better.” (对)

examples.text: 搬家以后，琳达对我们说，向南的房子真好，从早到晚都有太阳。
examples.translation: bān jiā yǐ hòu lín dá duì wǒ men shuō xiàng nán de fáng zi zhēn hǎo cóng zǎo dào wǎn dōu yǒu tài yáng — 4. After moving, Linda told us that a south-facing house is really nice, with sun from morning till night. (对, 向)

examples.text: 张老师对我说：“你的作业有几个错儿，中午我给你讲讲。”
examples.translation: zhāng lǎo shī duì wǒ shuō nǐ de zuò yè yǒu jǐ gè cuò ér zhōng wǔ wǒ gěi nǐ jiǎng jiǎng — 5. Teacher Zhang said to me, “There are a few mistakes in your homework; at noon I’ll go over them with you.” (对)

examples.text: 大卫和同学们边说话边往操场走去。
examples.translation: dà wèi hé tóng xué men biān shuō huà biān wǎng cāo chǎng zǒu qù — 6. David and his classmates walked toward the sports field as they talked. (往 or 向)

examples.text: 一看到妈妈，那个小女孩儿就飞快地向妈妈跑过去。
examples.translation: yí kàn dào mā mā nà ge xiǎo nǚ hái ér jiù fēi kuài de xiàng mā mā pǎo guò qù — 7. As soon as she saw her mother, the little girl ran quickly toward her. (向, since 往 can’t take a person)

explanations.title: Grammar Activity 7 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Match the elements in Column A with those in Column B by writing the letter in the middle column. B. Pair up, share your work and discuss why you made your choices; translate each sentence into English and back into Chinese. The book prints no key; my matched sentences:

examples.translation: měi cì kǎo wán shì mā mā zǒng duì wǒ shuō bú gòu hǎo nǐ yīng gāi kǎo yì bǎi fēn — 3. Every time after an exam Mom always says to me, “Not good enough; you should get 100.” (a)

examples.text: 今天王老师对我们说，下星期二是我们班的做饭日。

examples.text: 不下雨了，太阳也出来了，琳达对我说，现在咱们可以出去走走了吧？
examples.translation: bú xià yǔ le tài yáng yě chū lái le lín dá duì wǒ shuō xiàn zài zán men kě yǐ chū qù zǒu zǒu le ba — 5. The rain stopped and the sun came out; Linda said to me, “Now we can go out for a walk, can’t we?” (f)

examples.text: 从这儿向前走五十米，向左拐，再走五分钟就是邮局。
examples.translation: cóng zhèr xiàng qián zǒu wǔ shí mǐ xiàng zuǒ guǎi zài zǒu wǔ fēn zhōng jiù shì yóu jú — 6. From here go forward fifty meters, turn left, and walk five more minutes and you’re at the post office. (g)

examples.text: 老师向他笑笑，然后回答了他的问题。
examples.translation: lǎo shī xiàng tā xiào xiào rán hòu huí dá le tā de wèn tí — 7. The teacher smiled at him and then answered his question. (b)

lessons.title: 488. Lesson 19 Presentation 3 grammar: the conjunction 由于, and Skill Integration (Amtrak to Washington)
lessons.subtitle: 由于 … 因此/因而 · formal announcements · 乘火车去华盛顿

explanations.title: Conjunction 由于
explanations.body: In this presentation the train conductor announced: 列车长突然宣布：“由于安全原因，列车现在减速运行，……” Here 由于 is a conjunction similar to 因为, introducing a reason and meaning “because”. Compare with 因为: 1. 由于 is more formal and not usually used in casual conversation. 2. Because of its formality it cannot be used in the later part of a complex sentence like 因为: the book marks 她不想去跑步了，由于雨太大了 and 你得走路回去了，由于太晚了，没车了 with asterisks as wrong. 3. 因为 goes with 所以; 由于 goes with 因此 or 因而. Examples:

examples.text: 由于安全原因，列车现在减速运行。
examples.translation: yóu yú ān quán yuán yīn liè chē xiàn zài jiǎn sù yùn xíng — For safety reasons the train is now slowing down. (formal)

examples.text: 因为安全原因，列车现在减速运行。
examples.translation: yīn wèi ān quán yuán yīn liè chē xiàn zài jiǎn sù yùn xíng — Because of safety reasons the train is now slowing down. (less formal)

examples.text: 因为雨太大，她不想出去跑步了。
examples.translation: yīn wèi yǔ tài dà tā bù xiǎng chū qù pǎo bù le — Because the rain is too heavy she doesn’t want to go out running.

examples.text: 由于雨太大，她不想出去跑步了。
examples.translation: yóu yú yǔ tài dà tā bù xiǎng chū qù pǎo bù le — Because the rain is too heavy she doesn’t want to go out running. (rarely said)

examples.text: 她不想去跑步了，因为雨太大了。
examples.translation: tā bù xiǎng qù pǎo bù le yīn wèi yǔ tài dà le — She doesn’t want to go running anymore, because the rain is too heavy.

examples.text: 你得走路回去了，因为太晚了，没车了。
examples.translation: nǐ děi zǒu lù huí qù le yīn wèi tài wǎn le méi chē le — You have to walk back, because it’s too late and there are no more buses.

examples.text: 由于高铁给人们出行提供了方便，因此中国最近十几年出现了旅游热。
examples.translation: yóu yú gāo tiě gěi rén men chū xíng tí gōng le fāng biàn yīn cǐ zhōng guó zuì jìn shí jǐ nián chū xiàn le lǚ yóu rè — Because high-speed rail has made traveling convenient for people, a tourism boom has appeared in China in the last dozen or so years.

examples.text: 由于列车突然减速让乘客不适，因而列车长需要表示歉意。
examples.translation: yóu yú liè chē tū rán jiǎn sù ràng chéng kè bú shì yīn ér liè chē zhǎng xū yào biǎo shì qiàn yì — Because the train’s sudden slowdown made passengers uncomfortable, the conductor needs to apologize.

explanations.title: Grammar Activity 8 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up with a partner. Together think of a social event or scenario and come up with a formal announcement with 由于; write it in the table (Scenario; Announcement: Cause (由于), Outcome). B. Each pair shares the first part of their announcement in class and asks the class to guess the second part; after the class makes two guesses the pair shares the second part. (A picture, not included.) The book’s example, and my sample announcement:

examples.text: 在语言节宣布：由于演员身体不适，因此他们需要休息。
examples.translation: zài yǔ yán jié xuān bù yóu yú yǎn yuán shēn tǐ bú shì yīn cǐ tā men xū yào xiū xī — Pair 1 first part (the book’s example): At the Language Day announcement: “Because the actors feel unwell, therefore they need rest.” (class guess 1)

examples.text: 由于演员身体不适，因而大家看不到演出了。
examples.translation: yóu yú yǎn yuán shēn tǐ bú shì yīn ér dà jiā kàn bú dào yǎn chū le — Class guess 2: because the actors are unwell, everyone cannot see the show.

examples.text: 由于演员身体不适，因而学校请来了中医师。
examples.translation: yóu yú yǎn yuán shēn tǐ bú shì yīn ér xué xiào qǐng lái le zhōng yī shī — Pair 1 second part: because the actors are unwell, the school invited a traditional Chinese medicine doctor.

examples.text: 在学校宣布：由于明天有大雪，因此学校明天放假一天。
examples.translation: zài xué xiào xuān bù yóu yú míng tiān yǒu dà xuě yīn cǐ xué xiào míng tiān fàng jià yì tiān — Scenario: school announcement. Cause: because there will be heavy snow tomorrow; outcome: therefore school will be closed for a day tomorrow. (my sample announcement)

explanations.title: Skill Integration Activity 1 (Writing, Listening, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Song Laoshi wants to travel to Washington D.C., and you suggest that she take Amtrak; she has never taken a train in America. Think about what you would tell her to do; you may want to go to Amtrak’s Chinese website for the information (link not included). In Chinese, write your discussion points. B. Listen to the dialog and take notes (check your dictionary for 汽油 and 了解 first: mine, gasoline and to understand); pair up and discuss what information in the audio could benefit Song Laoshi on her trip, in the table 坐火车: 时间, 钱, 看什么, 设施; 火车上的服务和设施: 用餐, 卧铺. C. Go over the script and refine your notes; then write an email to Song Laoshi explaining what her trip will be like and how she should prepare (TO, CC, Subject). (Audio, not included; the book prints no script.)

lessons.subtitle: 市市通高铁 · 福建 山东 · 车次时刻表 · 记者与官员

explanations.title: Skill Integration Activity 2 (Reading, Speaking and Writing): 市市通高铁
explanations.body: A. Pair up and guess what the following expressions mean: 成为, 省内, 通, 实现, 随着. B. Read the news report, then mark the statements as True or False. C. Discuss your answers with your partner and translate the underlined sentences into English. D. With your partner create a dialog between a reporter and a transportation department official in China, using the information in the report; act it out for the class. The report (the book writes the years and numbers as digits):

rows: Hint: 换成, 分成, 变化, 变成 (become)
Hint: 内 is the opposite of 外 (within the province)
Hint: 交通; 101 号高速公路通旧金山 (lead to, open to traffic)
实 means “reality”, 现 “materialize” (achieve; e.g. 她实现了去北京上大学的计划)
Hints: 随时, 随身带, 随便 (along with)
tables.title: Skill Integration Activity 2 A: guess the meanings (the book’s hints; the meanings in the brackets are mine)

examples.text: 二零一八年福建省省内较大的城市都通了高铁，福建成为中国第一个市市通高铁的省。然后，山东、河南等七个省也在二零二零年实现了市市通高铁。
examples.translation: èr líng yī bā nián fú jiàn shěng shěng nèi jiào dà de chéng shì dōu tōng le gāo tiě fú jiàn chéng wéi zhōng guó dì yī gè shì shì tōng gāo tiě de shěng rán hòu shān dōng hé nán děng qī gè shěng yě zài èr líng èr líng nián shí xiàn le shì shì tōng gāo tiě — 1. In 2018 all the larger cities within Fujian Province had high-speed rail, and Fujian became China’s first province with high-speed rail in every city. Then Shandong, Henan and seven other provinces also achieved this in 2020. (underlined sentence 1; the book writes the years and 7 as digits)

examples.text: 山东省有一亿多人口，省内的十七个较大的城市已经全部通了高铁，以前坐火车从省内一个城市到另一个城市，最远的需要十多个小时，现在坐高铁不超过三个小时就到了。比如，青岛在山东的东部，是山东第二大城市。现在，从青岛坐高铁去山东东部的城市，一个小时以内就能到，去省内离青岛最远的城市，最多两个小时就能到达。
examples.translation: shān dōng shěng yǒu yí yì duō rén kǒu shěng nèi de shí qī gè jiào dà de chéng shì yǐ jīng quán bù tōng le gāo tiě yǐ qián zuò huǒ chē cóng shěng nèi yí gè chéng shì dào lìng yí gè chéng shì zuì yuǎn de xū yào shí duō gè xiǎo shí xiàn zài zuò gāo tiě bù chāo guò sān gè xiǎo shí jiù dào le bǐ rú qīng dǎo zài shān dōng de dōng bù shì shān dōng dì èr dà chéng shì xiàn zài cóng qīng dǎo zuò gāo tiě qù shān dōng dōng bù de chéng shì yí gè xiǎo shí yǐ nèi jiù néng dào qù shěng nèi lí qīng dǎo zuì yuǎn de chéng shì zuì duō liǎng gè xiǎo shí jiù néng dào dá — 2. Shandong Province has over 100 million people, and its 17 larger cities all have high-speed rail now. Before, going by train from one city to another within the province took more than ten hours at the farthest; now by high-speed rail it takes no more than three hours. For example, Qingdao is in eastern Shandong and is the province’s second-largest city. Now, from Qingdao you can reach cities in eastern Shandong in under an hour, and the farthest city in the province from Qingdao in two hours at most. (sentences 2 and 3 are underlined; the book writes 17 as digits)

examples.text: 现在高铁站提供的各种服务也越来越多。比如，在一些高铁站，旅客可以吃，住，购物，玩儿，也可以订旅游景点的门票，以及各地的酒店。
examples.translation: xiàn zài gāo tiě zhàn tí gōng de gè zhǒng fú wù yě yuè lái yuè duō bǐ rú zài yì xiē gāo tiě zhàn lǚ kè kě yǐ chī zhù gòu wù wánr yě kě yǐ dìng lǚ yóu jǐng diǎn de mén piào yǐ jí gè dì de jiǔ diàn — 3. The services provided by high-speed rail stations are also increasing. For example, at some stations passengers can eat, stay, shop and play, and can also book tickets to tourist attractions and hotels in various places. (underlined sentence 4)

explanations.title: The statements and my key

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context Activity 1 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Pair up and take turns answering the questions. Provide as many details as possible using two or three sentences. When you have finished, switch roles and repeat. (A photograph, not included.)

examples.text: 在中国坐高铁怎么订票、取票？
examples.translation: zài zhōng guó zuò gāo tiě zěn me dìng piào qǔ piào — 1. How do you book and pick up tickets for the high-speed rail in China?

examples.text: 中国一些大城市的高铁站是什么样子？
examples.translation: zhōng guó yì xiē dà chéng shì de gāo tiě zhàn shì shén me yàng zi — 2. What do the high-speed rail stations in some big Chinese cities look like?

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context Activity 2 (Reading, Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. You and one of your Chinese colleagues have just arrived at the train station to take a high-speed train from Shanghai to Beijing. Your colleague tells you that you don’t need tickets to check in. Read the following expressions and guess what each means by matching it with one of the five images (not included). B. An elderly woman comes to your colleague and asks for help; listen and write your notes in the table 关于 / 怎么做 (怎么进站; 没带身份证怎么办). (Audio, not included.) C. Two-way interpretation: a foreign tourist who speaks only English asks your colleague, who speaks only Chinese, for help, and you are the interpreter. Discuss with your partner how your colleague would answer her questions and how you would interpret. The book prints only the traveler’s English lines: 1. “I booked my ticket online. Do you know how to check in?” 2. “But I don’t have a Chinese ID, and I only have my passport with me.” 3. “Thank you! This is my first time taking a high-speed train. At such a high speed, I wonder if the train can run very smoothly.” 4. “How about their services. Will I have access to the internet?” 5. “That’s good to hear. How about food? What drinks do they have?” My sample interpretation for the first two:

headers: 意思 (mine; the book asks you to match each with a picture)
rows: enter the station by face scan
face the camera / line up with the lens
to compare (match) the face with the record
tables.title: Using Chinese in Context Activity 2 A: the expressions (the pictures are not included)

examples.text: 你（中文）：我的这位同事说，你不需要车票，可以直接刷脸进站。
examples.translation: nǐ zhōng wén wǒ de zhè wèi tóng shì shuō nǐ bù xū yào chē piào kě yǐ zhí jiē shuā liǎn jìn zhàn — Sample interpretation into Chinese (mine): my colleague says you don’t need a ticket and can enter the station by face scan.

examples.text: 你同事：对，你只要站在机器前面，对准镜头，机器比对以后，你就可以进站了。

examples.text: 你（中文）：她说她没有中国的身份证，只带了护照。

examples.translation: nǐ tóng shì méi guān xì tā kě yǐ bǎ hù zhào fàng zài jī qì shàng sǎo yí xià shū rù hào mǎ yě kě yǐ qù rén gōng chuāng kǒu bàn yì zhāng lín shí shēn fèn zhèng — The colleague (sample, mine): no problem, she can scan her passport on the machine and enter the number, or go to the staffed window for a temporary ID.

explanations.title: Using Chinese in Context Activity 3 (Reading, Speaking, Listening and Writing)
explanations.body: You are a reporter writing a special report for the International Journal of Culture and Society about the people and the development of the transportation system in Beijing. You learn about an event for an old-fashioned green train, and you and a colleague each do the following. A. Reporter A reads piece A and Reporter B reads piece B and each takes notes. B. After both reporters are done reading, share what you read with each other and complete the table (什么事情, 今天的情况, 过去的情况, 为什么会有今天事情). C. Together write a brief report based on the information in B. D. Report orally to the class. The two pieces (the book’s counts: 288 and 290 characters) and my filled table:

rows: 六四五一次绿皮火车停驶
最后一班，坐得满满的，很多人是铁路爱好者，不停地拍照片，有人流泪
最后一班，乘客背着大包小包、抱着孩子，还有车迷，十八时零一分开出
最早是给铁路职工上下班坐的，后来老百姓也能坐，票价只有六块多钱
主要往返于北京和廊坊之间，周五常常找不到座位，四元的票价性价比很高
现在大家不是开车就是坐高铁或快车，不太需要绿皮火车了
烧煤对环境不好，车速慢，地铁开通后人们更喜欢坐地铁
tables.title: Using Chinese in Context Activity 3 B: the table the two reporters complete (blank in the book; my fill)

examples.text: 六四五一次列车停驶。二零一九年一月五日，最后一班六四五一次列车从北京站开出。因为列车是绿色的，人们把它叫做绿皮火车。这班绿皮火车运行了几十年，是从北京去天津最便宜的一趟火车，一张票只有六块多钱。绿皮火车一方面便宜，另一方面也提供了一个体验老日子的机会，所以平时虽然坐不满，但也总是有人坐。今天，列车上坐得满满的，很多人是铁路爱好者。他们不停地拍照片，还有人留下了眼泪。据说，六四五一次列车最早是给上下班的铁路职工坐的，用的是最简易的车厢，铁路职工乘坐不需要买票。后来老百姓也可以坐了，由于票价便宜，坐的老百姓越来越多。但现在的生活和以前不一样了，出行的时候，大家不是开车就是坐高铁或快车，所以绿皮火车就不太需要了。
examples.translation: liù sì wǔ yī cì liè chē tíng shǐ èr líng yī jiǔ nián yī yuè wǔ rì zuì hòu yì bān liù sì wǔ yī cì liè chē cóng běi jīng zhàn kāi chū yīn wèi liè chē shì lǜ sè de rén men bǎ tā jiào zuò lǜ pí huǒ chē zhè bān lǜ pí huǒ chē yùn xíng le jǐ shí nián shì cóng běi jīng qù tiān jīn zuì pián yi de yí tàng huǒ chē yì zhāng piào zhǐ yǒu liù kuài duō qián lǜ pí huǒ chē yì fāng miàn pián yi lìng yì fāng miàn yě tí gōng le yí gè tǐ yàn lǎo rì zi de jī huì suǒ yǐ píng shí suī rán zuò bù mǎn dàn yě zǒng shì yǒu rén zuò jīn tiān liè chē shàng zuò de mǎn mǎn de hěn duō rén shì tiě lù ài hào zhě tā men bù tíng de pāi zhào piān hái yǒu rén liú xià le yǎn lèi jù shuō liù sì wǔ yī cì liè chē zuì zǎo shì gěi shàng xià bān de tiě lù zhí gōng zuò de yòng de shì zuì jiǎn yì de chē xiāng tiě lù zhí gōng chéng zuò bù xū yào mǎi piào hòu lái lǎo bǎi xìng yě kě yǐ zuò le yóu yú piào jià pián yi zuò de lǎo bǎi xìng yuè lái yuè duō dàn xiàn zài de shēng huó hé yǐ qián bù yí yàng le chū xíng de shí hòu dà jiā bú shì kāi chē jiù shì zuò gāo tiě huò kuài chē suǒ yǐ lǜ pí huǒ chē jiù bú tài xū yào le — Reporter A: Train 6451 stops running. On January 5, 2019, the last Train 6451 left Beijing Station. Because the train is green, people call it the “green-skin train”. This green train ran for decades and was the cheapest train from Beijing to Tianjin, a ticket costing only a little over six yuan. The green train was on one hand cheap, and on the other it offered a chance to experience the old days, so although usually not full, there were always people on it. Today the train was packed, and many were railway enthusiasts. They took photos non-stop, and some even shed tears. It is said that Train 6451 was originally for railway staff commuting to and from work, used the simplest carriages, and railway staff did not need tickets. Later ordinary people could ride, and because the fare was cheap, more and more ordinary people rode it. But life now is different from before; when going out people either drive or take the high-speed rail or a fast train, so the green train was no longer much needed. (the book writes the numbers as digits and counts 288 characters)

examples.text: 六四五一次列车今天“退休”。今天，走进最后一班六四五一次的绿皮车厢的，是背着大包小包、抱着孩子的乘客，还有喜欢绿皮车慢时光的车迷们。十八时零一分，六四五一次从北京站慢慢开动，坐在绿皮车内望着窗外，只见路上车水马龙，而车厢内却有一份宁静。列车员告诉记者，六四五一次列车的乘客主要往返于北京和廊坊之间。特别是到了每周五，经常找不到座位。有的人在北京工作、廊坊买房，工作日住在北京，周末回廊坊休假。从北京站到廊坊北七十四公里，行驶一小时十三分钟，四元的票价可以说性价比非常高，为百姓出行提供了方便。但是，这趟车的茶炉、暖气都是靠烧煤的，对环境很不好，而且它车速慢。地铁开通以后，人们都更喜欢坐地铁。所以这趟绿皮车就从今天起停驶了。
examples.translation: liù sì wǔ yī cì liè chē jīn tiān tuì xiū jīn tiān zǒu jìn zuì hòu yì bān liù sì wǔ yī cì de lǜ pí chē xiāng de shì bēi zhe dà bāo xiǎo bāo bào zhe hái zi de chéng kè hái yǒu xǐ huān lǜ pí chē màn shí guāng de chē mí men shí bā shí líng yī fēn liù sì wǔ yī cì cóng běi jīng zhàn màn màn kāi dòng zuò zài lǜ pí chē nèi wàng zhe chuāng wài zhǐ jiàn lù shàng chē shuǐ mǎ lóng ér chē xiāng nèi què yǒu yí fèn níng jìng liè chē yuán gào sù jì zhě liù sì wǔ yī cì liè chē de chéng kè zhǔ yào wǎng fǎn yú běi jīng hé láng fāng zhī jiān tè bié shì dào le měi zhōu wǔ jīng cháng zhǎo bú dào zuò wèi yǒu de rén zài běi jīng gōng zuò láng fāng mǎi fáng gōng zuò rì zhù zài běi jīng zhōu mò huí láng fāng xiū jià cóng běi jīng zhàn dào láng fāng běi qī shí sì gōng lǐ xíng shǐ yì xiǎo shí shí sān fēn zhōng sì yuán de piào jià kě yǐ shuō xìng jià bǐ fēi cháng gāo wèi bǎi xìng chū xíng tí gōng le fāng biàn dàn shì zhè tàng chē de chá lú nuǎn qì dōu shì kào shāo méi de duì huán jìng hěn bù hǎo ér qiě tā chē sù màn dì tiě kāi tōng yǐ hòu rén men dōu gèng xǐ huān zuò dì tiě suǒ yǐ zhè tàng lǜ pí chē jiù cóng jīn tiān qǐ tíng shǐ le — Reporter B: Train 6451 “retires” today. Today those who walked into the carriages of the last Train 6451 were passengers carrying big and small bags and holding children, and also train fans who love the slow time of the green train. At 18:01 Train 6451 pulled slowly out of Beijing Station; sitting inside looking out the window you saw only a stream of cars and horses on the road, while inside the carriage there was a calm. The train attendant told reporters that the passengers of Train 6451 mainly travel back and forth between Beijing and Langfang, especially on Fridays when seats are often hard to find. Some people work in Beijing and buy a home in Langfang, living in Beijing on workdays and returning to Langfang for the weekend. From Beijing Station to Langfang North is 74 kilometers, taking 1 hour 13 minutes, and a 4-yuan fare can be called very good value, providing convenience for ordinary people. But the tea boiler and the heating on this train both ran on burning coal, which is bad for the environment, and it is slow. After the subway opened people liked the subway better, so this green train stopped running from today. (the book writes the numbers as digits, glosses 廊坊 as Lángfāng and 煤 as méi, coal, and counts 290 characters)

lessons.title: 491. Lesson 19 Area Studies: China’s fast-growing transportation system
lessons.subtitle: 铁路 · 航空 · 水运 · 高速公路

explanations.title: Area Studies: China’s Fast-Growing Transportation System
explanations.body:
The book’s English reading, in five paragraphs (with pictures of a high-speed train, Beijing Daxing International Airport and a highway, not included). Its references are wikipedia.org, finance.ifeng.com, china.chinadaily.com.cn and sourcedb.igsnrr.cas.cn.

China’s transport infrastructure has been in the process of massive upgrades for the past few decades. For example, the annual transport volume of cargo has increased from 130.6 billion tons in 2000 to 543.4 billion tons in 2019. Rail plays a very important role in China’s transportation system. As of 2020, China’s railway mileage reached 141,400 kilometers, 36,000 kilometers of which are high-speed railways, the most in the world.

By 2035, according to plan, the national railway network will have an operating mileage of over 200,000 kilometers, including about 70,000 kilometers of high-speed rail. Cities with populations over 200,000 (336 cities) will be accessible by railways, and cities with populations over 500,000 (322 cities) will be accessible by high-speed rail.

Over the past 10 years, the annual growth rate of air travel has reached 14%. In 2019, China’s airlines transported 660 million passengers, a year-on-year increase of 7.9%, and cargo and mail transport volume was 7.5 million tons, a year-on-year increase of 1.9%. At the end of 2019, China’s airlines have 5,155 domestic and international routes, the fleet size has reached 3,818 vehicles and the number of airports has reached 238. The newly built Beijing Daxing International Airport will soon become the world’s busiest airport.

China’s waterways account for 1.56% of passenger transport volume, and 13.8% of China’s freight transport volume. There are 2007 coastal ports with berths of 10,000 tons and above. China’s merchant fleet ranks first in the world. Since 2005 China’s merchant shipbuilding capacity has been the largest in the world. In 2019, China’s shipbuilding industry completed 36.72 million deadweight tons, and export ships accounted for 92.1% of the total.

On December 21, 1984, China’s first expressway broke ground; the Shanghai-Jiading Expressway was 20.5 kilometers long. On September 1, 1990, Shenyang-Dalian Expressway was completed. With a length of 375 kilometers, it was the longest expressway in the country at the time. In 2017, the Beijing-Xinjiang Expressway was connected, cutting across the Gobi Desert with a total mileage of 2,768 kilometers; it is the longest highway in the world. In 2019, the total mileage of China’s highways was 4,846,500 kilometers. The national expressway network, the largest in the world, now consists of 7 capital radiation lines, 9 north-south vertical lines and 18 east-west horizontal lines.

explanations.title: Learning objectives (Lesson 20, The Post Office, 在邮局)
explanations.body: Unit 4 continues with Survival Skills and Social Factors. In this lesson you will obtain and provide information about mailing letters and parcels at the post office or with shipping services, describe the key services of the post office, carry out the mailing of letters or parcels or other procedures at the post office, and narrate a personal experience of mailing items by various means. To do so you must master the core vocabulary and patterns, the special modifiers for time order (表示时间先后的特别修饰语), the usage of 亲自, 恐怕, the 不仅…而且 construction, the post-modifier cluster in the 比 pattern, 最多/最少, 要看, the differences among 不过, 但是 and 可是, the connector 另外, the causative verb 使, the usage of 所有的 and the usage of 被 in neutral context. The Area Studies topic is the post office in China.

lessons.title: 495. Lesson 20 Presentation 1 grammar: modifiers for earlier and later times
lessons.subtitle: 大前年 前年 去年 今年 明年 后年 · 上(个)星期 下(个)月 · 天和年不能用个

explanations.title: 表示时间先后的特别修饰语
explanations.body: Students may occasionally say 一个天, 下个年 or 后个月, which are wrong in Chinese. The most obvious reason is the difference in how Chinese and English indicate previous and future days, weeks, months and years. Unlike English, Chinese uses two sets of modifiers. Set one, 大前--前--去/昨--今--明--后--大后, covers 天 and 年. Note 1: 天 and 年 use the same set of modifiers except for the previous day (昨天) and the previous year (去年). Note 2: 天 and 年 cannot take 个 as a measure word. Set two, 上上(个)--上(个)--这(个)--下(个)--下下(个), covers 星期 and 月. Note 3: 个 is optional in the table below; however, when a number is used before 月, adding or omitting 个 creates a difference in meaning: 一个月 means “a month”, whereas 一月 means “January”.

rows: the year before the year before last
tables.title: Set one for 年: 大前--前--去--今--明--后--大后
Set one for 天: 大前--前--昨--今--明--后--大后
Set two for 星期: 上上(个)--上(个)--这(个)--下(个)--下下(个)

lessons.title: 496. Lesson 20 Presentation 1 grammar: 亲自, 自己 and 一个人
lessons.subtitle: 亲自 = in person · 自己 or 一个人 = by oneself

explanations.title: The use of 亲自
explanations.body: 亲自 is used to indicate “do something in person”. In this instance 亲自 and 自己 can be used interchangeably, but 你得自己去办理护照 is ambiguous, since it can also mean “you have to go by yourself (no one will accompany you)”. 你得一个人去办理护照 avoids the ambiguity. 亲自 is also used to indicate that someone does something in person although they do not need to: 校长亲自打电话祝贺那个学生 implies that a principal usually does not or need not call a student in person to congratulate him. Examples:

examples.text: 你得亲自去办理护照。
examples.translation: nǐ děi qīn zì qù bàn lǐ hù zhào — 1. You have to go in person to get your passport.

examples.text: 要想知道一个地方好不好，最好亲自去那儿住几个月。
examples.translation: yào xiǎng zhī dào yí gè dì fāng hǎo bù hǎo zuì hǎo qīn zì qù nàr zhù jǐ gè yuè — 2. If you want to know whether a place is good, it’s best to go and live there yourself for a few months.

examples.text: 你得自己去办理护照。
examples.translation: nǐ děi zì jǐ qù bàn lǐ hù zhào — 3. You have to go and get your passport yourself. (自己 may also mean “alone”, so it is ambiguous)

examples.text: 你得一个人去办理护照。
examples.translation: nǐ děi yí gè rén qù bàn lǐ hù zhào — 4. You have to go and get your passport alone. (一个人 avoids the ambiguity)

examples.text: 校长亲自打电话祝贺那个学生。
examples.translation: xiào zhǎng qīn zì dǎ diàn huà zhù hè nà ge xué shēng — 5. The principal personally phoned to congratulate that student. (implies the principal does not usually need to)

explanations.title: Grammar Activity 3 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Read the dialogue and complete the sentences using 自己, 一个人 or 亲自. B. Pair up and check your answers. The book leaves the blanks to the student and prints no key; my completed dialogue:

examples.text: 太太：这个长周末你陪我去韩国旅行吧。先生：这个周末恐怕不行。下个星期一上海有一个很重要的会，我得亲自去参加。

Husband: I’m afraid I can’t this weekend. There is a very important meeting in Shanghai next Monday, and I have to attend in person. (亲自; key mine)

examples.text: 太太：哎呀，我已经买好飞机票了。先生：那你自己去吧。
examples.translation: tài tài āi yā wǒ yǐ jīng mǎi hǎo fēi jī piào le xiān shēng nà nǐ zì jǐ qù ba — Wife: Oh dear, I’ve already bought the plane ticket. Husband: Then go by yourself. (自己)

examples.text: 太太：一个人去没意思，而且要是我想照相都找不到人帮我照。先生：你跟你的朋友去怎么样？
examples.translation: tài tài yí gè rén qù méi yì si ér qiě yào shì wǒ xiǎng zhào xiàng dōu zhǎo bú dào rén bāng wǒ zhào xiān shēng nǐ gēn nǐ de péng yǒu qù zěn me yàng — Wife: Going alone is no fun, and if I want a photo I can’t find anyone to take it. Husband: How about going with your friends? (一个人)

examples.text: 太太：我的朋友也要跟自己的先生去旅行呢！先生：我听说韩国没有什么好玩的，你还是别去了！等以后我有空了，咱们一起去法国旅行。
examples.translation: tài tài wǒ de péng yǒu yě yào gēn zì jǐ de xiān shēng qù lǚ xíng ne xiān shēng wǒ tīng shuō hán guó méi yǒu shén me hǎo wán de nǐ hái shì bié qù le děng yǐ hòu wǒ yǒu kòng le zán men yì qǐ qù fǎ guó lǚ xíng — Wife: My friends are also going on trips with their own husbands! Husband: I hear there’s nothing fun in Korea; you’d better not go! When I have time later, let’s go to France together. (自己)

examples.text: 太太：你又没有亲自去过，怎么知道韩国不好玩？我看你就是不想陪我去！先生：好，好，我陪你去。不过到了韩国，你自己去逛街买东西，我得在旅馆里准备下个星期的会。
examples.translation: tài tài nǐ yòu méi yǒu qīn zì qù guò zěn me zhī dào hán guó bù hǎo wán wǒ kàn nǐ jiù shì bù xiǎng péi wǒ qù xiān shēng hǎo hǎo wǒ péi nǐ qù bú guò dào le hán guó nǐ zì jǐ qù guàng jiē mǎi dōng xī wǒ děi zài lǚ guǎn lǐ zhǔn bèi xià gè xīng qī de huì — Wife: You haven’t even been there yourself; how do you know Korea isn’t fun? I think you just don’t want to go with me! Husband: OK, OK, I’ll go with you. But when we get to Korea you go shopping by yourself; I have to prepare for next week’s meeting in the hotel. (亲自; 自己)

explanations.body: A. Pair up and familiarize yourselves with the following questions; walk around and interview your classmates. B. The whole class shares their findings in Chinese.

lessons.title: 497. Lesson 20 Presentation 1 grammar: 恐怕, 大概 and 也许
lessons.subtitle: I am afraid · probably · perhaps

explanations.title: 恐怕, 大概 & 也许
explanations.body: The adverb 恐怕 indicates inference and estimation. It is similar to 大概 and 也许 in meaning and is often used to soften the tone of the sentence; there are subtle differences. For inference or estimation, 大概 and 恐怕 require a more objective judgment, using the known information to predict a possible outcome. 大概 expresses stronger affirmation than 恐怕. 恐怕 also carries the meaning of “worry” and “anxiety”, so it usually leads to a more negative prediction. Compared with them, 也许 indicates a more subjective estimation and strongly expresses indefiniteness rather than affirmation; 也许 can be followed by either a positive or a negative prediction.

rows: a positive or a negative prediction
tables.title: 恐怕, 大概 and 也许 compared (the book’s explanation, put in a table)

examples.text: 现在去邮局的人恐怕不太多了吧？
examples.translation: xiàn zài qù yóu jú de rén kǒng pà bú tài duō le ba — 1. I’m afraid not many people go to the post office now, do they?

examples.text: 他坐五点发车的高铁，大概晚上八点才会到。
examples.translation: tā zuò wǔ diǎn fā chē de gāo tiě dà gài wǎn shàng bā diǎn cái huì dào — 2. He is taking the five o’clock high-speed train and will probably not arrive until eight in the evening. (the book writes 5 as a digit)

examples.text: 明天我有期中考试，恐怕去不了明天的聚会。
examples.translation: míng tiān wǒ yǒu qī zhōng kǎo shì kǒng pà qù bù liǎo míng tiān de jù huì — 3. I have a midterm exam tomorrow, so I’m afraid I can’t go to tomorrow’s party.

examples.text: 他明天也许来，也许不来。
examples.translation: tā míng tiān yě xǔ lái yě xǔ bù lái — 4. He may come tomorrow or he may not.

explanations.title: Grammar Activity 5 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Read and complete the sentences using 大概, 也许 or 恐怕. B. Pair up and check your answers by reading the sentences aloud and translating them. The book prints no key; my completed sentences:

examples.text: 水族馆离渔人码头不太远，走路大概只要十到十五分钟。
examples.translation: shuǐ zú guǎn lí yú rén mǎ tóu bú tài yuǎn zǒu lù dà gài zhǐ yào shí dào shí wǔ fēn zhōng — 1. The aquarium is not far from Fisherman’s Wharf; walking probably takes only 10 to 15 minutes. (key mine; the book writes 10-15 as digits)

examples.text: 天这么黑，恐怕快要下雨了。
examples.translation: tiān zhè me hēi kǒng pà kuài yào xià yǔ le — 2. The sky is so dark; I’m afraid it’s about to rain. (恐怕 or 也许)

examples.text: 这个周末要是天气好，也许我会去海边烤肉踢球好好放松一下。
examples.translation: zhè ge zhōu mò yào shì tiān qì hǎo yě xǔ wǒ huì qù hǎi biān kǎo ròu tī qiú hǎo hǎo fàng sōng yí xià — 3. If the weather is good this weekend, maybe I’ll go to the beach to barbecue and play ball and relax. (也许)

examples.text: 这个单元我没有花太多时间准备生词，这次的单元考试恐怕会考不好。
examples.translation: zhè ge dān yuán wǒ méi yǒu huā tài duō shí jiān zhǔn bèi shēng cí zhè cì de dān yuán kǎo shì kǒng pà huì kǎo bù hǎo — 4. I didn’t spend much time preparing the vocabulary for this unit, so I’m afraid I’ll do badly on this unit test. (恐怕)

examples.text: 我已经等了二十分钟的公共汽车了。我想我也许错过了这班车。
examples.translation: wǒ yǐ jīng děng le èr shí fēn zhōng de gōng gòng qì chē le wǒ xiǎng wǒ yě xǔ cuò guò le zhè bān chē — 5. I have already waited twenty minutes for the bus. I think maybe I missed it. (也许 or 恐怕; the book writes 20 as a digit)

examples.text: 这个月等我发工资，也许请你去吃中国饭。
examples.translation: zhè ge yuè děng wǒ fā gōng zī yě xǔ qǐng nǐ qù chī zhōng guó fàn — 6. When I get paid this month, maybe I’ll treat you to Chinese food. (也许)

lessons.title: 498. Lesson 20 Presentation 1 grammar: 不仅…而且…
lessons.subtitle: 不但/不仅/不只 … 而且/还/也 · not only … but also

explanations.title: The 不仅…而且 construction
explanations.body: In the previous lesson you learned 不但…而且 to express “not only … but also”. 不但 can be a substitute for 不仅 or 不只, all of which mean “not only” and can be followed by 而且, 还 or 也 to indicate a progressive relationship. Pattern: Subject + 不但/不仅/不只 …, 而且/还/也 …; or 不但/不仅/不只 + Subject 1 + …, 而且 Subject 2 + 还/也. Examples:

examples.text: 邮局不仅能寄信、寄包裹，而且还卖信封和邮票。
examples.translation: yóu jú bù jǐn néng jì xìn jì bāo guǒ ér qiě hái mài xìn fēng hé yóu piào — 1. The post office can not only send letters and parcels, but also sells envelopes and stamps.

examples.text: 高铁不仅速度快，而且坐起来也很舒服。
examples.translation: gāo tiě bù jǐn sù dù kuài ér qiě zuò qǐ lái yě hěn shū fú — 2. The high-speed rail is not only fast, but also comfortable to ride.

examples.text: 他不仅喜欢吃中国菜，而且也会做几道中国菜。
examples.translation: tā bù jǐn xǐ huān chī zhōng guó cài ér qiě yě huì zuò jǐ dào zhōng guó cài — 3. He not only likes eating Chinese food, but can also cook a few Chinese dishes.

examples.text: 小李不只会说流利的中文，他的中文歌也唱得很不错。
examples.translation: xiǎo lǐ bù zhǐ huì shuō liú lì de zhōng wén tā de zhōng wén gē yě chàng de hěn bú cuò — 4. Xiao Li can not only speak fluent Chinese; he sings Chinese songs quite well too.

examples.text: 不仅中国人用筷子，日本人、韩国人也用筷子。
examples.translation: bù jǐn zhōng guó rén yòng kuài zi rì běn rén hán guó rén yě yòng kuài zi — 5. Not only Chinese use chopsticks; Japanese and Koreans use chopsticks too.

explanations.title: Grammar Activity 7 (Reading, Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: Pair up. Student A asks the question and Student B answers it using the 不仅…而且 pattern. Switch roles and repeat. The five questions:

examples.text: 你常上网做些什么？
examples.translation: nǐ cháng shàng wǎng zuò xiē shén me — 1. What do you often do online?

examples.text: 你周末常去 德尔蒙特 购物中心做些什么？
examples.translation: nǐ zhōu mò cháng qù dé ěr méng tè gòu wù zhōng xīn zuò xiē shén me — 2. What do you often do at the Del Monte shopping center on weekends? (the book prints Del Monte in Latin letters)

examples.text: 蒙特雷的健身中心或国防语言学院的体育馆怎么样？
examples.translation: méng tè léi de jiàn shēn zhōng xīn huò guó fáng yǔ yán xué yuàn de tǐ yù guǎn zěn me yàng — 3. What are Monterey’s fitness centers or the Defense Language Institute’s gym like?

examples.text: 骑自行车游览蒙特雷怎么样？
examples.translation: qí zì xíng chē yóu lǎn méng tè léi zěn me yàng — 4. How is touring Monterey by bicycle?

examples.text: 你为什么这么喜欢爬山、露营、滑雪或你的爱好？
examples.translation: nǐ wèi shén me zhè me xǐ huān pá shān lù yíng huá xuě huò nǐ de ài hào — 5. Why do you like hiking, camping, skiing or your hobby so much?

lessons.title: 499. Lesson 20 Presentation 1 skill integration: Jenny’s email and two postal workers
lessons.subtitle: 台湾的快递 · 快递投递员 · 邮局营业员 · 活到老学到老

explanations.title: Skill Integration Activities 1 and 2 (Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: Activity 1 (Listening, Speaking and Reading): A. Listen and answer six questions: 1. What advice is given? Why? 2. What is said to be safer to do? 3. What is reported about the post office? 4. What suggestion is given? 5. What trend is described? 6. How did Li Guohao find his job? B. Pair up, share your answers in Chinese and read the script aloud. Activity 2 (Listening and Speaking): A. Listen to a conversation between an American student and a post office clerk (new vocabulary: 邮箱, yóuxiāng, P.O. box) and answer: 1. Why is John going to the post office? 2. What is John asked to do by the clerk? 3. What information is John not aware of? (at least two details) 4. What will John do tomorrow? B. Pair up and share your answers in Chinese. (Audio, not included; the book prints no script.)

explanations.title: Skill Integration Activity 3 (Reading, Speaking, Listening and Writing): Jenny’s email
explanations.body: A. Read the email sent from your classmate Jenny in Taiwan (TO: XXX (your name); CC; Subject) and answer: 1. Why did Jenny write the letter? 2. What did Jenny say about her school life? 3. What did Jenny learn about the courier service in Taiwan? 4. Where did Jenny mail her item? Why? B. Pair up and take turns retelling the story in Chinese. C. As her friend, write an email back to Jenny (TO: 珍妮; Subject: 你的回信). The email:

examples.text: 你好，
examples.translation: nǐ hǎo — Hello,

examples.text: 我来台湾师大学习已经两个星期了，开始慢慢习惯这里的生活。我想给你寄一个包裹，可是我学习很忙，一直找不到时间去邮局寄。后来我的朋友告诉我，快递公司比邮局更方便。我只要用手机在网上和快递公司预约付款，他们会亲自上门来取我的包裹，不用贴邮票，不需要填很多表。因为我每天都要上课，没时间在宿舍等他们上门，所以他们让我把包裹拿到宿舍附近的便利商店，他们会去那里取。昨天我已经寄出你的包裹了。你大概一个星期以后会收到，希望你会喜欢。你最近的生活怎么样？有空给我回信。这里的快递服务很方便，要是你还需要什么，就马上告诉我。
examples.translation: wǒ lái tái wān shī dà xué xí yǐ jīng liǎng gè xīng qī le kāi shǐ màn màn xí guàn zhè lǐ de shēng huó wǒ xiǎng gěi nǐ jì yí gè bāo guǒ kě shì wǒ xué xí hěn máng yì zhí zhǎo bú dào shí jiān qù yóu jú jì hòu lái wǒ de péng yǒu gào sù wǒ kuài dì gōng sī bǐ yóu jú gèng fāng biàn wǒ zhǐ yào yòng shǒu jī zài wǎng shàng hé kuài dì gōng sī yù yuē fù kuǎn tā men huì qīn zì shàng mén lái qǔ wǒ de bāo guǒ bú yòng tiē yóu piào bù xū yào tián hěn duō biǎo yīn wèi wǒ měi tiān dōu yào shàng kè méi shí jiān zài sù shè děng tā men shàng mén suǒ yǐ tā men ràng wǒ bǎ bāo guǒ ná dào sù shè fù jìn de biàn lì shāng diàn tā men huì qù nà lǐ qǔ zuó tiān wǒ yǐ jīng jì chū nǐ de bāo guǒ le nǐ dà gài yí gè xīng qī yǐ hòu huì shōu dào xī wàng nǐ huì xǐ huān nǐ zuì jìn de shēng huó zěn me yàng yǒu kòng gěi wǒ huí xìn zhè lǐ de kuài dì fú wù hěn fāng biàn yào shì nǐ hái xū yào shén me jiù mǎ shàng gào sù wǒ — I have been studying at Taiwan Normal University for two weeks and am slowly getting used to life here. I wanted to send you a parcel, but I am so busy with study that I could never find time to go to the post office. Later my friend told me that express companies are more convenient than the post office. I only need to use my phone to make an appointment and pay online with the express company, and they will come to my door in person to collect my parcel; no stamps to stick, not many forms to fill. Because I have class every day and have no time to wait in the dorm for them, they let me take the parcel to a convenience store near the dorm, where they will pick it up. Yesterday I already sent your parcel. You will probably receive it in about a week; I hope you like it. How is your life lately? Write back when you have time. The express service here is very convenient; if you need anything else, tell me right away.

examples.text: 祝好！你的朋友，珍妮。二零二零年六月五号
examples.translation: zhù hǎo nǐ de péng yǒu zhēn nī èr líng èr líng nián liù yuè wǔ hào — Best wishes! Your friend, Jenny. June 5, 2020. (the book writes the date in digits)

explanations.title: Skill Integration Activity 4 (Reading, Speaking and Listening): two passages
explanations.body: A. Pair up; each student reads one of the two passages and answers the questions. B. Each student then orally summarizes the passage they read to their partner; then each reads the other passage, answers the questions and compares answers. Passage 1 questions: 1. Who is the narrator? 2. How does he feel about his job? 3. What is the most important part of his job? 4. List at least three details about his job experience. 5. Based on the context, guess the meaning of 了解 in the underlined sentence. Passage 2 questions: 1. Who is the narrator? 2. How does she feel about her job after working in the post office? 3. What has she found challenging at work? Provide at least three examples. 4. What does the last sentence mean? The two passages:

examples.text: 我是一个快递投递员，虽然工作时间自由，但是工作真不轻松。我的工作最重要的是用最快的速度把客人的东西安全地送到。平时还好，但是要是外面刮风、下雨就会特别辛苦。另外，过年、过节是我最忙的时候，因为要送的东西特别多，常常得加班。有时自己的东西送完了，还得帮忙别的同事送，真是忙极了！不过，做这个工作也很有意思。我几乎什么东西都送过，像是行李、高尔夫球具、鲜花、水果和各地美食等。这个工作也让我更了解自己住的这个城市。每天出门送东西前，我都会先查一下那一天的路线，以前总会有几条我从来没走过的路。走过几次以后，现在不管去哪儿，我几乎都不用地图了。
examples.translation: wǒ shì yí gè kuài dì tóu dì yuán suī rán gōng zuò shí jiān zì yóu dàn shì gōng zuò zhēn bù qīng sōng wǒ de gōng zuò zuì zhòng yào de shì yòng zuì kuài de sù dù bǎ kè rén de dōng xī ān quán de sòng dào píng shí hái hǎo dàn shì yào shì wài miàn guā fēng xià yǔ jiù huì tè bié xīn kǔ lìng wài guò nián guò jié shì wǒ zuì máng de shí hòu yīn wèi yào sòng de dōng xī tè bié duō cháng cháng děi jiā bān yǒu shí zì jǐ de dōng xī sòng wán le hái děi bāng máng bié de tóng shì sòng zhēn shì máng jí le bú guò zuò zhè ge gōng zuò yě hěn yǒu yì si wǒ jī hū shén me dōng xī dōu sòng guò xiàng shì xíng li gāo ěr fū qiú jù xiān huā shuǐ guǒ hé gè dì měi shí děng zhè ge gōng zuò yě ràng wǒ gèng liǎo jiě zì jǐ zhù de zhè ge chéng shì měi tiān chū mén sòng dōng xī qián wǒ dōu huì xiān chá yí xià nà yì tiān de lù xiàn yǐ qián zǒng huì yǒu jǐ tiáo wǒ cóng lái méi zǒu guò de lù zǒu guò jǐ cì yǐ hòu xiàn zài bù guǎn qù nǎr wǒ jī hū dōu bú yòng dì tú le — I am an express delivery worker. Although my working hours are flexible, the work is really not easy. The most important thing in my job is to deliver customers’ things safely at the fastest speed. On ordinary days it’s fine, but when it’s windy or rainy outside it is especially hard. In addition, the New Year and holidays are my busiest time, because there is especially a lot to deliver and I often have to work overtime. Sometimes when I have finished my own deliveries I still have to help colleagues deliver theirs; I am so busy! Still, this job is also interesting. I have delivered almost everything, such as luggage, golf clubs, fresh flowers, fruit and local delicacies. This job has also made me understand the city I live in better. Every day before going out to deliver I check that day’s route first; there were always a few roads I had never walked. After walking them a few times, now wherever I go I hardly need a map. (the underlined sentence about 了解 is 这个工作也让我更了解自己住的这个城市; mine: 了解 means to understand or get to know)

examples.text: 我是一个邮局的营业员，在邮局已经工作了二十几年了。再过几年就可以退休了。进邮局以前，我以为邮局的工作很简单，就是卖卖邮票、信封、帮客人寄寄信，寄寄包裹什么的。进了邮局才知道邮局的业务比我想的要多得多，不是只有一般的邮政业务。那时候白天要上班，晚上还要去培训，学习其他的业务。通过培训，我学会了怎么帮客人开户、存款、汇款和转账等银行业务。后来做了这些业务，我才知道原来这些银行业务才是邮局业务的主要部分，而且很多人来邮局都是为了办这些事。最近我开始帮客人办保险。我觉得这个工作是这些工作中最难的，因为除了得知道每种保险的不同以外，我还得知道每种保险需要填的表，还要能回答客人的问题。工作了二十几年，还在学习。真是活到老学到老啊！
examples.translation: wǒ shì yí gè yóu jú de yíng yè yuán zài yóu jú yǐ jīng gōng zuò le èr shí jǐ nián le zài guò jǐ nián jiù kě yǐ tuì xiū le jìn yóu jú yǐ qián wǒ yǐ wéi yóu jú de gōng zuò hěn jiǎn dān jiù shì mài mài yóu piào xìn fēng bāng kè rén jì jì xìn jì jì bāo guǒ shén me de jìn le yóu jú cái zhī dào yóu jú de yè wù bǐ wǒ xiǎng de yào duō de duō bú shì zhǐ yǒu yì bān de yóu zhèng yè wù nà shí hòu bái tiān yào shàng bān wǎn shàng hái yào qù péi xùn xué xí qí tā de yè wù tōng guò péi xùn wǒ xué huì le zěn me bāng kè rén kāi hù cún kuǎn huì kuǎn hé zhuǎn zhàng děng yín háng yè wù hòu lái zuò le zhè xiē yè wù wǒ cái zhī dào yuán lái zhè xiē yín háng yè wù cái shì yóu jú yè wù de zhǔ yào bù fèn ér qiě hěn duō rén lái yóu jú dōu shì wèi le bàn zhè xiē shì zuì jìn wǒ kāi shǐ bāng kè rén bàn bǎo xiǎn wǒ jué de zhè ge gōng zuò shì zhè xiē gōng zuò zhōng zuì nán de yīn wèi chú le děi zhī dào měi zhǒng bǎo xiǎn de bù tóng yǐ wài wǒ hái děi zhī dào měi zhǒng bǎo xiǎn xū yào tián de biǎo hái yào néng huí dá kè rén de wèn tí gōng zuò le èr shí jǐ nián hái zài xué xí zhēn shì huó dào lǎo xué dào lǎo a — I am a post office clerk and have worked at the post office for more than twenty years. In a few more years I can retire. Before joining the post office I thought the work there was very simple, just selling stamps and envelopes, helping customers mail letters and parcels and so on. After joining I found that the post office’s business was much more than I thought, not only the ordinary postal business. In those days I worked in the daytime and went to training in the evenings to learn other business. Through the training I learned how to help customers open accounts, deposit, remit and transfer money and other banking business. Later, after doing this business, I found that these banking services were in fact the main part of the post office’s business, and many people come to the post office to handle these things. Recently I started helping customers with insurance. I think this job is the hardest of all, because besides having to know the differences between each insurance, I also have to know the forms to fill for each and be able to answer customers’ questions. Twenty-some years of work and still learning. Truly one is never too old to learn! (the last sentence is the proverb 活到老学到老)
