lessons.title: 523. Lesson 21 Presentation 1 grammar: the modal verb 应该 / 该
lessons.subtitle: 你应该带着身份证 · 不应该吸烟 · 应不应该 · 该你说了

explanations.title: The Modal Verb 应该
explanations.body: In Chinese, the modal 应该/该 denotes a moral obligation or practical necessity, similar to “ought to” or “should” in English. 应该 is the most common way to express “should,” and 该 is an informal way to say it. When 应该/该 is used as a modal verb it appears before a regular verb. Its negative is formed with 不, and its interrogative forms include both the 吗-question and the affirmative-negative patterns. Notes: 应该 may also be used like “should” in the sense of expressing “expectation” or “a logical conclusion.”

rows: Subject + 不 + 应该 + Verb + Object
Subject + 应该 + Verb + Object + (吗) ? · Subject + 应该 + 不应该 + Verb + Object ? · Subject + 应不应该 + Verb + Object ?
tables.title: The modal verb 应该/该: the book’s patterns

examples.text: 第一次到医院去看病，你应该带着你的身份证。
examples.translation: dì yī cì dào yī yuàn qù kàn bìng nǐ yīng gāi dài zhe nǐ de shēn fèn zhèng — 1. When you go to the hospital for the first time, you should take your ID card.

examples.text: 他太累了，应该回家休息。
examples.translation: tā tài lèi le yīng gāi huí jiā xiū xī — 2. He is too tired; he should go home and rest.

examples.text: 你身体不好，应该常常锻炼，不应该吸烟。
examples.translation: nǐ shēn tǐ bù hǎo yīng gāi cháng cháng duàn liàn bù yīng gāi xī yān — 3. Your health is poor; you should exercise often and should not smoke. (the book glosses 吸烟 as xī yān, smoke)

examples.text: 虽然小明不对，但是你也不应该打他。
examples.translation: suī rán xiǎo míng bú duì dàn shì nǐ yě bù yīng gāi dǎ tā — 4. Although Xiaoming is wrong, you shouldn’t hit him either.

examples.text: 睡觉以前，应该刷牙吗？
examples.translation: shuì jiào yǐ qián yīng gāi shuā yá ma — 5. Should one brush one’s teeth before going to bed?

examples.text: 我应该不应该告诉他这件事？
examples.translation: wǒ yīng gāi bù yīng gāi gào sù tā zhè jiàn shì — 6. Should I or shouldn’t I tell him this?

examples.text: 你头疼，应不应该吃点药？
examples.translation: nǐ tóu téng yīng bù yīng gāi chī diǎn yào — 7. You have a headache: should you take some medicine?

examples.text: 马克，该你说了。
examples.translation: mǎ kè gāi nǐ shuō le — 8. Mark, it’s your turn to speak. (here 该 means “it’s your turn”; 应该 should not be used in this sense)

examples.text: 这个句子不太难，你应该会翻译吧。
examples.translation: zhè ge jù zi bú tài nán nǐ yīng gāi huì fān yì ba — 1. This sentence is not too hard. You should be able to translate it. (应该 as expectation)

examples.text: 他是中国人，应该喜欢吃饺子。
examples.translation: tā shì zhōng guó rén yīng gāi xǐ huān chī jiǎo zi — 2. He’s Chinese and should like dumplings. (应该 as a logical conclusion)

examples.text: 我还不清楚该挂哪一科。
examples.translation: wǒ hái bù qīng chǔ gāi guà nǎ yì kē — The book’s first example: I’m still not clear which department I should register for. (该 is the informal form)

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: In this activity you will advise your classmates what they should or shouldn’t do, using the optative verb 应该/该. A. Write five sentences for each of your classmates that tell them what they should do (应该/该). B. Write five sentences that tell them what they should not do (不应该/不该). C. Take turns giving sincere advice. D. In groups of three, one of you asks for advice using 应该不应该 / 该不该 / 应不应该 and the other two offer suggestions. The book leaves the lines blank; my sentences:

examples.text: 你应该多喝水，早点睡觉。
examples.translation: nǐ yīng gāi duō hē shuǐ zǎo diǎn shuì jiào — You should drink more water and go to bed earlier. (Activity 1A, mine)

examples.text: 你不应该上课的时候玩手机。
examples.translation: nǐ bù yīng gāi shàng kè de shí hòu wán shǒu jī — You shouldn’t play with your phone in class. (1B, mine)

examples.text: 我应该不应该告诉老师我生病了？
examples.translation: wǒ yīng gāi bù yīng gāi gào sù lǎo shī wǒ shēng bìng le — Should I tell the teacher I’m sick? (1D, mine)

examples.text: 你应不应该去看医生？
examples.translation: nǐ yīng bù yīng gāi qù kàn yī shēng — Should you go to see a doctor? (1D, mine)

explanations.title: Activity 2 and Activity 3
explanations.body: Activity 2 (Listening, Writing and Speaking): listen to the passage and write the suggestions on what you should do when you see a doctor for the first time at a Chinese hospital (a table, 第一次去中国医院看病的建议). (Audio, not included.) Activity 3 (Speaking, Listening and Writing), Classroom Shoulds and Shouldn’ts: your class has a meeting on updating your classroom norms. A. Form groups of three and discuss what your class should and shouldn’t do in the classroom or during class; write your ideas in the table. B. Report your advice to the class. C. The class votes on the Dos and Don’ts and writes them on a flip chart for the classroom wall.

lessons.title: 524. Lesson 21 Presentation 1 grammar: the prohibitive 别
lessons.subtitle: 别忘了 · 别动 · 别说了 · 在英国千万别做什么

explanations.title: Prohibitive 别
explanations.body: In this lesson the guide nurse told the patient: 下次看病的时候，别忘了带上就诊卡和病历本。别忘了 is a fixed expression meaning “Don’t forget.” 了 is often used in this expression to focus on preventing the result of 忘. When 别 is used as a negative imperative marker it is similar to the English “Don’t!”. 别 and 不要 can be used interchangeably. A negative imperative is formed by placing 别 before a verb. When used for stopping an action that has been going on for a while, 了 is added to the end of the sentence.

examples.text: 对不起，我忘了你的生日是哪天。
examples.translation: duì bù qǐ wǒ wàng le nǐ de shēng rì shì nǎ tiān — 1. Sorry, I forgot which day your birthday is.

examples.text: 别忘了你明天早上要坐七点的飞机。
examples.translation: bié wàng le nǐ míng tiān zǎo shàng yào zuò qī diǎn de fēi jī — 2. Don’t forget you’re taking the seven o’clock flight tomorrow morning.

examples.text: 下次看病的时候，别忘了带上就诊卡和病历本。
examples.translation: xià cì kàn bìng de shí hòu bié wàng le dài shàng jiù zhěn kǎ hé bìng lì běn — 1. (别) Next time you see the doctor, don’t forget to bring the patient card and the record book.

examples.text: 下次看病的时候，不要忘了带上就诊卡和病历本。
examples.translation: xià cì kàn bìng de shí hòu bú yào wàng le dài shàng jiù zhěn kǎ hé bìng lì běn — 2. (不要) The same with 不要: 别 and 不要 can be used interchangeably.

examples.text: 别动！
examples.translation: bié dòng — 1. Don’t move!

examples.text: 请别说话。
examples.translation: qǐng bié shuō huà — 2. Please don’t talk!

examples.text: 吃饭的时候，别说话。
examples.translation: chī fàn de shí hòu bié shuō huà — 3. Don’t talk while eating.

examples.text: 请别叫太多的菜。我真地吃不下。
examples.translation: qǐng bié jiào tài duō de cài wǒ zhēn de chī bú xià — 4. Please don’t order too many dishes. I really can’t eat them all.

examples.text: 十二点了，该睡觉了，别看了！
examples.translation: shí èr diǎn le gāi shuì jiào le bié kàn le — 5. It’s twelve o’clock, time to sleep, stop watching!

examples.text: 别说了，我不想听。
examples.translation: bié shuō le wǒ bù xiǎng tīng — 6. Stop talking, I don’t want to hear it.

examples.text: 别问了，我不想说。
examples.translation: bié wèn le wǒ bù xiǎng shuō — 7. Stop asking, I don’t want to say.

examples.text: 别玩了，快去写作业。
examples.translation: bié wán le kuài qù xiě zuò yè — 8. Stop playing and go do your homework quickly.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: Game: A Naughty Kid. A. Work in groups of three. Take turns telling your group members “Don’t do something” using 别 + verb; the student who receives the command does the opposite. Example: Student A: 别唱歌！ Student B begins singing loudly. B. In groups of three, Student A gives a command to Student B with 应该; Student B does not follow the advice and performs the opposite; Student C uses 别…了 to stop Student B. Students take turns playing A, B and C. (Pictures, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Read the following blog post about studying in the U.K. and guess from the title what it is about: 在英国千万别做什么？ B. Pair up, read the article and discuss whether the advice also fits the situation in the U.S. The eight items:

examples.text: 别晚交作业。晚交作业，直接减百分之十的作业成绩。
examples.translation: bié wǎn jiāo zuò yè wǎn jiāo zuò yè zhí jiē jiǎn bǎi fēn zhī shí de zuò yè chéng jì — 1. Don’t hand in homework late. Late homework loses 10% of the homework grade directly. (the book writes 10%)

examples.text: 别晚上一个人出门。英国深夜在街道上有不少从夜店酒吧出来的醉汉。
examples.translation: bié wǎn shàng yí gè rén chū mén yīng guó shēn yè zài jiē dào shàng yǒu bù shǎo cóng yè diàn jiǔ bā chū lái de zuì hàn — 2. Don’t go out alone at night. In the U.K. late at night there are quite a few drunks coming out of nightclubs and bars on the streets. (the book glosses 醉汉 as zuìhàn)

examples.text: 别生病。英国留学看病要花很多时间，在医院里永远得等，而且看一次病要花好多钱。
examples.translation: bié shēng bìng yīng guó liú xué kàn bìng yào huā hěn duō shí jiān zài yī yuàn lǐ yǒng yuǎn děi děng ér qiě kàn yí cì bìng yào huā hǎo duō qián — 3. Don’t get sick. Seeing a doctor while studying in the U.K. takes a lot of time, you always have to wait in the hospital, and one visit costs a lot of money.

examples.text: 别在路上长时间看手机，一定要看好自己的包包和贵重物品。英国的小偷很多。
examples.translation: bié zài lù shàng cháng shí jiān kàn shǒu jī yí dìng yào kān hǎo zì jǐ de bāo bāo hé guì zhòng wù pǐn yīng guó de xiǎo tōu hěn duō — 4. Don’t look at your phone for a long time on the road; be sure to keep an eye on your bag and valuables. There are many thieves in the U.K.

examples.text: 别总是跟中国留学生一起玩。出来留学，多交几个外国朋友，锻炼英语能力和口语听力能力，感受外国的文化。
examples.translation: bié zǒng shì gēn zhōng guó liú xué shēng yì qǐ wán chū lái liú xué duō jiāo jǐ gè wài guó péng yǒu duàn liàn yīng yǔ néng lì hé kǒu yǔ tīng lì néng lì gǎn shòu wài guó de wén huà — 5. Don’t always hang out with Chinese students. When you study abroad, make more foreign friends, practice your English and your speaking and listening, and feel the foreign culture.

examples.text: 别吃太多甜食和高热量食物。英国人热爱甜品，好吃但是无助于减肥。
examples.translation: bié chī tài duō tián shí hé gāo rè liàng shí wù yīng guó rén rè ài tián pǐn hǎo chī dàn shì wú zhù yú jiǎn féi — 6. Don’t eat too many sweets and high-calorie foods. The British love desserts; they taste good but do not help you lose weight.

examples.text: 别带着护照到处跑，千万要看好。丢了护照补办很麻烦，花钱还花时间。
examples.translation: bié dài zhe hù zhào dào chù pǎo qiān wàn yào kān hǎo diū le hù zhào bǔ bàn hěn má fán huā qián hái huā shí jiān — 7. Don’t carry your passport around; be sure to keep it safe. Replacing a lost passport is troublesome, costing money and time.

examples.text: 别听信不认识的人，尝试毒品。国内国外一个样，毒品不要试。
examples.translation: bié tīng xìn bú rèn shí de rén cháng shì dú pǐn guó nèi guó wài yí gè yàng dú pǐn bú yào shì — 8. Don’t believe people you don’t know and try drugs. At home or abroad it’s the same: don’t try drugs.

explanations.title: Activity 6 (Writing, Speaking, Listening and Reading)
explanations.body: Tips to New Recruits. In this activity you give advice to new recruits who will start basic training soon: tell them what you are frequently told to do, or not do, during basic training, using 别 + verb or 别 + verb + 了. A. Individually think of three to five things you were told not to do or to stop doing during basic training and take notes in the table. B. In a group of three share your list and write your tips on a flip chart. C. Share your tips with the class. A few of mine (the book leaves the table blank):

examples.text: 别迟到！
examples.translation: bié chí dào — Don’t be late! (mine, a tip for new recruits)

examples.text: 别说话了，快起床！
examples.translation: bié shuō huà le kuài qǐ chuáng — Stop talking and get up quickly! (mine)

examples.text: 别忘了叠被子。
examples.translation: bié wàng le dié bèi zi — Don’t forget to make your bed. (mine)

examples.text: 别玩手机了，该睡觉了。
examples.translation: bié wán shǒu jī le gāi shuì jiào le — Stop playing with your phone; it’s time for bed. (mine)

lessons.title: 525. Lesson 21 Presentation 1 grammar: 那么 and 这么
lessons.subtitle: 没有那么严重 · 这么冷 · 这么 (近) 和 那么 (远) · 一起造句

explanations.title: The Use of 那么/这么
explanations.body: In English, “that” and “so” are often used to emphasize the degree of an adjective. In Chinese, 那么 and 这么 serve the same function and may be used with both adjectives and verbs, carrying the meaning “in that manner (那么)” or “so…, in such a manner (这么).” Structurally 那么/这么 is placed before an adjective or a verb. Negation is made with 没有.

rows: Sub. + 那么/这么 + adj./mental verbs (想/喜欢/爱…)
Sub. + 没有 + 那么/这么 + adj./mental verbs (想/喜欢/爱…)
tables.title: 那么/这么 (to emphasize degree)

examples.text: 我的病情没有那么严重，就挂普通门诊吧。
examples.translation: wǒ de bìng qíng méi yǒu nà me yán zhòng jiù guà pǔ tōng mén zhěn ba — The book’s first example: I’m not that sick, so I will register with a regular outpatient doctor.

examples.text: 天气这么冷，我不想出去锻炼了。
examples.translation: tiān qì zhè me lěng wǒ bù xiǎng chū qù duàn liàn le — 1. The weather is so cold that I don’t want to go out to exercise.

examples.text: 老师今天那么忙，你还是不要去找她了吧。
examples.translation: lǎo shī jīn tiān nà me máng nǐ hái shì bú yào qù zhǎo tā le ba — 2. The teacher is so busy today; you’d better not go to find her.

examples.text: 你那么聪明，一定可以学好中文。
examples.translation: nǐ nà me cōng míng yí dìng kě yǐ xué hǎo zhōng wén — 3. You’re so smart; you can surely learn Chinese well.

examples.text: 他说得这么快，你们听得懂吗？
examples.translation: tā shuō de zhè me kuài nǐ men tīng de dǒng ma — 4. He speaks so fast; can you understand?

examples.text: 其实，北京的冬天没有那么冷。
examples.translation: qí shí běi jīng de dōng tiān méi yǒu nà me lěng — 5. Actually, Beijing’s winter isn’t that cold.

examples.text: 他的中文不错，但也没有像你说的那么好。
examples.translation: tā de zhōng wén bú cuò dàn yě méi yǒu xiàng nǐ shuō de nà me hǎo — 6. His Chinese is good, but not as good as you say. (the book writes 象)

examples.text: 你这么喜欢玩手机，我那么不喜欢你只玩手机，不跟我聊天。
examples.translation: nǐ zhè me xǐ huān wán shǒu jī wǒ nà me bù xǐ huān nǐ zhǐ wán shǒu jī bù gēn wǒ liáo tiān — 7. You like playing with your phone so much, and I dislike so much that you only play with your phone and don’t chat with me.

explanations.title: Difference between 这么 and 那么
explanations.body: In Chinese 那么 and 这么 are essentially interchangeable, but they differ slightly. 这么 is used when the subject is near (in space or in time), when you would say “this” or 这个: 这么 + adj. = this + adj. (something close by). 那么 is used when the subject is far away (or in the past or not present), when you would say “that”: 那么 + adj. = that + adj. (something not close by).

examples.text: 你和我关系这么好。
examples.translation: nǐ hé wǒ guān xì zhè me hǎo — 1. You and I are on such good terms. (close by)

examples.text: 你和他关系那么好。
examples.translation: nǐ hé tā guān xì nà me hǎo — 1. You and he are on such good terms. (not close by)

examples.text: 他的病情没有你说的这么严重。
examples.translation: tā de bìng qíng méi yǒu nǐ shuō de zhè me yán zhòng — 2. His condition isn’t as serious as you say (here, near).

examples.text: 他的病情没有他说的那么严重。
examples.translation: tā de bìng qíng méi yǒu tā shuō de nà me yán zhòng — 2. His condition isn’t as serious as he says (there, far).

examples.text: 他那么高，你这么矮。
examples.translation: tā nà me gāo nǐ zhè me ǎi — 3. He (over there) is so tall, and you (right here) are so short.

examples.text: 她小时候那么能说，她现在怎么这么安静？
examples.translation: tā xiǎo shí hòu nà me néng shuō tā xiàn zài zěn me zhè me ān jìng — 4. She was so talkative when she was young. How is she so quiet now?

explanations.title: Activity 7 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A competition to create as many sentences as possible using 那么/这么 + adj. or 那么/这么 + verb, with words from two cards. The adjective card: 糟糕, 闷热, 自由, 恐怖, 兴奋, 轻松, 流行, 麻烦, 漂亮, 耐心. The verb-phrase card: 熬夜, 训练, 减肥, 干活, 走路, 安检, 促销, 做饭, 喝酒, 学习. Work in two teams; each team picks one word from either card and tells it to the rival team, who create a sentence with 那么/这么 using that word and add more information if they can; then switch. The team with the most sensible and logical sentences wins. The book’s two examples and my sentences for the rest:

examples.text: 这次考试我考得这么糟糕，一定通不过了。
examples.translation: zhè cì kǎo shì wǒ kǎo de zhè me zāo gāo yí dìng tōng bú guò le — 糟糕: I did so badly on this exam that I surely won’t pass. (the book’s example)

examples.text: 你这么熬夜，身体会有问题的。
examples.translation: nǐ zhè me áo yè shēn tǐ huì yǒu wèn tí de — 熬夜: Staying up so late, your health will have problems. (the book’s example)

examples.text: 今天这么闷热，我不想出去。
examples.translation: jīn tiān zhè me mēn rè wǒ bù xiǎng chū qù — 闷热: It’s so hot and stuffy today that I don’t want to go out. (mine)

examples.text: 你这么自由，真让我羡慕。
examples.translation: nǐ zhè me zì yóu zhēn ràng wǒ xiàn mù — 自由: You are so free; I really envy you. (mine)

examples.text: 那部电影那么恐怖，我不敢看。
examples.translation: nà bù diàn yǐng nà me kǒng bù wǒ bù gǎn kàn — 恐怖: That movie is so scary that I don’t dare to watch it. (mine)

examples.text: 听到这个好消息，他这么兴奋。
examples.translation: tīng dào zhè ge hǎo xiāo xī tā zhè me xīng fèn — 兴奋: Hearing this good news he is so excited. (mine)

examples.text: 周末那么轻松，我可以睡到十点。
examples.translation: zhōu mò nà me qīng sōng wǒ kě yǐ shuì dào shí diǎn — 轻松: The weekend is so relaxed that I can sleep until ten. (mine)

examples.text: 这个歌这么流行，大家都会唱。
examples.translation: zhè ge gē zhè me liú xíng dà jiā dōu huì chàng — 流行: This song is so popular that everyone can sing it. (mine)

examples.text: 办这个手续这么麻烦，我不想去了。
examples.translation: bàn zhè ge shǒu xù zhè me má fán wǒ bù xiǎng qù le — 麻烦: Going through this procedure is so troublesome that I don’t want to go. (mine)

examples.text: 你的朋友那么漂亮，一定很受欢迎。
examples.translation: nǐ de péng yǒu nà me piào liàng yí dìng hěn shòu huān yíng — 漂亮: Your friend is so pretty and must be very popular. (mine)

examples.text: 他教学生那么耐心，学生都喜欢他。
examples.translation: tā jiào xué shēng nà me nài xīn xué shēng dōu xǐ huān tā — 耐心: He is so patient in teaching students that they all like him. (mine)

examples.text: 你这么训练，一定会越来越强。
examples.translation: nǐ zhè me xùn liàn yí dìng huì yuè lái yuè qiáng — 训练: Training like this, you will surely get stronger and stronger. (mine)

examples.text: 他们那么减肥，身体会不好的。
examples.translation: tā men nà me jiǎn féi shēn tǐ huì bù hǎo de — 减肥: Dieting that hard, their health will suffer. (mine)

examples.text: 他这么干活，大家都很佩服他。
examples.translation: tā zhè me gàn huó dà jiā dōu hěn pèi fú tā — 干活: He works so hard that everyone admires him. (mine)

examples.text: 你这么走路，什么时候才能到？
examples.translation: nǐ zhè me zǒu lù shén me shí hòu cái néng dào — 走路: Walking like this, when will you ever arrive? (mine)

examples.text: 今天机场的安检这么严格，我们得早点到。
examples.translation: jīn tiān jī chǎng de ān jiǎn zhè me yán gé wǒ men děi zǎo diǎn dào — 安检: The security check at the airport is so strict today that we must arrive early. (mine)

examples.text: 这家商店这么促销，一定会有很多人来。
examples.translation: zhè jiā shāng diàn zhè me cù xiāo yí dìng huì yǒu hěn duō rén lái — 促销: With the shop running such a sale, many people will surely come. (mine)

examples.text: 你这么做饭，我觉得太好吃了。
examples.translation: nǐ zhè me zuò fàn wǒ jué de tài hǎo chī le — 做饭: Cooking like this, I think it’s delicious. (mine)

examples.text: 他这么喝酒，对身体不好。
examples.translation: tā zhè me hē jiǔ duì shēn tǐ bù hǎo — 喝酒: Drinking like this is bad for his health. (mine)

examples.text: 你那么学习，一定能考好。
examples.translation: nǐ nà me xué xí yí dìng néng kǎo hǎo — 学习: Studying like that, you will surely do well on the test. (mine)

explanations.title: Activity 8 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Use the video link to listen to a Chinese pop song, 《没那么简单》 by 黄小琥 (Huang Xiaohu). B. Pair up, read the lyrics, find the meaning of the four sentences that follow and translate them into English. C. Share your answers with the class. The book prints the lyrics with pinyin and then four lines of the song that all use 没那么/没有那么 (… 简单 / … 容易). I leave the lyrics and those four lines out because they are song lyrics. The pattern in them is the one you have just learned: 没那么/没有那么 + adjective means “not that + adjective”, for example 学中文没有那么难。

exercises.prompt: What do 这么 and 那么 emphasize?
options: The degree of an adjective or a verb

exercises.prompt: Where is 那么/这么 placed?
options: Before an adjective or a verb
没有 + Sub. + 那么 + adj.
Sub. + 没有 + 那么/这么 + adj.

exercises.prompt: Which is used when the subject is near?
Which is used for something far away or in the past?
“I’m not that sick, so I’ll register for the regular outpatient clinic.”
options: 我的病情那么没严重，就挂普通门诊吧。
我的病情不那么严重，就挂普通门诊吧。
我的病情没有那么严重，就挂普通门诊吧。
我的病情没严重那么，就挂普通门诊吧。

exercises.prompt: “The weather is so cold that I don’t want to go out.”
options: 天气没这么冷，我不想出去。
天气这么冷，我不想出去锻炼了。

exercises.prompt: Which sentence puts 他 far and 你 near?
What does 你这么熬夜，身体会有问题的 mean?
options: Staying up this late, your health will have problems

lessons.title: 526. Lesson 21 Presentation 1 skill integration: registration chart and two hospital notices
lessons.subtitle: 挂号流程 · 预约方式 · 人工窗口挂号 · 自助机挂号 · 初诊 复诊

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Pair up; each student listens to one segment of a conversation and answers questions. Segment 1: 1. What happened to the woman’s son? 2. Is the mother familiar with the place? How do you know? 3. What suggestion does the second speaker give? 4. Which department should the mother register for? 5. What does the mother ask the second speaker to do for her? 6. What does the mother need to show the second speaker, and why? Segment 2: 1. How long does the mother have to wait? 2. What should the mother pay attention to? 3. What should the mother fill out? 4. What should she do on future visits? 5. What is her registration number? 6. What reminder is the mother given at the end? B. Exchange information with your partner in Chinese. C. Listen to the entire conversation and reorder the activities 1. 准备医保卡, 2. 买病历本, 3. 填病历本, 4. 挂号, 5. 预约 in the sequence you hear. D. Share your answers and read the script. (Audio, not included; my sequence from the flow chart: 预约 → 准备医保卡 → 挂号 → 买病历本 → 填病历本.)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to a dialog and mark each statement True or False: 1. 病人不知道在哪儿挂号。 2. 病人第一次来看病。 3. 病人已经打电话预约了。 4. 病人挂的是普通门诊内科。 5. 王大夫是医院最有名的专家。 6. 病人最近开始头疼。 7. 病人只有医保卡，没有病历卡。 8. 病人不需要在挂号窗口排队挂号。 B. Listen again and answer in detail: 1. How could the patient get his registration number from the self-service registration machine? List at least three details. 2. What payment methods does the self-service machine accept? C. Pair up and share. D. Read the script. (Audio, not included; the book prints no key.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: Answer the following questions based on the information in the chart: 1. What is the information about? 2. How many ways are patients permitted to register and what are they? 3. When should patients make their appointment? 4. What registration methods were used when you visited the doctor?

rows: 支付宝生活号；微信公众号
平安医疗导航平台；平安互联医疗平台支付宝生活号；平安预约医疗服务平台；平安联挂号服务

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and read the patient guide for a hospital in Taiwan at the link given (wd.vghtpe.gov.tw). You read Part 1 and your partner reads Part 2; write a summary of the part you read, including what the guide is about and what patients should and should not do (under the headings 初诊/初診 and 复诊/複診). B. In Chinese, exchange your information. C. What are the differences between the registration process in hospitals in Taiwan and in the U.S.? Share your thoughts with the class. (The linked guide is not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: You want to understand the best way to register at a hospital in China, so you find the information below on a hospital’s website. A. Pair up; each student reads their own part, then notes the advantages in their partner’s part. B. Share your information and complete the table with your partner’s. C. Compare the information and decide which way you prefer; share your choice with the class. D. Learn three new Chinese words from the passages (my three: 自助, 缴费, 人工). Student 1 and Student 2:

rows: 可以买病历本或办病历卡，有问题可以问工作人员
功能多，可以用现金、支付宝、银行卡付钱，也可以自己办卡
提前预约好，到医院用手机或自助机取号就行了
tables.title: Activity 5: the advantages of the three ways (the book leaves the table blank; this is my filling)

examples.text: 人工窗口挂号。挂号交费人工窗口位于门诊六到八楼。带身份证的病人，可到人工窗口填写病历信息登记表，购买病历本或办理病历卡，挂普通门诊看病。网上提前预约好了，如何挂号？一、可用支付宝或微信“预约取号”功能，完成手机取号。二、也可以在门诊大厅自助机上使用“预约取号”功能，自助取号。三、或是到门诊六到八楼人工窗口取号。
examples.translation: rén gōng chuāng kǒu guà hào guà hào jiāo fèi rén gōng chuāng kǒu wèi yú mén zhěn liù dào bā lóu dài shēn fèn zhèng de bìng rén kě dào rén gōng chuāng kǒu tián xiě bìng lì xìn xī dēng jì biǎo gòu mǎi bìng lì běn huò bàn lǐ bìng lì kǎ guà pǔ tōng mén zhěn kàn bìng wǎng shàng tí qián yù yuē hǎo le rú hé guà hào yì kě yòng zhī fù bǎo huò wēi xìn yù yuē qǔ hào gōng néng wán chéng shǒu jī qǔ hào èr yě kě yǐ zài mén zhěn dà tīng zì zhù jī shàng shǐ yòng yù yuē qǔ hào gōng néng zì zhù qǔ hào sān huò shì dào mén zhěn liù dào bā lóu rén gōng chuāng kǒu qǔ hào — Registering at the manual window. The manual registration and payment windows are on floors 6 to 8 of the outpatient building. Patients with an ID card can go to a manual window, fill in the medical-record information form, buy a record book or get a record card, and register for a regular outpatient visit. If you have booked online in advance, how do you register? 1. You can use the “collect number for appointment” function of Alipay or WeChat to collect a number on your phone. 2. You can also use the “collect number for appointment” function on the self-service machine in the outpatient hall. 3. Or go to the manual windows on floors 6 to 8 to collect a number. (Student 1’s part; the book writes 6-8 and 1、2、3; translation mine)

examples.text: 自助机挂号。一、门诊各楼层的自助机有自助挂号、缴费、预约挂号、预约取号和自助办卡、账户管理等功能。二、自助机可以用现金、支付宝、银行卡等方式支付。三、第一次看病的病人，可以使用自助机办理病历卡：（一）用二代身份证通过自助机自助办理；（二）有支付宝的病人，可以使用自助机的“支付宝刷脸”功能自助办理；（三）也可以使用手机应用或支付宝申请电子病历卡或医保卡。
examples.translation: zì zhù jī guà hào yì mén zhěn gè lóu céng de zì zhù jī yǒu zì zhù guà hào jiǎo fèi yù yuē guà hào yù yuē qǔ hào hé zì zhù bàn kǎ zhàng hù guǎn lǐ děng gōng néng èr zì zhù jī kě yǐ yòng xiàn jīn zhī fù bǎo yín háng kǎ děng fāng shì zhī fù sān dì yī cì kàn bìng de bìng rén kě yǐ shǐ yòng zì zhù jī bàn lǐ bìng lì kǎ yí yòng èr dài shēn fèn zhèng tōng guò zì zhù jī zì zhù bàn lǐ èr yǒu zhī fù bǎo de bìng rén kě yǐ shǐ yòng zì zhù jī de zhī fù bǎo shuā liǎn gōng néng zì zhù bàn lǐ sān yě kě yǐ shǐ yòng shǒu jī yìng yòng huò zhī fù bǎo shēn qǐng diàn zi bìng lì kǎ huò yī bǎo kǎ — Registering at the self-service machine. 1. The self-service machines on each floor of the outpatient building have the functions of self-service registration, payment, appointment registration, collecting a number for an appointment, getting a card and account management. 2. The machines accept cash, Alipay, bank cards and other ways of payment. 3. Patients on a first visit can use the machine to get a record card: (1) with the second-generation ID card through the machine; (2) patients with Alipay can use the machine’s “Alipay face scan” function; (3) or apply for an electronic record card or insurance card with a phone app or Alipay. (Student 2’s part; translation mine)

lessons.title: 527. Lesson 21 Presentation 1 using Chinese in context: helping a friend see a doctor in Beijing
lessons.subtitle: 北京大学的朋友生病了 · 中国和美国看病的流程 · 打电话问医院

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Scenario: while studying at Beijing University, one of your American friends became ill and had to go to a hospital in Beijing. You and your classmates need to research to help your friend make an appointment and register, and explain the similarities and differences between Chinese and U.S. procedures. A. During your research online you find a chart (a picture, not included). Work in pairs; one of you reads the part about China and the other the part about the U.S. B. Exchange information and, in Chinese characters or pinyin, take notes in the table (流程: 预约, 挂号, 看病, 取药). C. Based on your notes, write the similarities and differences (相同点 / 不同点). D. Share your result in the class. My table:

rows: 打电话、用手机或网上预约，也可以到医院的自助机预约
带身份证、医保卡到挂号窗口或自助机挂号，买病历本
到诊所前台登记，出示保险卡
在候诊室等护士叫号，叫到号就进去看病
在候诊室等护士叫名字，然后看医生
先划价、交费，然后去药房取药
医生开药方，到药店取药
tables.title: Activity 1B: the process in China and in the U.S. (the chart in the book is a picture, not included; the China column is from this lesson and the U.S. column is my general description)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: Scenario: after learning the procedures of making an appointment and registering in a Chinese hospital, you and your classmates call the hospital where you will take your friend and want more information. A. Work in pairs and make a list of questions to ask, covering: 1. the most convenient way to book an appointment, 2. what to bring, 3. which department to register for, 4. paperwork, 5. insurance, 6. payment. B. Each pair calls the hospital (the teacher and two students play the patient-assistance worker) and writes down the answers. C. In a group of three share the information and decide how to handle the appointment and registration. D. After the discussion call the hospital again, make an appointment and register your friend. My six questions:

examples.text: 请问，挂号和预约最方便的办法是什么？
examples.translation: qǐng wèn guà hào hé yù yuē zuì fāng biàn de bàn fǎ shì shén me — 1. Excuse me, what is the most convenient way to register and make an appointment? (mine)

examples.text: 去医院的时候，我要带什么？
examples.translation: qù yī yuàn de shí hòu wǒ yào dài shén me — 2. What do I need to bring when I go to the hospital? (mine)

examples.text: 我头疼，还有点发烧，应该挂哪一科？
examples.translation: wǒ tóu téng hái yǒu diǎn fā shāo yīng gāi guà nǎ yì kē — 3. I have a headache and a bit of fever; which department should I register for? (mine)

examples.text: 挂号需要填什么表？要不要买病历本？
examples.translation: guà hào xū yào tián shén me biǎo yào bú yào mǎi bìng lì běn — 4. What forms do I need to fill in to register? Do I need to buy a record book? (mine)

examples.text: 你们收不收外国人的医保卡？
examples.translation: nǐ men shōu bù shōu wài guó rén de yī bǎo kǎ — 5. Do you accept foreigners’ medical insurance cards? (mine)

examples.text: 可以用现金付钱，还是只能用手机付钱？
examples.translation: kě yǐ yòng xiàn jīn fù qián hái shì zhǐ néng yòng shǒu jī fù qián — 6. Can I pay with cash, or only by phone? (mine)

exercises.prompt: Who needs help in the scenario?
options: An American friend studying in Beijing

exercises.prompt: What do you need to explain to your friend?
options: The similarities and differences between Chinese and U.S. procedures

explanations.title: Degree Complements with 得 (Verb + 得 vs Adjective + 得)
explanations.body: In Chinese there are two main reasons for using degree complements: to express how a verb happened or assess its quality, and to express to what extent (or degree) an adjective is true. Degree complements are usually composed of an adverb (sometimes omitted) and an adjective together. They appear after the main verb or adjective in a sentence with a 得 marker between them.

rows: V + 得 + degree complement (degree adverb + adjective)
V + O + V + 得 + degree complement
V + 得 + 不 + degree complement (adjective)
V + 得 + complement (adjective) + 不 + complement (adjective)
tables.title: Verbs with degree complements (Verb + 得 + degree complement)

examples.text: 前两天流得厉害，今天不流了，但是有点堵。
examples.translation: qián liǎng tiān liú de lì hài jīn tiān bù liú le dàn shì yǒu diǎn dǔ — 1. I had a very bad runny nose over the past couple of days. Today it stopped, but my nose is a bit stuffy.

examples.text: 我发烧、咳嗽，头也疼得厉害。
examples.translation: wǒ fā shāo ké sòu tóu yě téng de lì hài — 2. I had a fever and a cough. My headache was really bad, too.

examples.text: 他每天起得很早。
examples.translation: tā měi tiān qǐ de hěn zǎo — 1. He gets up very early every day.

examples.text: 王老师讲得真好。
examples.translation: wáng lǎo shī jiǎng de zhēn hǎo — 2. Teacher Wang explains really well.

examples.text: 李平学得快，我学得慢。

examples.text: 她回答问题回答得很好。

examples.text: 他说中文说得非常好。

explanations.title: Adjectives with Degree Complements
explanations.body: Degree complements with adjectives follow the basic patterns of degree complements with verbs (Adjective + 得 + degree complement). However, the complements can be adjectives, adverbs or other extents. They are often translated with the pattern “so … that” in English.

examples.text: 他身体好得很。
examples.translation: tā shēn tǐ hǎo de hěn — 1. His health is very good.

examples.text: 我肚子疼得厉害。
examples.translation: wǒ dǔ zi téng de lì hài — 2. My stomach hurts badly.

examples.text: 张华最近忙得要命。
examples.translation: zhāng huá zuì jìn máng de yào mìng — 3. Zhang Hua has been extremely busy lately.

examples.text: 她高兴得跳了起来。
examples.translation: tā gāo xìng de tiào le qǐ lái — 4. She was so happy that she jumped up.

examples.text: 她累得说不出话。
examples.translation: tā lèi de shuō bù chū huà — 5. She was so tired she couldn’t speak.

examples.text: 周末的时候，马克累得不想起床。
examples.translation: zhōu mò de shí hòu mǎ kè lèi de bù xiǎng qǐ chuáng — 6. At the weekend Mark was so tired he didn’t want to get up.

examples.text: 他今天开心得很。
examples.translation: tā jīn tiān kāi xīn de hěn — 7. He is very happy today.

examples.text: 他今天开心得唱起歌来。
examples.translation: tā jīn tiān kāi xīn de chàng qǐ gē lái — 7. He was so happy today that he started singing.

lessons.title: 532. Lesson 21 Presentation 2 grammar: adjectives as predicates (2)
lessons.subtitle: 嗓子疼，口也干 · 很 真 非常 更 有点儿 · 不很 很不 · 学习中文

explanations.title: Adjectives as Predicate (2)
explanations.body: As you learned in a previous lesson, when an adjective is used predicatively in Chinese it does not need a verb-to-be (是) to help it constitute a predicate, as in 今天天气很好. A predicate-adjective sentence describes or evaluates a person or thing. Structurally, a predicate adjective generally appears with some kind of degree adverb. The degree adverbs include 很, 太, 真, 更, 非常, etc.; among them 很 is the most common. Without an adverb, the sentence usually appears in a comparative situation.

rows: 这个房间大，那个房间小
tables.title: Adjectives as predicate (the book’s patterns)

examples.text: 嗓子疼，口也干，头也有点儿晕。
examples.translation: sǎng zi téng kǒu yě gān tóu yě yǒu diǎnr yūn — The book’s first example: I have a sore throat. My mouth is dry too. And I’m a bit dizzy too.

examples.text: 这个房间很大。
examples.translation: zhè ge fáng jiān hěn dà — 1. This room is very big. (很 + adj. = very)

examples.translation: tā sòng wǒ men de huār zhēn hǎo kàn — 2. The flowers he gave us are really pretty. (真 + adj. = really)

examples.text: 你们来看我，我非常高兴。

lessons.title: 533. Lesson 21 Presentation 2 grammar: 多/少, 快/慢, 早/晚 before a verb
lessons.subtitle: 多喝水 · 早来晚走 · 快跑 · 快跑 和 跑得快 的不同

explanations.title: 多/少、快/慢、早/晚 + Verb
explanations.body: In Chinese, the monosyllabic adjectives 多, 少, 快, 慢, 早, 晚 can be placed before a verb to tell how an action should be performed. In such usage the adjectives are called “adverbial adjuncts.” Adverbial adjuncts are usually placed immediately before a verb.

examples.text: 多喝水。
examples.translation: duō hē shuǐ — Drink more water. (the book’s first example)

examples.text: 明天早上你能早来半个小时吗？
examples.translation: míng tiān zǎo shàng nǐ néng zǎo lái bàn gè xiǎo shí ma — 1. Tomorrow morning, can you come half an hour early?

examples.text: 学习中文，一定要多听、多说、多看、多写。
examples.translation: xué xí zhōng wén yí dìng yào duō tīng duō shuō duō kàn duō xiě — 2. To learn Chinese you must listen more, speak more, read more and write more.

examples.text: 老王工作非常努力，他每天上班，总是早来晚走。
examples.translation: lǎo wáng gōng zuò fēi cháng nǔ lì tā měi tiān shàng bān zǒng shì zǎo lái wǎn zǒu — 3. Lao Wang works very hard; every day he always comes early and leaves late.

examples.text: 还有十分钟就要上课了，我们快跑吧！
examples.translation: hái yǒu shí fēn zhōng jiù yào shàng kè le wǒ men kuài pǎo ba — 4. There are ten minutes until class; let’s run fast!

examples.text: 你血压高，应该少喝酒。
examples.translation: nǐ xuè yā gāo yīng gāi shǎo hē jiǔ — 5. Your blood pressure is high; you should drink less alcohol.

explanations.title: Notes: (ADJ + Verb) vs (Verb 得 + ADJ)
explanations.body: An adjunct adjective tells the desired or factual manner of an action. The function of the adjectival degree complement is to describe the degree of the manner carried out by a completed action or a habitual action. 快 in 快跑 is an adjunct adjective that tells how you are expected to run, and no adverb can be placed before it. 很快 in 跑得很快 forms a degree complement and describes how you run habitually; an adverb is required before the adjective.

examples.text: 你快跑！
examples.translation: nǐ kuài pǎo — 1. (You) run quickly! (快 is an adjunct adjective; no adverb can be placed before it)

examples.text: 你跑得很快。
examples.translation: nǐ pǎo de hěn kuài — 2. You run very fast. (很快 forms a degree complement and needs an adverb)

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: The following information is from a medical magazine. A. Pre-reading: guess the meaning of the words 症状, 明显, 发热, 呼吸, 治疗 (supplementary vocabulary). B. Work in groups of three; each student reads one short passage, summarizes it in one sentence and fills in the table. C. Exchange information with your partners. D. Compare the similarities and differences among the three. E. Share your comparison with the class. The three passages:

tables.title: Activity 4A: the supplementary words (the book leaves them blank)

rows: 鼻子堵、流鼻涕、发热、咳嗽、头疼
很少身体酸疼，没有明显发热
轻，多数人不需要看医生
发热、嗓子疼、流鼻涕、全身疼痛、没有力气
咳嗽、高烧，甚至肺炎的症状
比较重，需要服药、休息或看医生
发热，突然发冷，然后高烧
咳嗽越来越厉害、胸痛、呼吸困难、头疼、全身酸疼、食量减少
tables.title: Activity 4B: the three illnesses (the book leaves the table blank; this is my filling)

examples.text: 感冒。症状有鼻子堵、流鼻涕、发热、咳嗽、头疼等。很少出现身体酸疼等全身不舒服的症状，病情比较轻。多数人不需要看医生就可以好。普通感冒通常没有明显发热，如果发热，一般也是中低烧，通常一到三天能正常，服用退烧药就可以。
examples.translation: gǎn mào zhèng zhuàng yǒu bí zi dǔ liú bí tì fā rè ké sòu tóu téng děng hěn shǎo chū xiàn shēn tǐ suān téng děng quán shēn bù shū fú de zhèng zhuàng bìng qíng bǐ jiào qīng duō shù rén bù xū yào kàn yī shēng jiù kě yǐ hǎo pǔ tōng gǎn mào tōng cháng méi yǒu míng xiǎn fā rè rú guǒ fā rè yì bān yě shì zhōng dī shāo tōng cháng yí dào sān tiān néng zhèng cháng fú yòng tuì shāo yào jiù kě yǐ — The common cold. Symptoms are a blocked nose, a runny nose, fever, cough, headache and so on. Aches and pains all over the body are seldom present and the condition is fairly light. Most people recover without seeing a doctor. An ordinary cold usually has no obvious fever; if there is a fever it is generally a medium-low one, usually back to normal in one to three days, and taking fever-reducing medicine is enough. (the book writes 1-3 天; translation mine)

examples.text: 流行性感冒（流感）。症状有发热、嗓子疼、流鼻涕、全身疼痛、没有力气等。部分的病人还会出现咳嗽、高烧，甚至有肺炎的症状。流感的发病特点是起病急、进展快，病人多有明显发热，而且常常是高烧。病人需要服药、在家休息或去看医生。
examples.translation: liú xíng xìng gǎn mào liú gǎn zhèng zhuàng yǒu fā rè sǎng zi téng liú bí tì quán shēn téng tòng méi yǒu lì qì děng bù fèn de bìng rén hái huì chū xiàn ké sòu gāo shāo shèn zhì yǒu fèi yán de zhèng zhuàng liú gǎn de fā bìng tè diǎn shì qǐ bìng jí jìn zhǎn kuài bìng rén duō yǒu míng xiǎn fā rè ér qiě cháng cháng shì gāo shāo bìng rén xū yào fú yào zài jiā xiū xī huò qù kàn yī shēng — Influenza (the flu). Symptoms are fever, sore throat, runny nose, aches all over, lack of strength and so on. Some patients also have a cough, high fever, and even the symptoms of pneumonia. The flu is characterized by a sudden onset and quick progress; patients mostly have an obvious fever, often a high one. Patients need to take medicine, rest at home or see a doctor. (translation mine)

examples.text: 肺炎。主要症状是发热，病人常常突然发冷，然后就是高烧。老年人可以是低烧或者不发热，咳嗽、胸痛。咳嗽会越来越厉害，有时呼吸困难。病人还会出现头疼、全身酸疼，食量减少的症状。得了肺炎的人需要马上去医院检查治疗。
examples.translation: fèi yán zhǔ yào zhèng zhuàng shì fā rè bìng rén cháng cháng tū rán fā lěng rán hòu jiù shì gāo shāo lǎo nián rén kě yǐ shì dī shāo huò zhě bù fā rè ké sòu xiōng tòng ké sòu huì yuè lái yuè lì hài yǒu shí hū xī kùn nán bìng rén hái huì chū xiàn tóu téng quán shēn suān téng shí liàng jiǎn shǎo de zhèng zhuàng dé le fèi yán de rén xū yào mǎ shàng qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá zhì liáo — Pneumonia. The main symptom is fever; patients often suddenly feel cold and then have a high fever. Elderly people may have a low fever or none, with cough and chest pain. The cough gets worse and worse and sometimes breathing is difficult. Patients also have headache, aches all over and reduced appetite. A person with pneumonia needs to go to the hospital at once for examination and treatment. (translation mine)

examples.text: 今天早上起床以后，林强觉得有点儿不舒服。下了课就到校医院去看病。他先挂了一个内科的号，然后就坐在内科门诊室的外面等着。过了一会儿，一个护士出来叫他进去。医生问他哪儿不舒服。林强告诉医生，他嗓子疼得厉害，不但咳嗽，而且口干，鼻子也堵得厉害。医生给他量了体温和血压，还听了听他的心脏。医生说他发高烧，三十九度，所以林强才觉得没有力气，全身都疼。不过，因为他的血压和心跳都还正常，所以医生认为他得的是流感。后来，医生给他开了一些感冒药，还让护士给他打了退烧针。医生告诉他那些感冒药他得吃一个星期，每天三次，一次两片，最好是早中晚各吃一次。另外，医生也让他不要去上课，在家休息，多喝热水。要是嗓子还疼，可以多吃梨。
examples.translation: jīn tiān zǎo shàng qǐ chuáng yǐ hòu lín qiáng jué de yǒu diǎnr bù shū fú xià le kè jiù dào xiào yī yuàn qù kàn bìng tā xiān guà le yí gè nèi kē de hào rán hòu jiù zuò zài nèi kē mén zhěn shì de wài miàn děng zhe guò le yí huìr yí gè hù shì chū lái jiào tā jìn qù yī shēng wèn tā nǎr bù shū fú lín qiáng gào sù yī shēng tā sǎng zi téng de lì hài bú dàn ké sòu ér qiě kǒu gān bí zi yě dǔ de lì hài yī shēng gěi tā liáng le tǐ wēn hé xuè yā hái tīng le tīng tā de xīn zàng yī shēng shuō tā fā gāo shāo sān shí jiǔ dù suǒ yǐ lín qiáng cái jué de méi yǒu lì qì quán shēn dōu téng bú guò yīn wèi tā de xuè yā hé xīn tiào dōu hái zhèng cháng suǒ yǐ yī shēng rèn wéi tā dé de shì liú gǎn hòu lái yī shēng gěi tā kāi le yì xiē gǎn mào yào hái ràng hù shì gěi tā dǎ le tuì shāo zhēn yī shēng gào sù tā nà xiē gǎn mào yào tā děi chī yí gè xīng qī měi tiān sān cì yí cì liǎng piàn zuì hǎo shì zǎo zhōng wǎn gè chī yí cì lìng wài yī shēng yě ràng tā bú yào qù shàng kè zài jiā xiū xī duō hē rè shuǐ yào shì sǎng zi hái téng kě yǐ duō chī lí — This morning after getting up Lin Qiang felt a bit unwell. After class he went to the school hospital to see a doctor. He first registered for internal medicine and then sat outside the internal-medicine consulting room waiting. After a while a nurse came out and called him in. The doctor asked where he felt unwell. Lin Qiang told the doctor that his throat hurt badly, that he not only coughed but his mouth was dry and his nose was badly blocked. The doctor took his temperature and blood pressure and also listened to his heart. The doctor said he had a high fever, 39 degrees, which is why Lin Qiang had no strength and ached all over. However, because his blood pressure and heartbeat were still normal, the doctor thought he had the flu. Then the doctor prescribed some cold medicine and had the nurse give him a fever-reducing injection. The doctor told him he had to take the cold medicine for a week, three times a day, two tablets each time, best once each morning, noon and evening. In addition, the doctor also told him not to go to class, to rest at home and drink plenty of hot water. If his throat still hurt he could eat more pears. (the book writes 三十九度 in characters; translation mine)

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Speaking and Writing)
explanations.body: Scenario: Doctor’s Visit in China. While you are studying at Sichuan University in Chengdu, China, you don’t feel well one day and need to see a doctor at a local hospital. Since it is your first visit and your Chinese is limited, you ask a classmate to help you find information about seeing the doctor, and you prepare a list of questions and other information you will need. A. Pair up; one partner plays the sick friend and the other the helper. Using the link given, both watch a YouTube video posted by an American student who just went to see a doctor in Chengdu and take notes in the table. B. Exchange your information. C. Discuss the differences between seeing a doctor in the U.S. and in China, as noted by the student in the video (中国 | 美国). D. Together create a list of questions and important information in Chinese that you think you will need (要告诉医生的信息 | 要问医生的问题). E. Share your information with the class. (The video is not included.)

headers: 在中国看病 (mine: what to note while watching)
rows: Doctor’s advice, treatment, getting the medicine
tables.title: Activity 1A: the note-taking table (the video is not included; only the scenario facts are filled)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Speaking, Writing and Listening): role-play cards
explanations.body: In this activity you create a role-play scenario between a patient and a doctor during a doctor’s visit. A. Each pair receives a set of role-play cards: Student 1 plays the patient and Student 2 the doctor. B. Study your card and decide what you need to say; you may jot down information or questions in Chinese pinyin or characters on your card. C. When you are ready, begin the role play. Patient card: you are sick and are seeing a doctor in a Chinese hospital; convey the following information appropriately: explain your symptoms; tell the time that you first got sick; explain your medical history; ask questions about checkups; ask about the doctor’s diagnosis; ask questions about treatments; ask about how to take medication(s); ask about anything else you need to pay attention to; ask where to get your medication or treatments; additional questions you may have. Doctor card: you are talking to your new patient and trying to figure out what their illness is; convey the following information, providing treatment and advice: ask about the patient’s conditions and symptoms; ask when the patient got sick; ask for the patient’s medical history; explain what checkups you will conduct; explain your diagnosis; explain treatment plans; tell the patient how to take his or her medicine(s); offer other advice for recovery; answer any additional questions the patient may ask.

lessons.title: 538. Lesson 21 Presentation 3: a night in the emergency room
lessons.subtitle: 肚子疼 恶心 呕吐 · 叫出租车 · 急诊室 · 验血 验尿 透视 · 急性肠胃炎 · 住院 输液

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up and discuss: A. Have you ever been to an emergency room (ER)? Why did you need to go? B. Do you have any friends or relatives who have been to the ER? What happened to them? C. What treatment or examinations did you receive on your last doctor’s visit? (Four small pictures, not included.)

explanations.title: Presentation 3: 急诊室
explanations.body: The passage is in four paragraphs; the book also prints it in traditional characters. The translations are mine.

examples.text: 星期二晚上大约九点左右，我觉得肚子疼，还有点恶心。过了半个小时以后，又开始呕吐，拉肚子。差不多半夜十二点我又发起烧来，而且腹痛、腹泻也越来越厉害。我的室友张林和王明赶紧叫了一辆出租车，把我送到了医院的急诊室。
examples.translation: xīng qī èr wǎn shàng dà yuē jiǔ diǎn zuǒ yòu wǒ jué de dǔ zi téng hái yǒu diǎn ě xīn guò le bàn gè xiǎo shí yǐ hòu yòu kāi shǐ ǒu tù lā dù zi chà bu duō bàn yè shí èr diǎn wǒ yòu fā qǐ shāo lái ér qiě fù tòng fù xiè yě yuè lái yuè lì hài wǒ de shì yǒu zhāng lín hé wáng míng gǎn jǐn jiào le yí liàng chū zū chē bǎ wǒ sòng dào le yī yuàn de jí zhěn shì — On Tuesday evening at about nine o’clock I felt a pain in my stomach and a bit of nausea. Half an hour later I began vomiting and had diarrhea. At about midnight I started running a fever again, and the stomach pain and diarrhea grew worse and worse. My roommates Zhang Lin and Wang Ming hurriedly called a taxi and took me to the hospital emergency room. (translation mine)

examples.text: 那天晚上看急诊的病人还真不少，我们等了半个小时，医生才给我检查。他先让我验血、验尿，还给我做了一个透视，最后确诊为急性肠胃炎。医生说我的病情很严重，得住院治疗。当天夜里我就在病房里接受治疗，护士给我输了液，还给我吃了药。
examples.translation: nà tiān wǎn shàng kàn jí zhěn de bìng rén hái zhēn bù shǎo wǒ men děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí yī shēng cái gěi wǒ jiǎn chá tā xiān ràng wǒ yàn xiě yàn niào hái gěi wǒ zuò le yí gè tòu shì zuì hòu què zhěn wèi jí xìng cháng wèi yán yī shēng shuō wǒ de bìng qíng hěn yán zhòng děi zhù yuàn zhì liáo dàng tiān yè lǐ wǒ jiù zài bìng fáng lǐ jiē shòu zhì liáo hù shì gěi wǒ shū le yè hái gěi wǒ chī le yào — There really were quite a few patients in the emergency room that night; we waited half an hour before the doctor examined me. He first had me do a blood test and a urine test and also gave me an X-ray, and finally confirmed acute gastroenteritis. The doctor said my condition was serious and I had to be hospitalized for treatment. That very night I received treatment in the ward; the nurse gave me an infusion and also gave me medicine. (translation mine)

examples.text: 医生让我住三天院，所以星期三早上张林帮我跟老师请了病假。老师让我不要着急，安心地在医院治疗。
examples.translation: yī shēng ràng wǒ zhù sān tiān yuàn suǒ yǐ xīng qī sān zǎo shàng zhāng lín bāng wǒ gēn lǎo shī qǐng le bìng jià lǎo shī ràng wǒ bú yào zháo jí ān xīn de zài yī yuàn zhì liáo — The doctor had me stay in hospital for three days, so on Wednesday morning Zhang Lin asked the teacher for sick leave for me. The teacher told me not to worry and to keep my mind at ease while being treated in the hospital. (translation mine)

examples.text: 三天后，我出了院，又在宿舍休息了两天，现在感觉好多了。医生说这次我生病是因为吃了不干净的东西，让我以后一定多加小心。这次多亏了室友们及时地把我送到了医院，我从心里感谢他们。下个星期我就可以回去上课了。
examples.translation: sān tiān hòu wǒ chū le yuàn yòu zài sù shè xiū xī le liǎng tiān xiàn zài gǎn jué hǎo duō le yī shēng shuō zhè cì wǒ shēng bìng shì yīn wèi chī le bù gān jìng de dōng xī ràng wǒ yǐ hòu yí dìng duō jiā xiǎo xīn zhè cì duō kuī le shì yǒu men jí shí de bǎ wǒ sòng dào le yī yuàn wǒ cóng xīn lǐ gǎn xiè tā men xià gè xīng qī wǒ jiù kě yǐ huí qù shàng kè le — Three days later I left the hospital and rested another two days in the dorm, and now I feel much better. The doctor said I fell ill this time because I ate something unclean, and told me to be especially careful from now on. This time, thanks to my roommates’ timely taking me to the hospital, I thank them from my heart. Next week I can go back to class. (translation mine)

lessons.title: 540. Lesson 21 Presentation 3 grammar: the compound directional complement 起来
lessons.subtitle: 发起烧来 · 热起来了 · 唱起歌来 · 开始 和 继续

explanations.title: Compound Directional Complement 起来
explanations.body: In Chinese, 起来 can be used both as a directional complement and as a resultative complement. As a directional complement it is similar to “up” in English, used literally as in “stand up”; as a resultative complement it often means “to start doing something” (traceable back to its directional meaning, “an upward action”). When 起来 shows that an action or state has begun and is ongoing, it is often used after a verb or an adjective, with 了 at the end of the sentence. The verbs are usually spontaneous actions like 唱, 跳, 聊, or states like 热, 冷, 好; 起来 cannot be used with planned actions. When 起来 is used with a verb that has an object, the V + 起 + O + 来 structure is often used, meaning “to start doing something”; such verb-object phrases include 唱歌, 跳舞, 吃饭, 发烧, 看书 etc.

headers: Action/state has begun and is ongoing
rows: V + 起 + O + 来 + 了
tables.title: The compound directional complement 起来

examples.text: 差不多半夜十二点我又发起烧来。
examples.translation: chà bu duō bàn yè shí èr diǎn wǒ yòu fā qǐ shāo lái — The book’s first example: Then I started having a fever around midnight.

examples.text: 小鸟飞起来了。
examples.translation: xiǎo niǎo fēi qǐ lái le — 1. The bird flew up.

examples.text: 大家都笑起来了。
examples.translation: dà jiā dōu xiào qǐ lái le — 2. Everyone started laughing.

examples.text: 天气热起来了。
examples.translation: tiān qì rè qǐ lái le — 3. The weather is getting hot.

examples.text: 因为很长时间没锻炼，他胖起来了。
examples.translation: yīn wèi hěn cháng shí jiān méi duàn liàn tā pàng qǐ lái le — 4. Because he hasn’t exercised for a long time, he is getting fat.

examples.text: 刚才还好好的，怎么现在下起雨来了？
examples.translation: gāng cái hái hǎo hǎo de zěn me xiàn zài xià qǐ yǔ lái le — 5. It was fine just now; how come it has started to rain?

examples.text: 烧烤以后，同学们在草地上跳起舞来。
examples.translation: shāo kǎo yǐ hòu tóng xué men zài cǎo dì shàng tiào qǐ wǔ lái — 6. After the barbecue the students started dancing on the grass.

examples.text: 半个小时以前，我拉起肚子来。
examples.translation: bàn gè xiǎo shí yǐ qián wǒ lā qǐ dǔ zi lái — 7. Half an hour ago I started having diarrhea.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Study the two word lists and take turns selecting one word from each list to create sentences with “Verb/Adjective + 起来 + 了” or “Verb + 起 + Object + 来”. List 1: 流鼻涕, 量血压, 发烧, 嗓子疼, 鼻子堵, 头晕, 量体温, 喝水, 吃药, 高兴, 兴奋, 紧张. List 2: 输液, 刮风, 下雪, 打, 跳, 站, 唱歌, 工作, 聊天, 哭, 热, 冷. B. Share your sentences with the class. My sentences:

examples.text: 我的鼻子堵起来了。
examples.translation: wǒ de bí zi dǔ qǐ lái le — My nose has started to get blocked. (Activity 1A, mine: 鼻子堵)

examples.text: 听到这个消息，大家都兴奋起来了。
examples.translation: tīng dào zhè ge xiāo xī dà jiā dōu xīng fèn qǐ lái le — Hearing this news everybody got excited. (兴奋, mine)

examples.text: 看到老师，他有点紧张起来了。
examples.translation: kàn dào lǎo shī tā yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng qǐ lái le — Seeing the teacher, he began to get a bit nervous. (紧张, mine)

examples.text: 刚说了几句，他们就聊起天来了。
examples.translation: gāng shuō le jǐ jù tā men jiù liáo qǐ tiān lái le — After just a few sentences they started chatting. (聊天, mine)

examples.text: 天气冷起来了，快下雪了。
examples.translation: tiān qì lěng qǐ lái le kuài xià xuě le — It’s getting cold and it’s about to snow. (冷, mine)

examples.text: 一到周末，他就唱起歌来。
examples.translation: yí dào zhōu mò tā jiù chàng qǐ gē lái — As soon as the weekend comes he starts singing. (唱歌, mine)

explanations.title: Activity 2 and Activity 3
explanations.body: Activity 2 (Listening and Speaking): A. Listen to six sentences and translate what you hear. B. Share your answers and read the scripts. (Audio, not included.) Activity 3 (Writing, Speaking and Listening): in this activity you describe your activities at an event you attended recently, using “起来 + 了” or “V + 起 + O + 来”. A. Write your story with at least four to six sentences. B. Pair up and exchange. C. Retell your partner’s story to the class. My sample:

examples.text: 上个星期六我们去参加了一个烧烤晚会。一到公园，大家就聊起天来了。过了一会儿，天气热起来了，我们都喝起水来。晚饭以后，有人唱起歌来，有人跳起舞来，大家都高兴起来了。
examples.translation: shàng gè xīng qī liù wǒ men qù cān jiā le yí gè shāo kǎo wǎn huì yí dào gōng yuán dà jiā jiù liáo qǐ tiān lái le guò le yí huìr tiān qì rè qǐ lái le wǒ men dōu hē qǐ shuǐ lái wǎn fàn yǐ hòu yǒu rén chàng qǐ gē lái yǒu rén tiào qǐ wǔ lái dà jiā dōu gāo xìng qǐ lái le — Last Saturday we went to a barbecue party. As soon as we reached the park everybody started chatting. After a while the weather got hot and we all started drinking water. After dinner some people started singing and some started dancing, and everyone cheered up. (Activity 3, my sample story)

lessons.title: 541. Lesson 21 Presentation 3 grammar: the 把 construction with a locative complement
lessons.subtitle: 把我送到了急诊室 · 把…放在 · 把…搬到 · 把和没有把

explanations.title: 把-Construction with Locative Complement
explanations.body: In a previous lesson you learned the Chinese 把 construction. The two major conditions for using it are (1) the definiteness of the object noun phrase and (2) the complexity of the verb phrase. The 把 construction is compulsory when the verb is followed by a locative complement, indicating placement or relocation of a thing or a person as a result of the action. A locative complement is made up of 在 or 到, followed by a place word. When a disposal verb takes both an object and a locative complement, the object must be placed after 把 and before the verb, leaving the verb and the complement to form one closed verbal unit. The locative complement tells where the object is moved via the disposal verb.

rows: 把 + Object + Verb + 在 or 到 + Place
tables.title: The 把 construction with a locative complement

examples.text: 我的室友张林和王明赶紧叫了一辆出租车，把我送到了医院的急诊室。
examples.translation: wǒ de shì yǒu zhāng lín hé wáng míng gǎn jǐn jiào le yí liàng chū zū chē bǎ wǒ sòng dào le yī yuàn de jí zhěn shì — The book’s first example: My roommates Zhang Lin and Wang Ming called a cab in a hurry and sent me to the hospital emergency room.

examples.text: 我把那些树种在院子里了。
examples.translation: wǒ bǎ nà xiē shù zhòng zài yuàn zi lǐ le — 1. I planted those trees in the yard.

examples.text: 你把自行车放在哪儿了？
examples.translation: nǐ bǎ zì xíng chē fàng zài nǎr le — 2. Where did you put the bicycle?

examples.text: 她把老师说的话都写在笔记本上了。
examples.translation: tā bǎ lǎo shī shuō de huà dōu xiě zài bǐ jì běn shàng le — 3. She wrote down everything the teacher said in her notebook.

examples.text: 我们快把这个病人送到医院去吧。
examples.translation: wǒ men kuài bǎ zhè ge bìng rén sòng dào yī yuàn qù ba — 4. Let’s quickly take this patient to the hospital.

examples.text: 我已经把椅子搬到楼上去了。
examples.translation: wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ yǐ zi bān dào lóu shàng qù le — 5. I have already moved the chair upstairs.

examples.text: 飞机是八点半起飞的。我七点十分开车把他们送到了机场。
examples.translation: fēi jī shì bā diǎn bàn qǐ fēi de wǒ qī diǎn shí fēn kāi chē bǎ tā men sòng dào le jī chǎng — 6. The plane took off at half past eight. At ten past seven I drove them to the airport.

explanations.title: 把-Construction with a Locative Complement vs. a Sentence Without the 把 Construction
explanations.body: The first sentence below tells what the speaker did with the trees; the second describes what the speaker did in the yard.

examples.text: 我把那些树种在院子里了。
examples.translation: wǒ bǎ nà xiē shù zhòng zài yuàn zi lǐ le — This tells what the speaker did with the trees, namely planting them in the backyard: I have planted those trees in the yard.

examples.text: 我在院子里种了一些树。
examples.translation: wǒ zài yuàn zi lǐ zhòng le yì xiē shù — This describes what the speaker did in the yard: I have planted some trees in the yard.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and complete the following sentences using the 把 construction with a locative complement. B. Share your answers. The book prints the five questions (A) and leaves B blank; my answers:

examples.text: 甲：你把你手机放在哪儿了？
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ bǎ nǐ shǒu jī fàng zài nǎr le — 1. Where did you put your phone?

examples.text: 乙：我把手机放在书包里了。
examples.translation: yǐ wǒ bǎ shǒu jī fàng zài shū bāo lǐ le — I put it in my bag. (B mine)

examples.text: 甲：老师把我的作业放到哪儿了？
examples.translation: jiǎ lǎo shī bǎ wǒ de zuò yè fàng dào nǎr le — 2. Where did the teacher put my homework?

examples.text: 乙：老师把你的作业放到桌子上了。
examples.translation: yǐ lǎo shī bǎ nǐ de zuò yè fàng dào zhuō zi shàng le — The teacher put your homework on the desk. (mine)

examples.text: 甲：你把你的军服送到哪儿去洗了？
examples.translation: jiǎ nǐ bǎ nǐ de jūn fú sòng dào nǎr qù xǐ le — 3. Where did you send your uniform to be washed?

examples.text: 乙：我把军服送到洗衣店去洗了。
examples.translation: yǐ wǒ bǎ jūn fú sòng dào xǐ yī diàn qù xǐ le — I sent it to the laundry. (mine)

examples.translation: jiǎ zhí bān de jūn rén bǎ hē le tài duō jiǔ de rén sòng dào nǎr le — 4. Where did the soldier on duty take the person who had drunk too much?

examples.text: 乙：他把那个人送到医院去了。
examples.translation: yǐ tā bǎ nà ge rén sòng dào yī yuàn qù le — He took him to the hospital. (mine)

examples.text: 甲：今年你家人朋友给你生日礼物了吗？他们要把礼物寄到这里了吗？
examples.translation: jiǎ jīn nián nǐ jiā rén péng yǒu gěi nǐ shēng rì lǐ wù le ma tā men yào bǎ lǐ wù jì dào zhè lǐ le ma — 5. Did your family and friends give you birthday gifts this year? Did they send the gifts here?

examples.text: 乙：给了，他们把礼物寄到学校来了。
examples.translation: yǐ gěi le tā men bǎ lǐ wù jì dào xué xiào lái le — Yes, they sent the gifts to the school. (mine)

explanations.title: Activity 5 and Activity 6
explanations.body: Activity 5 (Listening and Speaking): A. Listen to the dialog and answer: 1. What is the relationship between the two speakers? 2. What happened to the male speaker’s wallet? 3. What did he learn about his wallet? 4. What is the female speaker’s plan for tomorrow? 5. What kind of person do you think the male speaker is? 6. What kind of person is the female speaker? 7. What did the male speaker promise the female speaker? B. Share your answers and read the script with the class. (Audio, not included.) Activity 6 (Speaking, Listening and Writing): A. Pair up and take turns asking your partner to move an object in the classroom for you, using the 把 construction with a locative complement; your partner completes the action. B. When you are done, write three sentences in Chinese describing what your partner asked you to do. C. Share your sentences with the class. My three sample requests:

examples.text: 请你把窗户上的纸放在老师的桌子上。

exercises.prompt: What is a locative complement made of?

exercises.explanation: 把 focuses on the object’s placement.

options: I met them at the airport
They drove me to the airport
