lessons.title: 542. Lesson 21 Presentation 3 grammar: the negative imperative 不要, and negative modals
lessons.subtitle: 不要着急 · 不要说话了 · 不想 不能 不会 不用 不可以 不应该 不要 · 老外在中国不要做的九件事

explanations.title: Negative Imperative 不要
explanations.body: In Chinese, 不要 is a variant form of 别. It is used as a negative imperative to express a demand or command to refrain from doing something, like the English “Don’t do something.” 不要 and 别 may be used interchangeably; 别 can be seen as the short, informal form of 不要. Just like 别, 不要 appears before a verb, and the subject is usually omitted, as in English. You can also use 了 at the end of a sentence with 不要, which means to stop doing something.

examples.text: 老师让我不要着急，安心地在医院治疗。
examples.translation: lǎo shī ràng wǒ bú yào zháo jí ān xīn de zài yī yuàn zhì liáo — The book’s first example: My teacher told me not to worry and keep my mind on the treatment in the hospital.

examples.text: 不要走。
examples.translation: bú yào zǒu — 1. Don’t go.

examples.text: 不要打我。
examples.translation: bú yào dǎ wǒ — 2. Don’t hit me.

examples.text: 你晚上不要开车。
examples.translation: nǐ wǎn shàng bú yào kāi chē — 3. Don’t drive at night.

examples.text: 请不要离开我。
examples.translation: qǐng bú yào lí kāi wǒ — 4. Please don’t leave me.

examples.text: 请不要忘了关门。
examples.translation: qǐng bú yào wàng le guān mén — 5. Please don’t forget to close the door.

examples.text: 上课的时候，不要玩手机。
examples.translation: shàng kè de shí hòu bú yào wán shǒu jī — 6. Don’t play with your phone during class.

examples.text: 不要说话了，现在开始上课。
examples.translation: bú yào shuō huà le xiàn zài kāi shǐ shàng kè — 7. Stop talking; class is starting now.

examples.text: 不要再吃了，你都吃了三碗米饭了。
examples.translation: bú yào zài chī le nǐ dōu chī le sān wǎn mǐ fàn le — 8. Stop eating; you have already had three bowls of rice.

explanations.title: Activity 7 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Watch the YouTube video and pay attention to the usage of 不要 and 别. B. Pair up and determine how you would say the sentences in Chinese: 1. Don’t talk. 2. Don’t tell others. 3. Don’t move. 4. Stop talking. 5. Stop sleeping. 6. Stop laughing. 7. Stop horsing around. Write your answers and share your work with the class. Mine:

examples.text: 不要说话。
examples.translation: bú yào shuō huà — 1. Don’t talk. (Activity 7B, mine)

examples.text: 不要告诉别人。
examples.translation: bú yào gào sù bié rén — 2. Don’t tell others. (mine)

examples.text: 不要动。
examples.translation: bú yào dòng — 3. Don’t move. (mine)

examples.text: 不要说话了。
examples.translation: bú yào shuō huà le — 4. Stop talking. (mine)

examples.text: 不要再睡了。
examples.translation: bú yào zài shuì le — 5. Stop sleeping. (mine)

examples.text: 不要笑了。
examples.translation: bú yào xiào le — 6. Stop laughing. (mine)

examples.text: 不要胡闹了。
examples.translation: bú yào hú nào le — 7. Stop horsing around. (mine)

explanations.title: Activity 8 (Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Complete the sentences with the correct word from the list 不想 | 不能 | 不会 | 不用 | 不可以 | 不应该 | 不要. B. Pair up; share your answers and explain your choices. C. Study and compare the words and their meanings in the table. The book prints the seven sentences with blanks and no key; each word fits once, and my key:

tables.title: Activity 8C: the table of modals and their negatives (the book’s table)

examples.text: 我不会游泳，你能教我吗？
examples.translation: wǒ bú huì yóu yǒng nǐ néng jiāo wǒ ma — 1. 不会. I can’t swim; can you teach me? (key mine)

examples.text: 我明天要上班，不能跟你们一起去旧金山。
examples.translation: wǒ míng tiān yào shàng bān bù néng gēn nǐ men yì qǐ qù jiù jīn shān — 2. 不能. I have to work tomorrow, so I can’t go to San Francisco with you.

examples.text: 这条河不干净，不可以在这儿游泳。
examples.translation: zhè tiáo hé bù gān jìng bù kě yǐ zài zhèr yóu yǒng — 3. 不可以. This river isn’t clean; you may not swim here.

examples.text: 老师说，明天不用上课，因为是军事训练日。
examples.translation: lǎo shī shuō míng tiān bú yòng shàng kè yīn wèi shì jūn shì xùn liàn rì — 4. 不用. The teacher said there’s no need to go to class tomorrow because it’s a military training day.

examples.text: 我不想去看电影，我想在家休息。
examples.translation: wǒ bù xiǎng qù kàn diàn yǐng wǒ xiǎng zài jiā xiū xī — 5. 不想. I don’t want to go to a movie; I want to rest at home.

examples.text: 你身体不好，真不应该喝那么多酒。
examples.translation: nǐ shēn tǐ bù hǎo zhēn bù yīng gāi hē nà me duō jiǔ — 6. 不应该. Your health isn’t good; you really shouldn’t drink that much.

examples.text: 快起来，不要再睡了。我们得去集合。
examples.translation: kuài qǐ lái bú yào zài shuì le wǒ men děi qù jí hé — 7. 不要. Get up, stop sleeping. We have to go to the assembly.

explanations.title: Activity 9 (Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: The following article is from Chinadaily.com (adapted from world.chinadaily.com.cn): 老外在中国不要做的9件事 (nine things foreigners shouldn’t do in China). A. Scan the title and guess who should pay attention to it and what you expect to read about (看题目，猜大意). B. Work in groups of three; each student reads three items and shares the information with the group. C. Why do you think each tip is given? The nine items:

examples.text: 不要在公共场合发脾气。
examples.translation: bú yào zài gōng gòng chǎng hé fā pí qì — 1. Don’t lose your temper in public.

examples.text: 不要随便接受表扬。
examples.translation: bú yào suí biàn jiē shòu biǎo yáng — 2. Don’t accept praise casually. (the book glosses 表扬 as praise)

examples.text: 不要一开始就用中国人的名字叫他们。
examples.translation: bú yào yì kāi shǐ jiù yòng zhōng guó rén de míng zì jiào tā men — 3. Don’t call Chinese people by their first names right from the start. (the book prints 名叫, which I read as 名字叫)

examples.text: 不要让中国人丢脸。
examples.translation: bú yào ràng zhōng guó rén diū liǎn — 4. Don’t make Chinese people lose face.

examples.text: 不要等着别人买单。
examples.translation: bú yào děng zhe bié rén mǎi dān — 5. Don’t wait for others to pay the bill.

examples.text: 不要空手去朋友家。
examples.translation: bú yào kōng shǒu qù péng yǒu jiā — 6. Don’t go to a friend’s home empty-handed.

examples.text: 不要把中国人客气的时候说的“不，谢谢”当真。
examples.translation: bú yào bǎ zhōng guó rén kè qì de shí hòu shuō de bú xiè xiè dàng zhēn — 7. Don’t take the “No, thank you” that Chinese people say out of politeness seriously.

examples.text: 不要马上接受别人给的食物、饮料或礼物。
examples.translation: bú yào mǎ shàng jiē shòu bié rén gěi de shí wù yǐn liào huò lǐ wù — 8. Don’t accept food, drinks or gifts that others offer immediately.

examples.text: 不要在祝酒前喝酒。
examples.translation: bú yào zài zhù jiǔ qián hē jiǔ — 9. Don’t drink before the toast.

exercises.prompt: What is 不要 compared with 别?
exercises.explanation: 别 is the short, informal form.

exercises.prompt: What does 不要 + verb + 了 mean?
Which blank takes 不会: “我___游泳，你能教我吗？”
Which blank takes 不能: “我明天要上班，___跟你们一起去旧金山”?
Which blank takes 不用: “老师说，明天___上课，因为是军事训练日”?
Which blank takes 不应该: “你身体不好，真___喝那么多酒”?
Which blank takes 不想: “我___去看电影，我想在家休息”?
What does 不要空手去朋友家 advise?
options: Don’t go to a friend’s home empty-handed

exercises.prompt: What does 不要等着别人买单 advise?
options: Don’t wait for others to pay the bill

exercises.prompt: 老师让我___要着急，安心地在医院治疗。
不要再吃了，你都吃了三碗___饭了。

lessons.title: 543. Lesson 21 Presentation 3 skill integration: 120, sick-leave notes and a back injury
lessons.subtitle: 120 · 病假条 · 请假 批准 · 伤到后背 · 幸亏你来得早

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Writing, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to three dialogs once and answer: 1. What is 120? 2. When should people call this number? B. Listen again and complete the table (Dialog 1–3: who called 120 and the patient’s relation; the patient’s symptoms). C. Work in groups of three and share. D. Discuss: 1. What number should people call in the U.S. when they have an emergency? 2. Who is part of an emergency team in the U.S.? E. Share your answers and read the scripts. (Audio, not included; 120 is the emergency number for ambulances in China, as the scenario later in the lesson shows.)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Writing, Speaking and Reading)
explanations.body: A. Listen to a voicemail and mark the statements True or False; pair up, share and explain your reasoning: 1. 小雨给妈妈打电话留言。 2. 小雨今天不能回家因为她病了。 3. 小雨和室友叫了一辆出租车去医院急诊室。 4. 小雨在医院呆了一个晚上，她的室友文文回宿舍了。 5. 老师下午会到医院看小雨和王玲。 6. 小雨这个周末不能回家，她得等出院以后才能回家。 B. Listen again and complete the table (who was sent to the emergency room; when; how; symptoms; details about the emergency room; examinations; diagnosis; treatment; what the speaker and her roommate did for the patient; other details). C. Form a group of three and exchange. D. Read the script and compare. (Audio, not included; the book prints no key.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Speaking, Listening and Writing)
explanations.body: Read the notes from three students and complete the tasks. A. Pre-reading: guess the meaning of the words 病假, 病假条, 便条, 事假（条）, 批准. B. Work in groups of three; each student reads one note, determines what it is about and what is being requested, and writes the answers in the table. C. Exchange your information. D. Each student writes a sick-leave note or a leave note in Chinese and posts it on linoit.com, including reasons and requests. E. Share your note with the class. The three notes (the book prints the dates in digits):

tables.title: Activity 3A: the supplementary words (the book leaves the pinyin and English blank)

rows: 这两天睡得不好，头晕，头疼得特别厉害；要去看医生
孩子发高烧三十九度，咳嗽得很厉害；要带孩子去看病
呕吐、腹痛、发烧，被送进急诊室，得了急性肠胃炎，要住三天院
tables.title: Activity 3B: what each note is about (the book leaves the table blank; this is my filling)

examples.text: 杨老师：您好！我是大卫。今天早上九点十五分我得去看医生，因为这两天我睡得不好，而且头晕、头疼得特别厉害。特向您请假一个半小时（九点十五分至十点十五分），希望您能够批准。谢谢！您的学生：王大卫　二零二零年四月二十八日
examples.translation: yáng lǎo shī nín hǎo wǒ shì dà wèi jīn tiān zǎo shàng jiǔ diǎn shí wǔ fēn wǒ děi qù kàn yī shēng yīn wèi zhè liǎng tiān wǒ shuì de bù hǎo ér qiě tóu yūn tóu téng de tè bié lì hài tè xiàng nín qǐng jià yí gè bàn xiǎo shí jiǔ diǎn shí wǔ fēn zhì shí diǎn shí wǔ fēn xī wàng nín néng gòu pī zhǔn xiè xiè nín de xué shēng wáng dà wèi èr líng èr líng nián sì yuè èr shí bā rì — Teacher Yang: Hello! I am David. This morning at 9:15 I have to see a doctor, because for the past two days I haven’t slept well and I have been dizzy and had a very bad headache. I am asking you for one and a half hours’ leave (9:15 to 10:15) and hope you can approve it. Thank you! Your student: Wang David, April 28, 2020. (a sick-leave note, 病假条; the book writes the times and date in digits)

examples.text: 王老师：您好！刚刚我的太太打来电话，说我的孩子病了，发高烧三十九度，而且咳嗽得非常厉害。需要我回家带孩子去看病，所以今天下午的课我不能上了。特请半天假，希望您能够批准。谢谢！学生：马克　二零二零年五月六日
examples.translation: wáng lǎo shī nín hǎo gāng gāng wǒ de tài tài dǎ lái diàn huà shuō wǒ de hái zi bìng le fā gāo shāo sān shí jiǔ dù ér qiě ké sòu de fēi cháng lì hài xū yào wǒ huí jiā dài hái zi qù kàn bìng suǒ yǐ jīn tiān xià wǔ de kè wǒ bù néng shàng le tè qǐng bàn tiān jià xī wàng nín néng gòu pī zhǔn xiè xiè xué shēng mǎ kè èr líng èr líng nián wǔ yuè liù rì — Teacher Wang: Hello! My wife just phoned to say that my child is ill, with a high fever of 39 degrees and a very bad cough. I need to go home and take the child to see a doctor, so I can’t attend this afternoon’s class. I am asking for half a day’s leave and hope you can approve it. Thank you! Student: Mark, May 6, 2020. (a sick-leave note; the book writes the date in digits)

examples.text: 张老师：您好！昨天晚上十点我因为呕吐、腹痛和发烧，被送进了医院的急诊室。医生说我得了急性肠胃炎，需要住三天院，所以这几天不能到校上课。特向您请三天假（周二至周四），希望您能够批准。谢谢！（假条和医生证明请王兰带给您）您的学生：琳达　二零二零年六月八日
examples.translation: zhāng lǎo shī nín hǎo zuó tiān wǎn shàng shí diǎn wǒ yīn wèi ǒu tù fù tòng hé fā shāo bèi sòng jìn le yī yuàn de jí zhěn shì yī shēng shuō wǒ dé le jí xìng cháng wèi yán xū yào zhù sān tiān yuàn suǒ yǐ zhè jǐ tiān bù néng dào xiào shàng kè tè xiàng nín qǐng sān tiān jià zhōu èr zhì zhōu sì xī wàng nín néng gòu pī zhǔn xiè xiè jià tiáo hé yī shēng zhèng míng qǐng wáng lán dài gěi nín nín de xué shēng lín dá èr líng èr líng nián liù yuè bā rì — Teacher Zhang: Hello! Last night at ten I was taken to the hospital emergency room because of vomiting, stomach pain and fever. The doctor said I have acute gastroenteritis and need to stay in hospital for three days, so I cannot come to school these days. I am asking you for three days’ leave (Tuesday to Thursday) and hope you can approve it. Thank you! (Please ask Wang Lan to bring you the note and the doctor’s certificate.) Your student: Linda, June 8, 2020. (the book writes the date in digits)

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: Read the following passage about a student’s ER experience and complete the tasks. A. Pair up. Each student receives two slips from the teacher, reads two parts of the passage, writes a summary of each part and exchanges the information with the partner. B. Together, order the paragraphs ①–④ into a logical story and share it with the class (Correct Order: _ → _ → _ → _). My order: ③ → ① → ④ → ② (③ the injury and the trip to the ER, ① the ER treatment, ④ leaving with medicine and a note, ② three days at home). C. Translate three sentences from the passage (sample translations below). D. Share your translation with the class. Student 1’s and Student 2’s slips:

examples.text: ① 那天我们到急诊室的时候，因为是早上只有一两个病人，所以很快就有一个女医生过来问我的病情。她先给我量了量血压，听了一下心脏，然后又给我做了一个透视，拍了Ｘ光。等拍的片子出来后，医生告诉我幸亏没有伤到骨头，所以不需要住院治疗，但是得打针、输液治疗。医生先让护士给我打了止痛针，很快我的疼痛开始慢慢减轻。然后护士又给我输液，输了大概两个小时。② 我在家躺了三天，不能坐和走，只能躺着，到了第四天才能站起来。以后锻炼的时候，我一定得多加小心，不能再受伤了。
examples.translation: nà tiān wǒ men dào jí zhěn shì de shí hòu yīn wèi shì zǎo shàng zhǐ yǒu yì liǎng gè bìng rén suǒ yǐ hěn kuài jiù yǒu yí gè nǚ yī shēng guò lái wèn wǒ de bìng qíng tā xiān gěi wǒ liáng le liáng xuè yā tīng le yí xià xīn zàng rán hòu yòu gěi wǒ zuò le yí gè tòu shì pāi le guāng děng pāi de piān zi chū lái hòu yī shēng gào sù wǒ xìng kuī méi yǒu shāng dào gǔ tou suǒ yǐ bù xū yào zhù yuàn zhì liáo dàn shì děi dǎ zhēn shū yè zhì liáo yī shēng xiān ràng hù shì gěi wǒ dǎ le zhǐ tòng zhēn hěn kuài wǒ de téng tòng kāi shǐ màn màn jiǎn qīng rán hòu hù shì yòu gěi wǒ shū yè shū le dà gài liǎng gè xiǎo shí wǒ zài jiā tǎng le sān tiān bù néng zuò hé zǒu zhǐ néng tǎng zhe dào le dì sì tiān cái néng zhàn qǐ lái yǐ hòu duàn liàn de shí hòu wǒ yí dìng děi duō jiā xiǎo xīn bù néng zài shòu shāng le — ① When we got to the emergency room that day, because it was morning and there were only one or two patients, a woman doctor soon came over to ask about my condition. She first measured my blood pressure and listened to my heart, then gave me an X-ray and took an X-ray picture (the book writes “X 光”; I wrote the letter in full-width form). When the picture came out the doctor told me that luckily the bone wasn’t injured, so no hospitalization was needed, but I had to have an injection and an infusion. The doctor first had the nurse give me a painkiller injection, and soon my pain slowly eased. Then the nurse gave me an infusion for about two hours. ② I lay at home for three days, unable to sit or walk, only lie; only on the fourth day could I stand up. When I exercise in the future I must be extra careful and not get hurt again. (Student 1’s two slips; translation mine)

examples.text: ③ 上个星期一在体育馆锻炼的时候，我不小心伤到了后背，休息了几天。后来有一点好转，所以我就试着举起双手，突然后背又疼起来，而且疼痛越来越严重，最后不得不请我的同学送我去了医院的急诊室。④ 离开急诊室以前，医生给我开了两种止痛药，告诉我回家以后一定要按时吃药。最后，医生又给我开了一张医生证明，让我这个星期不要着急去上课，跟老师请几天假，就在家安心养病，多休息，少动。
examples.translation: shàng gè xīng qī yī zài tǐ yù guǎn duàn liàn de shí hòu wǒ bù xiǎo xīn shāng dào le hòu bèi xiū xī le jǐ tiān hòu lái yǒu yì diǎn hǎo zhuǎn suǒ yǐ wǒ jiù shì zhe jǔ qǐ shuāng shǒu tū rán hòu bèi yòu téng qǐ lái ér qiě téng tòng yuè lái yuè yán zhòng zuì hòu bù dé bù qǐng wǒ de tóng xué sòng wǒ qù le yī yuàn de jí zhěn shì lí kāi jí zhěn shì yǐ qián yī shēng gěi wǒ kāi le liǎng zhǒng zhǐ tòng yào gào sù wǒ huí jiā yǐ hòu yí dìng yào àn shí chī yào zuì hòu yī shēng yòu gěi wǒ kāi le yì zhāng yī shēng zhèng míng ràng wǒ zhè ge xīng qī bú yào zháo jí qù shàng kè gēn lǎo shī qǐng jǐ tiān jià jiù zài jiā ān xīn yǎng bìng duō xiū xī shǎo dòng — ③ Last Monday while exercising in the gym I carelessly injured my back and rested a few days. Later it got a little better, so I tried to raise both hands, and suddenly my back hurt again, and the pain got worse and worse; finally I had no choice but to ask my classmate to take me to the hospital emergency room. ④ Before leaving the emergency room the doctor prescribed two kinds of painkillers and told me I must take them on time after getting home. Finally the doctor also gave me a doctor’s certificate and told me not to hurry to class this week, to ask the teacher for a few days’ leave, to recuperate at home with peace of mind, to rest more and move less. (Student 2’s two slips; translation mine)

examples.text: 后来有一点好转，所以我就试着举起双手，突然后背又疼起来，而且疼痛越来越严重，最后不得不请我的同学送我去了医院的急诊室。
examples.translation: hòu lái yǒu yì diǎn hǎo zhuǎn suǒ yǐ wǒ jiù shì zhe jǔ qǐ shuāng shǒu tū rán hòu bèi yòu téng qǐ lái ér qiě téng tòng yuè lái yuè yán zhòng zuì hòu bù dé bù qǐng wǒ de tóng xué sòng wǒ qù le yī yuàn de jí zhěn shì — 1. Later it got a little better, so I tried to raise both hands, and suddenly my back hurt again, and the pain got worse and worse; finally I had no choice but to ask my classmate to take me to the hospital emergency room. (translation mine)

examples.text: 等拍的片子出来后，医生告诉我幸亏没有伤到骨头，所以不需要住院治疗，但是得打针、输液治疗。
examples.translation: děng pāi de piān zi chū lái hòu yī shēng gào sù wǒ xìng kuī méi yǒu shāng dào gǔ tou suǒ yǐ bù xū yào zhù yuàn zhì liáo dàn shì děi dǎ zhēn shū yè zhì liáo — 2. When the picture came out the doctor told me that luckily the bone wasn’t injured, so no hospitalization was needed, but I had to have an injection and an infusion. (mine)

examples.text: 最后，医生又给我开了一张医生证明，让我这个星期不要去上课了，跟老师请几天假，就在家安心养病，多休息，少动。
examples.translation: zuì hòu yī shēng yòu gěi wǒ kāi le yì zhāng yī shēng zhèng míng ràng wǒ zhè ge xīng qī bú yào qù shàng kè le gēn lǎo shī qǐng jǐ tiān jià jiù zài jiā ān xīn yǎng bìng duō xiū xī shǎo dòng — 3. Finally the doctor gave me a doctor’s certificate and told me not to go to class this week, to ask the teacher for a few days’ leave, to recuperate at home with peace of mind, and to rest more and move less. (mine)

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Read the following dialog (a joke about a hospital) and answer the question: Why was the patient scared, initially? What did the doctor really mean?

examples.text: 去医院检查后，医生拿着我的报告单说：“幸亏你来得早……”我吓出了一身冷汗，以为自己得了什么重病，结果医生慢慢地说：“再晚点，我就下班了。”
examples.translation: qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá hòu yī shēng ná zhe wǒ de bào gào dān shuō xìng kuī nǐ lái de zǎo wǒ xià chū le yì shēn lěng hàn yǐ wéi zì jǐ dé le shén me zhòng bìng jié guǒ yī shēng màn màn de shuō zài wǎn diǎn wǒ jiù xià bān le — After the examination at the hospital the doctor held my report and said, “Luckily you came early…” I broke out in a cold sweat, thinking I had some serious illness, and then the doctor slowly said, “A little later and I would have gone off duty.” (the book’s joke; translation mine. Answer: the patient was scared because 幸亏你来得早 sounds as if a serious illness was caught only just in time; the doctor really meant he was about to finish work.)

options: One and a half hours’ leave

exercises.prompt: Why did David need to see a doctor?

exercises.explanation: 睡得不好，头晕、头疼得特别厉害.

options: His child had a high fever and a bad cough

options: She was sent to the ER with gastroenteritis and had to stay three days
exercises.explanation: 被送进了医院的急诊室…住三天院.

lessons.title: 544. Lesson 21 Presentation 3 using Chinese in context: calling 120, an ER story, ERs in China and the U.S.
lessons.subtitle: 看急诊 · 打幺二零 · 病假条 · 急诊室的故事 · 中美看急诊

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Writing, Speaking, Listening and Reading): 看急诊
explanations.body: Scenario: while you and your classmates are studying in Shanghai, one of your housemates has a medical emergency. You and your friend need to call the local emergency center and get your roommate to an emergency room for treatment, then help the roommate ask for sick leave and tell your teacher what happened. A. Work in groups of three. Two members prepare a phone call to the local emergency center; the other acts as the 120 operator and prepares questions to ask the callers; all jot down key words and important information. B. In your group call the emergency hotline 120 and take turns explaining what happened and what help you need; the operator responds. C. Pair up. Text your teacher to ask for sick leave for your housemate and write a draft of the sick-leave note (病假条). D. Find two other students to form a new group of three; your teacher calls you to ask what happened after receiving your message. Include: 1. when, 2. symptoms, 3. what you did, 4. checkups, 5. diagnosis, 6. treatment, 7. estimated recovery time, 8. other information. E. The class reads the sick-leave notes together. My sample call and note:

examples.text: 接线员：您好，这里是幺二零急救中心。请问出什么事了？
examples.translation: jiē xiàn yuán nín hǎo zhè lǐ shì yāo èr líng jí jiù zhōng xīn qǐng wèn chū shén me shì le — Hello, this is the 120 emergency center. What has happened? (sample call, mine)

examples.text: 我：我的室友肚子疼得很厉害，一直呕吐，还发高烧。
examples.translation: wǒ wǒ de shì yǒu dǔ zi téng de hěn lì hài yì zhí ǒu tù hái fā gāo shāo — My roommate has a terrible stomach ache, keeps vomiting and has a high fever. (mine)

examples.text: 接线员：你们在哪儿？请告诉我地址。
examples.translation: jiē xiàn yuán nǐ men zài nǎr qǐng gào sù wǒ dì zhǐ — Where are you? Please tell me the address. (mine)

examples.text: 我：我们在上海复旦大学的二号宿舍楼。
examples.translation: wǒ wǒ men zài shàng hǎi fù dàn dà xué de èr hào sù shè lóu — We are in Dormitory Building 2 at Fudan University in Shanghai. (mine)

examples.text: 接线员：病人多大年纪？他有没有意识？
examples.translation: jiē xiàn yuán bìng rén duō dà nián jì tā yǒu méi yǒu yì shí — How old is the patient? Is he conscious? (mine)

examples.text: 我：二十岁，他有意识，可是疼得说不出话。
examples.translation: wǒ èr shí suì tā yǒu yì shí kě shì téng de shuō bù chū huà — Twenty. He is conscious, but in too much pain to speak. (mine)

examples.text: 接线员：好，救护车马上就到。请不要给他吃东西，也别让他一个人。

examples.text: 我：好的，谢谢您！

lessons.title: 546. Lesson 21 Area Studies: China’s Healthcare Sector, Promising for 2020 and Beyond
lessons.subtitle: 医疗行业 · 医保覆盖 · 健康科技 · 医疗人工智能 · 2020年以后

explanations.title: China’s Healthcare Sector Promising for 2020 and Beyond (1)
explanations.body: In China, many sectors of the healthcare industry are growing rapidly. There are numerous reasons: urbanization, an aging population, a continuous rise in wages and living standards for Chinese citizens, greater innovation in high-tech and broader access to healthcare. China constantly improves its health statistics: per capita healthcare spending in China has risen from $42 in 2000 to $398 in 2016, according to World Bank statistics. China passed Japan in total healthcare spending in 2016 with $574 billion compared to Japan’s $469 billion and passed the U.S. in hospital beds per 1,000 persons, with 3.8 for China and only 2.9 in the U.S., according to OECD data. China is seeing some of the fastest growth in this category, putting it ahead of countries such as Norway, Canada and the UK. This is in part due to Chinese government policies such as increased funding for hospitals.

explanations.title: (2) Doctors, nurses, life expectancy and the reasons for growth
explanations.body: The number of doctors per 1,000 inhabitants has also been continuously rising in China since 2002, from 1.13 to 2.01 in 2017, according to OECD health data, putting it above the East Asian and Pacific average. A similar development is seen in the number of nurses per 1,000 inhabitants, with 1 in 2004 rising to 2.7 in 2017. Life expectancy has also continuously risen in China: according to statistics for the United Nations World Population Prospects the current life expectancy for Chinese citizens is 76.79 years, significantly higher than the world average life expectancy of 72 years. The growing healthcare sector is in many aspects a byproduct of China’s recent economic rise. Several hundred million people were lifted out of poverty in recent decades, which led to overall higher living standards and affordability of healthcare services. This in turn created the continuously rising life expectancy, with more people reaching retirement age than ever before, which further increases the demand for healthcare services. Within the last two decades China has benefited from large-scale reforms in the fields of medical infrastructure and insurance as well as the opening-up of its healthcare market. Focus has been on developing urban areas and continuously making healthcare more accessible in rural China. This has boosted development and the number of hospitals, doctors and medical equipment.

explanations.title: (3) Medical insurance and health tech
explanations.body: The most important contributor might be that, according to the State Council, China has created the world’s largest network for basic medical insurance accessible for all, and formed a healthcare service system encompassing both urban and rural areas. By the end of 2016 basic medical insurance had reached over 1.3 billion citizens nationwide, accounting for more than 95 percent of the total population. Promising industries for 2020 and beyond: health tech and medical AI. To tackle overcrowded hospitals in an innovative way, the government made it clear that health technology is a strategic area of development for China. It features heavily in both the 13th Five-Year Plan (2016–2020) and its Healthy China 2030 strategy. In April 2018 the State Council also issued new guidelines to promote internet-based healthcare, encouraging medical institutions to leverage internet-based technologies to improve the efficiency of medical services. China’s large number of smartphone and internet users (700 million today) provides large potential for more technology use in healthcare subsectors. Everything can be done via apps in the future, also called “fingertip medical treatment”. Data from the National Health Commission showed that in 2017 China’s online healthcare market reached 32.5 billion yuan ($4.6 billion), 45.87 percent higher than that of the previous year. The market will grow to 90 billion yuan by 2020.

explanations.title: (4) WeChat, medical AI and the outlook
explanations.body: Tencent, for example, has already been steadily building up a network of participating hospitals, over 38,000 medical facilities as of 2017, where users can book doctors’ appointments through their WeChat Intelligent Healthcare to avoid long lines at medical facilities. Following their health checkup, patients can also conveniently access their medical reports through WeChat and pay for their medical bills. Also, China is a frontrunner in the field of medical AI. In 2018 Alibaba’s health unit introduced AI software that could help interpret CT scans and an AI medical lab to help doctors make diagnoses. Deep-learning algorithms trained through the data of billions can analyze medical outputs like CT and MRI images with a close to 100 percent accuracy. Tencent established the AI Medical Innovation System or AIMIS, an AI-powered diagnostic medical imaging service, available so far in over 10 hospitals across the country. Images of patient tissue are fed into the AI software, which can then determine in under four seconds whether the body looks normal, inflamed or cancerous. Currently over 130 Chinese companies are working on applying AI in healthcare, with their number expected to grow even further in 2020. Outlook: the healthcare market in China is expected to reach 198 billion yuan ($28.59 billion) in 2026, increasing tenfold from 2016, according to China Briefing. China believes it is the government’s duty to further regulate the market through innovative measures and policies and assure that with the growth of the healthcare sector medical treatment remains affordable for all citizens. The programs of Healthy China 2020 and Healthy China 2030 both outline comprehensive health care reforms which aim to ensure universal healthcare access as well as improve the overall health situation of all Chinese people. China has managed to progress in three fields simultaneously to ensure stable growth of the healthcare sector: reducing overcrowding of hospitals, increasing quality of healthcare, and at the same time keeping healthcare affordable and accessible to all. (References printed in the book: Chinadaily (2020), Michael Santiago (2020), Ali Sheikh (2020).)

explanations.title: Unit 4 overview and Lesson 22 objectives (请问怎么走, Asking for Directions)
explanations.body: Unit 4, Survival Skill and Social Factors. Lesson 22 topic: Ask for directions. Tasks and functions: obtain and provide simple directions; ask and provide directions; understand and explain ways of taking public transportation; describe facilities and provide directions at an airport. Grammar: 还 as a modal adverb; common expressions for taking public transportation; the basic structure of explanatory text; approximate numbers. Area Studies: China’s Tourism. Upon completion of this lesson you will be able to: ask for directions; understand and give directions for driving, walking, and taking public transportation; describe facilities and provide directions at an airport. To do so you must master: new words and phrases for these functions; common expressions used when taking public transportation; the general expressions for giving directions; the basic structure of explanatory text; 还 as a modal adverb; approximate numbers.

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up and discuss: A. How do you usually get directions when you go someplace new? B. What is the best way to get directions when taking public transportation? C. Have you ever gotten lost? How did you find directions? D. Has anyone ever asked you for help with directions? How did you help them? E. In the internet era, do you think people can still get lost? Under what circumstances might that happen? (A photograph is not included.)

lessons.title: 549. Lesson 22 Presentation 1 grammar: 还 as a modal adverb
lessons.subtitle: 我还真不知道 · 我还以为…呢 · 还担心…呢 · 还可以 还不错 · 比…还…

explanations.title: 还 Used to Express a Certain Mood or Tone
explanations.body: Aside from its many other meanings and usages, 还 can also be used to express certain moods or tones, depending on the context. Pattern: Subject + 还 + Predicate. In sentences 1 and 2, 还 expresses a surprised tone, indicating something the speaker just realized but thinks he should have known or realized before. In sentence 3, the speaker is surprised that his previous thoughts were wrong. In sentence 4, 还 expresses a tone of relief from original worries. In sentence 5, 还 creates a sense of pride and can be translated as “even” in English. Without 还, these sentences are bland, even though they still convey the same meaning.

examples.text: 美国大使馆？我还真不知道。
examples.translation: měi guó dà shǐ guǎn wǒ hái zhēn bù zhī dào — The book’s example 1: The American Embassy? I really don’t know. (还 expresses surprise: something the speaker just realized he should have known)

examples.text: 我看，你是上网上瘾了。——还真有点儿。
examples.translation: wǒ kàn nǐ shì shàng wǎng shàng yǐn le hái zhēn yǒu diǎnr — 2. I think you’re addicted to the internet. — Yes, a bit actually. (还 again expresses surprise; the book prints 上网瘾了, which I read as 上网上瘾了)

examples.text: 你看起来这么年轻，我还以为你是学生呢！
examples.translation: nǐ kàn qǐ lái zhè me nián qīng wǒ hái yǐ wéi nǐ shì xué shēng ne — 3. You look so young, I thought you were a student! (the speaker is surprised that his earlier thought was wrong)

examples.text: 流感啊？我还担心是肺炎呢。
examples.translation: liú gǎn a wǒ hái dān xīn shì fèi yán ne — 4. The flu? I was afraid it was pneumonia. (还 expresses relief from an original worry)

examples.text: 听起来挺酷的。——那当然，我们的乐队还上过电视呢！
examples.translation: tīng qǐ lái tǐng kù de nà dāng rán wǒ men de yuè duì hái shàng guò diàn shì ne — 5. It sounds pretty cool. — Of course; our band has even been on TV! (还 creates a sense of pride and can be translated “even”)

explanations.title: 还 before a positive adjective
explanations.body: Another common use of 还 is to place it in front of a positive adjective to weaken it, or to make the speaker’s tone less enthusiastic. Pattern: Subject + 还 + Positive Adjective (好 / 行 / 可以 / 不错). Notes: when “还 + adjective” is used in a comparative sentence, it functions as emphasis.

examples.text: 饭厅还可以，厨房好像小了一点儿。
examples.translation: fàn tīng hái kě yǐ chú fáng hǎo xiàng xiǎo le yì diǎnr — 1. The dining room is OK; the kitchen seems a little small.

examples.text: 这次她考得还好。
examples.translation: zhè cì tā kǎo de hái hǎo — 2. She did fairly well on this exam. (the book prints 考的)

examples.text: 这家饭店做的菜还不错。
examples.translation: zhè jiā fàn diàn zuò de cài hái bú cuò — 3. The dishes at this restaurant are pretty good.

examples.text: 这件衣服的颜色还行，就是样式有点老。
examples.translation: zhè jiàn yī fú de yán sè hái xíng jiù shì yàng shì yǒu diǎn lǎo — 4. The color of this garment is all right; the style is just a bit old-fashioned.

examples.text: 他比爸爸还高了！
examples.translation: tā bǐ bà bà hái gāo le — Note: He is even taller than his father! (还 + adjective in a comparative sentence works as emphasis)

examples.text: 我卖的西瓜比篮球还大，比糖还甜。
examples.translation: wǒ mài de xī guā bǐ lán qiú hái dà bǐ táng hái tián — My watermelons are even bigger than a basketball and sweeter than candy.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Read the following sentences and explain the function of each use of 还. Then pair up and check your answer with your partner’s. The book gives the five sentences; the explanations are mine:

examples.text: 这个房子还可以，但是有点儿贵。
examples.translation: zhè ge fáng zi hái kě yǐ dàn shì yǒu diǎnr guì — 1. 还 weakens the positive adjective: This house is OK, but a bit expensive. (key mine)

examples.text: 我还没去过中国的邮局。
examples.translation: wǒ hái méi qù guò zhōng guó de yóu jú — 2. 还没 = not yet (the ordinary meaning, “still/yet”): I haven’t been to a Chinese post office yet.

examples.text: 他唱得比专业歌手还好。
examples.translation: tā chàng de bǐ zhuān yè gē shǒu hái hǎo — 3. 还 in a comparison emphasizes: He sings even better than a professional singer.

examples.text: 晚上一个人走路，还真有点儿害怕。
examples.translation: wǎn shàng yí gè rén zǒu lù hái zhēn yǒu diǎnr hài pà — 4. 还真 expresses surprise at oneself: Walking alone at night, I really am a bit scared.

examples.text: 你还在这儿？我还以为你回家了呢。
examples.translation: nǐ hái zài zhèr wǒ hái yǐ wéi nǐ huí jiā le ne — 5. First 还 = still; second 还以为…呢 expresses surprise that the earlier thought was wrong: You’re still here? I thought you had gone home.

options: Surprise at something the speaker should have known

options: Surprise that the earlier thought was wrong

What does 还 express in 我们的乐队还上过电视呢?

Which adjectives does the weakening pattern use?

大, 小, 多, 少

exercises.prompt: What does 还 do in 他比爸爸还高了?
What does 我还没去过中国的邮局 mean?
options: I haven’t been to a Chinese post office yet

lessons.title: 550. Lesson 22 Presentation 1 grammar: approximate numbers
lessons.subtitle: 几分钟 十几分钟 二十来分钟 二十分钟左右 · 四五分钟 两三个 十七八个 · 两 as 几 · 一望二三里

explanations.title: Approximate Numbers
explanations.body: There are various ways to express an approximate number. Another way to express approximation is by using two numbers together; usually the smaller number is placed before the larger. Pattern: Number + (Number + 1).

examples.text: 再走四五分钟就到了。
examples.translation: zài zǒu sì wǔ fēn zhōng jiù dào le — The book’s example 1: Walk four or five more minutes and you’ll be there.

examples.text: 教室里只有两三个学生。
examples.translation: jiào shì lǐ zhǐ yǒu liǎng sān gè xué shēng — 2. There are only two or three students in the classroom.

examples.text: 操场上有十七八个学生在锻炼。
examples.translation: cāo chǎng shàng yǒu shí qī bā gè xué shēng zài duàn liàn — 3. There are seventeen or eighteen students exercising on the playground.

examples.text: 他看起来三十五六岁的样子。
examples.translation: tā kàn qǐ lái sān shí wǔ liù suì de yàng zi — 4. He looks about thirty-five or thirty-six.

examples.text: 西安市的人均工资是六七千元人民币。
examples.translation: xī ān shì de rén jūn gōng zī shì liù qī qiān yuán rén mín bì — 5. The average income per person in Xi’an is six or seven thousand yuan.

explanations.title: Notes
explanations.body: 1. When 二 and 三 are used together as single-digit numbers and followed by a measure word, 二 usually is in the form of 两, like 两三个菜, 两三斤苹果. 2. Numbers that end with “0” cannot be used with adjacent numbers, like “9, 10” or “10, 11”. 3. When two-digit numbers are used together, they must be shortened; “16 or 17” would be 十六七, and “30 to 40” would be 三四十. Note that even when used alone, 两 can be an unspecified number. Like the English phrase “a couple of”, 两 is an unspecified number in the sentences below and is equivalent to 几, or “a few.”

examples.text: 我请你喝两杯。
examples.translation: wǒ qǐng nǐ hē liǎng bēi — 1. I’ll treat you to a couple of drinks.

examples.text: 来，下两盘（棋）！
examples.translation: lái xià liǎng pán qí — 2. Come on, let’s play a couple of games (of chess)!

examples.text: 过两天就是爸爸的生日了。
examples.translation: guò liǎng tiān jiù shì bà bà de shēng rì le — 3. In a couple of days it’s Dad’s birthday.

examples.text: 到我这儿来玩儿两天吧。
examples.translation: dào wǒ zhèr lái wánr liǎng tiān ba — 4. Come and stay with me a couple of days.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading)
explanations.body: Pair up. With your partner, discuss what is wrong with the following sentences. The book prints the five wrong sentences (it prints the digit-free forms 十十一, 十五十六, 二三, 六八 and the 过两天 dialog); my corrections and reasons:

examples.text: 我今天买了十一个苹果。
examples.translation: wǒ jīn tiān mǎi le shí yī gè píng guǒ — 1. The book’s wrong sentence: 我今天买了十十一个苹果. Fix (mine): numbers ending in 0 cannot be placed next to another number, so say 十一个 (exactly eleven) or 十几个 (about ten-odd): I bought eleven apples today.

examples.text: 操场上有十五六个学生。
examples.translation: cāo chǎng shàng yǒu shí wǔ liù gè xué shēng — 2. Wrong: 十五十六个. Two-digit numbers used together must be shortened: There are fifteen or sixteen students on the playground. (fix mine)

examples.text: 我认识两三个中国朋友。
examples.translation: wǒ rèn shí liǎng sān gè zhōng guó péng yǒu — 3. Wrong: 二三个. 二 before a measure word is 两: I know two or three Chinese friends. (fix mine)

examples.text: 我吃了六七个饺子。
examples.translation: wǒ chī le liù qī gè jiǎo zi — 4. Wrong: 六八个. Adjacent approximate numbers must be consecutive (六七 or 七八): I ate six or seven dumplings. (fix mine)

examples.text: 张文：过两天咱们去看电影吧。——马克：好的，是后天吗？
examples.translation: zhāng wén guò liǎng tiān zán men qù kàn diàn yǐng ba mǎ kè hǎo de shì hòu tiān ma — 5. Wrong: 过两天 is an unspecified “in a couple of days” (like 几天), not exactly the day after tomorrow, so Mark’s question is a misunderstanding: Zhang Wen: Let’s go to the movies in a couple of days. — Mark: OK, do you mean the day after tomorrow? (key mine)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Speaking)
explanations.body: Pair up. Read about Mr. Wang and take turns saying the underlined phrases in Chinese: 1. Mr. Wang is 50–60 years old. 2. He has been working at the university for 20–30 years. 3. His salary is around ¥5000–6000 a month. 4. He teaches 25 to 26 students in each class. 5. He teaches 14–15 hours per week. 6. He does not finish work until 11 p.m.–12 a.m. every night. My sentences:

examples.text: 他今年五六十岁了。
examples.translation: tā jīn nián wǔ liù shí suì le — 1. Mr. Wang is fifty to sixty years old. (Activity 3, mine)

examples.text: 他在这所大学工作二三十年了。
examples.translation: tā zài zhè suǒ dà xué gōng zuò èr sān shí nián le — 2. He has been working at the university for twenty to thirty years. (mine)

examples.text: 他的工资每个月五六千元左右。
examples.translation: tā de gōng zī měi gè yuè wǔ liù qiān yuán zuǒ yòu — 3. His salary is around five or six thousand yuan a month. (mine)

examples.text: 他每个班有二十五六个学生。
examples.translation: tā měi gè bān yǒu èr shí wǔ liù gè xué shēng — 4. He has twenty-five or twenty-six students in each class. (mine)

examples.text: 他每个星期上十四五个小时的课。
examples.translation: tā měi gè xīng qī shàng shí sì wǔ gè xiǎo shí de kè — 5. He teaches fourteen or fifteen hours a week. (mine)

examples.text: 他每天晚上十一二点才下班。
examples.translation: tā měi tiān wǎn shàng shí yī èr diǎn cái xià bān — 6. He does not finish work until eleven or twelve every night. (mine)

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading)
explanations.body: Read the poem aloud and note the poetic use of numbers (the book adds a picture, not included).

examples.text: 一望二三里，烟村四五家，门前六七树，八九十枝花。
examples.translation: yí wàng èr sān lǐ yān cūn sì wǔ jiā mén qián liù qī shù bā jiǔ shí zhī huā — Activity 4: the poem of numbers. As far as the eye can see, two or three li; a misty village of four or five homes; before the door six or seven trees; eight, nine, ten sprays of flowers. (translation mine)

lessons.title: 551. Lesson 22 Presentation 1 grammar: taking the subway and the bus
lessons.subtitle: 从/在 · 乘/坐 地铁几号线 · 坐几站 · 到/在…站下车 · 换…线 · …就到了

explanations.title: Common Expressions Used When Taking Public Transportation
explanations.body: In China, subway routes are often coded with numbers, colors, or the name of the main destination. As you can see on the Beijing subway map (not included), there are 地铁4号线, 地铁5号线, 地铁8号线, 地铁大兴线, 地铁大兴机场线 and 地铁亦庄线. The expressions for taking a bus are the same as those for the subway. Buses are usually marked with 路 instead of 线.

rows: 乘/坐 + 地铁 + 几号线
Taking a subway (乘 is more formal than 坐)
到/在 + 某站 + 下车
Getting off the subway at a certain stop
tables.title: Common expressions for taking the subway (the book writes the blanks with ～ and #; I used 某地, 几号线 and 几)

examples.text: 到对面的地铁站，乘二号线，坐四站到东直门。
examples.translation: dào duì miàn de dì tiě zhàn chéng èr hào xiàn zuò sì zhàn dào dōng zhí mén — From the dialog: Go to the subway station opposite, take Line 2, go four stops to Dongzhimen.

examples.text: 在那儿坐二号线到东直门，然后换四一八路公交车，坐到安家楼站下车。
examples.translation: zài nàr zuò èr hào xiàn dào dōng zhí mén rán hòu huàn sì yī bā lù gōng jiāo chē zuò dào ān jiā lóu zhàn xià chē — Take Line 2 there to Dongzhimen, then change to bus 418 and ride to Anjialou Station and get off. (the same expressions work for buses, which are marked with 路 instead of 线)

explanations.title: Activities 7 and 8 (Speaking)
explanations.body: Activity 7: A. 马克 is at Terminal 3 at the Beijing Capital International Airport. Tell him how to get to 建国门 by subway, using the map and search results as a reference (Map A). B. 马克 wants to go to the 王府井 shopping center from 北京大学. Tell him how to get there by subway, using Map B. Activity 8: A. Use the bus routes below to find a way to get from 火车站 to 钟楼站 in Xi’an. B. Use the bus route below to find a way to get from 钟楼站 to the Terracotta Warriors Museum (兵马俑) in Xi’an. New word: 终点站 (zhōngdiǎn zhàn; last stop; terminal). (The subway maps, search results and bus-route screenshots are not included.)

exercises.explanation: 乘 is more formal than 坐.

explanations.body: Pair up. Listen to each audio segment (eight segments) and use the map to find the destination it describes. Mark the number of the corresponding segment on the map. Compare your work with your partner’s. The map’s labels (the picture is not included) are: 人民南路, 商场, 医院, 体育馆, 公共汽车站, 书店, 西大街, 电影院, 理发店, 停车场, 咖啡厅, 中国饭馆, 东大街, 邮局, 图书馆, 银行, 学校, with traffic lights at the crossings.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: Read the passage and complete the tasks. A. Using what you read, draw the bus route in your notebook and circle the buses David needs to take (a Beijing bus-route map around 天安门, 西单, 东单, 建国门, 王府井, 前门大街; the map is not included). B. Using the instructions from the passerby, how should David get to the American Embassy after leaving the bus? In your notebook, draw the route on the map (建国门站, 立交桥) and mark the approximate location of the embassy. Compare your work with your partner’s. The book prints the bus numbers 320 and 1 in digits; I spelled them out.

examples.text: 大卫：请问，从这儿到美国大使馆怎么走？
examples.translation: dà wèi qǐng wèn cóng zhèr dào měi guó dà shǐ guǎn zěn me zǒu — Excuse me, how do I get to the American Embassy from here?

examples.text: 路人：你从这儿过马路，到对面坐三二零路公交车，然后在天安门换往东开的一路公共汽车，坐五站到建国门下车。
examples.translation: lù rén nǐ cóng zhèr guò mǎ lù dào duì miàn zuò sān èr líng lù gōng jiāo chē rán hòu zài tiān ān mén huàn wǎng dōng kāi de yí lù gōng gòng qì chē zuò wǔ zhàn dào jiàn guó mén xià chē — Cross the road here, take bus 320 on the other side, then at Tiananmen change to bus 1 going east, ride five stops and get off at Jianguomen.

examples.text: 大卫：在哪儿下车？我没听清楚。您能不能再说一遍？
examples.translation: dà wèi zài nǎr xià chē wǒ méi tīng qīng chǔ nín néng bù néng zài shuō yí biàn — Where do I get off? I didn’t hear clearly. Could you say it once more?

examples.text: 路人：在建国门下车。下车后再走二十多分钟就到了。
examples.translation: lù rén zài jiàn guó mén xià chē xià chē hòu zài zǒu èr shí duō fēn zhōng jiù dào le — Get off at Jianguomen. After you get off, walk another twenty-odd minutes and you will be there.

examples.text: 大卫：那在建国门下了车怎么走？
examples.translation: dà wèi nà zài jiàn guó mén xià le chē zěn me zǒu — And how do I walk after getting off at Jianguomen?

examples.text: 路人：下了车，你会看到一座立交桥，你在红绿灯那儿过马路，然后沿着那条路往北走，在第二个十字路口向右拐，再一直往前走就到了。
examples.translation: lù rén xià le chē nǐ huì kàn dào yí zuò lì jiāo qiáo nǐ zài hóng lǜ dēng nàr guò mǎ lù rán hòu yán zhe nà tiáo lù wǎng běi zǒu zài dì èr gè shí zì lù kǒu xiàng yòu guǎi zài yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu jiù dào le — After getting off you will see an overpass. Cross the road at the traffic light, then walk north along that road, turn right at the second crossroads, and keep going straight ahead; you’ll be there.

examples.text: 大卫：大使馆在路的左边还是右边？
examples.translation: dà wèi dà shǐ guǎn zài lù de zuǒ biān hái shì yòu biān — Is the embassy on the left or the right side of the road?

examples.text: 路人：我不太清楚，不过大楼前有美国国旗。你到那儿就知道了。
examples.translation: lù rén wǒ bú tài qīng chǔ bú guò dà lóu qián yǒu měi guó guó qí nǐ dào nàr jiù zhī dào le — I’m not too sure, but there is an American flag in front of the building. You’ll know when you get there.

examples.text: 大卫：谢谢您！
examples.translation: dà wèi xiè xiè nín — Thank you!

examples.text: 路人：不客气。
examples.translation: lù rén bú kè qì — You’re welcome.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Listening, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the dialog (Conversation 1). In your notebook, draw the route to the American embassy from where the speaker and the traffic police are, and mark the location of the embassy (audio and map not included). B. Pair up. Using your drawing, give your partner directions. Then compare your drawings. C. Read Conversation 2. Draw the route to the intended destination in your notebook and mark the destination on the map (the map shows 立交桥, 菜市场 and 农贸市场). B. Pair up and compare your drawings.

examples.text: 甲：请问到大华旅行社怎么走？

examples.text: 乙：您从前边儿那个立交桥底下一直往北走，到了十字路口往西拐，路北有个菜市场，菜市场的旁边是个银行，在银行那儿向北拐，沿着那条街往北走不远，有个农贸市场，农贸市场的对面就是大华旅行社。
examples.translation: yǐ nín cóng qián biān ér nà ge lì jiāo qiáo dǐ xià yì zhí wǎng běi zǒu dào le shí zì lù kǒu wǎng xī guǎi lù běi yǒu gè cài shì chǎng cài shì chǎng de páng biān shì gè yín háng zài yín háng nàr xiàng běi guǎi yán zhe nà tiáo jiē wǎng běi zǒu bù yuǎn yǒu gè nóng mào shì chǎng nóng mào shì chǎng de duì miàn jiù shì dà huá lǚ xíng shè — From under that overpass ahead, go straight north; at the crossroads turn west; on the north side of the road there is a vegetable market, next to the vegetable market is a bank; at the bank turn north, walk north along that street not far, and there is a farmers’ market; Dahua Travel Agency is right opposite the farmers’ market.

examples.text: 甲：谢谢！哎，坐公共汽车能不能到那儿？
examples.translation: jiǎ xiè xiè āi zuò gōng gòng qì chē néng bù néng dào nàr — Thanks! Oh, can I get there by bus?

examples.text: 乙：可以，不过您得到马路对面去坐车。您要是在马路这边儿坐车，您就坐到别的地方去了。

lessons.title: 553. Lesson 22 Presentation 1 using Chinese in context: subway maps, Nanjing and Zaicheng in Qingdao

explanations.title: Activity 1 and Activity 2 (Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: Activity 1: You are planning to visit several tourist attractions (yellow frames on the map) in Beijing from 人民大学 (with the person icon). Pair up and take turns giving directions on how to take the subway and transfer to an attraction without revealing your destination to your partner. Your partner will listen to your instructions and figure out your destination. Activity 2: Go to map.bjsubway.com, click on the two stations of your interest to set as 起点 and 终点 (zhōngdiǎn; destinations) and describe the route. A. 三号航站楼 to 中国美术馆. B. 人民大学 to 奥林匹克公园. C. Click on any two stations of interest and describe the route. (Maps and the website are not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Speaking)
explanations.body: You are in Nanjing and are staying at the Jinling Hotel. You want to travel to the places listed below from your hotel. Pair up. Work with your partner to choose five destinations you both want to visit and describe the route to each. Listen to each other to see whose description is clearer. Destinations: 工商银行, 胜利电影院, 老广东菜馆, 新街口百货商店, 大华电影院, 人民商场, 同庆楼菜馆, 动物商场, 延安影剧院. (The map is not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Reading, Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: Read the short passages and listen to the conversations between Zaicheng and local Chinese people; then answer the questions. Part 1 questions (conversation with the ticket-booth clerk): 1. Where is he from? 2. Where does he want to go? 3. According to the clerk, what route should he take? 4. Where is the bus station? Part 2 questions (conversation with an old man): 1. How does Zaicheng know he is closer to downtown? 2. What is Zaicheng’s usual way to navigate? Why must he use the “old way”? 3. What is his alternate destination? 4. How will Zaicheng get to his destination (list at least three details)? Part 3 questions (taxi driver and police): 1. How will he get to the hotel from where he is? 2. Why don’t people know the street Zaicheng is looking for? (Audio, not included; the passages are:)

examples.text: 大家好，我叫在成。我现在在中国青岛。这里离韩国很近，从首尔坐飞机一个小时就到了。我现在在机场，我要去青岛市区。刚才我问怎么去市区，他们说我需要坐大巴。
examples.translation: dà jiā hǎo wǒ jiào zài chéng wǒ xiàn zài zài zhōng guó qīng dǎo zhè lǐ lí hán guó hěn jìn cóng shǒu ěr zuò fēi jī yí gè xiǎo shí jiù dào le wǒ xiàn zài zài jī chǎng wǒ yào qù qīng dǎo shì qū gāng cái wǒ wèn zěn me qù shì qū tā men shuō wǒ xū yào zuò dà bā — Part 1: Hello everyone, my name is Zaicheng. I am in Qingdao, China now. It is very close to Korea; from Seoul it takes one hour by plane. I am at the airport now and I want to go to downtown Qingdao. Just now I asked how to get to the city and they said I need to take the shuttle bus. (translation mine)

examples.text: 我坐上了大巴，窗外的景色很美。慢慢地我看见很多高楼，好像到了市区。我下了车，可是不知道这是什么地方。因为没有网络，所以我不能查地图问路。啊，马路对面就有一个公交车站，我去问问等车的人。
examples.translation: wǒ zuò shàng le dà bā chuāng wài de jǐng sè hěn měi màn màn de wǒ kàn jiàn hěn duō gāo lóu hǎo xiàng dào le shì qū wǒ xià le chē kě shì bù zhī dào zhè shì shén me dì fāng yīn wèi méi yǒu wǎng luò suǒ yǐ wǒ bù néng chá dì tú wèn lù a mǎ lù duì miàn jiù yǒu yí gè gōng jiāo chē zhàn wǒ qù wèn wèn děng chē de rén — Part 2: I got on the shuttle bus and the scenery outside the window was beautiful. Gradually I saw many tall buildings, as if I had reached the city. I got off, but I didn’t know where this was. Because there was no network, I couldn’t check the map to ask the way. Ah, there is a bus stop across the road; I’ll go and ask the people waiting for the bus. (translation mine)

examples.text: 我坐到山东路以后下了车，可是还没有找到我要去的酒店。我问了两三个人，谁都不知道西吴路在哪儿。我只好坐出租车。
examples.translation: wǒ zuò dào shān dōng lù yǐ hòu xià le chē kě shì hái méi yǒu zhǎo dào wǒ yào qù de jiǔ diàn wǒ wèn le liǎng sān gè rén shéi dōu bù zhī dào xī wú lù zài nǎr wǒ zhǐ hǎo zuò chū zū chē — Part 3: After riding to Shandong Road I got off, but I still hadn’t found the hotel I was going to. I asked two or three people, and nobody knew where Xiwu Road was. I had no choice but to take a taxi. (translation mine)

examples.text: 我终于到了酒店。你们都看到我在中国没有网络，迷路的样子了。
examples.translation: wǒ zhōng yú dào le jiǔ diàn nǐ men dōu kàn dào wǒ zài zhōng guó méi yǒu wǎng luò mí lù de yàng zi le — I finally reached the hotel. You have all seen how I got lost in China without a network. (the book’s closing line; the book’s credit line reads 宰成-米达: 一个韩国男生在中国迷路了, “a Korean boy gets lost in China”)

lessons.title: 555. Lesson 22 Presentation 2: directions to a friend’s home
lessons.subtitle: 周末聚聚 · 百度地图 · 沿着卫国路往南开 · 丁字路口 停车牌 · 上二号高速 下高速

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up and discuss: A. How have methods of navigation changed over time? B. What are the possible ways for a driver to get directions? C. What are the popular online maps in the U.S.? Can you use these apps overseas? D. When was the last time you hand-drew a map? Why? E. What road signs may you need to refer to when giving directions to a driver? (Two photographs are not included.)

explanations.title: Presentation 2: 到张文家怎么走
explanations.body: The book also prints the dialog in traditional characters; the digits 2, 20, 21 and 15 are spelled out in the Chinese text. The translations are mine.

examples.text: 张文：马克，周末有什么安排吗？我想请几个朋友到家里聚聚。
examples.translation: zhāng wén mǎ kè zhōu mò yǒu shén me ān pái ma wǒ xiǎng qǐng jǐ gè péng yǒu dào jiā lǐ jù jù — Mark, do you have any plans for the weekend? I’d like to invite a few friends over to my home to get together. (translation mine)

examples.text: 马克：太好了！我一定去。你家住哪儿？
examples.translation: mǎ kè tài hǎo le wǒ yí dìng qù nǐ jiā zhù nǎr — Great! I’ll definitely come. Where do you live?

examples.text: 张文：我把地址发给你，你在百度地图上一查就知道怎么走了。
examples.translation: zhāng wén wǒ bǎ dì zhǐ fā gěi nǐ nǐ zài bǎi dù dì tú shàng yì chá jiù zhī dào zěn me zǒu le — I’ll send you the address, and you’ll know how to get there as soon as you look it up on Baidu Maps.

examples.text: 马克：我的手机还不能用百度地图。这样吧，你告诉我怎么走，我画个图。
examples.translation: mǎ kè wǒ de shǒu jī hái bù néng yòng bǎi dù dì tú zhè yàng ba nǐ gào sù wǒ zěn me zǒu wǒ huà gè tú — My phone still can’t use Baidu Maps. Tell you what: you tell me how to get there and I’ll draw a map.

examples.text: 张文：好吧。你出了学校以后，沿着卫国路往南开，过两个红绿灯……
examples.translation: zhāng wén hǎo ba nǐ chū le xué xiào yǐ hòu yán zhe wèi guó lù wǎng nán kāi guò liǎng gè hóng lǜ dēng — OK. After you leave the school, drive south along Weiguo Road and pass two traffic lights…

examples.text: 马克：慢点，慢点，过两个红绿灯…
examples.translation: mǎ kè màn diǎn màn diǎn guò liǎng gè hóng lǜ dēng — Slow down, slow down, pass two traffic lights…

examples.text: 张文：对，在第三个红绿灯往右拐，就是兴华街。沿着兴华街一直往前开，就到了一个丁字路口。
examples.translation: zhāng wén duì zài dì sān gè hóng lǜ dēng wǎng yòu guǎi jiù shì xīng huá jiē yán zhe xīng huá jiē yì zhí wǎng qián kāi jiù dào le yí gè dīng zì lù kǒu — Right, turn right at the third traffic light and that’s Xinghua Street. Drive straight ahead along Xinghua Street and you’ll come to a T-junction.

examples.text: 马克：什么路口？
examples.translation: mǎ kè shén me lù kǒu — What kind of junction?

examples.text: 张文：丁字路口。那儿有一个停车牌。
examples.translation: zhāng wén dīng zì lù kǒu nàr yǒu yí gè tíng chē pái — A T-junction. There is a stop sign there.

examples.text: 马克：哦，知道了。你接着说。
examples.translation: mǎ kè ó zhī dào le nǐ jiē zhe shuō — Oh, I see. Go on.

examples.text: 张文：在那儿往左拐，你会看到一个很大的绿色路牌，从那儿上二号高速公路，往北开二十分钟左右。
examples.translation: zhāng wén zài nàr wǎng zuǒ guǎi nǐ huì kàn dào yí gè hěn dà de lǜ sè lù pái cóng nàr shàng èr hào gāo sù gōng lù wǎng běi kāi èr shí fēn zhōng zuǒ yòu — Turn left there and you’ll see a big green road sign; get on Highway 2 from there and drive north for about twenty minutes.

examples.text: 马克：上二号高速，往北开。然后呢？
examples.translation: mǎ kè shàng èr hào gāo sù wǎng běi kāi rán hòu ne — Get on Highway 2, drive north. And then?

examples.text: 张文：然后从二十一号出口下高速路。下了高速，就是中山路，我家就在中山路十五号。
examples.translation: zhāng wén rán hòu cóng èr shí yī hào chū kǒu xià gāo sù lù xià le gāo sù jiù shì zhōng shān lù wǒ jiā jiù zài zhōng shān lù shí wǔ hào — Then take Exit 21 off the highway. Once you’re off the highway that’s Zhongshan Road, and my home is at 15 Zhongshan Road.

examples.text: 马克：你看看，我画得对不对？
examples.translation: mǎ kè nǐ kàn kàn wǒ huà de duì bú duì — Take a look: did I draw it right?

examples.text: 张文：（仔细看了一下）真不错！没想到你不光中文好，图也画得这么漂亮。
examples.translation: zhāng wén zǐ xì kàn le yí xià zhēn bú cuò méi xiǎng dào nǐ bù guāng zhōng wén hǎo tú yě huà de zhè me piào liàng — (looks carefully) Really good! I didn’t expect that you were not only good at Chinese but could also draw such a beautiful map. (the book has an interjection of agreement here, “ń”, which I left out because the app cannot speak it)

examples.text: 马克：你过奖了！
examples.translation: mǎ kè nǐ guò jiǎng le — You flatter me!

examples.text: 张文：不过说真的，你还是想办法装个地图软件吧，那以后不管上哪儿你都不会迷路了。
examples.translation: zhāng wén bú guò shuō zhēn de nǐ hái shì xiǎng bàn fǎ zhuāng gè dì tú ruǎn jiàn ba nà yǐ hòu bù guǎn shàng nǎr nǐ dōu bú huì mí lù le — But seriously, you’d better find a way to install a map app; then wherever you go you won’t get lost.

lessons.title: 556. Lesson 22 Presentation 2 activities: landmarks, road signs and the route to Zhang Wen’s home
lessons.subtitle: Activities 1 to 4 · 人行道 单行道 · 出了 沿着 过 · 往右拐 · 上二号高速

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening)
explanations.body: A. Global listening: listen to Presentation 2 once and answer: 1. Why is Mike going to Zhang Wen’s house? (to a get-together with friends) 2. How does Zhang Wen usually navigate? (with a map app such as Baidu Maps) 3. How does Mike plan to find Zhang Wen’s house? (he will draw a map from Zhang Wen’s directions) 4. What mode of transportation will Mike use? (driving) 5. What kind of landmarks are mentioned in their conversation? (traffic lights, a T-junction, a stop sign, a green road sign, a highway exit). B. Detailed listening: listen again, draw a map of the route to Zhang Wen’s house in your notebook (the book’s blank map shows 学校, Weiguo Road, Xinghua Street, Highway 2, Exit 21 and Zhongshan Road 15), and in groups of three compare your work. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. With your partner, name the following landmarks (eight pictures; the first example is 人行道, the sidewalk). B. Name each sign correctly (twelve road-sign pictures; the first example is 单行道, one-way street). (All the pictures are not included, so the answers are not given.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Complete the sentences using the English translation. B. Pair up. Take turns reading the sentences of the completed passage. Listen to each other’s work and discuss any differences. The book prints the six sentences with blanks; the completed Chinese (key mine) with the book’s English:

examples.text: 出了学校以后，沿着卫国路往南开，过两个红绿灯。
examples.translation: chū le xué xiào yǐ hòu yán zhe wèi guó lù wǎng nán kāi guò liǎng gè hóng lǜ dēng — 1. After leaving school, drive south along Weiguo Street and pass two traffic lights. (the book’s English; the blanks are 出了, 沿着, 过; key mine)

examples.text: 在第三个红绿灯往右拐，就是兴华街。
examples.translation: zài dì sān gè hóng lǜ dēng wǎng yòu guǎi jiù shì xīng huá jiē — 2. Turn right at the third traffic light onto Xinghua Street. (往右拐)

examples.text: 沿着兴华街一直往前开，就到了一个丁字路口。
examples.translation: yán zhe xīng huá jiē yì zhí wǎng qián kāi jiù dào le yí gè dīng zì lù kǒu — 3. Go straight along Xinghua Street until you reach a T-junction. (一直往前开)

examples.text: 在那儿往左拐，你会看到一个很大的绿色路牌，从那儿上二号高速公路，往北开二十分钟左右。
examples.translation: zài nàr wǎng zuǒ guǎi nǐ huì kàn dào yí gè hěn dà de lǜ sè lù pái cóng nàr shàng èr hào gāo sù gōng lù wǎng běi kāi èr shí fēn zhōng zuǒ yòu — 4. Turn left at the T-junction, you will see a large green sign, take Highway 2 and drive north for about 20 minutes. (会看到, 上, 往北开)

examples.text: 然后从二十一号出口下高速路。
examples.translation: rán hòu cóng èr shí yī hào chū kǒu xià gāo sù lù — 5. Take exit 21 to get off the highway onto Zhongshan Road. (从, 下高速)

examples.text: 下了高速，就是中山路，我家就在中山路十五号。
examples.translation: xià le gāo sù jiù shì zhōng shān lù wǒ jiā jiù zài zhōng shān lù shí wǔ hào — 6. My home is at 15 Zhongshan Road. (就在)

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Listening and Speaking)
explanations.body: Listen to the conversation. Write step-by-step instructions in English on how to get from Xiao Wen’s house to Zhuang Hua’s house. In Chinese, explain your notes to your partner and compare your work. (Audio, not included.)

exercises.prompt: Which fills “___学校以后，沿着卫国路往南开”?
Which fills “在第三个红绿灯___，就是兴华街”?
Which fills “沿着兴华街一直往前开，___到了一个丁字路口”?
Which fills “从那儿___二号高速公路”?
Which fills “然后从二十一号出口___高速路”?
Which fills “我家___在中山路十五号”?
exercises.explanation: 我家就在中山路十五号.

exercises.prompt: 在那儿往左拐，你会看___一个很大的绿色路牌。

lessons.title: 557. Lesson 22 Presentation 2 grammar: asking for and giving directions (1)
lessons.subtitle: 请问怎么走 · 离这儿…公里 · 出了…以后 · 沿着…往…开/走

explanations.title: Asking for Directions
explanations.body: Asking for directions is still inevitable, even in this digital age. There are two basic ways to ask for direction in Chinese: for a particular place, “This Place + 在哪儿？”, “（到）This Place + 怎么走？” and “怎么去 + This Place？”; for a particular kind of place, “哪儿有 This Kind of Place？” and “这附近有 This Kind of Place 吗？”. Speakers usually begin with polite phrases like 请问；你好，我想问一下…；不好意思，你能告诉我…；劳驾, etc.

tables.title: Two basic ways to ask for directions

examples.text: 请问，这附近有地铁站吗？
examples.translation: qǐng wèn zhè fù jìn yǒu dì tiě zhàn ma — 1. Excuse me, is there a subway station nearby?

examples.text: 我想问一下，到美国大使馆怎么走？
examples.translation: wǒ xiǎng wèn yí xià dào měi guó dà shǐ guǎn zěn me zǒu — 2. I’d like to ask, how do I get to the American Embassy?

examples.text: 你好！你能告诉我怎么去机场吗？
examples.translation: nǐ hǎo nǐ néng gào sù wǒ zěn me qù jī chǎng ma — 3. Hello! Can you tell me how to get to the airport?

examples.text: 劳驾，请问哪儿有厕所？
examples.translation: láo jià qǐng wèn nǎr yǒu cè suǒ — 4. Excuse me, where is the restroom?

examples.text: 不好意思，请问，金河饭店在哪儿？
examples.translation: bù hǎo yì sī qǐng wèn jīn hé fàn diàn zài nǎr — 5. Sorry to bother you, where is the Jinhe Hotel?

explanations.title: Giving directions: distance and time
explanations.body: Giving directions for walking or driving are the same, except the verbs used are 走 for walking and 开 for driving. Before giving detailed directions, it’s always useful to explain how far the destination is and how long it will take to get there. Patterns: 某地离这儿几公里; 从某地到某地开车需要多长时间; 从某地到某地开车多长时间就到了.

examples.text: 文化公园离这儿不太远，走路二十分钟就到了。
examples.translation: wén huà gōng yuán lí zhèr bú tài yuǎn zǒu lù èr shí fēn zhōng jiù dào le — 1. Culture Park is not too far from here; it takes twenty minutes on foot.

examples.text: 就在前面不远。走到停车牌那儿右拐就到了。
examples.translation: jiù zài qián miàn bù yuǎn zǒu dào tíng chē pái nàr yòu guǎi jiù dào le — 2. It’s just ahead, not far. Walk to the stop sign, turn right and you’re there.

examples.text: 我家离学校二十多公里，开车需要半个小时左右。
examples.translation: wǒ jiā lí xué xiào èr shí duō gōng lǐ kāi chē xū yào bàn gè xiǎo shí zuǒ yòu — 3. My home is more than twenty kilometers from school; it takes about half an hour by car.

examples.text: 从市中心到机场有七十多公里，坐地铁要一个多小时。
examples.translation: cóng shì zhōng xīn dào jī chǎng yǒu qī shí duō gōng lǐ zuò dì tiě yào yí gè duō xiǎo shí — 4. From downtown to the airport is more than seventy kilometers; it takes over an hour by subway.

explanations.title: Leaving a place
explanations.body: If leaving from an airport, train station, school, or similar place: 出了某地以后; 从某地出来/出去以后.

examples.text: 出了北京大学东门以后，往右转。
examples.translation: chū le běi jīng dà xué dōng mén yǐ hòu wǎng yòu zhuǎn — 1. After going out of the East Gate of Peking University, turn right.

examples.text: 出了三号航站楼以后，过马路。
examples.translation: chū le sān hào háng zhàn lóu yǐ hòu guò mǎ lù — 2. After leaving Terminal 3, cross the road.

examples.text: 从地铁站八号出口出来以后，一直往前走。
examples.translation: cóng dì tiě zhàn bā hào chū kǒu chū lái yǐ hòu yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu — 3. After coming out of Exit 8 of the subway station, go straight ahead.

examples.text: 从我家出来就是文华街。
examples.translation: cóng wǒ jiā chū lái jiù shì wén huá jiē — 4. Coming out of my home is Wenhua Street.

examples.text: 请问，在哪儿坐出租车？——从三号门出去，往左拐就是。
examples.translation: qǐng wèn zài nǎr zuò chū zū chē cóng sān hào mén chū qù wǎng zuǒ guǎi jiù shì — 5. Excuse me, where do I get a taxi? — Go out of Gate 3 and turn left; that’s it.

examples.text: 请问邮局在哪儿？——出了学校西门以后，过马路就是。
examples.translation: qǐng wèn yóu jú zài nǎr chū le xué xiào xī mén yǐ hòu guò mǎ lù jiù shì — 6. Where is the post office? — After going out of the West Gate of the school, cross the road and that’s it.

explanations.title: 沿着 … 往/向 … 开/走
explanations.body: Patterns: 沿着 street + 往/向 + direction + 开/走 + a certain distance or time; 沿着 street + 往/向 + direction + 开/走到 + landmark. Notes: 1. When giving directions, 往 and 向 are interchangeable. 2. In Southern China, the relative directions 左/右 are more commonly used, while in Northern China, the cardinal directions 东/西/南/北 are more commonly used. 3. The commonly used measurement unit is 公里 for longer distances and 米 for shorter and more precise distances. You can also use “mile” 英里 and “foot” 英尺.

examples.text: 沿着红星路往前开。
examples.translation: yán zhe hóng xīng lù wǎng qián kāi — 1. Drive forward along Hongxing Road.

examples.text: 沿着人民路往西开五公里。
examples.translation: yán zhe rén mín lù wǎng xī kāi wǔ gōng lǐ — 2. Drive west along Renmin Road for five kilometers.

examples.text: 沿着三号高速往北开二十分钟。
examples.translation: yán zhe sān hào gāo sù wǎng běi kāi èr shí fēn zhōng — 3. Drive north along Highway 3 for twenty minutes.

examples.text: 沿着这条小路走二百米左右。
examples.translation: yán zhe zhè tiáo xiǎo lù zǒu èr bǎi mǐ zuǒ yòu — 4. Walk about two hundred meters along this lane.

examples.text: 沿着这条路一直走到红绿灯那儿。
examples.translation: yán zhe zhè tiáo lù yì zhí zǒu dào hóng lǜ dēng nàr — 5. Keep walking along this road to the traffic light.

exercises.prompt: Which verb is used for walking directions, and which for driving?
options: 开 for walking, 走 for driving
走 for walking, 开 for driving
exercises.explanation: 走 for walking and 开 for driving.

exercises.prompt: Which question asks for a kind of place?
Which polite phrase means “Excuse me” (get someone’s attention)?
exercises.explanation: 劳驾 is a polite opener.

exercises.prompt: How do you say “it takes about half an hour by car”?
options: 开车需要半个小时左右

exercises.prompt: What does 沿着人民路往西开五公里 mean?
options: Drive west along Renmin Road for five kilometers

exercises.prompt: Which units are used for long and short distances?
options: 米 for long, 公里 for short
公里 for long, 米 for short

exercises.prompt: Are 往 and 向 interchangeable in directions?
In which part of China are 左/右 more common?
请问邮局在哪儿？——出了学校西门以后，过马路___是。
我想问一___，到美国大使馆怎么走？

lessons.title: 558. Lesson 22 Presentation 2 grammar: asking for and giving directions (2)
lessons.subtitle: 过…个红绿灯 · 往左拐 往右转 · 就是 你会看到 · 继续往前开 · …就到了 · 开到底

explanations.title: Passing traffic lights and intersections
explanations.body: Pattern: 过 + number + 个红绿灯/路口. The difference between 经过 and 穿过: 经过 means “to pass by”, whereas 穿过 means “to pass through”. On the book’s map (not included) you 经过 a coffee shop and then 穿过 a park.

examples.text: 过三个路口。
examples.translation: guò sān gè lù kǒu — 1. Pass three intersections.

examples.text: 过两个红绿灯，到第三个往右拐。
examples.translation: guò liǎng gè hóng lǜ dēng dào dì sān gè wǎng yòu guǎi — 2. Pass two traffic lights and turn right at the third.

examples.text: 走过两个街区，看到红绿灯时往左拐。
examples.translation: zǒu guò liǎng gè jiē qū kàn dào hóng lǜ dēng shí wǎng zuǒ guǎi — 3. Walk past two blocks and turn left when you see a traffic light.

explanations.title: Turning
explanations.body: Notes: 1. 转 and 拐 are interchangeable when giving directions. 2. 那儿 is optional. 3. 往/向 can be omitted in this situation.

examples.text: 一直往前走，在红绿灯那儿往左拐。
examples.translation: yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu zài hóng lǜ dēng nàr wǎng zuǒ guǎi — 1. Go straight ahead and turn left at the traffic light.

examples.text: 在第二个十字路口向右转。
examples.translation: zài dì èr gè shí zì lù kǒu xiàng yòu zhuǎn — 2. Turn right at the second crossroads.

examples.text: 在停车牌那儿左转，或者在丁字路口那儿左转。
examples.translation: zài tíng chē pái nàr zuǒ zhuǎn huò zhě zài dīng zì lù kǒu nàr zuǒ zhuǎn — 3. Turn left at the stop sign or at the T-junction. (the book writes 停车牌/丁字路口)

examples.text: 沿着北街走到红绿灯，然后向右转。
examples.translation: yán zhe běi jiē zǒu dào hóng lǜ dēng rán hòu xiàng yòu zhuǎn — 4. Walk along North Street to the traffic light, then turn right.

examples.text: 请问地铁站在哪儿？——一直往前走，走到红绿灯那儿左拐。
examples.translation: qǐng wèn dì tiě zhàn zài nǎr yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu zǒu dào hóng lǜ dēng nàr zuǒ guǎi — 5. Where is the subway station? — Go straight ahead and turn left at the traffic light.

examples.text: 沿着这条街一直走到红绿灯那儿，然后向右拐。
examples.translation: yán zhe zhè tiáo jiē yì zhí zǒu dào hóng lǜ dēng nàr rán hòu xiàng yòu guǎi — 6. Keep walking along this street to the traffic light, then turn right.

explanations.title: Pointing out a landmark
explanations.body: Patterns: 就是 + landmark; 你会看到 + landmark. And “过了 landmark 以后，继续往前走/开”.

examples.text: 出了学校大门，就是富兰克林大街。
examples.translation: chū le xué xiào dà mén jiù shì fù lán kè lín dà jiē — 1. Out of the school gate is Franklin Street.

examples.text: 下了高速，就是中山路。
examples.translation: xià le gāo sù jiù shì zhōng shān lù — 2. Once you get off the highway, that’s Zhongshan Road.

examples.text: 在第三个红绿灯往右拐，就是兴华路。
examples.translation: zài dì sān gè hóng lǜ dēng wǎng yòu guǎi jiù shì xīng huá lù — 3. Turn right at the third traffic light and that’s Xinghua Road.

examples.text: 一直往前走，你会看到一个停车牌。
examples.translation: yì zhí wǎng qián zǒu nǐ huì kàn dào yí gè tíng chē pái — 4. Keep going straight and you will see a stop sign.

examples.text: 再走五十米左右，你会看到左边有一个蓝色的路牌。
examples.translation: zài zǒu wǔ shí mǐ zuǒ yòu nǐ huì kàn dào zuǒ biān yǒu yí gè lán sè de lù pái — 5. Walk about fifty meters more and you will see a blue street sign on the left.

examples.text: 过了邮局以后，继续往前走。
examples.translation: guò le yóu jú yǐ hòu jì xù wǎng qián zǒu — 1. After passing the post office, keep going straight.

examples.text: 在第三个红绿灯往右拐，就是兴华路，沿着兴华路继续往前开。
examples.translation: zài dì sān gè hóng lǜ dēng wǎng yòu guǎi jiù shì xīng huá lù yán zhe xīng huá lù jì xù wǎng qián kāi — 2. Turn right at the third traffic light and that’s Xinghua Road; keep driving along Xinghua Road.

explanations.title: Arriving at the destination, naming an intersection, and the end of the road
explanations.body: Arriving: destination 就到了; destination 就在你的右手边/左手边/前面; destination 就在 landmark 的 direction. Naming an intersection: A路和B路的（十字）路口. To the end of the road: 开/走 + 到 + 底/头.

examples.text: 再走不远就到了。王府井大饭店就在路的西边。
examples.translation: zài zǒu bù yuǎn jiù dào le wáng fǔ jǐng dà fàn diàn jiù zài lù de xī biān — 1. Go a little farther and you’re there. The Wangfujing Hotel is on the west side of the road.

examples.text: 大华旅行社就在农贸市场的对面。
examples.translation: dà huá lǚ xíng shè jiù zài nóng mào shì chǎng de duì miàn — 2. The Dahua Travel Agency is right opposite the farmers’ market.

examples.text: 中国银行就在你的右手边。
examples.translation: zhōng guó yín háng jiù zài nǐ de yòu shǒu biān — 3. The Bank of China is right on your right.

examples.text: 人民北路和文太西街的十字路口
examples.translation: rén mín běi lù hé wén tài xī jiē de shí zì lù kǒu — 1. the intersection of Renmin North Road and Wentai West Street

examples.text: 文太正街和人民中路的十字路口
examples.translation: wén tài zhèng jiē hé rén mín zhōng lù de shí zì lù kǒu — 2. the intersection of Wentai Main Street and Renmin Middle Road

examples.text: 沿着文华路一直往北开，开到文化路和红星路的路口向右转。
examples.translation: yán zhe wén huá lù yì zhí wǎng běi kāi kāi dào wén huà lù hé hóng xīng lù de lù kǒu xiàng yòu zhuǎn — 3. Drive straight north along Wenhua Road; at the junction of Wenhua Road and Hongxing Road turn right.

examples.text: 离开停车场以后，沿着白云巷一直往前开，开到底，往左拐。
examples.translation: lí kāi tíng chē chǎng yǐ hòu yán zhe bái yún xiàng yì zhí wǎng qián kāi kāi dào dǐ wǎng zuǒ guǎi — Example 1 (a map): After leaving the parking lot, drive straight ahead along Baiyun Lane, to the end, then turn left.

examples.text: 你沿着玉林三巷一直往南走，走到头往右拐，就是玉林东街，再走到头，然后往左拐，就是玉林街。
examples.translation: nǐ yán zhe yù lín sān xiàng yì zhí wǎng nán zǒu zǒu dào tóu wǎng yòu guǎi jiù shì yù lín dōng jiē zài zǒu dào tóu rán hòu wǎng zuǒ guǎi jiù shì yù lín jiē — Example 2 (a map): Walk straight south along Yulin Third Lane, to the end, turn right, that’s Yulin East Street; walk to the end again and then turn left, and that’s Yulin Street.

exercises.prompt: What is the difference between 经过 and 穿过?
options: Only 穿过 is used for roads
经过 is through; 穿过 is by
经过 is passing by; 穿过 is passing through

exercises.prompt: How do you say “pass three intersections”?
Are 转 and 拐 interchangeable?
What does 出了学校大门，就是富兰克林大街 mean?
options: The school is on Franklin Street
Franklin Street is far from school
Out of the school gate is Franklin Street

exercises.prompt: Which means “you will see a stop sign”?
What does 过了邮局以后，继续往前走 mean?
options: Turn left at the post office
After passing the post office keep going straight
Go back to the post office

exercises.prompt: Which means “is right opposite the farmers’ market”?

options: Walk to the head of the bus
Walk to the end of the road
exercises.explanation: 到底/到头: to the end.

options: 人民北路和文太西街的十字路口
人民北路在文太西街里

exercises.prompt: 在第二个十字路口向右___。
再走五十米左右，你会看___左边有一个蓝色的路牌。

lessons.title: 559. Lesson 22 Presentation 2 grammar: highways, and activities on giving directions
lessons.subtitle: 上高速公路 · 从…号出口下高速 · 往东行驶 · 十一个方向翻译 · 蒙特雷到圣何塞

explanations.title: Getting on a highway
explanations.body: The specific verbs for getting on and off a highway are 上 and 下. Pattern: 上高速公路 / 上往 + direction + 开的 + number + 号高速公路. (The book illustrates these with road-sign photos, not included.)

examples.text: 上京沪高速公路。
examples.translation: shàng jīng hù gāo sù gōng lù — 1. Get on the Beijing–Shanghai Expressway. (a picture of the sign, not included)

examples.text: 上三十三号高速。
examples.translation: shàng sān shí sān hào gāo sù — 2. Get on Highway 33.

examples.text: 上一号高速。
examples.translation: shàng yī hào gāo sù — 3. Get on Highway 1.

examples.text: 上往东行驶的四十号高速公路。
examples.translation: shàng wǎng dōng xíng shǐ de sì shí hào gāo sù gōng lù — 4. Get on Highway 40 going east.

examples.text: 上往北行驶的八十五号高速公路。
examples.translation: shàng wǎng běi xíng shǐ de bā shí wǔ hào gāo sù gōng lù — 5. Get on Highway 85 going north.

explanations.title: Getting off a highway
explanations.body: Pattern: 从 + number + 号出口下高速公路.

examples.text: 从一百八十九号出口下高速公路。
examples.translation: cóng yì bǎi bā shí jiǔ hào chū kǒu xià gāo sù gōng lù — 1. Get off the highway at Exit 189.

examples.text: 去斗南走一百五十八号公路，从二百四十号出口下高速。
examples.translation: qù dòu nán zǒu yì bǎi wǔ shí bā hào gōng lù cóng èr bǎi sì shí hào chū kǒu xià gāo sù — 2. To go to Dounan, take Highway 158 and get off at Exit 240.

examples.text: 再往前开两公里就是二百四十号出口，从那里下高速公路。
examples.translation: zài wǎng qián kāi liǎng gōng lǐ jiù shì èr bǎi sì shí hào chū kǒu cóng nà lǐ xià gāo sù gōng lù — 3. Drive two more kilometers and that’s Exit 240; get off the highway there.

examples.text: 从二号出口下高速公路，就到了重庆北路。
examples.translation: cóng èr hào chū kǒu xià gāo sù gōng lù jiù dào le chóng qìng běi lù — 4. Get off the highway at Exit 2 and you reach Chongqing North Road.

examples.text: 从四号出口下高速，下了高速以后，就是松江路。
