explanations.body: A. Listen to six sentences with 每…都… and translate them into English. B. Pair up and check your translations with your partner. Then retell the sentences in Chinese with your partner. (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: The Use of 的 (a soothing tone)
explanations.body: The particle 的 is most often a structural particle, but it can also be a sentence-final particle which indicates that the speaker is certain about what is said. When used this way, it expresses a type of “mood” and is thus called a “modal particle”. Frequently, the statement will include 会 or 一定会 to emphasize the speaker’s certainty. Pattern: Statement + 的.

examples.text: 我每天都挺忙的。
examples.translation: wǒ měi tiān dōu tǐng máng de — 1. I’m very busy every day. (的 shows the speaker is certain)

examples.text: 别着急，他会好起来的。
examples.translation: bié zháo jí tā huì hǎo qǐ lái de — 2. Don’t worry, he will get better. (会 … 的 emphasizes certainty)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Pair up. Student A says something and Student B responds with 的. The book’s example: A: 我们坐高铁去北京怎么样？ B: 好啊，高铁挺快的，几个小时就到了，比坐飞机方便多了。 Then: 1. A: 这个包裹你打算怎么寄？去邮局寄还是让快递公司寄？ 2. A: 大夫，你觉得我这个病什么时候才能好？ 3. A: 大夫，护士刚给我量了血压，我想知道我的血压是不是正常。 4. A: 你觉得麻婆豆腐和宫保鸡丁好吃吗？ 5. A: 你知道中国的地铁是不是很新，很干净？ 6. A: 明天就要单元考试了。我很紧张，怕考不好。 The book leaves B blank; my replies:

examples.text: 好啊，高铁挺快的，几个小时就到了，比坐飞机方便多了。
examples.translation: hǎo a gāo tiě tǐng kuài de jǐ gè xiǎo shí jiù dào le bǐ zuò fēi jī fāng biàn duō le — The book’s example: Student A: 我们坐高铁去北京怎么样？ Student B: Good idea, the high-speed train is pretty fast; it takes only a few hours, much more convenient than flying.

examples.text: 我打算去邮局寄，邮局的价格便宜，也很安全的。
examples.translation: wǒ dǎ suàn qù yóu jú jì yóu jú de jià gé pián yi yě hěn ān quán de — 1. I plan to mail it at the post office; the post office is cheap and also safe. (reply to 这个包裹你打算怎么寄？, mine)

examples.text: 别担心，你吃几天药就会好的。
examples.translation: bié dān xīn nǐ chī jǐ tiān yào jiù huì hǎo de — 2. Don’t worry, you’ll get better after a few days of medicine. (reply to the doctor question, mine)

examples.text: 你的血压不会有问题的，很正常。
examples.translation: nǐ de xuè yā bú huì yǒu wèn tí de hěn zhèng cháng — 3. Your blood pressure won’t have a problem; it’s normal. (mine)

examples.text: 好吃，它们都很好吃的。
examples.translation: hǎo chī tā men dōu hěn hǎo chī de — 4. Yes, they are both very tasty. (mine)

examples.text: 中国的地铁挺新的，也挺干净的。
examples.translation: zhōng guó de dì tiě tǐng xīn de yě tǐng gān jìng de — 5. Chinese subways are quite new and also quite clean. (mine)

examples.text: 别紧张，你复习得很好，一定会考好的。
examples.translation: bié jǐn zhāng nǐ fù xí de hěn hǎo yí dìng huì kǎo hǎo de — 6. Don’t be nervous; you’ve reviewed well and will certainly do well. (mine)

exercises.prompt: What does 每 need before a noun?
Which word is usually added to the predicate with 每?
Which words need no measure word after 每?
options: 天, 年, 周, 次

exercises.prompt: What does 她做的每道菜都好吃 mean?
options: Every dish she cooks is delicious

exercises.prompt: What does the sentence-final 的 show?
options: The speaker is certain about what is said

exercises.prompt: What do statements with this 的 often include?
What does 别着急，他会好起来的 mean?
options: Don’t worry, he will get better

exercises.prompt: 她妈妈每___都来美国度假。
我们班每个学生___很努力学习。

lessons.title: 580. Lesson 23 Presentation 2 grammar: 差不多, 左右, 大约, 大概 and 和…相比
lessons.subtitle: 差不多四个月 · 八点左右 · 大约半个小时 · 大概二十万 · 和纽约的地铁相比

explanations.title: The Adverbs 差不多, 左右, 大约, 大概
explanations.body: The adverbs 差不多, 左右, 大约, 大概 are used to express approximations and can be interchangeable, but there are some differences. 差不多, 大约 and 大概 are placed before a number and measure word, whereas 左右 is placed after a number and measure word. Although 大概 and 左右 are used to make estimations or draw inferences, occasionally they have different connotations.

rows: 差不多九点了，我们得开会了。
more or less, about, or so
安娜每天早上八点左右到公司。
高铁大约半个小时来一趟车。
approximately, more or less; or to speculate, make a guess
电视节目大概二十分钟有一个广告。 他今天没来上课，大概生病了。
tables.title: The adverbs 差不多, 左右, 大约, 大概

examples.text: 我学了差不多四个月的中文了。
examples.translation: wǒ xué le chà bu duō sì gè yuè de zhōng wén le — 差不多 + number + measure word: I have studied Chinese for almost four months.

examples.text: 张老师今年大约三十岁。
examples.translation: zhāng lǎo shī jīn nián dà yuē sān shí suì — 大约 + number + measure word: Teacher Zhang is about thirty this year. (the book writes 30 in digits)

examples.text: 这件衣服大概五十块钱。
examples.translation: zhè jiàn yī fú dà gài wǔ shí kuài qián — 大概 + number: This garment is about fifty yuan.

examples.text: 我每天六点左右起床。
examples.translation: wǒ měi tiān liù diǎn zuǒ yòu qǐ chuáng — number + measure word + 左右: I get up at about six every day.

examples.text: 大概二十万人民币。
examples.translation: dà gài èr shí wàn rén mín bì — A: 这辆车你花了多少钱？ B: About 200,000 yuan. (大概 implies the speaker is unclear or uncertain about the amount, or perhaps cannot remember)

examples.text: 二十万人民币左右。
examples.translation: èr shí wàn rén mín bì zuǒ yòu — B: Around 200,000 yuan. (左右 implies a greater level of accuracy or certainty)

explanations.title: 左右 with the others
explanations.body: 左右 can be used with 差不多, 大约 and 大概 to express approximations.

examples.text: 从蒙特雷开到旧金山差不多两个小时左右。
examples.translation: cóng méng tè léi kāi dào jiù jīn shān chà bu duō liǎng gè xiǎo shí zuǒ yòu — 1. It takes about two hours to drive from Monterey to San Francisco.

examples.text: 我老家夏天最高气温大约有四十摄氏度左右。
examples.translation: wǒ lǎo jiā xià tiān zuì gāo qì wēn dà yuē yǒu sì shí shè shì dù zuǒ yòu — 2. The highest temperature in my hometown in summer is about 40 degrees Celsius.

examples.text: 这辆汽车大概才十万多人民币左右。
examples.translation: zhè liàng qì chē dà gài cái shí wàn duō rén mín bì zuǒ yòu — 3. This car is only about 100,000 yuan. (the book writes 40 in digits in sentence 2)

explanations.title: Activities 3 and 4 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Activity 3: Pair up. Each student asks their partner questions, who responds with 差不多, 左右, 大约, or 大概. A组问题: 1. 你每天几点睡觉？几点起床？ 2. 周末的时候，你大概几点起床，几点睡觉？ 3. 你每天大概学习多少个小时？ 4. 一个星期你大概学习多少个生词？ 5. 你大概一个月花多少钱？ B组问题: 1. 你打算什么时候回老家看父母？ 2. 你多长时间给你父母打一次电话？ 3. 在你老家，夏天的最高气温有多少？冬天的最低气温呢？ 4. 你老家有多少人口？ 5. 在你老家，多少钱才能买到一座房子？ Activity 4: Pair up, complete the sentences with 差不多, 左右, 大约, or 大概. The completed sentences (key mine):

examples.text: 他大概是日本人。
examples.translation: tā dà gài shì rì běn rén — 1. He is probably Japanese. (key mine; the book gives the blanks without an answer)

examples.text: 今天中午有九十华氏度左右。
examples.translation: jīn tiān zhōng wǔ yǒu jiǔ shí huá shì dù zuǒ yòu — 2. It is about 90 degrees Fahrenheit at noon today. (左右)

examples.text: 我今天差不多八点才到学校。
examples.translation: wǒ jīn tiān chà bu duō bā diǎn cái dào xué xiào — 3. I didn’t get to school until almost eight today. (差不多)

examples.text: 大概明年这个时候，我就可以毕业了。
examples.translation: dà gài míng nián zhè ge shí hòu wǒ jiù kě yǐ bì yè le — 4. About this time next year I can graduate. (大概)

examples.text: 丽莉在深圳实习了差不多四个月了。
examples.translation: lì lì zài shēn zhèn shí xí le chà bu duō sì gè yuè le — 5. Lily has been interning in Shenzhen for almost four months. (差不多)

examples.text: 我们学校大约有三千多留学生。
examples.translation: wǒ men xué xiào dà yuē yǒu sān qiān duō liú xué shēng — 6. Our school has about three thousand international students. (大约)

examples.text: 现在快两点了，他怎么还没到？大概路上堵车了。
examples.translation: xiàn zài kuài liǎng diǎn le tā zěn me hái méi dào dà gài lù shàng dǔ chē le — 7. It’s nearly two; why hasn’t he arrived yet? Probably there’s a traffic jam. (大概)

examples.text: 差不多十一点了，咱们该睡觉了，明天还得早起呢。
examples.translation: chà bu duō shí yī diǎn le zán men gāi shuì jiào le míng tiān hái děi zǎo qǐ ne — 8. It’s almost eleven; we should go to bed, we still have to get up early tomorrow. (差不多)

explanations.title: The Prepositional Phrase 和……相比
explanations.body: The prepositional phrase 和……相比 is used to compare two things (A and B) with an emphasis on A. 跟 is also used with 相比. In colloquial Chinese, “相” can be omitted. Pattern: 和（跟）+ B +（相）比，A……

examples.text: 和纽约的地铁相比，深圳的地铁要新得多。
examples.translation: hé niǔ yuē de dì tiě xiāng bǐ shēn zhèn de dì tiě yào xīn de duō — 1. Compared with the New York subway, the Shenzhen subway is much newer.

examples.text: 中国跟三十年前相比，发生了巨大的变化。
examples.translation: zhōng guó gēn sān shí nián qián xiāng bǐ fā shēng le jù dà de biàn huà — 2. Compared with thirty years ago, China has undergone enormous changes. (the book prints a space after 中国)

examples.text: 和东部比，我更喜欢美国的西部。
examples.translation: hé dōng bù bǐ wǒ gèng xǐ huān měi guó de xī bù — 3. Compared with the East, I like the American West more.

examples.text: 我的中文和上个月比，有了很大的进步。
examples.translation: wǒ de zhōng wén hé shàng gè yuè bǐ yǒu le hěn dà de jìn bù — 4. Compared with last month, my Chinese has made great progress.

explanations.title: Activity 5 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Student A will say the first part of the sentence and Student B will continue with the second part: 1. 和刚学中文的时候比，… 2. 和蒙特雷的气候相比… 3. 和中国的人口数量相比，… 4. 跟旧金山这个大城市比，… 5. 和一般的大学比，… 6. 和（跟）中国产品的价格比，… B. With your partner, create your own sentences. C. Share your group work with the class. My completions:

examples.text: 和刚学中文的时候比，我现在的中文进步了很多。
examples.translation: hé gāng xué zhōng wén de shí hòu bǐ wǒ xiàn zài de zhōng wén jìn bù le hěn duō — 1. Compared with when I had just begun to learn Chinese, my Chinese has improved a lot now. (Activity 5, my completion)

examples.text: 和蒙特雷的气候相比，北京的冬天冷多了。
examples.translation: hé méng tè léi de qì hòu xiāng bǐ běi jīng de dōng tiān lěng duō le — 2. Compared with the climate of Monterey, Beijing’s winter is much colder. (mine)

examples.text: 和中国的人口数量相比，美国的人口少多了。
examples.translation: hé zhōng guó de rén kǒu shù liàng xiāng bǐ měi guó de rén kǒu shǎo duō le — 3. Compared with China’s population, America’s population is much smaller. (mine)

examples.text: 跟旧金山这个大城市比，蒙特雷小多了。
examples.translation: gēn jiù jīn shān zhè ge dà chéng shì bǐ méng tè léi xiǎo duō le — 4. Compared with a big city like San Francisco, Monterey is much smaller. (mine)

examples.text: 和一般的大学比，我们学校的学生学外语的时间更长。
examples.translation: hé yì bān de dà xué bǐ wǒ men xué xiào de xué shēng xué wài yǔ de shí jiān gèng cháng — 5. Compared with ordinary universities, the students at our school spend more time learning foreign languages. (mine)

examples.text: 和中国产品的价格比，进口产品的价格贵得多。
examples.translation: hé zhōng guó chǎn pǐn de jià gé bǐ jìn kǒu chǎn pǐn de jià gé guì de duō — 6. Compared with the prices of Chinese products, the prices of imported products are much higher. (mine)

options: At the beginning of the sentence
After the number and measure word

exercises.prompt: Which of these is placed before a number?
What does 他今天没来上课，大概生病了 mean?
options: He didn’t come to class today; he’s probably ill

exercises.prompt: Which answer sounds more precise: 大概二十万 or 二十万左右?
How do you say “almost four months”?
What does 和纽约的地铁相比，深圳的地铁要新得多 mean?
options: There is no subway in Shenzhen
Compared with New York’s subway, Shenzhen’s is much newer

exercises.prompt: What can be omitted in colloquial Chinese in 和…相比?

lessons.title: 581. Lesson 23 Presentation 2 skill integration: working abroad, finding a home in Shanghai
lessons.subtitle: 外国人在中国工作 · 来中国的目的 · 前途 网友 发挥 挑战 · 在上海找房子

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the recording and write the main idea. B. Listen and transcribe the missing words in Pinyin, then translate into English: 还有一些外国人在中国从事…、贸易、…和投资方面的工作，因为中国是一个…大市场，和经济活动有关的工作机会很多。 C. Pair up and discuss. D. Listen again and answer: 1. 在中国教英语的外国人都是从说英语的国家来的吗？ 2. 除了教英文，外国人在中国还做什么工作？ 3. 为什么很多外国人觉得在中国工作和生活压力小？ 4. 这些在中国工作和学习的人回国以后会怎么样？ E. Discuss and share. F. Discuss: 1. 学完中文以后，你有没有去中国或是台湾工作和生活的计划？ 2. 如果你打算去中国或是台湾，你想做什么？ 3. 你喜欢这种“一边工作一边旅游”的生活方式吗？你打算将来去哪个国家过这样的生活？ (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to the recording and fill in the table 我来中国的目的 (mùdì; purpose): 第一个目的, 第二个目的, 第三个目的, with 其他信息. B. Pair up and discuss; read the script if necessary. C. Define the following words with your partner, using a dictionary if necessary: 前途 qiántú, 网友 wǎngyǒu, 发挥 fāhuī, 挑战 tiǎozhàn. D. Discussion: 说话人觉得在中国教英文没有挑战，不能发挥他的中文能力，你同意他的话吗？为什么？ (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Read a blog entry by an American who works in China and answer the questions: 1. 说话人找到的房子怎么样？ 2. 说话人搬到租好的房子里以后做了什么？ 3. 上海那个星期的天气怎么样？ 4. 今天说话人做了什么？ B. Pair up and discuss. C. With your partner, discuss your experience of finding an apartment in another city or abroad. The blog entry (the book glosses 中介 and 开关 in pinyin in brackets) and my answers:

examples.text: 最近我忙着在上海找房子，前两天中介带我去徐汇区看了一个房子。这个房子很干净，有很多窗户，厨房也很大，而且离地铁站只有五分钟，交通很方便，我很喜欢，马上和他签了租房合同，付了半年的房租。
examples.translation: zuì jìn wǒ máng zhe zài shàng hǎi zhǎo fáng zi qián liǎng tiān zhōng jiè dài wǒ qù xú huì qū kàn le yí gè fáng zi zhè ge fáng zi hěn gān jìng yǒu hěn duō chuāng hù chú fáng yě hěn dà ér qiě lí dì tiě zhàn zhǐ yǒu wǔ fēn zhōng jiāo tōng hěn fāng biàn wǒ hěn xǐ huān mǎ shàng hé tā qiān le zū fáng hé tóng fù le bàn nián de fáng zū — Recently I have been busy looking for a place in Shanghai; a couple of days ago an agent (中介, zhōngjiè) took me to see an apartment in Xuhui District. The apartment is very clean with lots of windows and a big kitchen, and it is only five minutes from the subway station, so transportation is very convenient. I liked it very much, signed the rental contract with him immediately and paid half a year’s rent. (translation mine)

examples.text: 昨天早上，我从宾馆搬到了新租的房子。收拾好东西以后，我先去附近的家乐福买了一些东西。然后又去中国电信开通了网络服务。回到家后，我觉得非常累，想洗澡放松一下，结果却发现没有热水。我马上打电话给房东问他怎么回事，房东说需要把热水器打开才有热水。我按他说的，打开开关，热水就出来了。
examples.translation: zuó tiān zǎo shàng wǒ cóng bīn guǎn bān dào le xīn zū de fáng zi shōu shí hǎo dōng xī yǐ hòu wǒ xiān qù fù jìn de jiā lè fú mǎi le yì xiē dōng xī rán hòu yòu qù zhōng guó diàn xìn kāi tōng le wǎng luò fú wù huí dào jiā hòu wǒ jué de fēi cháng lèi xiǎng xǐ zǎo fàng sōng yí xià jié guǒ què fā xiàn méi yǒu rè shuǐ wǒ mǎ shàng dǎ diàn huà gěi fáng dōng wèn tā zěn me huí shì fáng dōng shuō xū yào bǎ rè shuǐ qì dǎ kāi cái yǒu rè shuǐ wǒ àn tā shuō de dǎ kāi kāi guān rè shuǐ jiù chū lái le — Yesterday morning I moved from the hotel into the newly rented apartment. After tidying up, I first went to a nearby Carrefour to buy a few things. Then I went to China Telecom to get the internet service connected. After getting home I felt very tired and wanted to wash and relax, but found there was no hot water. I immediately phoned the landlord to ask what was wrong, and he said I had to turn on the water heater to have hot water. I did as he said and turned on the switch (开关, kāiguān), and the hot water came out. (mine)

examples.text: 我来到上海差不多一个星期了，还没有看到太阳，天总是阴的，前天下雨了，感觉有点儿冷。今天我们公司的一个美国同事要回国，所以我们为他举办了一个聚会。大家在一起吃饭，聊天，然后去黄浦江坐游船看风景。我还拍了一个小视频，打算寄给我父母看。
examples.translation: wǒ lái dào shàng hǎi chà bu duō yí gè xīng qī le hái méi yǒu kàn dào tài yáng tiān zǒng shì yīn de qián tiān xià yǔ le gǎn jué yǒu diǎnr lěng jīn tiān wǒ men gōng sī de yí gè měi guó tóng shì yào huí guó suǒ yǐ wǒ men wèi tā jǔ bàn le yí gè jù huì dà jiā zài yì qǐ chī fàn liáo tiān rán hòu qù huáng pǔ jiāng zuò yóu chuán kàn fēng jǐng wǒ hái pāi le yí gè xiǎo shì pín dǎ suàn jì gěi wǒ fù mǔ kàn — I have been in Shanghai for almost a week and still haven’t seen the sun; the sky is always overcast, and the day before yesterday it rained and felt a bit cold. Today an American colleague at our company is going back to his country, so we held a party for him. We ate and chatted together and then took a cruise on the Huangpu River to see the scenery. I also took a short video and plan to send it to my parents. (mine)

examples.text: 说话人找到的房子怎么样？
examples.translation: shuō huà rén zhǎo dào de fáng zi zěn me yàng — 1. What was the apartment the speaker found like? Answer (mine): clean, with many windows and a big kitchen, five minutes from the subway.

examples.text: 说话人搬到租好的房子里以后做了什么？
examples.translation: shuō huà rén bān dào zū hǎo de fáng zi lǐ yǐ hòu zuò le shén me — 2. What did the speaker do after moving in? Answer (mine): went shopping at Carrefour, had the internet connected, found no hot water and called the landlord.

examples.text: 上海那个星期的天气怎么样？

lessons.title: 582. Lesson 23 Presentation 2 using Chinese in context: six cities, a tutor and an internship email
lessons.subtitle: 外国人最想去的六座城市 · 找家教 · 阿里巴巴实习 · 工资 待遇 奖金 补助

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: Scenario: your class is going to graduate and several of you would like to work and live in China. Your teacher just saw a news report about the most favored cities for foreigners and recommends it to you. Read about these cities and research them online; then select a city for your journey. A. In two groups, Group A reads about Chengdu, Guangzhou and Hangzhou and Group B reads about Shenzhen, Beijing and Shanghai. Summarize the passage about each city in the table. B. Within your group, fill in the table with information on the city your group likes most and your reasons. C. Each group presents its selection and reasons to the class. (Six photographs are not included.)

examples.text: 随着中国经济的不断发展，越来越多的外国人来中国工作和学习。老外们通常喜欢去哪些城市呢？下面是老外们选出的最想去的六座城市，我们来看看他们是怎么描述这几个城市的？
examples.translation: suí zhe zhōng guó jīng jì de bú duàn fā zhǎn yuè lái yuè duō de wài guó rén lái zhōng guó gōng zuò hé xué xí lǎo wài men tōng cháng xǐ huān qù nǎ xiē chéng shì ne xià miàn shì lǎo wài men xuǎn chū de zuì xiǎng qù de liù zuò chéng shì wǒ men lái kàn kàn tā men shì zěn me miáo shù zhè jǐ gè chéng shì de — With the continuous development of China’s economy more and more foreigners come to China to work and study. Which cities do foreigners usually like to go to? Below are the six cities that foreigners picked as the ones they most want to go to; let’s see how they describe them. (translation mine)

examples.text: 对西方人来说，成都是一个非常有味道的城市，这里有很多漂亮的竹林，还有大熊猫保护区。成都人的生活轻松、悠闲，非常适合喜欢安静的外国人。虽然四川话和普通话不一样，但成都能让外国人感受到真正的中国文化，欣赏到美丽的自然景色。
examples.translation: duì xī fāng rén lái shuō chéng dū shì yí gè fēi cháng yǒu wèi dào de chéng shì zhè lǐ yǒu hěn duō piào liàng de zhú lín hái yǒu dà xióng māo bǎo hù qū chéng dū rén de shēng huó qīng sōng yōu xián fēi cháng shì hé xǐ huān ān jìng de wài guó rén suī rán sì chuān huà hé pǔ tōng huà bù yí yàng dàn chéng dū néng ràng wài guó rén gǎn shòu dào zhēn zhèng de zhōng guó wén huà xīn shǎng dào měi lì de zì rán jǐng sè — Chengdu: For Westerners Chengdu is a very flavorful city with many beautiful bamboo forests and a giant panda reserve. Chengdu people’s life is relaxed and leisurely, very suitable for foreigners who like quiet. Although the Sichuan dialect is different from Mandarin, Chengdu lets foreigners feel real Chinese culture and enjoy beautiful natural scenery. (translation mine)

examples.text: 广州是中国四个最大的城市之一。广州的商业活动非常活跃，很多外国人来这里做生意。广州和香港很近，这两个城市的人都说广东话。
examples.translation: guǎng zhōu shì zhōng guó sì gè zuì dà de chéng shì zhī yì guǎng zhōu de shāng yè huó dòng fēi cháng huó yuè hěn duō wài guó rén lái zhè lǐ zuò shēng yì guǎng zhōu hé xiāng gǎng hěn jìn zhè liǎng gè chéng shì de rén dōu shuō guǎng dōng huà — Guangzhou: Guangzhou is one of the four biggest cities in China. Business activity in Guangzhou is very active and many foreigners come here to do business. Guangzhou is close to Hong Kong, and people in both cities speak Cantonese. (mine)

examples.text: 杭州是一个轻松、浪漫的城市，也是一个有悠久历史的古城。对喜欢中国文化和历史的外国人来说，杭州是最好的选择。另外杭州有很多科技公司，马云的阿里巴巴总公司就在杭州。
examples.translation: háng zhōu shì yí gè qīng sōng làng màn de chéng shì yě shì yí gè yǒu yōu jiǔ lì shǐ de gǔ chéng duì xǐ huān zhōng guó wén huà hé lì shǐ de wài guó rén lái shuō háng zhōu shì zuì hǎo de xuǎn zé lìng wài háng zhōu yǒu hěn duō kē jì gōng sī mǎ yún de ā lǐ bā bā zǒng gōng sī jiù zài háng zhōu — Hangzhou: Hangzhou is a relaxed, romantic city and also an ancient city with a long history. For foreigners who like Chinese culture and history, Hangzhou is the best choice. In addition Hangzhou has many technology companies; Jack Ma’s Alibaba headquarters is in Hangzhou. (mine)

examples.text: 深圳在香港旁边，也是中国四大城市之一。深圳有很多科技公司和贸易公司，是一个非常开放、自由的城市，非常受外国专业人士的喜爱。
examples.translation: shēn zhèn zài xiāng gǎng páng biān yě shì zhōng guó sì dà chéng shì zhī yì shēn zhèn yǒu hěn duō kē jì gōng sī hé mào yì gōng sī shì yí gè fēi cháng kāi fàng zì yóu de chéng shì fēi cháng shòu wài guó zhuān yè rén shì de xǐ ài — Shenzhen: Shenzhen is next to Hong Kong and is also one of China’s four big cities. Shenzhen has many technology and trading companies and is a very open and free city, much loved by foreign professionals. (mine)

examples.text: 北京是中国的首都，既是古老的城市，又是现代化的大都市。北京有最好的大学，也有和美国硅谷一样的中关村。百度和联想公司都在那里。北京有各个国家的大使馆，很多外国公司也喜欢把总部设在北京。
examples.translation: běi jīng shì zhōng guó de shǒu dū jì shì gǔ lǎo de chéng shì yòu shì xiàn dài huà de dà dū shì běi jīng yǒu zuì hǎo de dà xué yě yǒu hé měi guó guī gǔ yí yàng de zhōng guān cūn bǎi dù hé lián xiǎng gōng sī dōu zài nà lǐ běi jīng yǒu gè gè guó jiā de dà shǐ guǎn hěn duō wài guó gōng sī yě xǐ huān bǎ zǒng bù shè zài běi jīng — Beijing: Beijing is China’s capital, both an ancient city and a modern metropolis. Beijing has the best universities and also Zhongguancun, which is like America’s Silicon Valley; Baidu and Lenovo are both there. Beijing has the embassies of every country and many foreign companies like to put their headquarters in Beijing. (mine)

examples.text: 上海是中国最大的城市，是一个国际大都市。上海的生活丰富多彩，中西文化汇集，很多外国人喜欢在这里工作和生活。上海是经济、金融中心，有很多的工作机会。
examples.translation: shàng hǎi shì zhōng guó zuì dà de chéng shì shì yí gè guó jì dà dū shì shàng hǎi de shēng huó fēng fù duō cǎi zhōng xī wén huà huì jí hěn duō wài guó rén xǐ huān zài zhè lǐ gōng zuò hé shēng huó shàng hǎi shì jīng jì jīn róng zhōng xīn yǒu hěn duō de gōng zuò jī huì — Shanghai: Shanghai is China’s largest city, an international metropolis. Life in Shanghai is rich and colorful, Chinese and Western cultures meet, and many foreigners like to work and live here. Shanghai is an economic and financial center and has many job opportunities. (mine)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Writing, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Scenario: you are working for an American company in China. You want to improve your Chinese and find a private tutor. You hear an advertisement on the radio about a Chinese teacher and you are interested. Call this teacher to schedule a private lesson. A. Listen to the radio advertisement and write a summary. B. Pair up and discuss; read the script if needed. C. Role-play: call this teacher and ask for the information you need; your partner plays the teacher at the tutoring center. Questions you want to ask: 你们的家教中心在哪儿？你们都有什么课？你们的老师怎么样？一节课多少钱？到家里上课多少钱？什么时间上课？一次上几个小时？ Questions the tutoring center wants to ask: 你是怎么知道我们家教中心的？你以前学过中文吗？在哪儿学的？你为什么要请家教？你想在哪方面提高你的中文水平？你住在哪儿？你想一次学几个小时？ (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening, Writing, Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Scenario: you have just received an email from your old classmate, who is working as an intern for Alibaba in Hangzhou, China. After reading the email, you reply, expressing your interest in working for Alibaba and hoping to learn more about becoming an intern. A. Listen to the email and write a summary (audio, not included). B. Pair up, discuss and read the script if necessary. C. With your partner, reply to your classmate’s email (TO: 小楠; Subject: 你写给小楠的电子邮件). D. Share your email with the class. My sample reply:

examples.text: 小楠，你好：收到你的邮件，知道你在杭州的阿里巴巴实习，一切都很顺利，我真为你高兴。我对阿里巴巴的实习机会很感兴趣。你能告诉我怎么申请吗？实习的工资和待遇怎么样？有没有奖金和补助？我的中文还不太好，会不会有问题？希望你尽快回信。祝你一切顺利！
examples.translation: xiǎo nán nǐ hǎo shōu dào nǐ de yóu jiàn zhī dào nǐ zài háng zhōu de ā lǐ bā bā shí xí yí qiè dōu hěn shùn lì wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng wǒ duì ā lǐ bā bā de shí xí jī huì hěn gǎn xìng qù nǐ néng gào sù wǒ zěn me shēn qǐng ma shí xí de gōng zī hé dài yù zěn me yàng yǒu méi yǒu jiǎng jīn hé bǔ zhù wǒ de zhōng wén hái bú tài hǎo huì bú huì yǒu wèn tí xī wàng nǐ jǐn kuài huí xìn zhù nǐ yí qiè shùn lì — Hello, Xiaonan: I received your email and learned that you are interning at Alibaba in Hangzhou and everything is going well; I am really happy for you. I am very interested in the internship opportunities at Alibaba. Can you tell me how to apply? What are the salary and benefits of the internship like? Are there bonuses and subsidies? My Chinese is still not very good; will that be a problem? I hope you will reply soon. Wishing you all the best! (my sample reply to Activity 3C; translation mine)

lessons.title: 584. Lesson 23 Presentation 3: Luo Wen studies Chinese medicine in Tianjin
lessons.subtitle: 罗文在天津 · 下雪高兴极了 · 留学生宿舍 · 四节中医课 · 视频聊天

explanations.title: Getting Started
explanations.body: Pair up and discuss: A. Do you know anything about Tianjin? What can you say about it? B. Do you have experience learning foreign languages in other countries? If so, could you briefly share it? C. How much do you know about Chinese medicine? Do you know anyone who has learned Chinese medicine? (Four photographs are not included.)

explanations.title: Presentation 3: 罗文在天津
explanations.body: The book also prints the passage in traditional characters. The translations are mine.

examples.text: 我叫罗文，是泰国人，现在住在天津。天津是一个现代大都市，有很多西式风格的建筑，还有一条美丽的海河。尽管这儿的冬天特别冷，可是我却很喜欢，因为我没见过雪，所以每次下雪我都高兴极了。
examples.translation: wǒ jiào luó wén shì tài guó rén xiàn zài zhù zài tiān jīn tiān jīn shì yí gè xiàn dài dà dū shì yǒu hěn duō xī shì fēng gé de jiàn zhù hái yǒu yì tiáo měi lì de hǎi hé jǐn guǎn zhèr de dōng tiān tè bié lěng kě shì wǒ què hěn xǐ huān yīn wèi wǒ méi jiàn guò xuě suǒ yǐ měi cì xià xuě wǒ dōu gāo xìng jí le — My name is Luo Wen; I am Thai and now live in Tianjin. Tianjin is a modern metropolis with many Western-style buildings and a beautiful Hai River. Although the winters here are especially cold, I like them very much, because I had never seen snow, so every time it snows I am extremely happy. (translation mine)

examples.text: 我在天津医科大学学习中医和汉语。我住在留学生宿舍里，宿舍周围有很多树和花儿。我的房间不太大，但是很舒适，而且晚上可以看到城市的夜景。宿舍一楼有一个西餐厅和一个南亚餐厅。有时候我去这两个餐厅吃饭，有时候去中国学生食堂吃饭。我还常常和朋友们一起上街买菜，然后自己做饭。我觉得买菜、做饭是很有意思的事情。周末我会和朋友们一起去逛街。
examples.translation: wǒ zài tiān jīn yī kē dà xué xué xí zhōng yī hé hàn yǔ wǒ zhù zài liú xué shēng sù shè lǐ sù shè zhōu wéi yǒu hěn duō shù hé huār wǒ de fáng jiān bú tài dà dàn shì hěn shū shì ér qiě wǎn shàng kě yǐ kàn dào chéng shì de yè jǐng sù shè yì lóu yǒu yí gè xī cān tīng hé yí gè nán yà cān tīng yǒu shí hòu wǒ qù zhè liǎng gè cān tīng chī fàn yǒu shí hòu qù zhōng guó xué shēng shí táng chī fàn wǒ hái cháng cháng hé péng yǒu men yì qǐ shàng jiē mǎi cài rán hòu zì jǐ zuò fàn wǒ jué de mǎi cài zuò fàn shì hěn yǒu yì si de shì qíng zhōu mò wǒ huì hé péng yǒu men yì qǐ qù guàng jiē — I study Chinese medicine and Chinese at Tianjin Medical University. I live in the international students’ dormitory, which is surrounded by many trees and flowers. My room is not very big but very comfortable, and in the evening I can see the city’s night view. On the first floor of the dorm there is a Western restaurant and a South Asian restaurant. Sometimes I eat at these two restaurants and sometimes at the Chinese students’ canteen. I also often go out with friends to buy groceries and then cook myself. I think buying groceries and cooking are very interesting things. On weekends I go shopping with friends. (mine)

examples.text: 我们的课程很紧张，每天有四节中医课，还有两节语言课。下课以后，我先做作业，然后休息一下，听听音乐，看看书，或者和朋友聊一会儿天儿。六点半我吃晚饭。晚饭后我会跟室友散一会儿步。回到宿舍后，我不仅要复习一下当天学过的内容，而且还得预习一下第二天的课程，然后再和爸爸妈妈视频聊天。和他们说话是我每天最开心的事。虽然我每天都很忙，但是我非常喜欢这里的生活。我很感谢父母给我这个机会，让我来中国学习中医和汉语。
examples.translation: wǒ men de kè chéng hěn jǐn zhāng měi tiān yǒu sì jié zhōng yī kè hái yǒu liǎng jié yǔ yán kè xià kè yǐ hòu wǒ xiān zuò zuò yè rán hòu xiū xī yí xià tīng tīng yīn yuè kàn kàn shū huò zhě hé péng yǒu liáo yí huìr tiān ér liù diǎn bàn wǒ chī wǎn fàn wǎn fàn hòu wǒ huì gēn shì yǒu sàn yí huìr bù huí dào sù shè hòu wǒ bù jǐn yào fù xí yí xià dàng tiān xué guò de nèi róng ér qiě hái děi yù xí yí xià dì èr tiān de kè chéng rán hòu zài hé bà bà mā mā shì pín liáo tiān hé tā men shuō huà shì wǒ měi tiān zuì kāi xīn de shì suī rán wǒ měi tiān dōu hěn máng dàn shì wǒ fēi cháng xǐ huān zhè lǐ de shēng huó wǒ hěn gǎn xiè fù mǔ gěi wǒ zhè ge jī huì ràng wǒ lái zhōng guó xué xí zhōng yī hé hàn yǔ — Our courses are intense: every day there are four Chinese medicine classes and two language classes. After class I first do homework, then rest a bit, listen to music, read, or chat with friends for a while. At six thirty I eat dinner. After dinner I take a walk with my roommates for a while. After getting back to the dorm I not only have to review what I learned that day but also have to preview the next day’s lessons, and then video-chat with my parents. Talking with them is the happiest thing of my day. Although I am busy every day, I like life here very much. I am very grateful to my parents for giving me this opportunity to come to China to study Chinese medicine and Chinese. (mine)

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Global listening: listen to Presentation 3 and answer: 1. What is the main idea of this presentation? (Luo Wen’s study and life in Tianjin) 2. Who is the speaker? (Luo Wen, a Thai student). B. Detailed listening: 1. 天津是个什么样的城市？ (a modern metropolis with many Western-style buildings and a beautiful river) 2. 罗文为什么喜欢天津的冬天？ (he had never seen snow) 3. 罗文住的地方怎么样？ (an international students’ dorm with trees and flowers, a small but comfortable room and a night view) 4. 他在哪儿吃饭？ (the dorm’s Western and South Asian restaurants and the Chinese students’ canteen) 5. 他喜欢做饭吗？你怎么知道？ (yes, he thinks buying groceries and cooking are very interesting) 6. 下课以后，他做什么？ (homework, rest, music, reading or chatting) 7. 晚饭以后，他做什么？ (a walk with roommates, review, preview, a video chat with his parents). C. Pair up, discuss and share. (Audio, not included; the answers in brackets are from the text.)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to Passage 1 and answer: 1. Where is Bill? What is he doing there? 2. What is the city like where Bill is staying? Provide three details. B. Pair up and discuss. C. examples.translation: luó wén xiàn zài zhù zài tiān jīn tā tè bié xǐ huān zài tiān jīn zhè ge dà dū shì shēng huó — 1. Luo Wen now lives in Tianjin and especially likes living in this big city, Tianjin. (key mine: 都市)

Around his apartment there are all kinds of buildings, both ancient and modern, with a thousand styles and many forms, not only Chinese-style but also Western-style. (建筑, 现代, 风格, 西式; 周围 is already printed in the book’s text)

lessons.title: 586. Lesson 23 Presentation 3 grammar: 尽管…可是… and …极了
lessons.subtitle: 尽管…，可是… · 可是…却/还是… · 高兴极了 · 快极了 · 好极了

explanations.title: The Construction 尽管……，可是……
explanations.body: The conjunction 尽管 means “although” or “even though” and is a little stronger than 虽然 in emphasizing contrast. It can be followed by 可是, which further emphasizes a shift in meaning in the second part of a statement. In the construction “尽管……，可是……”, 是 can be omitted. In addition, 却 or 还是 can be added after 可是.

examples.text: 尽管天津的冬天特别冷，可是我却很喜欢这儿的冬天。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn tiān jīn de dōng tiān tè bié lěng kě shì wǒ què hěn xǐ huān zhèr de dōng tiān — 1. Although winter in Tianjin is especially cold, I like the winter here.

examples.text: 尽管我没有太多的钱，可是我生活得很幸福。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn wǒ méi yǒu tài duō de qián kě shì wǒ shēng huó de hěn xìng fú — 2. Although I don’t have much money, I live very happily.

examples.text: 尽管她学习很努力，可是她却没有很大的进步。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn tā xué xí hěn nǔ lì kě shì tā què méi yǒu hěn dà de jìn bù — 3. Although she studies very hard, she has not made great progress. (是 can be omitted after 可, and 却 or 还是 can be added after 可是)

examples.text: 尽管中文很难，可是我还是要学。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn zhōng wén hěn nán kě shì wǒ hái shì yào xué — 4. Although Chinese is hard, I still want to learn it.

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and match the statements in Column A with those in Column B to make complete sentences. Write the letters from Column B in the table. Column B: a. 可他还是要去上班。 b. 可是买车的人还是越来越多。 c. 可很多人还是喜欢喝。 d. 可我的发音还是不太好。 e. 可我们还得去操场集合。 f. 可是她的单元考试没有通过。 g. 可是医生让她天天吃降压药。 B. Pair up, read the above sentences aloud and translate them into English. C. Students take turns creating their own sentences using “尽管……，可是……”. The book gives no key; my matching (1–d, 2–f, 3–g, 4–b, 5–a, 6–c, 7–e):

examples.text: 尽管我已经学了四个月的中文了，可我的发音还是不太好。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn wǒ yǐ jīng xué le sì gè yuè de zhōng wén le kě wǒ de fā yīn hái shì bú tài hǎo — 1 → d. Although I have studied Chinese for four months, my pronunciation is still not very good. (key mine)

examples.text: 尽管玛丽学习很努力，可是她的单元考试没有通过。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn mǎ lì xué xí hěn nǔ lì kě shì tā de dān yuán kǎo shì méi yǒu tōng guò — 2 → f. Although Mary studies hard, she didn’t pass her unit test.

examples.text: 尽管有时候我妈妈的血压不太高，可是医生让她天天吃降压药。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn yǒu shí hòu wǒ mā mā de xuè yā bú tài gāo kě shì yī shēng ràng tā tiān tiān chī jiàng yā yào — 3 → g. Although my mother’s blood pressure is not too high sometimes, the doctor has her take blood-pressure medicine every day.

examples.text: 尽管天天开车上班对身体不好，可是买车的人还是越来越多。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn tiān tiān kāi chē shàng bān duì shēn tǐ bù hǎo kě shì mǎi chē de rén hái shì yuè lái yuè duō — 4 → b. Although driving to work every day is bad for health, more and more people still buy cars.

examples.text: 尽管老张今天感觉不舒服，可他还是要去上班。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn lǎo zhāng jīn tiān gǎn jué bù shū fú kě tā hái shì yào qù shàng bān — 5 → a. Although Lao Zhang feels unwell today, he still has to go to work.

examples.text: 尽管喝酒对身体不好，可很多人还是喜欢喝。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn hē jiǔ duì shēn tǐ bù hǎo kě hěn duō rén hái shì xǐ huān hē — 6 → c. Although drinking is bad for health, many people still like to drink.

examples.text: 尽管今天早上会下雨，可我们还得去操场集合。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn jīn tiān zǎo shàng huì xià yǔ kě wǒ men hái děi qù cāo chǎng jí hé — 7 → e. Although it will rain this morning, we still have to go to the playground to assemble. (the book prints no comma after 下雨)

explanations.title: The Expression ……极了
explanations.body: The expression ……极了 is a degree complement and is used to intensify both positive and negative adjectives. It means “extremely” or “very” and is used in spoken, colloquial Chinese. Pattern: Subject + Adjective + 极了. As a degree complement, the structure “adjective + 极了” can be placed after 得: Subject + Verb + 得 + Adjective + 极了.

examples.text: 罗文很喜欢雪，每次下雪，他都高兴极了。
examples.translation: luó wén hěn xǐ huān xuě měi cì xià xuě tā dōu gāo xìng jí le — 1. Luo Wen likes snow very much; every time it snows he is extremely happy.

examples.text: 考试那天，我紧张极了，结果考得不好。
examples.translation: kǎo shì nà tiān wǒ jǐn zhāng jí le jié guǒ kǎo de bù hǎo — 2. On the exam day I was extremely nervous and as a result did not do well.

examples.text: 他跑得快极了。
examples.translation: tā pǎo de kuài jí le — 3. He runs extremely fast. (Verb + 得 + adjective + 极了)

examples.text: 大卫说中文说得好极了。
examples.translation: dà wèi shuō zhōng wén shuō de hǎo jí le — 4. David speaks Chinese extremely well.

examples.text: 这个小孩可爱极了。
examples.translation: zhè ge xiǎo hái kě ài jí le — The book’s example for Activity 2: This child is extremely cute.

examples.text: 我爷爷今年已经八十九岁了，可他的身体棒极了。
examples.translation: wǒ yé yé jīn nián yǐ jīng bā shí jiǔ suì le kě tā de shēn tǐ bàng jí le — Activity 2C’s example: My grandfather is already eighty-nine this year but his health is extremely good. (the book writes 89 in digits)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Pair up and talk about the images using the expression “……极了” and write your comments beneath each image (six photographs: not included). Example: 这个小孩可爱极了。 B. Share your group work with the class. C. Pair up and discuss your family members using ……极了. Each partner says at least three sentences. Example: 我爷爷今年已经八十九岁了，可他的身体棒极了。

lessons.title: 587. Lesson 23 Presentation 3 grammar: 有 and 是 for existence, and compound-complex sentences
lessons.subtitle: 旁边有一个公园 · 旁边是景山公园 · 孩子前边有个人 · 递进 转折 因果 · 不仅…而且… 虽然…但是…

explanations.title: The Existence Words 有 and 是
explanations.body: 有 is used to indicate the existence of someone or something in a particular place: Location Word + 有 + Noun/Noun Phrase/Someone. 是 is used to indicate existence when we know there is someone or something in a particular place, but we want to know specifically who the person or what the thing is: Location Word + 是 + Noun/Noun Phrase/Someone. 有 only denotes what exists in a certain place, while a sentence that uses 是 not only indicates that a thing exists in a certain place, but also further specifies what that thing is. The object of a sentence indicating existence with 有 is usually a general reference, while the object of a sentence indicating existence with 是 is usually a specific reference.

examples.text: 我家旁边有一个公园。
examples.translation: wǒ jiā páng biān yǒu yí gè gōng yuán — 1. There is a park next to my house. (有 only denotes what exists in a place)

examples.text: 我家旁边是一个公园。
examples.translation: wǒ jiā páng biān shì yí gè gōng yuán — 2. Next to my house is a park. (是 also specifies what it is)

examples.text: 我家旁边有一个公园。是什么公园？是景山公园。
examples.translation: wǒ jiā páng biān yǒu yí gè gōng yuán shì shén me gōng yuán shì jǐng shān gōng yuán — A: There is a park next to my house. B: What park is it? A: (Next to my house) is Jingshan Park.

examples.text: 孩子前边有个人。
examples.translation: hái zi qián biān yǒu gè rén — Right: There is a person in front of the child.

examples.text: 孩子前边有妈妈。
examples.translation: hái zi qián biān yǒu mā mā — Wrong: with 有 the object is usually a general reference, not “the mother”.

examples.text: 孩子前边是妈妈。
examples.translation: hái zi qián biān shì mā mā — Right: In front of the child is the mother.

examples.text: 妈妈在孩子前面。
examples.translation: mā mā zài hái zi qián miàn — Right: The mother is in front of the child.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Reading and Speaking)
explanations.body: Pair up and mark the following statements as either True or False. Correct any false statements and explain why they are false. The book prints the six statements without a key; my answers and corrections:

examples.text: 学校门口有一辆小汽车。
examples.translation: xué xiào mén kǒu yǒu yí liàng xiǎo qì chē — 1. 学校门口是一辆小汽车 — false. Correction (mine): 有, because the car is a general reference: There is a car at the school gate.

examples.text: 百货大楼前面有一个广场。
examples.translation: bǎi huò dà lóu qián miàn yǒu yí gè guǎng chǎng — 2. 百货大楼前面有一个广场 — true: There is a square in front of the department store.

examples.text: 我家房子前面有一棵树。
examples.translation: wǒ jiā fáng zi qián miàn yǒu yì kē shù — 3. 我家房子前面是一棵树 — false. Correction (mine): 有: There is a tree in front of my house.

examples.text: 我家的树上有两只小鸟。
examples.translation: wǒ jiā de shù shàng yǒu liǎng zhī xiǎo niǎo — 4. 我家的树上是两只小鸟 — false. Correction (mine): 有: There are two little birds in my tree.

examples.text: 图书馆旁边是一片小树林。
examples.translation: tú shū guǎn páng biān shì yí piàn xiǎo shù lín — 5. 图书馆旁边是一片小树林 — true: Next to the library is a small wood. (key mine)

examples.text: 这个包里有手机和钱包。
examples.translation: zhè ge bāo lǐ yǒu shǒu jī hé qián bāo — 6. A: 这个包里有什么东西？ B: 这个包里有手机和钱包。 — true: What is in this bag? There is a phone and a wallet.

explanations.title: Activity 4 (Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Translate the following sentences into Chinese by using 有 or 是: 1. There are a lot of Chinese newspapers in the library. 2. Next to the bedroom is a bathroom. 3. Who is on your left? 4. There is a bank across from the post office. 5. There is a lot of western-style architecture in Tianjin. 6. Across from the supermarket is a coffee shop. B. Pair up and share your translations and explain why you used 有 or 是. My Chinese:

examples.text: 图书馆里有很多中文报纸。
examples.translation: tú shū guǎn lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhōng wén bào zhǐ — 1. There are a lot of Chinese newspapers in the library. (有; Activity 4, key mine)

examples.text: 卧室旁边是一个洗手间。
examples.translation: wò shì páng biān shì yí gè xǐ shǒu jiān — 2. Next to the bedroom is a bathroom. (是)

examples.text: 你左边是谁？
examples.translation: nǐ zuǒ biān shì shuí — 3. Who is on your left? (是)

examples.text: 邮局对面有一个银行。
examples.translation: yóu jú duì miàn yǒu yí gè yín háng — 4. There is a bank across from the post office. (有)

examples.text: 天津有很多西式建筑。
examples.translation: tiān jīn yǒu hěn duō xī shì jiàn zhù — 5. There is a lot of western-style architecture in Tianjin. (有)

examples.text: 超市对面是一个咖啡店。
examples.translation: chāo shì duì miàn shì yí gè kā fēi diàn — 6. Across from the supermarket is a coffee shop. (是)

explanations.title: The Compound-Complex Sentences 多重复句
explanations.body: The compound-complex sentence 多重复句 has at least two sentences. There are several types of compound-complex sentences in Chinese that indicate different relationships such as progressive relation (递进复句), transitional relation (转折复句) and causative relation (因果复句) etc.

rows: 不但/不仅…，而且/还/也/甚至还…
tables.title: The compound-complex sentence 多重复句: three types

examples.text: 刚开始是有点儿难，可是我很有兴趣，就不觉得那么难了，而且越学越爱学。
examples.translation: gāng kāi shǐ shì yǒu diǎnr nán kě shì wǒ hěn yǒu xìng qù jiù bù jué de nà me nán le ér qiě yuè xué yuè ài xué — 1. [转折关系] 可是…就不觉得那么难了 + [递进关系] 而且…: At the beginning it was a bit hard, but I was very interested and did not find it so hard, and moreover the more I learned the more I loved learning.

examples.text: 尽管这儿的冬天特别冷，可是我却很喜欢，因为我没见过雪，所以每次下雪我都高兴极了。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn zhèr de dōng tiān tè bié lěng kě shì wǒ què hěn xǐ huān yīn wèi wǒ méi jiàn guò xuě suǒ yǐ měi cì xià xuě wǒ dōu gāo xìng jí le — 2. [转折关系] 尽管…可是…却… + [因果关系] 因为…所以…: Although winter here is especially cold, I like it, because I had never seen snow, so every time it snows I am extremely happy.

explanations.title: Activities 5 and 6
explanations.body: Activity 5 (Reading, Writing and Speaking): A. Read the sentences and highlight the conjunctions. Mark them with a progressive relation (递进复句), a transitional relation (转折复句) or a causative relation (因果复句). B. Pair up and explain the relationship between the clauses in each sentence. My answers:

examples.text: 罗文的房间不太大，但是很舒适，而且晚上可以看到城市的夜景。
examples.translation: luó wén de fáng jiān bú tài dà dàn shì hěn shū shì ér qiě wǎn shàng kě yǐ kàn dào chéng shì de yè jǐng — 1. 但是 = transitional; 而且 = progressive. Luo Wen’s room is not very big but very comfortable, and also in the evening he can see the city’s night view. (Activity 5, mine)

examples.text: 尽管“老外”是很友好的称呼，但是我还是不喜欢别人叫我“老外”，因为他们用“老外”这个词的时候，就指着我，让别人看我，让我感觉很不舒服。
examples.translation: jǐn guǎn lǎo wài shì hěn yǒu hǎo de chēng hū dàn shì wǒ hái shì bù xǐ huān bié rén jiào wǒ lǎo wài yīn wèi tā men yòng lǎo wài zhè ge cí de shí hòu jiù zhǐ zhe wǒ ràng bié rén kàn wǒ ràng wǒ gǎn jué hěn bù shū fú — 2. 尽管…但是 = transitional; 因为 = causative. Although “laowai” is a friendly term, I still don’t like being called “laowai”, because when they use the word they point at me and make others look at me, which makes me feel very uncomfortable.

examples.text: 在西方国家，人们不仅不问别人的年龄，而且也不问赚多少钱，但是在中国，大家都喜欢问，不过这是中国人向你表示友好的一种方式。
examples.translation: zài xī fāng guó jiā rén men bù jǐn bú wèn bié rén de nián líng ér qiě yě bú wèn zhuàn duō shǎo qián dàn shì zài zhōng guó dà jiā dōu xǐ huān wèn bú guò zhè shì zhōng guó rén xiàng nǐ biǎo shì yǒu hǎo de yì zhǒng fāng shì — 3. 不仅…而且 = progressive; 但是 and 不过 = transitional. In Western countries people not only don’t ask others’ ages but also don’t ask how much they earn, but in China everyone likes to ask; however, it is a way for Chinese to show you friendliness.

explanations.title: Activity 6 (Listening, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to six compound-complex sentences and translate them into English. B. Pair up and check your translations with your partner. Discuss the functions of the compound-complex sentences. C. With your partner, create three compound-complex sentences by using the following patterns or conjunctions: 不但/不仅…，而且/还/也/甚至还…; 虽然/尽管…，但是/却/可是…; 因为/由于…，所以…. D. Share your team’s work with the class. (Audio, not included.)

exercises.prompt: Which word indicates mere existence in a place?
Which word also specifies what the thing is?
Which sentence is correct for “There is a car at the school gate”?
options: 学校门口有一辆小汽车
学校门口有是一辆小汽车

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is correct for “Who is on your left?”
exercises.explanation: Asking for a specific person → 是.

exercises.prompt: Which type is 不仅…而且…?
Which type is 虽然…但是…?
Which type is 因为…所以…?
我家旁边有一个公园。——___什么公园？

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. Listen to a recording about an American student and write the main idea. B. Transcribe the missing words in Pinyin and translate them into English: 1. 力马克是一个…的美国年轻人。他的老家在美国…州的…。 2. 学了中文以后，他慢慢地对中国的…和文化有了兴趣，常常看中国的…和…。 C. Pair up and discuss. D. Listen again and answer: 1. 力马克除了会中文，他还会哪种外语？你怎么知道的？ 2. 是什么事情让他开始学中文的？ 3. 学了中文以后，他对什么感兴趣？他喜欢看什么？ 4. 来中国学中文以后，他的中文水平怎么样？ 5. 大家说马克的中文很好，他是怎么回答的？ 6. 马克每天都把自己的生活和学习情况写下来，这样做有什么好处？ E. Discuss and share. F. Discuss: 1. 力马克在学中文以前学过日语，这对他学汉语有什么帮助？ 2. 力马克喜欢中国历史和哲学，也喜欢看中国新闻和电影，你觉得这对他学中文有什么好处？ 3. 力马克每天都把自己的生活和学习写下来。你是不是也这样？你觉得这么做对你学中文有什么帮助？ (Audio, not included.)

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Writing and Speaking)
explanations.body: A. In two groups, read the following news report about Diyala from the Republic of Mali. Group A reads Paragraphs 1 and 2 and Group B reads Paragraphs 3 and 4. Summarize each passage and note any unfamiliar words. B. Pair up with a member of the other group. Exchange your summary and discuss the meanings of any unfamiliar words. C. Discuss: 1. 为什么迪亚拉在中国火了？ 2. 为了学好中医，他是怎么做的？ 3. 学中医对他来说难不难？你是怎么知道的？ 4. 他是一个外国人，病人喜欢让他看病吗？ 5. 现在他的生活情况怎么样？以后有什么打算?

examples.text: 在四川成都一家中医医院，一位黑人中医突然火了起来。他叫迪亚拉，来自非洲马里共和国。他皮肤黑黑的，牙齿很白，穿着医院的白衣服，口袋中插着一支笔，很熟练地给病人诊脉、针灸。
examples.translation: zài sì chuān chéng dū yì jiā zhōng yī yī yuàn yí wèi hēi rén zhōng yī tū rán huǒ le qǐ lái tā jiào dí yà lā lái zì fēi zhōu mǎ lǐ gòng hé guó tā pí fū hēi hēi de yá chǐ hěn bái chuān zhe yī yuàn de bái yī fú kǒu dài zhōng chā zhe yì zhī bǐ hěn shú liàn de gěi bìng rén zhěn mài zhēn jiǔ — Paragraph 1: In a Chinese medicine hospital in Chengdu, Sichuan, a Black doctor of Chinese medicine suddenly became famous. His name is Diyala and he is from the Republic of Mali in Africa. His skin is dark and his teeth are very white; he wears the hospital’s white uniform with a pen in his pocket and very skillfully takes patients’ pulses and does acupuncture. (translation mine; adapted in the book from an article by the reporter Guo Linlin of Beijing Youth Daily; the book glosses 迪亚拉, 皮肤, 诊脉 and 针灸 in pinyin, which I left out)

examples.text: 迪亚拉在一九八四年从马里医学院毕业后就来到中国学习中医。在中国的三十多年中，他先后在北京、广州和成都等城市学习，获得了博士后学位。他是中国第一个有中医学博士的外国人。为了学习中医，迪亚拉阅读了很多中国的古书，翻译汉语词典，听中国古代的戏剧，逛博物馆等。他不仅精通中医，还了解中国文化，而且汉字写得也特别好。
examples.translation: dí yà lā zài yī jiǔ bā sì nián cóng mǎ lǐ yī xué yuàn bì yè hòu jiù lái dào zhōng guó xué xí zhōng yī zài zhōng guó de sān shí duō nián zhōng tā xiān hòu zài běi jīng guǎng zhōu hé chéng dū děng chéng shì xué xí huò dé le bó shì hòu xué wèi tā shì zhōng guó dì yī gè yǒu zhōng yī xué bó shì de wài guó rén wèi le xué xí zhōng yī dí yà lā yuè dú le hěn duō zhōng guó de gǔ shū fān yì hàn yǔ cí diǎn tīng zhōng guó gǔ dài de xì jù guàng bó wù guǎn děng tā bù jǐn jīng tōng zhōng yī hái liǎo jiě zhōng guó wén huà ér qiě hàn zì xiě de yě tè bié hǎo — Paragraph 2: After graduating from the Mali medical school in 1984, Diyala came to China to study Chinese medicine. In more than thirty years in China he studied successively in Beijing, Guangzhou, Chengdu and other cities and obtained a post-doctoral degree. He is the first foreigner in China with a doctorate in Chinese medicine. To study Chinese medicine, Diyala read many ancient Chinese books, translated Chinese dictionaries, listened to ancient Chinese drama and visited museums. He is not only proficient in Chinese medicine but also understands Chinese culture, and he writes Chinese characters especially well too. (mine; the book writes 1984 in digits)

examples.text: 最近，北京青年报记者采访了他。记者问他在中国学中医有没有感到很难。他说，“为了能看懂中医的古书，我学了一年半的汉语。除了和中国同学一起上课外，我自己还要努力学习。我买了一些工具书，背或者翻译这些书，不懂就去问老师，和老中医交流学习。”记者又问他有没有病人不愿意让他看病或者不相信他。迪亚拉说，“刚开始工作的时候，很少有病人找我看病，十天才看过两个病人。后来，大家知道我看病很好，我才开始变得每天都很忙。”
examples.translation: zuì jìn běi jīng qīng nián bào jì zhě cǎi fǎng le tā jì zhě wèn tā zài zhōng guó xué zhōng yī yǒu méi yǒu gǎn dào hěn nán tā shuō wèi le néng kàn dǒng zhōng yī de gǔ shū wǒ xué le yì nián bàn de hàn yǔ chú le hé zhōng guó tóng xué yì qǐ shàng kè wài wǒ zì jǐ hái yào nǔ lì xué xí wǒ mǎi le yì xiē gōng jù shū bèi huò zhě fān yì zhè xiē shū bù dǒng jiù qù wèn lǎo shī hé lǎo zhōng yī jiāo liú xué xí jì zhě yòu wèn tā yǒu méi yǒu bìng rén bú yuàn yì ràng tā kàn bìng huò zhě bù xiāng xìn tā dí yà lā shuō gāng kāi shǐ gōng zuò de shí hòu hěn shǎo yǒu bìng rén zhǎo wǒ kàn bìng shí tiān cái kàn guò liǎng gè bìng rén hòu lái dà jiā zhī dào wǒ kàn bìng hěn hǎo wǒ cái kāi shǐ biàn de měi tiān dōu hěn máng — Paragraph 3: Recently a reporter from Beijing Youth Daily interviewed him. The reporter asked whether he found it very hard to study Chinese medicine in China. He said, “To be able to read the ancient books of Chinese medicine I studied Chinese for a year and a half. Besides attending class with my Chinese classmates I also had to study hard myself. I bought some reference books, memorized or translated them, asked teachers when I didn’t understand, and exchanged ideas with old Chinese doctors.” The reporter also asked whether any patients were unwilling to let him treat them or didn’t trust him. Diyala said, “When I first started working very few patients came to me; in ten days I saw only two patients. Later everyone knew that I treat patients well and only then did I start to be busy every day.” (mine)

examples.text: 现在，迪亚拉已经在成都结婚了。他和太太有两个孩子。他打算在非洲成立一个中医治疗中心，教那里的医生用中医给病人看病。

He and his wife have two children. He plans to set up a Chinese medicine treatment center in Africa and teach the doctors there to treat patients with Chinese medicine. (mine)

lessons.title: 591. Lesson 23 Area Studies: International Students in China
lessons.subtitle: 来华留学生 · 学生人数 · 来源国 · 最受欢迎的地方 · 为什么选择中国

explanations.title: International Students in China (1)
explanations.body: The number of international students studying in China has been increasing over the past decade, along with the number of foreigners working and traveling in China. According to the Chinese Ministry of Education statistics, in 2018 a total of 492,185 foreign students from 196 countries studied in 1,004 higher education institutions in 31 regions across the country. This is an increase of 3,013 people over 2017, just 0.62%. (The above data does not include Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan.) In 2016, China was the third largest receiver of international students globally, with 442,773 international students. By 2018 this number grew to 492,185 (10.49% growth from 2017). In 2018 China was the most popular country in Asia for international students and the second most popular in the world. The number of international students in China has grown steadily since 2003, with no impact from the rise of terrorism or the 2008 global financial crisis. In contrast to the reported decline of enrollment in the U.S. and the UK, China’s international student population continues to increase. China is now the leading destination for Anglophone African students. (A chart of international students in China, 2003–2017, from Wikipedia, is not included.)

explanations.title: (2) Statistics by country in 2018
explanations.body: Statistics of International Students by Continent in 2018. All African countries grouped together: 81,562 students (2017: 61,594), 16.57% of the total. By country (rank in 2018: country, students in 2018, students in 2017, percent of total in 2018, rank in 2017): 1. South Korea, 50,600 (70,540), 10.28%, rank 1. 2. Thailand, 28,608 (23,044), 5.81%, rank 2. 3. Pakistan, 28,023 (18,626), 5.69%, rank 3. 4. India, 23,192 (18,717), 4.71%, rank 5. 5. United States, 20,996 (23,838), 4.27%, rank 4. 6. Russia, 19,239 (17,971), 3.91%, rank 6. 7. Indonesia, 15,050 (14,714), 3.06%, rank 8. 8. Laos, 14,645, 2.98%. 9. Japan, 14,230 (13,595), 2.89%, rank 7. 10. Kazakhstan, 11,784 (13,996), 2.39%, rank 9. 11. Vietnam, 11,299 (10,639), 2.30%. 12. Bangladesh, 10,735, 2.18%. 13. France, 10,695, 2.17%. 14. Mongolia, 10,158, 2.06%. 15. Malaysia, 9,479, 1.93%. (Source: Wikipedia; the book’s printed figure for South Korea’s 2018 total, 50,600, is smaller than its 2017 figure of 70,540, as printed.)

explanations.title: (3) Top locations, degrees and scholarships
explanations.body: The Top 10 Locations for International Students: 1. Beijing 80,786; 2. Shanghai 61,400; 3. Jiangsu 45,778; 4. Zhejiang 38,190; 5. Liaoning 27,879; 6. Tianjin 23,691; 7. Guangdong 22,034; 8. Hubei 21,371; 9. Yunnan 19,311; 10. Shandong 19,078. Provinces (regions) with more than 10,000 people: Guangxi 15,217; Sichuan 13,990; Heilongjiang 13,429; Shaanxi 12,919; Fujian 10,340. The total number of foreign students receiving academic education in China is 258,122, accounting for 52.44% of the total number of foreign students in China, an increase of 16,579 over 2017, and an increase of 6.86% over the same period last year. There are 85,062 foreign masters and doctoral students, an increase of 12.28% over 2017. Of these there are 25,618 doctoral students and 59,444 masters students. In 2018 there were 234,063 non-degree international students. There are 63,041 international students assisted by the Chinese government scholarship, accounting for 12.81% of the total number of students in China, and 429,144 international students funded by other resources, accounting for 87.19%.

explanations.title: (4) Why China
explanations.body: Various factors combine to make China a desirable destination for international students. 1. China boasts a significant number of world-class universities. 2. Universities in China are attractive research centers. 3. It costs less than studying in developed countries. 4. There is a huge diversity of universities and programs. 5. There are more career opportunities due to China’s growing economic strength. 6. Many graduate and postgraduate programs are offered in English. 7. A huge number of scholarships are on offer from the Chinese government. China is openly pursuing a policy of growing its soft power globally, by way of persuasion and attraction. Attracting international students, especially by way of scholarships, is one effective way of growing this influence. References: www.moe.gov.cn; International Students in China.

explanations.title: Activity 2 (Reading, Speaking and Listening)
explanations.body: A. Form groups of three. Your teacher will show one character (from the table) at a time. Each group will think of as many vocabulary/phrases that contain that character as they can. The teacher will set a time to complete the task. The team that compiles the most vocabulary wins. B. Read each set of words below and highlight the words that share similar meanings (synonyms) or have opposite meanings (antonyms). The book gives no key; my answers are in the next card. C. Using the words in Part B, select three non-answer words and explain the meaning of that phrase in your own words, without giving away the exact wording. Your partner will guess which phrase you are suggesting. Students take turns. For example: 做这件事的时候，有时候你需要验血、验尿 — answer: 体检.

tables.title: Activity 2A: words that contain one character (the book gives only the four characters; the words are mine, mostly from the Unit 4 lessons)

examples.text: 交流，交通，表达，填表
examples.translation: jiāo liú jiāo tōng biǎo dá tián biǎo — 1. Mine: 交流 and 表达 are close in meaning (communicate / express); none of these is the opposite of another.

examples.text: 休息，体会，体检，体验
examples.translation: xiū xī tǐ huì tǐ jiǎn tǐ yàn — 2. Mine: 体会 and 体验 are close in meaning (to experience, to appreciate).

examples.text: 运行，锻炼，健身，空运
examples.translation: yùn xíng duàn liàn jiàn shēn kōng yùn — 3. Mine: 锻炼 and 健身 are close in meaning (to exercise); 运行 means to run (a service) and 空运 is air transport.

examples.text: 进步，散步，发展，出发
examples.translation: jìn bù sàn bù fā zhǎn chū fā — 4. Mine: 进步 and 发展 are close in meaning (progress / develop); 散步 is to take a walk and 出发 is to set off.

examples.text: 增加，提供，提取，减少
examples.translation: zēng jiā tí gōng tí qǔ jiǎn shǎo — 5. Mine: 增加 and 减少 are opposites (increase / decrease); 提供 provides and 提取 withdraws.

examples.text: 空闲，繁忙，舒服，适合
examples.translation: kòng xián fán máng shū fú shì hé — 6. Mine: 空闲 and 繁忙 are opposites (free / busy); 舒服 and 适合 are both about being comfortable or fitting.

explanations.title: Activity 3 (Listening, Reading and Speaking)

lessons.title: 596. Lesson 24 Presentation Activities Review: translating sentences, part 1
lessons.subtitle: 国庆长假 · 高铁平稳 · 减速 · 贺卡 · 特快专递 · 万能手 · 发烧发得很厉害

explanations.title: Activity 1 (Speaking, Writing, and Reading), items 1 to 8
explanations.body: A. Pair up. Take turns translating the sentences to your partner in Chinese. Some key expressions have been provided. B. Go over the suggested answer provided by the teacher and refine your sentences. The book prints the English sentences and key expressions only; the Chinese sentences below are mine, built from the key expressions, with numbers spelled out in characters.

examples.text: 儿子，国庆长假快到了，你陪我和你妈回老家住几天，怎么样？
examples.translation: ér zi guó qìng cháng jià kuài dào le nǐ péi wǒ hé nǐ mā huí lǎo jiā zhù jǐ tiān zěn me yàng — 1A. Son, National Day holiday is coming. How about you accompany me and your mom back to our hometown for a few days? (国庆长假，陪)

examples.text: 我早就订好高铁票了。反正我们每年国庆都回去看奶奶。
examples.translation: wǒ zǎo jiù dìng hǎo gāo tiě piào le fǎn zhèng wǒ men měi nián guó qìng dōu huí qù kàn nǎi nǎi — 1B. I booked high-speed train tickets a long time ago. We go and see grandma every National Day anyway. (早就，反正)

examples.text: 高铁开得这么平稳，如果列车长不告诉我们，我们根本不知道现在的时速是三百五十公里。
examples.translation: gāo tiě kāi de zhè me píng wěn rú guǒ liè chē zhǎng bú gào sù wǒ men wǒ men gēn běn bù zhī dào xiàn zài de shí sù shì sān bǎi wǔ shí gōng lǐ — 2. The high-speed train was traveling so steadily that I’d have had no idea it was going 350 km an hour if the conductor hadn’t told us. (平稳，如果，根本)

examples.text: 列车减速运行了五分钟，列车长才通知我们。她还说，列车一定会准时到达上海。
examples.translation: liè chē jiǎn sù yùn xíng le wǔ fēn zhōng liè chē zhǎng cái tōng zhī wǒ men tā hái shuō liè chē yí dìng huì zhǔn shí dào dá shàng hǎi — 3. The train conductor only informed us of the slowdown after the train had been running at a reduced speed for five minutes. She also said that the train would arrive in Shanghai on time for sure. (减速，才，一定)

examples.text: 她不但给我寄了生日贺卡，而且还寄了一份礼物，都是用特快专递寄的。
examples.translation: tā bú dàn gěi wǒ jì le shēng rì hè kǎ ér qiě hái jì le yí fèn lǐ wù dōu shì yòng tè kuài zhuān dì jì de — 4. Not only did she send me a birthday card, but also a present. And she sent them by express mail. (不但…而且…)

examples.text: 多长时间能寄到，要看你怎么寄。如果寄特快专递，最多三天就能寄到，不过那样寄很贵。
examples.translation: duō cháng shí jiān néng jì dào yào kàn nǐ zěn me jì rú guǒ jì tè kuài zhuān dì zuì duō sān tiān jiù néng jì dào bú guò nà yàng jì hěn guì — 5. How long it will take to arrive depends on how you are going to send it. It will take three days, at most, by express mail, but it would be expensive to send it that way. (寄到，要看，最多，那样寄，不过)

examples.text: 邮局每天办理很多信件和包裹业务，另外还办理交费等业务，所以被很多人称为“万能手”。
examples.translation: yóu jú měi tiān bàn lǐ hěn duō xìn jiàn hé bāo guǒ yè wù lìng wài hái bàn lǐ jiāo fèi děng yè wù suǒ yǐ bèi hěn duō rén chēng wéi wàn néng shǒu — 6. The post office handles a lot of mail and packages every day. Besides this they also handle utility payments and other business. Therefore, they are called a “Jack of all trades” by many people. (办理，另外，被)

examples.text: 吃了药以后，如果发烧还是这么厉害，请再来。下次挂普通门诊就行了，别忘了带病历卡。
examples.translation: chī le yào yǐ hòu rú guǒ fā shāo hái shì zhè me lì hài qǐng zài lái xià cì guà pǔ tōng mén zhěn jiù xíng le bié wàng le dài bìng lì kǎ — 7. After taking the medicine, please come back if your fever is still as bad as it is now. Just register for the regular outpatient clinic next time, and don’t forget to bring your registration card. (这么厉害，下次，普通门诊，别) (病历卡 for “registration card” is mine)

examples.text: 你发烧发得很厉害，看起来是得了流感。你先吃点儿药，多喝水，好好休息。
examples.translation: nǐ fā shāo fā de hěn lì hài kàn qǐ lái shì dé le liú gǎn nǐ xiān chī diǎnr yào duō hē shuǐ hǎo hǎo xiū xī — 8. Your fever is bad, and it looks like you’ve got the flu. Take some medicine first. You need to drink a lot of water and get plenty of rest. (发烧发得…，看起来，先，多，好好)

Which expression means “not at all (with a negative)”?
exercises.explanation: 根本不知道: no idea at all.

lessons.title: 597. Lesson 24 Presentation Activities Review: translating sentences, part 2
lessons.subtitle: 发起烧来 · 迷路 · 沿着 一直 过 拐 · 位于 仅次于 · 听着听着就 · 吃着吃着就 · 好极了

explanations.title: Activity 1 (continued), items 9 to 15
explanations.body: The book prints the English sentences and key expressions only; the Chinese sentences below are mine, built from the key expressions.

examples.text: 半夜她发起烧来，肚子也疼，还恶心。我赶紧开车把她送到了医院急诊室。
examples.translation: bàn yè tā fā qǐ shāo lái dǔ zi yě téng hái ě xīn wǒ gǎn jǐn kāi chē bǎ tā sòng dào le yī yuàn jí zhěn shì — 9. She started to have a fever in the middle of the night, and she also felt stomach pain and nausea. I quickly drove her to the hospital for emergency treatment. (V+起+O+来，把，送到)

examples.text: 请问，我迷路了，您能告诉我到火车站怎么走吗？
examples.translation: qǐng wèn wǒ mí lù le nín néng gào sù wǒ dào huǒ chē zhàn zěn me zǒu ma — 10A. Excuse me, I cannot find my way. Can you tell me how to get to the railway station? (迷路，到…怎么走)

examples.text: 您从这儿坐往北开的地铁，坐三站下车，然后往东走。过了两个十字路口，往左拐就到了。
examples.translation: nín cóng zhèr zuò wǎng běi kāi de dì tiě zuò sān zhàn xià chē rán hòu wǎng dōng zǒu guò le liǎng gè shí zì lù kǒu wǎng zuǒ guǎi jiù dào le — 10B. Take the north-bound subway from here, get off at the third stop, then go east. Turn left after passing two intersections, and you will be there. (往，过，拐)

examples.text: 我再说一遍：出了富兰克林门，沿着街往下坡走，过了第三个红绿灯往左拐，一直走到头就到了。我说得对吗？
examples.translation: wǒ zài shuō yí biàn chū le fù lán kè lín mén yán zhe jiē wǎng xià pō zǒu guò le dì sān gè hóng lǜ dēng wǎng zuǒ guǎi yì zhí zǒu dào tóu jiù dào le wǒ shuō de duì ma — 11. Let me repeat. Go downhill along the street after you go out the Franklin Gate, make a left turn at the third traffic light, then go to the end of the street and I’ll be there. Did I say it right? (沿着，一直，过，拐，头 (end)，说得)

examples.text: 旧金山国际机场位于旧金山的南边，是美国西部第二大机场，仅次于洛杉矶国际机场。
examples.translation: jiù jīn shān guó jì jī chǎng wèi yú jiù jīn shān de nán biān shì měi guó xī bù dì èr dà jī chǎng jǐn cì yú luò shān jī guó jì jī chǎng — 12. San Francisco International Airport is located on the south side of San Francisco. It is the second largest airport in the western United States, second only to Los Angeles International Airport. (位于，仅次于)

examples.text: 要提高汉语听力，你需要多听真实的语言材料。一开始有些材料你可能听不懂，但是慢慢地，听着听着你就听懂了。
examples.translation: yào tí gāo hàn yǔ tīng lì nǐ xū yào duō tīng zhēn shí de yǔ yán cái liào yì kāi shǐ yǒu xiē cái liào nǐ kě néng tīng bù dǒng dàn shì màn màn de tīng zhe tīng zhe nǐ jiù tīng dǒng le — 13. To improve your Chinese listening comprehension you need to listen to a lot of authentic material. You may have difficulty understanding some material in the beginning, but slowly, as you keep listening, you will understand it. (听力，慢慢地，听着听着就)

examples.text: 虽然四川菜对我来说很辣，但是吃着吃着就习惯了。我已经学着做过好几次四川菜了。
examples.translation: suī rán sì chuān cài duì wǒ lái shuō hěn là dàn shì chī zhe chī zhe jiù xí guàn le wǒ yǐ jīng xué zhe zuò guò hǎo jǐ cì sì chuān cài le — 14. Although Sichuan dishes were very spicy to me, I became used to it as I kept eating them. I have tried making Sichuan dishes several times. (虽然…但是…，吃着吃着就，学着)

examples.text: 她不但喜欢说中文，而且喜欢唱中文歌。她的中文歌唱得好极了！
examples.translation: tā bú dàn xǐ huān shuō zhōng wén ér qiě xǐ huān chàng zhōng wén gē tā de zhōng wén gē chàng de hǎo jí le — 15. Not only does she like to speak Chinese, but she also likes to sing Chinese songs. She sings Chinese songs amazingly well! (不但…而且…，极了)

explanations.body: A. Guess the meaning of the following expressions. B. Listen to the three passages and match them with the pictures below (audio and three pictures, not included). C. Form groups of three. Each partner listens to one dialog, prepares a summary and completes the table (大意: 第一篇, 第二篇, 第三篇). D. Share your work in group and take notes in the above table of the other two passages. Ask each of your partners at least three questions. E. Read the scripts below and check your summary and notes.

tables.title: Activity 2A: guess the meaning of the following expressions (meanings mine)

explanations.title: Script Passage 1: the train manager’s announcement
explanations.body: The book writes G80 and the digits as numerals; here they are spelled out and the letter is full-width. The translations are mine.

examples.text: 各位旅客，您好！我是本次列车的列车长马小明。欢迎您乘坐Ｇ八十从广州开往北京的高速列车。北京和广州之间的高铁是目前中国线路最长，也是经过的省最多的南北方向的高速铁路。京广铁路全线是二零一二年十二月建成通车的。
examples.translation: gè wèi lǚ kè nín hǎo wǒ shì běn cì liè chē de liè chē zhǎng mǎ xiǎo míng huān yíng nín chéng zuò bā shí cóng guǎng zhōu kāi wǎng běi jīng de gāo sù liè chē běi jīng hé guǎng zhōu zhī jiān de gāo tiě shì mù qián zhōng guó xiàn lù zuì cháng yě shì jīng guò de shěng zuì duō de nán běi fāng xiàng de gāo sù tiě lù jīng guǎng tiě lù quán xiàn shì èr líng yī èr nián shí èr yuè jiàn chéng tōng chē de — Script Passage 1, paragraph 1: Dear passengers, hello! I am Ma Xiaoming, the train manager of this train. Welcome aboard the G80 high-speed train from Guangzhou to Beijing. The high-speed railway between Beijing and Guangzhou is currently the longest line in China and also the north-south high-speed railway that passes through the most provinces. The whole Beijing–Guangzhou railway was completed and opened to traffic in December 2012. (the book writes G80 and the date in digits; translation mine)

examples.text: 我们的列车今天早上七点离开广州，将在今天下午五点零一分到达北京。沿途一共运行两千三百公里，平均每小时车速是二百八十七公里。
examples.translation: wǒ men de liè chē jīn tiān zǎo shàng qī diǎn lí kāi guǎng zhōu jiāng zài jīn tiān xià wǔ wǔ diǎn líng yī fēn dào dá běi jīng yán tú yí gòng yùn xíng liǎng qiān sān bǎi gōng lǐ píng jūn měi xiǎo shí chē sù shì èr bǎi bā shí qī gōng lǐ — Paragraph 2: Our train left Guangzhou at seven this morning and will arrive in Beijing at 5:01 this afternoon. Along the way it runs a total of 2,300 kilometers, with an average speed of 287 kilometers per hour. (mine)

examples.text: 各位旅客，本次列车提供免费无线上网服务。如果您需要用餐，餐车就在第五号车厢。另外，每节车厢有热水器，您可以用热水泡茶或咖啡。服务员也给您准备好了各种饮料和零食，每隔半小时售货车会到每个车厢，欢迎旅客们购买。
examples.translation: gè wèi lǚ kè běn cì liè chē tí gōng miǎn fèi wú xiàn shàng wǎng fú wù rú guǒ nín xū yào yòng cān cān chē jiù zài dì wǔ hào chē xiāng lìng wài měi jié chē xiāng yǒu rè shuǐ qì nín kě yǐ yòng rè shuǐ pào chá huò kā fēi fú wù yuán yě gěi nín zhǔn bèi hǎo le gè zhǒng yǐn liào hé líng shí měi gé bàn xiǎo shí shòu huò chē huì dào měi gè chē xiāng huān yíng lǚ kè men gòu mǎi — Paragraph 3: Dear passengers, this train offers free wireless internet. If you need a meal, the dining car is in car number five. In addition, each car has a water heater, and you can use the hot water to make tea or coffee. The attendants have also prepared all kinds of drinks and snacks for you, and every half hour the sales cart will come to each car; passengers are welcome to buy. (mine)

explanations.title: Script Passage 2: Lao Lin, a postman
explanations.body: Numbers are spelled out. The translations are mine.

examples.text: 我姓林，你就叫我老林吧。我十七岁起就在邮局工作，每天骑着自行车出去送信送包裹。那时的邮局只寄信、寄包裹、打长途电话。今年我五十七岁了，过去的这三十年，我们的邮局变化太大了。现在寄信的人少多了，更没人来邮局打长途电话了，但寄的包裹越来越多。现在我们邮局除了办理一般的包裹业务以外，还办理国内和国外的特快专递。现在邮局的业务都离不开电脑和网络。过去要知道一个包裹在什么地方，需要花一个星期，打很多电话才能找到。现在客人自己上网随时就能查到。以前我们骑自行车送邮件，现在呢，都是用汽车，有些地方甚至用上了无人飞机。
examples.translation: wǒ xìng lín nǐ jiù jiào wǒ lǎo lín ba wǒ shí qī suì qǐ jiù zài yóu jú gōng zuò měi tiān qí zhe zì xíng chē chū qù sòng xìn sòng bāo guǒ nà shí de yóu jú zhǐ jì xìn jì bāo guǒ dǎ cháng tú diàn huà jīn nián wǒ wǔ shí qī suì le guò qù de zhè sān shí nián wǒ men de yóu jú biàn huà tài dà le xiàn zài jì xìn de rén shǎo duō le gèng méi rén lái yóu jú dǎ cháng tú diàn huà le dàn jì de bāo guǒ yuè lái yuè duō xiàn zài wǒ men yóu jú chú le bàn lǐ yì bān de bāo guǒ yè wù yǐ wài hái bàn lǐ guó nèi hé guó wài de tè kuài zhuān dì xiàn zài yóu jú de yè wù dōu lí bù kāi diàn nǎo hé wǎng luò guò qù yào zhī dào yí gè bāo guǒ zài shén me dì fāng xū yào huā yí gè xīng qī dǎ hěn duō diàn huà cái néng zhǎo dào xiàn zài kè rén zì jǐ shàng wǎng suí shí jiù néng chá dào yǐ qián wǒ men qí zì xíng chē sòng yóu jiàn xiàn zài ne dōu shì yòng qì chē yǒu xiē dì fāng shèn zhì yòng shàng le wú rén fēi jī — Script Passage 2, paragraph 1: My surname is Lin; just call me Lao Lin. I have worked in the post office since I was seventeen, going out every day by bicycle to deliver letters and packages. The post office then only sent letters and packages and made long-distance calls. This year I am fifty-seven, and in the past thirty years our post office has changed enormously. Now far fewer people send letters, and even fewer come to the post office to make long-distance calls, but more and more packages are sent. Now besides handling ordinary package business our post office also handles domestic and international express mail. Now the post office’s business cannot do without computers and the internet. In the past, to know where a package was, you needed to spend a week and make many phone calls before finding it. Now customers can check it online themselves at any time. Before, we delivered mail by bicycle; now it is all by car, and in some places we even use drones. (the book writes 17; translation mine)

examples.text: 邮局现在不仅寄送信件和包裹，还代收各种费用，并且办理银行业务。我儿子今年二十五岁，也在邮局工作。不过，他不办理信件或包裹业务，而是在邮局大厅为顾客提供银行服务。
examples.translation: yóu jú xiàn zài bù jǐn jì sòng xìn jiàn hé bāo guǒ hái dài shōu gè zhǒng fèi yòng bìng qiě bàn lǐ yín háng yè wù wǒ ér zi jīn nián èr shí wǔ suì yě zài yóu jú gōng zuò bú guò tā bú bàn lǐ xìn jiàn huò bāo guǒ yè wù ér shì zài yóu jú dà tīng wèi gù kè tí gōng yín háng fú wù — Paragraph 2: Now the post office not only sends letters and packages but also collects all kinds of fees on behalf of others and handles banking business. My son is twenty-five this year and also works in the post office. However, he does not handle letters or packages; instead he provides banking services for customers in the post office hall. (mine)

explanations.title: Script Passage 3: Xiao Yang’s postcard kiosk
explanations.body: Numbers are spelled out. The translation is mine.

examples.text: 二十一岁的小杨住在山东省济南市，那是一个风景不错的城市。到济南旅游的游客不仅多，而且喜欢买一些当地的纪念品。今年四月，小杨在一条游客特别多的大街上，租下了一个售货亭。她的售货亭不卖日用品，也不卖书和报纸杂志，只卖明信片。她卖的明信片上都有一张济南的风景照片。为了方便游客，她在售货亭旁边放了一个邮筒。客人买了明信片以后，先填上收件人名字和地址，再贴上邮票，然后把它放进邮筒。到了下午四点，小杨就会把游客放在邮筒里的明信片取出来，然后亲自到邮局把它们寄走。几天以后，收件人就能收到一张来自济南的漂亮的明信片。小杨的售货亭已经开了三个多月了，每天都有很多人来买明信片。小杨说，这个售货亭能给游客带来不同的体验，这是最让她高兴的事。
examples.translation: èr shí yī suì de xiǎo yáng zhù zài shān dōng shěng jǐ nán shì nà shì yí gè fēng jǐng bú cuò de chéng shì dào jǐ nán lǚ yóu de yóu kè bù jǐn duō ér qiě xǐ huān mǎi yì xiē dāng dì de jì niàn pǐn jīn nián sì yuè xiǎo yáng zài yì tiáo yóu kè tè bié duō de dà jiē shàng zū xià le yí gè shòu huò tíng tā de shòu huò tíng bú mài rì yòng pǐn yě bú mài shū hé bào zhǐ zá zhì zhǐ mài míng xìn piàn tā mài de míng xìn piàn shàng dōu yǒu yì zhāng jǐ nán de fēng jǐng zhào piān wèi le fāng biàn yóu kè tā zài shòu huò tíng páng biān fàng le yí gè yóu tǒng kè rén mǎi le míng xìn piàn yǐ hòu xiān tián shàng shōu jiàn rén míng zì hé dì zhǐ zài tiē shàng yóu piào rán hòu bǎ tā fàng jìn yóu tǒng dào le xià wǔ sì diǎn xiǎo yáng jiù huì bǎ yóu kè fàng zài yóu tǒng lǐ de míng xìn piàn qǔ chū lái rán hòu qīn zì dào yóu jú bǎ tā men jì zǒu jǐ tiān yǐ hòu shōu jiàn rén jiù néng shōu dào yì zhāng lái zì jǐ nán de piào liàng de míng xìn piàn xiǎo yáng de shòu huò tíng yǐ jīng kāi le sān gè duō yuè le měi tiān dōu yǒu hěn duō rén lái mǎi míng xìn piàn xiǎo yáng shuō zhè ge shòu huò tíng néng gěi yóu kè dài lái bù tóng de tǐ yàn zhè shì zuì ràng tā gāo xìng de shì — Script Passage 3: Xiao Yang, twenty-one, lives in Jinan, Shandong Province, a city with fine scenery. The tourists who travel to Jinan are not only many but also like to buy local souvenirs. This April Xiao Yang rented a kiosk on a street with an especially large number of tourists. Her kiosk does not sell daily necessities, nor books, newspapers and magazines; it sells only postcards. Every postcard she sells has a photo of Jinan scenery. To make things convenient for tourists she put a mailbox beside the kiosk. After customers buy a postcard they first fill in the addressee’s name and address, then put on a stamp, and then drop it into the mailbox. At four in the afternoon Xiao Yang takes the postcards out of the mailbox and then goes to the post office herself to send them off. A few days later the addressee will receive a beautiful postcard from Jinan. Xiao Yang’s kiosk has been open for more than three months and many people come to buy postcards every day. Xiao Yang says this kiosk can give tourists a different experience, and that is the thing that makes her happiest. (mine)
